tourDays.title: Depart for the Holy Land
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport and board an overnight flight to the Holy Land. Meals served on board.
tourDays.activities: Board overnight international flight; In-flight meals

tourDays.title: Arrive in Tel Aviv
tourDays.description: Arrive at Ben Gurion Airport in Tel Aviv, meet your guide/driver, transfer to hotel in Tel Aviv, check in and enjoy dinner at the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Arrival at Ben Gurion Airport; Meet guide/driver; Transfer to hotel and check-in; Dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Tel Aviv - Caesarea - Nazareth - Cana - Tiberias
tourDays.description: Travel from Tel Aviv to Caesarea Maritima to view Roman ruins, continue to Nazareth (museum, archaeological garden, St. Joseph's workshop/Church of St. Joseph) and the Church of the Annunciation grotto, then to Cana for Mass at the Wedding Church (renewal of vows available), and on to the hotel by the Sea of Galilee.
tourDays.activities: Visit Caesarea Maritima (Roman theatre, Herod's Palace, hippodrome, harbor); Visit Nazareth museum and archaeological garden; Visit St. Joseph's Church (workshop) and Church of the Annunciation grotto; Celebrate Mass at the Wedding Church in Cana; Renewal of wedding vows ceremony (optional for married couples); Transfer to hotel by the Sea of Galilee

tourDays.title: Tiberias: Sea of Galilee
tourDays.description: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee and visits to Capernaum (synagogue), the Mount of Beatitudes, Tabgha, St. Peter's Primacy, and Magdala (Mary Magdalene's birthplace). Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee; Visit Capernaum and its synagogue; Visit Mount of Beatitudes; Visit Tabgha (site of the multiplication of the loaves and fishes); Visit St. Peter's Primacy; Visit Magdala

tourDays.title: Mt. Tabor - Jericho - Jerusalem
tourDays.description: Drive to Mount Tabor for reflection and Mass at the Basilica of the Transfiguration, continue south to the Jordan Valley and Jericho to view the Mount of Temptation, then drive up to Jerusalem and check in to hotel.
tourDays.activities: Visit Mount Tabor; Celebrate Mass at the Basilica of the Transfiguration; Visit Jericho and view the Mount of Temptation; Transfer to Jerusalem and hotel check-in

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Bethlehem & Ein Karem
tourDays.description: Visit Ein Karem (Church of St. John the Baptist and Church of the Visitation), then drive to Bethlehem to visit the shepherds' fields, Manger Square, the Church of the Nativity and the Grotto of the Nativity. Celebrate Mass in Bethlehem and return to Jerusalem.
tourDays.activities: Visit Church of St. John the Baptist (Ein Karem); Visit Church of the Visitation (Ein Karem); Visit the shepherds' fields; Visit Manger Square and Church of the Nativity; Enter the Grotto of the Nativity; Celebrate Mass in Bethlehem

tourDays.title: Jordan River - Qumran - Dead Sea
tourDays.description: Drive through the Judean wilderness, spend time at the Jordan River reflecting on the Baptism of Christ, visit the Qumran site where the Dead Sea Scrolls were found, and have time to swim or float in the Dead Sea before returning to Jerusalem.
tourDays.activities: Drive through Judean wilderness; Reflection time at the Jordan River; Visit Qumran (Dead Sea Scrolls site); Swim or float in the Dead Sea

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Mt. of Olives - Gethsemane - Mt. Zion (Upper Room)
tourDays.description: Visit the Mount of Olives for panoramic views, Pater Noster Shrine, Dominus Flevit, Gethsemane and the Church of All Nations (Rock of Agony). Visit the Western Wall, Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu, the Upper Room on Mount Zion and the Benedictine Church of the Dormition. Return to the hotel for dinner.
tourDays.activities: Visit Mount of Olives (panoramic view); Visit Pater Noster Shrine; Visit Dominus Flevit; Visit Gethsemane and Church of All Nations; Visit Western Wall; Visit Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu; Visit the Upper Room (Mt. Zion); Visit Benedictine Church of the Dormition

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Via Dolorosa - Holy Sepulchre - Western Wall
tourDays.description: Very early procession along the Via Dolorosa starting at the Antonia Fortress and ending at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre. Celebrate Mass at the Holy Sepulchre, then visit the Church of St. Anne and the Pool of Bethesda and end with a visit to the Western Wall.
tourDays.activities: Prayerful procession along the Via Dolorosa; Visit Antonia Fortress; Celebrate Mass at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Visit Church of St. Anne; Visit Pool of Bethesda; Visit Western Wall

tourDays.title: Jerusalem - Lisbon
tourDays.description: Depart Jerusalem for Tel Aviv Airport and fly to Lisbon. On arrival in Lisbon meet your guide/driver and transfer to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Tel Aviv Airport; Flight from Tel Aviv to Lisbon; Meet local guide/driver in Lisbon; Transfer to hotel and check-in; Dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Lisbon - Santarem - Fatima
tourDays.description: Travel from Lisbon to Fatima with a stop in Santarem for Mass at St. Stephen's Church and veneration of the 13th-century Eucharistic Miracle; continue to Fatima for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive from Lisbon to Santarem; Mass at St. Stephen's Church (Santarem); Venerate the Eucharistic Miracle in Santarem; Continue to Fatima and check in

tourDays.title: Fatima
tourDays.description: Full day in Fatima visiting the Little Chapel of the Apparitions, the Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary (tombs of the visionaries), the Museum 'Fatima: Light and Peace', the Holy Trinity Basilica, walk the Via Sacra (Stations of the Cross), visit Valinhos, and conclude with private devotions and a candlelight procession.
tourDays.activities: Visit Little Chapel of the Apparitions; Visit Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary (tombs of St. Francisco, St. Jacinta, Sister Lucia); Visit Fatima Museum (Fatima: Light and Peace); Visit Holy Trinity Basilica; Walk the Via Sacra (Stations of the Cross); Visit Valinhos (apparition site); Private devotions and candlelight procession

tourDays.title: Fatima - Salamanca
tourDays.description: Depart Fatima for Salamanca. Walking tour of Salamanca visiting Plaza Mayor, La Clerecia, Casa de las Conchas, University of Salamanca, the Roman Bridge, Iglesia de San Marcos, Iglesia de San Martin, and the old and new cathedrals. Overnight in Salamanca.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Salamanca; Walking tour of Salamanca (Plaza Mayor, La Clerecia, Casa de las Conchas, University, Roman Bridge); Visit Iglesia de San Marcos and Iglesia de San Martin; Visit the two Salamanca Cathedrals

tourDays.title: Salamanca - Alba de Tormes - Avila - Burgos
tourDays.description: Visit Alba de Tormes to celebrate Mass at the Carmelite Monastery associated with St. Teresa, see the museum with her relics; continue to Avila to view the medieval walls, Cathedral de Avila, Basilica de San Vicente and the Incarnation Convent; proceed to Burgos for dinner and overnight, with time to see Burgos Cathedral.
tourDays.activities: Visit Carmelite Monastery in Alba de Tormes and celebrate Mass; Visit museum dedicated to St. Teresa (relics); Visit Avila (city walls, Cathedral de Avila, Basilica de San Vicente, Incarnation Convent); Transfer to Burgos and free time to explore Burgos Cathedral

tourDays.title: Burgos - Loyola - Lourdes
tourDays.description: Transfer from Burgos to Loyola to visit the birthplace and Basilica of St. Ignatius and pray at the venerated room; after free time for lunch, continue to Lourdes with scenic views of the Pyrenees and check in to the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Visit Loyola (birthplace of St. Ignatius) and Basilica; Pray in the venerated room associated with St. Ignatius; Free time for lunch; Transfer to Lourdes and hotel check-in

tourDays.title: Lourdes
tourDays.description: Begin Lourdes pilgrimage activities: attend Mass at the Grotto, view a video presentation about Lourdes, participate in the spring/bathing ritual (wash and drink the water), pray the life-size Stations of the Cross, visit Boly Mill and the Cachot, and attend the evening candlelight procession and Rosary.
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass at the Grotto of Massabielle; Watch video presentation about Lourdes; Participate in the miraculous spring ritual (wash hands/face, drink water); Pray the Stations of the Cross (life-size); Visit Boly Mill (birthplace of St. Bernadette); Visit the Cachot (family's former home/prison site); Attend evening candlelight procession and Rosary

tourDays.title: Lourdes
tourDays.description: A second day in Lourdes for additional devotions and visits: daily Mass, opportunities for the blessing of the sick, further time at the Grotto and baths, and evening Marian devotions including the candlelight procession.
tourDays.activities: Daily Mass (including Mass at the Grotto if scheduled); Blessing of the sick (opportunity to attend); Use of the baths and spring as desired; Additional visits to sanctuary sites (Grotto, Basilica); Evening candlelight procession and Rosary

tourDays.title: Lourdes - Paris - Lisieux (St. Therese - the Little Flower)
tourDays.description: Fly from Pau or Lourdes to Paris, continue by coach to Lisieux to visit the Basilica of St. Therese, Les Buissonnets (family home), and the Carmelite Convent where St. Therese is buried. Dinner and overnight in Lisieux.

tourDays.description: Celebrate Mass in Lisieux, then travel to the Normandy landing beaches and visit the Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial in Colleville-sur-Mer. Return to Lisieux for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass in Lisieux; Visit Normandy landing beaches (D-Day sites); Visit Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial (Colleville-sur-Mer); Return to Lisieux

tourDays.title: Lisieux â Chartres â Paris

tourDays.title: Paris

tourDays.activities: Guided excursion; Visit oratory and statue; Harbor boat tour; Visit St. John's Co-Cathedral and Museum

Visit the Mellieha Sanctuary of Our Lady, Munxar Parish Church, Gozo Cathedral of the Assumption, St. Georgeâs Basilica, the side chapel housing relics of St. Clement, and the Basilica of the National Shrine of the Blessed Virgin of TaâPinu. tourDays.description: Attend the Papal Audience in St. Peterâs Square or the Audience Hall (when scheduled). Afternoon in the Piazza Navona area for free time and lunch (on your own). Visit the Archbasilica of St. John the Lateran, the Holy Stairs, and the Basilica of St. Mary Major where Holy Mass will be celebrated. Dinner and overnight.

tourDays.description: Board the bus to the Abbey of Monte Cassino, then continue to San Giovanni Rotondo, where St. Pio lived. Dinner and overnight in San Giovanni Rotondo.
tourDays.activities: Bus transfer; Visit Abbey of Monte Cassino; Travel to San Giovanni Rotondo

tourDays.title: Assisi: Basilica of St. Francis & Porziuncola
tourDays.description: Tour the Basilica of St. Francis (tomb of St. Francis and frescoes). Visit the Santuario Della Spogliazione (tomb of Blessed Carlo Acutis). Walking tour through Assisi with free time for prayer, shopping and lunch. After lunch visit the Basilica of St. Mary of the Angels, including the Porziuncola and the Capella del Transito (place where St. Francis died). Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.description: Drive to Siena. Visit the Basilica of St. Catherine (St. Domenico), the Shrine of St. Catherine, the Duomo di Siena and enjoy a walking tour and free time in Piazza del Campo. Continue on to Florence; free time to explore in the afternoon. Dinner and overnight in Florence.
tourDays.activities: Visit Basilica of St. Catherine and Shrine; Walking tour of Siena and Duomo visit; Free time in Piazza del Campo; Transfer to Florence; Explore Florence on your own

tourDays.title: Florence Guided Tour
tourDays.description: Guided tour beginning at Santa Croce, then walk by Piazza Signorina, Palazzo Vecchio, Uffizi, Ponte Vecchio, Republic Square to Santa Maria del Fiore. Visit L'Accademia to view artworks including Michelangelo's David. Afternoon free to explore Florence. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Guided city tour; Visit Santa Croce and major Florence sites; Visit L'Accademia (view David); Free time in afternoon

tourDays.title: Transfer to Padua
tourDays.description: Board the motorcoach for transfer to Padua. Sightseeing tour including the University of Padua, the Basilica of Santa Giustina, and the Basilica of St. Anthony where you may visit his tomb. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Motorcoach transfer to Padua; Sightseeing tour; Visit Basilica of St. Anthony and tomb

tourDays.title: Venice Full-Day Excursion
tourDays.description: Early breakfast and bus to Venice. After Mass enjoy a walking tour including St. Markâs Square, the Golden Basilica of San Marco, the Bridge of Sighs, and the Dogesâ Palace. Return to Padua for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Bus transfer to Venice; Attend Mass in Venice; Walking tour of Venice including St. Mark's Square and Doges' Palace

tourDays.title: Return Home
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast transfer to Venice airport for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Venice airport; Board return flights home

tourDays.title: Depart from Home
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport, where you will board your overnight flight(s).
tourDays.activities: Make your way to your local airport; Board overnight flight(s)

tourDays.title: Arrive in Malta
tourDays.description: Upon arrival, collect your luggage and proceed to the arrival hall, where you will be met by a tour guide and/or driver and transferred to your hotel. Your guide will share the Maltese Islandsâ rich history of St. Paul and Christianity. You will attend Mass at a local church before dinner at your hotel.
tourDays.activities: Collect luggage; Meet tour guide and/or driver; Transfer to hotel; Attend Mass at a local church; Dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: The Three Cities and Valletta
tourDays.description: After breakfast at your hotel, depart for a full-day guided excursion to the Three Cities of Vittoriosa, Cospicua, and Senglea. In 1530, the Knights of St. John settled here on the east coast in the creeks of Grand Harbor. Next, see the Miraculous Statue of Jesus Christ the Redeemer in the Oratory of the Basilica, dedicated to the birth of the Virgin Mary in Senglea. Later, take a typical harbor boat tour from Vittoriosa across the Grand Harbor to Valletta and see its waterfront. You will also see St. Johnâs Co-Cathedral and Museum in Valletta. Visit the Oratory, which houses the famous Caravaggio paintings. Enjoy dinner and a restful overnight.
tourDays.activities: Depart for full-day guided excursion to the Three Cities; See the Miraculous Statue of Jesus Christ the Redeemer in the Oratory (Senglea); Take a harbor boat tour from Vittoriosa to Valletta; Visit St. Johnâs Co-Cathedral and Museum; Visit the Oratory housing Caravaggio paintings; Dinner

tourDays.title: Mellieha and Gozo
tourDays.description: After breakfast at your hotel, depart for a full dayâs guided excursion to Gozo, a sister island of Malta. Here youâll visit the Mellieha Sanctuary of Our Lady, a Marian Shrine. Pope John Paul II blessed the Sanctuary during his visit to Malta in 1990. From the Sanctuary, you will be able to enjoy a picturesque view of the Valley of Our Lady, Mellieha Bay, Comino, and Gozo. Later, see Munxar Parish Church, which is a Baroque-style building dedicated to St. Paul, the Gozo Cathedral of the Assumption, and St. Georgeâs Basilica, known as the golden church of the âMarble Basilicaâ of Gozo. The relics of St. Clement rest in the Baroque altar in the side chapel of St. Lazarus, which is one of eleven side chapels within the Basilica. Next, visit the Basilica of the National Shrine of the Blessed Virgin of TaâPinu, Maltaâs most important pilgrimage site. The narrow rooms on either side of the altar are full of testaments to the local peoplesâ belief in the intercession of Our Lady. Return by ferry to Malta, and enjoy dinner and an overnight at your hotel.
tourDays.activities: Visit Mellieha Sanctuary of Our Lady; Enjoy views of the Valley of Our Lady, Mellieha Bay, Comino, and Gozo; Visit Munxar Parish Church; Visit Gozo Cathedral of the Assumption; Visit St. Georgeâs Basilica; See relics of St. Clement in St. Lazarus side chapel; Visit Basilica of the National Shrine of the Blessed Virgin of TaâPinu; Return by ferry to Malta; Dinner

tourDays.title: St. Paulâs Bay, Mdina and Rabat
tourDays.description: After breakfast at your hotel, another full day of touring awaits. See St. Paulâs Bay by boat, the Church of the Assumption of Our Lady, St. Paulâs Cathedral, the Museum in Mdina, the medieval walled city, the Bastions, St. Paulâs Catacombs, and St. Paulâs Grotto. St. Paulâs Grotto is said to be the place where St. Paul took refuge and prayed for three months while trying to convert the Maltese people to Christianity following his shipwreck around 60 AD. Pope John Paul II prayed in the grotto during his visit in 1990. Return to Malta for dinner and your last overnight.
tourDays.activities: See St. Paulâs Bay by boat; Visit the Church of the Assumption of Our Lady; Visit St. Paulâs Cathedral; Visit the Museum in Mdina; See the medieval walled city and Bastions; Visit St. Paulâs Catacombs; Visit St. Paulâs Grotto; Dinner

tourDays.title: Return Home

Krizevac (Cross Mountain), evening gatherings for the reported apparitions, adoration, visiting the Community of Cenacolo, and prayer at various shrine sites.

tourDays.activities: Flight from Pau/Lourdes to Paris; Transfer to Lisieux; Visit Basilica of St. Therese; View relics and objects at Les Buissonnets; Tour the Carmelite Convent

tourDays.title: Normandy D-Day beaches and American Cemetery
tourDays.description: Celebrate Mass in Lisieux, then travel to the Normandy landing beaches and visit the Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial in Colleville-sur-Mer. Return to Lisieux for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass in Lisieux; Visit Normandy D-Day landing beaches; Visit Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial (Colleville-sur-Mer); Pray at cemetery

tourDays.title: Visit Chartres Cathedral and transfer to Paris
tourDays.description: Early breakfast and depart for Chartres to visit the Cathedral Notre Dame and venerate the Veil of Our Lady relic on display; free time for lunch in Chartres, then continue to Paris to check in, dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Chartres Cathedral; Venerate relic of the Veil of Our Lady; Free time for lunch in Chartres; Transfer to Paris

tourDays.title: Mass and full day sightseeing in Paris
tourDays.description: Celebrate Mass then full day sightseeing including Sacre Coeur Basilica (Montmartre), Chapel of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal (view incorrupt body of St. Catherine Laboure), Saint Vincent de Paul Church, Notre Dame Cathedral, and a bus tour of landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower, Invalides, Arc de Triomphe, and Champs-Elysees. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass; Visit Sacre Coeur Basilica; Visit Chapel of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal; View incorrupt body of St. Catherine Laboure; Visit Saint Vincent de Paul Church; Visit Notre Dame Cathedral; Bus tour of Paris landmarks (Eiffel Tower, Invalides, Arc de Triomphe, Champs-Elysees)

tourDays.title: Flight(s) to Medjugorje and coach transfer
tourDays.description: Early departure from Paris for flights to Medjugorje. Upon arrival, a private coach transfer of approximately 2.5 hours brings the group to the village of Medjugorje. Meet fellow pilgrims, spiritual leader, and host family; check into host family inn accommodations.
tourDays.activities: Flights from Paris to Medjugorje; 2.5 hour private coach transfer to Medjugorje; Meet spiritual leader and host family; Check-in to host family inn

tourDays.title: Begin stay in Medjugorje â Mass, climbs, devotions
tourDays.description: Opportunities include daily Mass at St. James Church (English-speaking), climbing Apparition Hill and Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain), evening Rosary and local apparition celebrations, Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament, visit to the Community of Cenacolo, and prayer at the Statue of the Risen Christ.
tourDays.activities: Attend Daily Mass at St. James Church; Climb Apparition Hill and pray the Rosary at designated stops; Climb Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain) and pray Stations of the Cross; Join evening Rosary and apparition celebration; Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament (opportunity); Visit the Community of Cenacolo; Pray at the Statue of the Risen Christ

tourDays.title: Continued devotion in Medjugorje
tourDays.description: Continue opportunities for Mass, climbs to Apparition Hill and Cross Mountain, Adoration, evening Rosary and local Mass, visit Community of Cenacolo, and private prayer time.
tourDays.activities: Attend Daily Mass at St. James Church; Climb Apparition Hill; Climb Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain) and pray Stations of the Cross; Participate in evening Rosary and local Mass/Blessing of the Sick; Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament; Visit the Community of Cenacolo; Private prayer at statue and holy sites

tourDays.title: Final full day in Medjugorje
tourDays.description: Final full day with continued opportunities for Mass, climbing Apparition Hill and Mt. Krizevac, Adoration, visit to Cenacolo, prayer at the Risen Christ statue, and participation in evening Rosary, Mass and Blessing of the Sick.
tourDays.activities: Attend Daily Mass at St. James Church; Climb Apparition Hill and Mt. Krizevac; Participate in Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament; Visit Community of Cenacolo; Prayer at Statue of the Risen Christ; Join evening Rosary and local Mass/Blessing of the Sick

tourDays.title: Return transfer to airport and flights home
tourDays.description: Early breakfast, farewells, and motor coach transfer to Dubrovnik Airport (or Split or Sarajevo) for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast and farewells; Motor coach transfer to Dubrovnik Airport (or Split or Sarajevo); Flights home to USA

tourDays.title: Depart for Paris
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport, where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Travel to local airport; Board overnight flight(s); Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Arrive Paris - Lisieux
tourDays.description: Upon arriving at Paris Airport, make your way to the baggage claim area and collect your luggage. Proceed to the Arrivals Hall where you will be greeted by your driver, who will transfer you to meet your Spiritual Director, Tour Escort, and fellow pilgrims. Attend Mass at the Sacre Coeur Basilica. Time permitting, you may have the opportunity during your free time to ascend a staircase to the Dome for a panoramic view of Paris. Depart for Lisieux and visit the Basilica of St. Therese. Dinner and overnight in Lisieux.
tourDays.activities: Arrival and baggage claim; Transfer to meet Spiritual Director and group; Attend Mass at Sacre Coeur Basilica; Optional ascent to Sacre Coeur Dome (time permitting); Visit Basilica of St. Therese; Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Lisieux (St. Therese - the Little Flower)- Landing Beaches & American Cemetery
tourDays.description: After breakfast the group will celebrate Mass, then travel to the Normandy landing beaches. Visit the Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial in Colleville-Sur-Mer. Return to Lisieux for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass in Lisieux; Travel to Normandy landing beaches; Visit Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial; Return to Lisieux

tourDays.title: Lisieux - Chartres - Paris
tourDays.description: Early breakfast and depart for Chartres. Visit Chartres Cathedral (Notre Dame) and venerate a relic of the Veil of Our Lady. Free time for lunch in Chartres, then continue to Paris for hotel check-in, dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Depart for Chartres; Visit Chartres Cathedral (Notre Dame); Venerate relic of the Veil of Our Lady; Free time for lunch; Transfer to Paris and hotel check-in

tourDays.title: Paris
tourDays.description: Full sightseeing tour of Paris. Visit and celebrate Mass at the Shrine of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal and view the incorrupt body of St. Catherine Laboure. Walk to Saint Vincent de Paul Church. Visit Notre Dame Cathedral. Panoramic motor coach tour including the Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe and pass by the Louvre. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass at the Shrine of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal; View incorrupt body of St. Catherine Laboure; Walk to Saint Vincent de Paul Church; Visit Notre Dame Cathedral; Panoramic sightseeing by motor coach (Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, pass by Louvre)

tourDays.title: Paris - Amsterdam
tourDays.description: Transfer to the airport for a short flight to Amsterdam. Upon arrival transfer to the hotel. Visit the Chapel of Our Lady of All Nations and celebrate Mass. Visit the historic site of a Eucharistic Miracle. Dinner and overnight in Amsterdam.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to airport; Short flight Paris to Amsterdam; Transfer to hotel; Visit Chapel of Our Lady of All Nations; Celebrate Mass; Visit site of a Eucharistic Miracle

tourDays.title: Amsterdam â Zaanse Schans â Amsterdam
tourDays.description: Celebrate Mass, then enjoy a guided walking tour of Amsterdam viewing the Royal Place, National Monument (Vrijheidsbeeld), Flower Markets, Opera House, City Hall and Begijnenhof. View (from outside) cultural highlights such as the Van Gogh Museum, Anne Frank House, Rembrandt House and Rijksmuseum. After lunch free time, proceed to Zaanse Schans to visit the bakery museum, clog makers, cheese factory, windmills and other historical sites. Return to Amsterdam for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass; Guided walking tour of Amsterdam; View cultural sites from outside (Van Gogh Museum, Anne Frank House, Rembrandt House, Rijksmuseum); Free time for lunch; Visit Zaanse Schans (bakery museum, clog makers, cheese factory, windmills); Return to Amsterdam

tourDays.title: Amsterdam â Utrecht â Ghent - Bruges
tourDays.description: Depart for Utrecht and visit Katherineâs Convent Museum (Catharijne Convent). Free time for lunch, then transfer to Ghent to see the Adoration of the Mystic Lamb at St. Bavo Cathedral and celebrate Mass. Continue to Bruges for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Katherineâs Convent Museum (Catharijne Convent) in Utrecht; Free time for lunch; Transfer to Ghent; Visit St. Bavo Cathedral and view Adoration of the Mystic Lamb; Celebrate Mass; Transfer to Bruges

tourDays.title: Bruges
tourDays.description: Visit the Church of Our Lady for the celebration of Mass and view Michelangelo's marble statue Madonna and Child. Visit the Holy Saviorâs Cathedral and the Basilica of the Holy Blood (which holds a venerated relic). Afternoon free time for lunch and strolling. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass at the Church of Our Lady; View Michelangelo's Madonna and Child; Visit Holy Saviorâs Cathedral; Visit Basilica of the Holy Blood; Free time for lunch and strolling

tourDays.title: Bruges â Dinant - Beauraing - Banneux - Aachen
tourDays.description: Board the motor coach and travel with a stop in Dinant for lunch. Visit the Shrine of Our Lady of Beauraing, then continue to Banneux to visit the Shrine of Our Lady of Banneux. Continue to Aachen for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Board motor coach; Stop in Dinant for lunch; Visit Shrine of Our Lady of Beauraing; Visit Shrine of Our Lady of Banneux; Transfer to Aachen

tourDays.title: Aachen - Cologne - Aachen
tourDays.description: Short sightseeing tour of Aachen. Attend Mass at Aachen Cathedral and have the opportunity to venerate a 14th century statue of the Blessed Virgin. Depart for Cologne for sightseeing and visit the Kolner Dom (Cologne Cathedral) which houses the relics of the Three Magi. Return to Aachen for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Sightseeing in Aachen; Celebrate Mass at Aachen Cathedral; Venerate 14th century statue of the Blessed Virgin; Sightseeing in Cologne; Visit Kolner Dom (Cologne Cathedral)

tourDays.title: Aachen - Trier - Heidelberg
tourDays.description: Drive to Trier. Visit the Porta Nigra, Roman amphitheater and baths, and the Constantine Basilica (Aula Palatina). Celebrate Mass at Trier Cathedral, with free time for lunch. Visit the Liebfrauenkirche. Proceed to Heidelberg for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Trier; Visit Porta Nigra; Visit Roman amphitheater and baths; Visit Constantine Basilica (Aula Palatina); Celebrate Mass at Trier Cathedral; Free time for lunch; Visit Liebfrauenkirche; Transfer to Heidelberg

tourDays.title: Heidelberg â Rothenburg ob der Tauber - Heidelberg
tourDays.description: Tour Heidelberg's Old Town including the ruins of Heidelberg Castle, the marketplace, the Church of the Holy Spirit and the Old Bridge. Celebrate Mass at a local church. Free time for lunch, then proceed to Rothenburg ob der Tauber to see picturesque lanes, half-timbered houses and the fortification wall; walk on top of the wall. Return to Heidelberg for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Tour Heidelberg Old Town and Heidelberg Castle ruins; Visit marketplace and Church of the Holy Spirit; Walk on Old Bridge; Celebrate Mass; Free time for lunch; Visit Rothenburg ob der Tauber and walk on city wall; Return to Heidelberg

tourDays.title: Heidelberg â Neuhausen am Rheinfall ( Rhine Falls) â Muri Monastery - Lucerne
tourDays.description: Depart for Neuhausen am Rheinfall for a boat trip to see the Rhine Falls. After lunch transfer to the Benedictine monastery of Muri to see the Romanesque crypt, Gothic raised choir and central octagon in Baroque style. Celebrate Mass at Muri Monastery and continue to Lucerne for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Boat trip at Rhine Falls (Neuhausen am Rheinfall); Free time for lunch; Visit Muri Monastery (Romanesque crypt, Gothic choir, central octagon); Celebrate Mass at Muri Monastery; Transfer to Lucerne

tourDays.title: Lucerne â EinSiedlen - Lucerne
tourDays.description: Guided tour of Lucerne, view the Chapel Bridge from the outside. Enjoy a scenic ride along Lake Lucerne and Lake Zug to Einsiedeln. Celebrate Mass at Einsiedeln Abbey and visit the Benedictine Monastery of Einsiedeln. Return to Lucerne for a farewell dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Guided tour of Lucerne; View Chapel Bridge (outside); Scenic ride along Lake Lucerne and Lake Zug; Celebrate Mass at Einsiedeln Abbey; Visit Benedictine Monastery of Einsiedeln; Farewell dinner

tourDays.title: Lucerne â Zurich - Return Home
tourDays.description: Early breakfast, transfer to Zurich airport for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Transfer to Zurich airport; Return flights home

tourDays.title: Depart for Greece
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Make own way to local airport; Board overnight flight(s); In-flight meals

tourDays.title: Arrive Thessaloniki
tourDays.description: Upon landing at Makedonia Thessaloniki Airport, collect your luggage, meet your tour guide/driver, transfer to the hotel, relax after check in and enjoy an evening meal. Overnight in Thessaloniki.
tourDays.activities: Collect luggage; Meet tour guide/driver; Transfer to hotel; Relax after check-in; Evening meal; Overnight in Thessaloniki

tourDays.title: Philippi - Kavala - Thessaloniki
tourDays.description: Visit Philippi (site of St. Paulâs first sermon in Europe and where Lydia was baptized), including the Roman Forum and the prison ruins. Continue to the port city of Kavala (ancient Neapolis). Return to Thessaloniki for evening meal and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Philippi Roman Forum; View prison ruins associated with Paul and Silas; Visit Kavala (ancient Neapolis); Return to Thessaloniki for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Thessaloniki City Tour - Kalambaka
tourDays.description: Morning city tour of Thessaloniki (including the triumphal Arch of Galerius and other ancient artifacts), then transfer to Kalambaka for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Thessaloniki city tour; View Arch of Galerius and ancient artifacts; Transfer to Kalambaka

tourDays.title: Meteora - Delphi
tourDays.description: Drive to the Meteora Monasteries, view Byzantine art and the scenery, then continue to Delphi for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Meteora; Visit Meteora Monasteries; View Byzantine art and scenery; Continue to Delphi

tourDays.title: Delphi - Athens
tourDays.description: Visit the archaeological site and museum at Delphi, then continue to Athens for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Delphi site and museum; Transfer to Athens; Dinner and overnight in Athens

tourDays.title: Athens - Excursion to Corinth
tourDays.description: Tour Athens (Acropolis: Parthenon, Erectheum, Propylae), ascend Mars Hill, view the ancient Agora, drive by Syntagma Square, University of Athens and National Library, visit Panathenaic Stadium, then proceed to ancient Corinth (first-century shops, site of Paulâs trial by Gallio, Fountain of Peirene, Temple of Apollo). Return to Athens for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Acropolis (Parthenon, Erectheum, Propylae); Ascend Mars Hill; Visit ancient Agora; Drive by Syntagma Square and view University and National Library; Visit Panathenaic Stadium; Visit ancient Corinth sites

tourDays.title: Athens - Start 3-day Cruise (Celestyal Cruises Cruise Line) to Mykonos
tourDays.description: Proceed to Piraeus port and board the 3-day Celestyal cruise. First stop: Mykonos â transfer to Hora for a walking tour including Alefkandra, then return to the ship for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Piraeus port; Board Celestyal cruise ship; Visit Mykonos; Transfer to Hora; Walking tour of Hora and Alefkandra; Return to cruise ship for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Kusadasi - Ephesus (Mary's House) - Patmos
tourDays.description: Arrive Kusadasi; transfer to Mt. Koressos to visit the small stone chapel (House of the Virgin Mary). Walk through the Magnesian Gate into ancient Ephesus for a guided walking tour (Odeon, Fountain of Trajan, Baths of Scolastika, Temple of Hadrian, Library of Celsus, Great Theatre, Arcadian Way). On return view the Basilica of Saint John. Embark and continue to Patmos; visit Chora, Monastery of Saint John the Theologian, its museum, and the Monastery and Grotto of the Apocalypse; free time in the port of Scala.
tourDays.activities: Arrive at Kusadasi; Visit Mt. Koressos stone chapel (House of the Virgin Mary); Walk through Magnesian Gate into Ephesus; Guided walking tour of Ephesus sites (Odeon, Fountain of Trajan, Baths of Scolastika, Temple of Hadrian, Library of Celsus, Great Theatre); View Basilica of Saint John; Visit Patmos: Chora and Monastery of Saint John the Theologian; Visit Monastery and Grotto of the Apocalypse; Free time at Scala port

tourDays.title: Heraklion - Santorini
tourDays.description: Transfer to Heraklion on Crete to visit the Palace of Knossos (partially reconstructed Minoan site). Embark ship to Santorini and visit Thira (white-washed houses, narrow streets). Return to the ship for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Heraklion; Visit Palace of Knossos; Embark and sail to Santorini; Visit Thira on Santorini; Return to ship for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Piraeus - Athens - Tel Aviv
tourDays.description: Disembark the cruise, transfer to Athens airport, fly to Tel Aviv. Upon arrival meet the 206 Tours representative and transfer to your hotel in the Tel Aviv area; dinner at the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Disembark cruise; Transfer to Athens airport; Flight from Athens to Tel Aviv; Meet 206 Tours representative; Transfer to hotel in Tel Aviv area; Dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Tel Aviv - Caesarea - Nazareth - Cana - Tiberias
tourDays.description: Depart Tel Aviv for Caesarea Maritima (Roman theatre, Herodâs Palace, Hippodrome, harbor). Continue to Nazareth to visit the museum and archaeological garden, St. Josephâs workshop and the Church of the Annunciation grotto (house of the Blessed Mother). Drive to Cana to celebrate Mass at the Wedding Church and for married couples the option to renew wedding vows. Continue to hotel by the Sea of Galilee for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Caesarea Maritima and see Roman theatre, Herodâs Palace and Hippodrome; Visit Nazareth museum and archaeological garden; Visit St. Josephâs workshop and Church of the Annunciation grotto; Drive to Cana and celebrate Mass at Wedding Church; Opportunity to renew wedding vows (ceremony, not a Mass); Transfer to hotel by the Sea of Galilee

tourDays.title: Tiberias: Sea of Galilee
tourDays.description: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee. Visit Capernaum (synagogue), the Mount of Beatitudes, Tabgha (site of the multiplication of loaves and fishes), St. Peterâs Primacy, and Magdala (Mary Magdaleneâs birthplace). Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee; Visit Capernaum and its synagogue; Visit Mount of Beatitudes; Visit Tabgha; Visit St. Peterâs Primacy; Visit Magdala

tourDays.title: Mt. Tabor - Jericho - Jerusalem
tourDays.description: Drive to Mount Tabor (site of the Transfiguration), celebrate Mass at the Basilica of the Transfiguration. Continue to the Jordan Valley and Jericho (visit Mount of Temptation). Drive up to Jerusalem, check in to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Mount Tabor; Celebrate Mass at Basilica of the Transfiguration; Drive to Jordan Valley and Jericho; View Mount of Temptation; Transfer to Jerusalem and check in to hotel

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Bethlehem & Ein Karem
tourDays.description: Visit Ein Karem (Church of St. John the Baptist and Church of the Visitation). Drive to Bethlehem to visit the fields of the shepherds, enter the Church of the Nativity and the Grotto of the Nativity; attend Mass in Bethlehem. Return to hotel in Jerusalem for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Church of St. John the Baptist in Ein Karem; Visit Church of the Visitation; Drive to Bethlehem and visit fields and caves; Enter Church of the Nativity and Grotto of the Nativity; Attend Mass in Bethlehem; Return to Jerusalem hotel

tourDays.title: Jordan River - Qumran - Dead Sea
tourDays.description: Drive through the Judean wilderness, visit the Jordan River for reflection on the Baptism of Christ. In the afternoon visit Qumran (site of the Dead Sea Scrolls). Time to swim or float in the Dead Sea before returning to Jerusalem.
tourDays.activities: Drive through Judean wilderness; Visit Jordan River for reflection; Visit Qumran archaeological site; Swim/float in the Dead Sea; Return to Jerusalem

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Mt. Of Olives - Gethsemane - Mt. Zion (Upper Room)
tourDays.description: Visit the Mount of Olives for panoramic views, Pater Noster Shrine, Dominus Flevit. Continue to Gethsemane and the Church of All Nations (Rock of Agony). Visit the Western Wall, Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu (House of the High Priest Caiaphas), the Upper Room on Mt. Zion, and the Benedictine Church of the Dormition. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Mount of Olives and panoramic viewpoints; Visit Pater Noster Shrine and Dominus Flevit; Visit Gethsemane and Church of All Nations; Visit Western Wall; Visit Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu; Visit Upper Room (Mt. Zion); Visit Benedictine Church of the Dormition

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Via Dolorosa - Holy Sepulchre- Western Wall
tourDays.description: Very early procession along the Via Dolorosa starting at the Antonia Fortress to the Church of the Holy Sepulchre. Attend Mass at the Holy Sepulchre. Later revisit the Old City: Church of St. Anne, Pool of Bethesda, and end the day at the Western Wall.
tourDays.activities: Early prayerful procession along Via Dolorosa; Start at Antonia Fortress and proceed to Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Attend Mass at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Visit Church of St. Anne and Pool of Bethesda; Visit Western Wall

tourDays.title: Return Flights Home
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast and farewells, transfer to Tel Aviv airport for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Transfer to Tel Aviv airport; Depart on return flights

tourDays.title: Depart for Lisbon
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport, where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Make way to local airport; Board overnight flight(s); Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Arrive Lisbon
tourDays.description: Upon landing at Lisbon Airport, and after claiming your baggage, proceed to the arrival's hall, where you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver. This afternoon we will enjoy Panoramic tour of Lisbon, which will include St. Jerome's Monastery, built to give thanks to the Virgin Mary, we will drive by the Belem Tower and many landmarks including the 25th of April Bridge, Basilica of the Star, and the Marquee of Pombal Square. Our last stop will be St. Anthony's Church. Patron Saint of lost things is best known as St. Anthony of Padua (Italy), but he was born and baptized here in Lisbon, Portugal. The Church where we will celebrate Mass is built upon St. Anthony's birth. Welcome dinner and overnight in Lisbon.
tourDays.activities: Panoramic tour of Lisbon; Visit St. Jerome's Monastery; Drive by Belem Tower and other landmarks; Visit St. Anthony's Church; Celebrate Mass; Welcome dinner

tourDays.title: Lisbon - Santarem - Fatima
tourDays.description: Today, we will head to Fatima, on the way will stop in town of Santarem for Mass at St. Stephens Church, and to venerate the 13th century Eucharistic Miracle. Continue to Fatima, a Hamlet of Aljustrel, the birthplace and home of the three shepherd children. Dinner and overnight in Fatima.
tourDays.activities: Travel from Lisbon to Santarem and Fatima; Mass at St. Stephens Church; Venerate the 13th century Eucharistic Miracle

tourDays.title: Fatima
tourDays.description: Today will surely be a memorable experience, as you pray and meditate upon one of Our Blessed Mother's apparition sites. Our Lady appeared to three shepherd children; Lucia (age 10), Jacinta (age 7), and Francisco (age 9). These apparitions occurred monthly from May until October of 1917. Our profoundly reflective day begins with a visit to the Little Chapel of the Apparitions. Continue with a visit to the Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary. Visit the Museum with the exhibition: Fatima: Light and Peace. Continue with a visit to the Holy Trinity Basilica. After free time for lunch, we will experience Christ's unconditional love by participating in the Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra. The day ends with a visit to Valinhos. Your night will conclude with private devotions, and a candlelight procession.
tourDays.activities: Visit Little Chapel of the Apparitions; Visit Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary; Visit Museum (Fatima: Light and Peace); Visit Holy Trinity Basilica; Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra; Private devotions; Candlelight procession

tourDays.title: Fatima - Salamanca
tourDays.description: Depart Fatima and head to Salamanca, following a full breakfast at the hotel. Salamanca is a city in the Castilla y Leon region. Our walking tour will bring us by the most noteworthy sites such as; the grand Plaza Mayor; La Clerecia; La Casa de las Conchas; the University of Salamanca; the Roman Bridge; La Iglesia de San Marcos; La Iglesia de San Martin. Visit the inside of the two joint Salamanca Cathedrals (old and new). Return to your hotel for dinner and overnight in Salamanca.
tourDays.activities: Travel from Fatima to Salamanca; Walking tour of Salamanca visiting major sites; Visit inside the old and new Salamanca Cathedrals

tourDays.title: Salamanca - Alba de Tormes - Avila - Burgos
tourDays.description: This morning, after breakfast, you will board the bus and enjoy a short transfer to the village of Alba de Tormes. This town is home to the Carmelite Monastery that Saint Teresa founded in 1571. Upon arrival in Alba de Tormes, your group will celebrate Mass at this Monastery where the saint died and was buried. Visit the museum dedicated to St. Teresa of Avila, which also holds her incorrupt heart and left arm. Free time for lunch, before continuing to Avila to see the eleventh-century walls, Cathedral de Avila, Basilica de San Vicente and the Incarnation Convent. After walking in the footsteps of St. Teresa, continue your journey to Burgos. Dinner and overnight in Burgos.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Alba de Tormes; Mass at Carmelite Monastery; Visit St. Teresa museum and relics; Free time for lunch; Visit Avila city walls and Cathedral de Avila; Visit Basilica de San Vicente and Incarnation Convent; Travel to Burgos

tourDays.title: Burgos - Loyola - Lourdes
tourDays.description: Following breakfast, transfer from Burgos to Loyola to visit the birthplace of St. Ignatius, founder of the Jesuit Order. In Loyola, you will see the 17th century Basilica that is dedicated to this remarkable Saint and the "Holy House," the birthplace of St. Ignatius. After free time for lunch, board the bus and continue to Lourdes with a spectacular view of the Pyrenees Mountains. Upon arrival in Lourdes, check-in to your hotel, dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Loyola; Visit Basilica and Holy House in Loyola; Pray at venerated room; Free time for lunch; Travel to Lourdes; Hotel check-in

tourDays.title: Lourdes (Day 1 of 2)
tourDays.description: Over the next two days, you will stay in a small town, nestled within the Pyrenees Mountains. During your time in Lourdes, you will pray and meditate in a site of Our Lady's apparitions. Attend Mass at the Grotto; watch a video presentation that explains the story of Lourdes; participate with the gesture of the miraculous spring (wash your hands, wash your face and drink the water). Meditate upon the "life-size" Stations of the Cross that overlook the Grotto of Massabielle. See Boly Mill, the birthplace of St. Bernadette, and the "Cachot," an abandoned prison where Bernadette's impoverished family lived. Each evening following dinner, attend the candlelight procession and the Rosary.
tourDays.activities: Pray and meditate at the apparitions site; Attend Mass at the Grotto; Watch video presentation about Lourdes; Participate in the miraculous spring gesture (wash/drink); Pray the life-size Stations of the Cross; Visit Boly Mill and the Cachot; Attend candlelight procession and Rosary each evening

tourDays.title: Lourdes (Day 2 of 2)
tourDays.description: Continued time in Lourdes to pray, attend Mass at the Grotto, participate in the miraculous spring, visit Lourdes sites, meditate upon the Stations of the Cross, and attend evening candlelight procession and Rosary.
tourDays.activities: Continue prayers and devotions in Lourdes; Attend Mass at the Grotto; Participate in miraculous spring; Visit sanctuary sites (Boly Mill, Cachot); Meditate on Stations of the Cross; Attend candlelight procession and Rosary

tourDays.title: Lourdes â Tel Aviv
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast and heartfelt farewells, your group will leave by motor coach and transfer to the Toulouse, Pau or Lourdes airport for your flights to Tel Aviv. Upon arrival at Ben Gurion Airport in Tel Aviv, proceed to baggage claim, then to the Arrival's Hall to be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver. Transfer to your hotel in Tel Aviv to check-in. Enjoy dinner at the hotel before retiring for the evening.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast and farewells; Transfer to Toulouse/Pau/Lourdes airport; Fly to Tel Aviv; Arrive at Ben Gurion Airport and collect luggage; Transfer to Tel Aviv hotel and check-in; Dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Tel Aviv - Caesarea - Nazareth - Cana - Tiberias (Theme: The Annunciation)
tourDays.description: This morning we will depart Tel Aviv to Caesarea Maritima. We will see the Roman theatre, Herod's Palace, view the Hippodrome, and the harbor. Continue to Nazareth to visit the museum and archaeological Garden and St. Joseph's workshop / St. Joseph's Church. Within the Church of the Annunciation, go down to the Grotto to see the remains of the house of the Blessed Mother. From here, drive to Cana, where Jesus performed His first miracle. We celebrate Mass here at the Wedding Church, and married couples will have the chance to renew their wedding vows. From there, continue to our hotel by the Sea of Galilee for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Depart Tel Aviv for Caesarea Maritima; See Roman theatre, Herod's Palace, Hippodrome and harbor; Visit Nazareth museum and archaeological garden; Visit St. Joseph's workshop / St. Joseph's Church; Visit Church of the Annunciation and Grotto; Celebrate Mass at the Wedding Church in Cana; Opportunity for married couples to renew vows; Travel to hotel by the Sea of Galilee

tourDays.title: Tiberias: Sea of Galilee (Theme: The Ministry of Christ in the Galilee)
tourDays.description: This morning we take a boat ride on the beautiful Sea of Galilee. Then we visit Capernaum, the fishing town where Jesus lived. In Capernaum, we see the Synagogue where Jesus taught. We continue to the Mount of Beatitudes, then to Tabgha, and St. Peter's Primacy. Continue visiting Mary Magdalene's birthplace in Magdala. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee; Visit Capernaum and its Synagogue; Visit Mount of Beatitudes; Visit Tabgha; Visit St. Peter's Primacy; Visit Magdala (Mary Magdalene's birthplace)

tourDays.title: Mt. Tabor - Jericho - Jerusalem (Theme: The Transfiguration)
tourDays.description: After breakfast, drive to the site of the Transfiguration, Mount Tabor. Celebrate Mass at the Basilica of the Transfiguration and then continue south towards the Jordan Valley to Jericho. In Jericho, view the Mount of Temptation. Drive up to Jerusalem to check in to your hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Mount Tabor; Celebrate Mass at the Basilica of the Transfiguration; Travel to Jericho and view Mount of Temptation; Drive to Jerusalem and check in to hotel

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Bethlehem & Ein Karem (Theme: The Visitation and Nativity)
tourDays.description: This morning visit the village of Ein Karem: Church of St John the Baptist and the Church of the Visitation. Later drive to Bethlehem to visit the fields where the Angel appeared to the shepherds, enter the caves, see Manger Square and the Church of the Nativity. Proceed down to the Grotto of the Nativity. Following Mass in Bethlehem, return to the hotel in Jerusalem for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Ein Karem (Church of St John the Baptist); Visit Church of the Visitation; Drive to Bethlehem and visit the fields of the shepherds; Enter caves and see Manger Square; Visit Church of the Nativity and Grotto of the Nativity; Celebrate Mass in Bethlehem

tourDays.title: Jordan River - Qumran - Dead Sea (Theme: Early Years in Jerusalem & the Wilderness)
tourDays.description: Drive through the Judean wilderness. Head to the Jordan River for time to reflect on the Baptism of Christ. In the afternoon, visit Qumran where the Dead Sea Scrolls were found. Before returning to Jerusalem, there is time to swim or float on the Dead Sea.
tourDays.activities: Drive through the Judean wilderness; Reflect at the Jordan River (Baptism site); Visit Qumran (Dead Sea Scrolls site); Swim or float in the Dead Sea

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Mt. Of Olives - Gethsemane - Mt. Zion (Theme: Palm Sunday and the Agony in the Garden)
tourDays.description: After breakfast, make your way to the Mount of Olives for a panoramic view of Jerusalem. Visit the Pater Noster Shrine, Dominus Flevit, Gethsemane and the Church of All Nations (Rock of Agony). Visit the Western Wall, the house of the High Priest Caiaphas (Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu), the Upper Room on Mt. Zion and the Benedictine Church of the Dormition. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Mount of Olives for panoramic view; Visit Pater Noster Shrine; Visit Dominus Flevit; Visit Gethsemane and Church of All Nations; Visit Western Wall; Visit Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu (house of Caiaphas); Visit Upper Room (Mt. Zion); Visit Benedictine Church of the Dormition

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Via Dolorosa - Holy Sepulchre - Western Wall (Theme: The Way of the Cross, The Crucifixion, The Resurrection)
tourDays.description: Very early this morning walk together in prayerful procession along the Via Dolorosa starting at the Antonia Fortress and ending at the Church of the Holy Sepulcher. After Mass at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre return to the hotel for breakfast. Later revisit the Old City to see the Church of St. Anne, the Pool of Bethesda, and end the day with a visit to the Western Wall.
tourDays.activities: Early morning procession along the Via Dolorosa; Walk from Antonia Fortress to Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Attend Mass at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Visit Church of St. Anne; Visit Pool of Bethesda; Visit Western Wall

tourDays.title: Return Flights Home

tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Transfer to Tel Aviv airport; Board return flights home

tourDays.activities: Arrival and baggage claim; Meet guide/driver; Transfer to hotel; Free afternoon (stroll in Krakow); Welcome dinner and show at a local restaurant

tourDays.title: Zakopane excursion and Jaszczorowka Chapel
tourDays.description: Drive through the mountains to the village of Zakopane. Take a cable car to a mountaintop for panoramic views, visit Jaszczorowka Chapel (associated with young Karol Wojtyla), walk surrounding paths, visit Krupowki Street and the local bazaar for shopping, then return to Krakow for dinner.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Zakopane; Cable car ride to mountaintop; Visit Jaszczorowka Chapel; Walk/prayer on surrounding paths; Shopping at Krupowki Street; Return to Krakow and dinner

tourDays.description: Explore Krakowâs Market Square (including St. Maryâs Tower, Town Hall Tower, Cloth Hall), visit Wawel Hill with the Cathedral and Coronation Chapel and pray at the tomb of St. Stanislaus. Drive to Auschwitz to visit the former camp, view the cell of St. Maximilian Kolbe and the Martyrdom Museum, then return to Krakow for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Market Square and St. Maryâs Tower; Visit Wawel Hill Cathedral and Coronation Chapel; Pray at the tomb of St. Stanislaus; Visit Auschwitz concentration camp; View St. Maximilian Kolbe's cell; Visit Martyrdom Museum; Return to hotel in Krakow

tourDays.title: Shrine of Divine Mercy and Wieliczka Salt Mine
tourDays.description: Depart for Lagiewniki to visit the Shrine of Divine Mercy (images of the Merciful Jesus, relics of St. Faustina, convent chapel and Tomb). Celebrate Mass at the Shrine and have the opportunity to pray by a relic of St. John Paul II. Continue to the Wieliczka Salt Mine (UNESCO World Heritage Site), then return to Krakow for a farewell dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Shrine of Divine Mercy in Lagiewniki; Celebrate Mass at the Shrine; Pray by a relic of St. John Paul II; Visit Wieliczka Salt Mine; Farewell dinner in Krakow

tourDays.title: Transfer to Prague

tourDays.title: Prague churches and Old Town walking tour
tourDays.description: Visit the Church of Our Lady Victorious (home of the Infant Jesus of Prague) and celebrate Mass. Take a walking tour of Old Town Prague and the Royal Route: Old Town Square, St. Nicholas Church, St. Vitus Cathedral, St. George Basilica, Loreto Church, Strahov Monastery, Karlova Street, Charles Bridge, view Prague Castle and the Astronomical Clock, and walk Wenceslas Square. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Church of Our Lady Victorious and attend Mass; Walking tour of Old Town and the Royal Route; Visit St. Nicholas Church, St. Vitus Cathedral, St. George Basilica, Loreto Church, Strahov Monastery; Walk Karlova Street and Charles Bridge; View Prague Castle, Astronomical Clock and Wenceslas Square

tourDays.title: Shrine of Our Lady of Guadalupe; Coyoacan & San Angel
tourDays.description: Visit the Shrine of Our Lady of Guadalupe and celebrate Mass in the modern Basilica. Free time for prayer and reflection. Drive south to San Angel for Mass at San Jacinto Church. Visit the former convent and church of El Carmen and the Church of Santa Catarina in Coyoacan. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.

Visit the Zocalo to see the National Palace and Metropolitan Cathedral. Continue to the Plaza of Santo Domingo (Our Lady of the Rosary and Our Lady of Covadonga). tourDays.title: Shrines of Tlaxcala and Ocotlan; Cholula and Puebla sightseeing
tourDays.description: Travel through the mountains to Tlaxcala and the Shrine of San Miguel Del Milagro; celebrate Mass at the site. Continue to Ocotlan to visit the Basilica of Our Lady of Ocotlan and view the miraculous image in a tree trunk. Stop at Cholula to visit the 7 super-imposed Pyramids of Quetzalcoatl. Continue to Puebla for lunch at Hotel Colonial and sightseeing of Puebla Cathedral, the Rosary Chapel and other sites. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel through mountain scenery; Celebrate Mass at Shrine of San Miguel Del Milagro; Visit Basilica of Our Lady of Ocotlan and view miraculous image; Visit Cholula and Pyramids of Quetzalcoatl; Lunch at Hotel Colonial (Puebla); Sightseeing in Puebla (Cathedral, Rosary Chapel)

tourDays.title: Plaza of the Three Cultures; Shrine of Our Lady of Guadalupe; Teotihuacan
tourDays.description: Travel via the Plaza of the Three Cultures to the baptismal place of Juan Diego. Visit the Shrine of Our Lady of Guadalupe and celebrate Mass in the modern Basilica. Continue to San Juan Teotihuacan for lunch and a guided tour of the archaeological zone (Pyramids of the Sun and Moon, Temple of Quetzalcoatl) and local arts and crafts markets. Return to hotel. Optional evening performance at the Palace of Fine Arts (additional $115 per person including roundtrip transfers).
tourDays.activities: Visit Plaza of the Three Cultures and baptismal place of Juan Diego; Celebrate Mass at the Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe; Visit San Juan Teotihuacan; Guided tour of Teotihuacan archaeological zone; Visit local arts and crafts markets; Optional Palace of Fine Arts performance (supplement)
