tourDays.description: Travel toward Fatima with a stop in Santarem for Mass at St. Stephen's Church and to venerate the 13th-century Eucharistic Miracle. Continue to Fatima (Aljustrel) â the birthplace and home of the three shepherd children. Dinner and overnight in Fatima.
tourDays.activities: Drive from Lisbon toward Fatima; Mass at St. Stephen's Church (Santarem); Venerate the Eucharistic Miracle in Santarem; Transfer to Fatima (Aljustrel); Dinner and overnight in Fatima

tourDays.title: Fatima
tourDays.description: Visit the Little Chapel of the Apparitions, the Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary (tombs of St. Francisco, St. Jacinta and Sister Lucia), the Museum 'Fatima: Light and Peace' and the Holy Trinity Basilica. After free time for lunch, participate in the Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra, visit Valinhos, and conclude the night with private devotions and a candlelight procession. Dinner and overnight in Fatima.
tourDays.activities: Visit Little Chapel of the Apparitions; Visit Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary and view tombs of St. Francisco, St. Jacinta and Sister Lucia; Visit Museum 'Fatima: Light and Peace'; Visit Holy Trinity Basilica; Free time for lunch; Participate in Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra; Visit Valinhos (site of apparitions); Private devotions and candlelight procession

tourDays.title: Return Home
tourDays.description: Enjoy an early morning breakfast followed by a transfer to Lisbon airport for your return flight(s) home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Transfer to Lisbon airport; Depart on return flights home

tourDays.title: Depart the USA
tourDays.description: Your pilgrimage begins as you depart the USA on your international overnight flight.
tourDays.activities: Depart the USA; Overnight international flight

tourDays.title: Arrive in Athens / Embark
tourDays.description: You will arrive in Athens, Greece, where you will be met by our representative and transferred to the port to board the Celebrity Infinity cruise ship.
tourDays.activities: Arrive in Athens; Transfer to port; Board Celebrity Infinity

tourDays.title: Kavala / Visit Philippi
tourDays.description: Visit Philippi, where Paul spoke to women by the riverside and Lydia was baptized. Visit the commemorative site, see a Roman-period crypt believed to have been a prison for Paul, and see the agora, basilica, and theater.
tourDays.activities: Visit Philippi; See Roman-period crypt; See the agora; See the basilica; See the theater

tourDays.title: Thessaloniki
tourDays.description: Discover Thessaloniki, stroll through the basilica of St. Demetrios, view the Roman agora, and see the Galerius Arch and portions of the Old City Ramparts.
tourDays.activities: Stroll basilica of St. Demetrios; View Roman agora; See Galerius Arch; Walk portions of Old City Ramparts

tourDays.title: At Sea
tourDays.description: Day spent cruising at sea.
tourDays.activities: Cruising / At sea

tourDays.title: Santorini
tourDays.description: Dock in Santorini, the picturesque Greek island with whitewashed villages and blue domes. The island perches on volcanic cliffs. Explore the island on your own or join optional shore excursions (not included).
tourDays.activities: Dock in Santorini; Explore island independently; Optional shore excursions (available for purchase)

tourDays.title: Kusadasi / Ephesus
tourDays.description: Visit Ephesus, view excavations including the agora and the library, visit the Ephesus Experience Museum and the terrace houses, see the site of the Temple of Artemis, and visit a carpet factory for a local lunch and presentation.
tourDays.activities: Explore Ephesus archaeological site; Visit Ephesus Experience Museum; View terrace houses; See Temple of Artemis site; Visit carpet factory; Enjoy local lunch and presentation

tourDays.title: Mykonos
tourDays.description: Arrive at Mykonos. Admire the whitewashed buildings and windmills. Explore the island on your own or join optional shore excursions (not included).
tourDays.activities: Explore Mykonos independently; Optional shore excursions (available for purchase)

tourDays.title: Rhodes / Old Town walking tour
tourDays.description: Explore Rhodes on foot starting in Old Town. Pass through the Agora and Collachium (Knights of St. John), visit churches, the Jewish quarter, Inns of the Knights, and the Palace of the Grand Masters; tour the palace interior and walk down the Street of the Knights.
tourDays.activities: Walking tour of Rhodes Old Town; Visit churches and Jewish quarter; Tour Palace of the Grand Masters interior; Walk the Street of the Knights

tourDays.title: At Sea
tourDays.description: Day spent cruising at sea.
tourDays.activities: Cruising / At sea

tourDays.title: Athens / Corinth
tourDays.description: Disembark Celebrity Infinity and discover Athens: explore the Acropolis, Propylaea, Parthenon, and Erechtheum; stand on Mars Hill. Travel to Corinth to visit the archaeological museum, marketplace, temples, and stand on the Bema where Paul stood before Gallio.
tourDays.activities: Disembark ship; Explore Acropolis, Propylaea, Parthenon, Erechtheum; Stand on Mars Hill; Travel to Corinth; Visit archaeological museum, marketplace, and temples; Stand on the Bema

tourDays.title: Return to the USA
tourDays.description: Return to the USA.
tourDays.activities: Return travel to the USA

tourDays.title: Depart for Jordan
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport where you will board your overnight flight. Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Travel to local airport; Board overnight flight; Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Arrive Amman
tourDays.description: Upon arrival in Amman, make your way to the baggage claim area and collect your luggage. Proceed to the Arrivalâs Hall, where you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver. Transfer to the hotel in Amman for check-in and enjoy dinner at the hotel before retiring for the evening.
tourDays.activities: Collect luggage; Meet tour guide/driver; Transfer to hotel; Hotel check-in; Dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Petra
tourDays.description: Transfer to the âlostâ city of Petra. Enjoy a walking tour of the former capital and trading center. First stop is the Siq, a mile-long gorge with structures carved into the mountains. The walk culminates with a visit to the Petra Museum, which holds artifacts from the Neolithic period, Roman architecture, and a Byzantine chapel. Spend the afternoon at leisure for shopping. Return to Amman for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Petra; Walking tour of Petra; Visit the Siq; Visit Petra Museum; Free time / shopping; Return to Amman

tourDays.title: Kerak - Madaba - Mt. Nebo
tourDays.description: After breakfast travel to the Castle of Kerak. Transfer to Madaba to visit St. Georgeâs Church, home to the oldest map of the Holy Land. Later, visit Mt. Nebo, the site mentioned in Deuteronomy where Moses climbed and where he died and was buried. Return to Amman for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Castle of Kerak; Visit St. George's Church in Madaba; Visit Mt. Nebo; Return to Amman

tourDays.title: Amman - Jerash - Tel Aviv (Crossing the Jordanian Border into Israel)
tourDays.description: Depart for Jerash to see one of the best-preserved sites of Roman architecture outside Italy, including paved and colonnaded streets, temples, theaters, public squares, baths, fountains and city walls. Later cross the Jordanian border into the Holy Land and continue toward the Mediterranean coast to Tel Aviv for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Depart for Jerash; Sightseeing in Jerash (Roman ruins); Cross Jordanian border into Israel; Travel to Tel Aviv

tourDays.title: Tel Aviv - Caesarea - Nazareth - Cana - Tiberias
tourDays.description: Depart Tel Aviv to Caesarea Maritima to see the Roman theatre, Herodâs Palace, the Hippodrome, and the harbor. Continue to Nazareth to visit the museum and archaeological garden and St. Josephâs workshop. Visit the Church of the Annunciation grotto. Drive to Cana where Jesus performed His first miracle; celebrate Mass at the Wedding Church and married couples may renew their vows. Continue to the hotel by the Sea of Galilee for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Caesarea Maritima; See Roman theatre and Herod's Palace; Visit Nazareth museum and archaeological garden; Visit St. Joseph's workshop; Visit Grotto of the Church of the Annunciation; Drive to Cana; Mass at Wedding Church in Cana; Renewal of wedding vows (optional for married couples); Continue to Sea of Galilee hotel

tourDays.title: Tiberias: Sea of Galilee
tourDays.description: Take a boat ride on the Sea of Galilee. Visit Capernaum to see the synagogue where Jesus taught. Continue to the Mount of Beatitudes, Tabgha (site of the Feeding of the 5,000), St. Peterâs Primacy, and Magdala, the birthplace of Mary Magdalene. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee; Visit Capernaum and the synagogue; Visit Mount of Beatitudes; Visit Tabgha (site of the Feeding of the 5,000); Visit St. Peter's Primacy; Visit Magdala

tourDays.title: Mt. Tabor - Jericho - Jerusalem
tourDays.description: Drive to Mount Tabor, site of the Transfiguration, with time for reflection and Mass at the Basilica of the Transfiguration. Continue south to the Jordan Valley and visit Jericho, viewing the Mount of Temptation. Drive up to Jerusalem and check in to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Mount Tabor; Reflect and celebrate Mass at Basilica of the Transfiguration; Drive to Jericho and view Mount of Temptation; Travel to Jerusalem and hotel check-in

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Bethlehem & Ein Karem
tourDays.description: Visit Ein Karem to see the Church of St. John the Baptist and the Church of the Visitation. Drive to Bethlehem to visit the fields of the shepherds, Manger Square, and the Church of the Nativity, proceeding down to the Grotto of the Nativity. Attend Mass in Bethlehem, then return to the hotel in Jerusalem for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Church of St. John the Baptist in Ein Karem; Visit Church of the Visitation; Drive to Bethlehem; Visit shepherds' fields and caves; Visit Manger Square and Church of the Nativity (Grotto); Mass in Bethlehem; Return to Jerusalem

tourDays.title: Jordan River - Qumran - Dead Sea
tourDays.description: Drive through the Judean wilderness to the Jordan River for reflection on the Baptism of Christ. In the afternoon visit Qumran, site where the Dead Sea Scrolls were found. Before returning to Jerusalem there is time to swim or float on the Dead Sea.
tourDays.activities: Drive through the Judean wilderness; Reflection at the Jordan River (Baptism site); Visit Qumran (Dead Sea Scrolls site); Swim or float on the Dead Sea; Return to Jerusalem

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Mt. Of Olives - Gethsemane - Mt. Zion (Upper Room)
tourDays.description: Visit the Mount of Olives for panoramic views of Jerusalem. Visit the Pater Noster Shrine, Dominus Flevit, and Gethsemane (including the Church of All Nations over the Rock of Agony). Opportunity to visit the Western Wall. Continue to the Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu (house of Caiaphas), the Upper Room on Mt. Zion, and the Benedictine Church of the Dormition. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Mount of Olives; Visit Pater Noster Shrine; Visit Dominus Flevit; Visit Gethsemane and Church of All Nations; Visit Western Wall; Visit Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu; Visit Upper Room on Mt. Zion; Visit Benedictine Church of the Dormition

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Via Dolorosa - Holy Sepulchre - Western Wall
tourDays.description: Very early this morning walk in prayerful procession along the Via Dolorosa, starting at the Antonia Fortress and ending at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre. Attend Mass at the Holy Sepulchre, return to the hotel for breakfast, then revisit the Old City to see the Church of St. Anne and the Pool of Bethesda. End the day with a visit to the Western Wall.
tourDays.activities: Prayerful procession along the Via Dolorosa; Visit Antonia Fortress; Attend Mass at Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Visit Church of St. Anne; Visit Pool of Bethesda; Visit Western Wall

tourDays.title: Return Flights Home
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast and farewells, transfer to the Tel Aviv airport for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Transfer to Tel Aviv airport; Board return flights home

tourDays.title: Depart USA
tourDays.description: Board your overnight transatlantic flights from your hometown. Meals are served on board.
tourDays.activities: Overnight transatlantic flight; In-flight meals

tourDays.title: Arrive in Medjugorje
tourDays.description: Upon arrival, you will be greeted by a tour guide/driver, escorted to the vehicle for the 2 1/2 hour drive to the village of Medjugorje. Meet fellow pilgrims and your spiritual leader, be introduced to your host family in whose inn you will stay for the next three nights. Enjoy dinner.
tourDays.activities: Arrival transfer; 2 1/2 hour drive to Medjugorje; Meet spiritual leader and fellow pilgrims; Meet host family and check in to inn; Dinner

tourDays.title: Medjugorje
tourDays.description: Time in Medjugorje intended as a personal retreat with opportunities for prayer and reflection. Local guide accompanies the group. Activities include daily Mass, climbing Apparition Hill and Mt. Krizevac, Adoration, visit to the Community of Cenacolo, and prayer at the Statue of the Risen Christ.
tourDays.activities: Attend Daily Mass (English); Climb Apparition Hill (recite the Rosary); Climb Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain) and pray the Stations of the Cross; Join evening apparitions/rosary; Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament; Visit the Community of Cenacolo; Prayer at the Statue of the Risen Christ

tourDays.title: Medjugorje
tourDays.description: Continued time in Medjugorje for prayer and reflection with opportunities similar to Day 3 (Mass, climbs, Adoration, visit to Cenacolo, prayer at the statue). Local guide available during stay; a 206 Tours representative is available for questions.
tourDays.activities: Attend Daily Mass (English); Climb Apparition Hill (recite the Rosary); Climb Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain) and pray the Stations of the Cross; Join evening apparitions/rosary; Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament; Visit the Community of Cenacolo; Prayer at the Statue of the Risen Christ

tourDays.title: Medjugorje â Dubrovnik
tourDays.description: After breakfast, transfer to Dubrovnik. Arrive in time to check in to the hotel. Afternoon at leisure. Welcome dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Transfer from Medjugorje to Dubrovnik; Hotel check-in; Afternoon at leisure; Welcome dinner

tourDays.title: Dubrovnik
tourDays.description: Morning walking tour of Old Dubrovnik including visits to the Franciscan Monastery, old harbor, St. Laurence Fortress, the Sponza and Rector's Palaces and other points of interest. Rest of day at leisure.
tourDays.activities: Morning walking tour of Old Dubrovnik; Visit Franciscan Monastery (old pharmacy); Visit old harbor; Visit St. Laurence Fortress; Visit Sponza Palace and Rector's Palace; Afternoon at leisure

tourDays.title: Dubrovnik - Split
tourDays.description: Depart Dubrovnik and travel north along the Adriatic coast to Split. City tour of Split featuring the historic inner city built around Diocletian's Palace, with sights including Jupiter's Temple, the Peristyle and the Cathedral. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Coach travel along the Adriatic coast; City tour of Split; Visit Diocletian's Palace and Roman remnants (Jupiter's Temple, Peristyle, Cathedral)

tourDays.title: Split - Trogir - Plitvice Lakes
tourDays.description: After breakfast, head to Trogir to see its artistic center. Then travel inland to Plitvice Lakes National Park and take a walking tour around several of the lower lakes. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Trogir; Travel to Plitvice Lakes National Park; Walking tour around several lower lakes

tourDays.title: Plitvice Lakes - Opatija - Postojna - Bled
tourDays.description: Return to the coast and travel along the bay of Kvarner to Opatija for free time. Continue north to Postojna to tour the Postojna Caves by miniature electric train. Afterwards continue to Bled. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Coach travel along the bay of Kvarner; Free time in Opatija; Tour Postojna Caves by miniature electric train; Travel to Bled

tourDays.title: Bled
tourDays.description: Sightseeing tour of Bled featuring the town, lakeshore and Bled Castle perched on a cliff above the lake. Remainder of the day at leisure for optional activities such as visiting the small island in the middle of the lake. Overnight.
tourDays.activities: Sightseeing tour of Bled; Visit Bled Castle; Optional visit to the island in the middle of the lake

tourDays.title: Bled - Ljubljana - Zagreb
tourDays.description: Start the day with a walking tour of Ljubljana visiting the Central open-air Market, the Three Bridges, Baroque Town Hall and Robba's Fountain. Then continue to Zagreb, the capital of Croatia. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Walking tour of Ljubljana; Visit Central open-air Market; See the Three Bridges; Visit Baroque Town Hall; See Robba's Fountain; Transfer to Zagreb

tourDays.title: Zagreb
tourDays.description: Text repeats a walking tour of Ljubljana and continuation to Zagreb. (As provided in itinerary.) Overnight in Zagreb.
tourDays.activities: Walking tour of Ljubljana (as stated); Continue to Zagreb

tourDays.title: Zagreb - USA
tourDays.description: After breakfast, drive to nearby Zagreb airport for flights home.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Zagreb airport; Depart on flights home

tourDays.title: Depart for Lourdes
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport, where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Make way to local airport; Board overnight flight(s); Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Arrive in Lourdes
tourDays.description: Upon arriving at Pau or Toulouse Airport, make your way to the baggage claim area and collect your luggage. Proceed to the arrival hall, where your tour guide and/or driver will greet you. Embark on the scenic drive to Lourdes. Check into your hotel, and then relax or explore before dinner. Following dinner, you will have free time to attend the candlelight procession and pray the Rosary (April â October only).
tourDays.activities: Arrive at Pau or Toulouse Airport; Collect luggage; Meet tour guide/driver; Scenic drive to Lourdes; Check into hotel; Attend candlelight procession and pray the Rosary (AprilâOctober only)

tourDays.title: Lourdes
tourDays.description: Over the next two days, you will stay in a small town in the Pyrenees Mountains. During your time in Lourdes, you will pray and meditate at the site of Our Ladyâs apparitions. You will have the opportunity to attend Mass at the Grotto, watch a video presentation that explains the story of Lourdes, participate in the gesture of the miraculous spring (wash your hands and face, and drink the water), meditate upon the life-size Stations of the Cross that overlook the Grotto of Massabielle, see Boly Mill (birthplace of St. Bernadette) and the Cachot. Following dinner, you may attend the candlelight procession and pray the Rosary.
tourDays.activities: Pray and meditate at the site of Our Ladyâs apparitions; Attend Mass at the Grotto; Watch video presentation about Lourdes; Participate in the miraculous spring (wash hands/face, drink water); Meditate upon the life-size Stations of the Cross; Visit Boly Mill (birthplace of St. Bernadette); Visit the Cachot; Attend candlelight procession and Rosary (evening)

tourDays.title: Lourdes
tourDays.description: Over the next two days, you will stay in a small town in the Pyrenees Mountains. During your time in Lourdes, you will pray and meditate at the site of Our Ladyâs apparitions. You will have the opportunity to attend Mass at the Grotto, watch a video presentation that explains the story of Lourdes, participate in the gesture of the miraculous spring (wash your hands and face, and drink the water), meditate upon the life-size Stations of the Cross that overlook the Grotto of Massabielle, see Boly Mill (birthplace of St. Bernadette) and the Cachot. Following dinner, you may attend the candlelight procession and pray the Rosary.
tourDays.activities: Pray and meditate at the site of Our Ladyâs apparitions; Attend Mass at the Grotto; Watch video presentation about Lourdes; Participate in the miraculous spring (wash hands/face, drink water); Meditate upon the life-size Stations of the Cross; Visit Boly Mill (birthplace of St. Bernadette); Visit the Cachot; Attend candlelight procession and Rosary (evening)

tourDays.title: Lourdes to Lisieux via Paris
tourDays.description: Enjoy breakfast before departing for Pau or Lourdes Airport for your short flight to Paris, continue on to Lisieux. During your visit in Lisieux, you will see the Basilica of St. Therese, view relics, clothing, and personal objects at Les Buissonnets, and tour the Carmelite Convent where St. Therese entered and is buried. Dinner and overnight in Lisieux.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast; Flight from Pau or Lourdes to Paris; Transfer to Lisieux; Visit Basilica of St. Therese; View relics and personal objects at Les Buissonnets; Tour the Carmelite Convent

tourDays.title: Normandy landing beaches and American Cemetery
tourDays.description: After breakfast and celebrating Mass in Lisieux, travel to the Normandy landing beaches and visit the Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial in Colleville-sur-Mer to honor the American troops who died in Europe during World War II. Return to Lisieux for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass in Lisieux; Travel to Normandy landing beaches; Visit Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial; Return to Lisieux

tourDays.title: Chartres and transfer to Paris
tourDays.description: Depart for Chartres to visit the Cathedral Notre Dame and its stained-glass windows. Pilgrims may venerate a relic of the Veil of Our Lady on display at the main altar. Free time for lunch in Chartres, then continue to Paris, check in at your hotel, followed by free time, dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast; Depart for Chartres; Visit Chartres Cathedral (Notre Dame); Venerate relic of the Veil of Our Lady; Lunch in Chartres (free time); Continue to Paris and check in hotel

tourDays.title: Paris sightseeing and shrines
tourDays.description: Celebrate Mass, then enjoy a full day of sightseeing including Sacre Coeur Basilica on Montmartre, the Chapel of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal (view the incorrupt body of St. Catherine Laboure), Saint Vincent de Paul Church, Notre Dame Cathedral, and a bus tour of Paris sights including the Eiffel Tower, the Invalides, Arc de Triomphe, and the Champs-Elysees. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass; Visit Sacre Coeur Basilica; Visit Chapel of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal and view incorrupt body of St. Catherine Laboure; Walk to Saint Vincent de Paul Church; Visit Notre Dame Cathedral; Bus tour of Paris (Eiffel Tower, Invalides, Arc de Triomphe, Champs-Elysees)

tourDays.title: Fly to Rome; Meet and Greet
tourDays.description: After breakfast transfer to Charles de Gaulle Airport and fly to Rome. Upon arrival transfer to the hotel for check-in and free time. Later in the afternoon meet in the hotel lobby for a Meet and Greet with fellow pilgrims, depart for Mass, and attend a welcome dinner. After dinner there is an optional group walk to St. Peterâs Square for the Rosary.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Charles de Gaulle Airport; Flight to Rome; Transfer to hotel and check-in; Free time to explore Rome; Meet and Greet with fellow pilgrims; Attend Mass; Welcome dinner; Optional group Rosary at St. Peter's Square

tourDays.title: Papal Audience and major basilicas
tourDays.description: Breakfast followed by the Papal Audience in St. Peterâs Square (celebrated each Wednesday, pending the papal schedule). Free time for lunch. Afternoon visits include St. John Lateran, the Holy Staircase, and the Basilica of St. Mary Major. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Attend Papal Audience in St. Peter's Square (Wednesday, pending schedule); Free time for lunch/shopping; Visit St. John Lateran Basilica; Visit the Holy Staircase; Visit Basilica of St. Mary Major

tourDays.title: Vatican museums, St. Peter's and ancient Rome
tourDays.description: Early breakfast, then visit St. Peterâs Basilica and the Vatican Museum (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel, Last Judgment). Visit the tomb of Saint John Paul II. Free time at Piazza Navona for lunch. Continue along the Appian Way to see Quo Vadis Chapel, Baths of Caracalla, Arch of Drusus, Tomb of Cecilia Metella, and the catacombs of St. Callixtus. Conclude with a visit to the Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls and dinner at a local restaurant.
tourDays.activities: Visit St. Peter's Basilica; Visit Vatican Museum (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel, Last Judgment); Visit tomb of Saint John Paul II; Free time at Piazza Navona; Visit Appian Way sites (Quo Vadis Chapel, Baths of Caracalla, Arch of Drusus, Tomb of Cecilia Metella, Catacombs of St. Callixtus); Visit Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls; Dinner at a local restaurant

tourDays.title: Fly to Medjugorje and transfer
tourDays.description: Depart from Italy for your flight(s) to Medjugorje. Upon arrival you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver and taken on the approximately 2.5 hour drive to the village of Medjugorje. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Flight from Italy to Medjugorje; Arrival transfer and approximately 2.5 hour drive to Medjugorje; Dinner and overnight in Medjugorje

tourDays.title: Medjugorje pilgrimage activities
tourDays.description: While in Medjugorje you will share in the faith journey of pilgrims with a local guide. Activities include Daily Mass at St. James Church, climbing Apparition Hill and Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain), attending evening prayers for the apparitions, adoration of the Blessed Sacrament, visiting the Community of Cenacolo, and prayer at the Statue of the Risen Christ. Confessions in English and other sacramental opportunities are available.
tourDays.activities: Attend Daily Mass at St. James Church; Climb Apparition Hill and recite the Rosary; Climb Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain) and pray the Stations of the Cross; Join evening apparitions/rosary at St. James Church or Apparition Hill; Attend Croatian Mass and Blessing of the Sick (where available); Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament; Visit the Community of Cenacolo; Prayer at the Statue of the Risen Christ; Confessions in English at St. James Church (where available)

tourDays.title: Return home
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast and heartfelt farewells, transfer to Dubrovnik, Split, or Sarajevo Airport for your return flight(s) home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Transfer to Dubrovnik, Split, or Sarajevo Airport; Board return flight(s) home

tourDays.title: Departure
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport and board overnight flights to begin the pilgrimage.
tourDays.activities: Travel to local airport; Board overnight flight(s)

tourDays.title: Arrive in Malta
tourDays.description: Arrive in Malta, collect luggage, meet your guide/driver at arrivals and transfer to the hotel. Guide will present information about St. Paul and Christianity in the Maltese Islands. Attend Mass at a local church before dinner at the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Airport arrival and transfer to hotel; Guided orientation about St. Paul and Christianity in Malta; Attend Mass; Dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Malta - The Three Cities - Valletta
tourDays.description: Full-day guided excursion to the Three Cities (Vittoriosa, Cospicua, Senglea). See the Miraculous Statue of Jesus Christ the Redeemer in the Oratory in Senglea. Take a harbor boat from Vittoriosa across Grand Harbor to Valletta, view the waterfront, visit St. John's Co-Cathedral and Museum including Caravaggio paintings. Dinner and overnight at the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Guided excursion to the Three Cities; Visit oratory and view Miraculous Statue of Jesus Christ the Redeemer; Harbor boat tour across Grand Harbor; Visit St. John's Co-Cathedral and Museum; Dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Malta - Mellieha - Gozo
tourDays.description: Full-day guided excursion to Gozo. Visit the Mellieha Sanctuary of Our Lady, Munxar Parish Church, Gozo Cathedral of the Assumption, St. George's Basilica, the side chapel of St. Lazarus, and the Basilica of Ta'Pinu. Return by ferry to Malta for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Guided island excursion to Gozo; Visit Mellieha Sanctuary of Our Lady; Visit Munxar Parish Church; Visit Gozo Cathedral of the Assumption; Visit St. George's Basilica and side chapel of St. Lazarus; Visit Basilica of the National Shrine of the Blessed Virgin of Ta'Pinu; Ferry return to Malta

tourDays.title: Malta - St. Paul's Bay - Mosta - Mdina - Rabat
tourDays.description: Full day of guided tours visiting St. Paul's Bay by boat, the Church of the Assumption of Our Lady, St. Paul's Cathedral and Museum in Mdina, the medieval walled city and Bastions, St. Paul's Catacombs, and St. Paul's Grotto (site associated with St. Paul). Return to Malta for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Boat trip at St. Paul's Bay; Visit Church of the Assumption of Our Lady; Visit St. Paul's Cathedral and Museum (Mdina); Tour medieval walled city and Bastions (Mdina); Visit St. Paul's Catacombs and St. Paul's Grotto

tourDays.title: Malta - Rome
tourDays.description: Transfer to the airport for flight to Rome. Upon arrival in Rome, claim baggage and transfer to the hotel. Free time to unpack and explore. Meet in the hotel lobby for a meet and greet with fellow pilgrims and the priest, depart together for Mass, followed by a welcome dinner and optional Rosary at St. Peter's Square.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Malta airport and flight to Rome; Arrival in Rome and transfer to hotel; Free time in Rome; Meet and greet with group and priest; Attend Mass; Welcome dinner; Optional Rosary at St. Peter's Square

tourDays.title: Rome: Papal Audience and Historic Sites
tourDays.description: Attend the Papal Audience in St. Peter's Square or Audience Hall (when scheduled). Visit Piazza Navona area for free time and lunch. This afternoon visit the Archbasilica of St. John Lateran, the Holy Stairs (Scala Santa), and the Basilica of St. Mary Major where Mass will be celebrated. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Attend Papal Audience (when scheduled); Free time/lunch at Piazza Navona; Visit Archbasilica of St. John Lateran; Visit Holy Stairs (Scala Santa); Celebrate Mass at Basilica of St. Mary Major; Dinner

tourDays.title: Rome: Vatican and Ancient Christian Sites
tourDays.description: Tour St. Peter's Basilica (including Michelangelo's Pieta, and tombs of Pope Benedict XVI and St. John Paul II). Visit the Vatican Museum (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel). After lunch, continue to the Appian Way, the Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls, and the Catacombs. Dinner and overnight in Rome.
tourDays.activities: Tour St. Peter's Basilica; View Michelangelo's Pieta; Visit tombs of Pope Benedict XVI and St. John Paul II; Visit Vatican Museum (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel); Visit Appian Way; Visit Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls; Visit Catacombs

tourDays.title: Rome - Montecassino - San Giovanni Rotondo
tourDays.description: Travel by bus through the Roman countryside to Montecassino to visit the Benedictine monastery founded by Saint Benedict (around 530 A.D.). After the visit and a chance to shop the gift shop, continue by bus to San Giovanni Rotondo, check in, enjoy dinner at a restaurant and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Scenic bus transfer through Roman countryside; Visit Montecassino monastery; Visit gift shop at Montecassino; Bus transfer to San Giovanni Rotondo; Check in and dinner

tourDays.title: San Giovanni Rotondo and Monte Sant'Angelo
tourDays.description: Visit the Old Church in San Giovanni Rotondo. After Mass, tour the Sanctuary to view the crucifix associated with St. Pio and the confessional he used. Travel along the Gargano Peninsula to the Grotto of St. Michael the Archangel (Monte Sant'Angelo) and visit the shrine. Free time and return to San Giovanni Rotondo for devotion and reflection, dinner and overnight. Between May and October there is an optional weekly Candlelight Procession after dinner.
tourDays.activities: Visit Old Church (San Giovanni Rotondo); Attend Mass; Tour Sanctuary and view crucifix; Visit St. Pio's confessional; Bus excursion along Gargano Peninsula; Visit Grotto of St. Michael the Archangel (Monte Sant'Angelo); Devotion and reflection time

tourDays.title: San Giovanni Rotondo - Lanciano - Loreto - Assisi
tourDays.description: Depart for Assisi via Lanciano, stopping for a private Mass at the Convent/Church of Saint Francis built over the ancient Church of St. Longinus (site of the Eucharistic Miracle). Continue to the Marian Shrine of Loreto to visit the Holy House of Nazareth and the Madonna of Loreto. End the day in Assisi with dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Private Mass at Convent/Church of Saint Francis (Lanciano); Visit site associated with the Eucharistic Miracle; Visit Marian Shrine of Loreto and the Holy House of Nazareth; Travel to Assisi, dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Assisi
tourDays.description: Tour the Basilica of St. Francis, visit the tomb of St. Francis and frescoes depicting his life. Pray at the tomb of St. Carlo Acutis at Santuario Della Spogliazione. Walking tour of the town including the birthplace of St. Francis and the Church of St. Clare. After lunch, visit the Basilica of St. Mary of the Angels (Porziuncola and Capella del Transito), the Rose Garden and the cave where St. Francis prayed. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Basilica of St. Francis and tomb; View frescoes of St. Francis' life; Pray at tomb of St. Carlo Acutis (Santuario Della Spogliazione); Walking tour of Assisi including birthplace of St. Francis; Visit Church of St. Clare; Visit Basilica of St. Mary of the Angels (Porziuncola and Capella del Transito); Visit Rose Garden and St. Francis' prayer cave

tourDays.title: Assisi - Orvieto - Assisi
tourDays.description: Drive through the Umbrian mountains to Orvieto. Visit Orvieto's renowned Cathedral. Return to Assisi for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Bus ride through Umbrian mountains; Visit Orvieto and Orvieto Cathedral; Return to Assisi

tourDays.title: Return Home
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast, depart by motor coach and transfer to Rome Fiumicino airport for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Motor coach transfer to Rome Fiumicino airport; Board return flight(s) home

tourDays.title: Depart for Lisbon
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport and board overnight flight(s). Meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Travel to local airport; Board overnight flight(s); Dine on board (meals served)

tourDays.title: Arrive in Lisbon
tourDays.description: Arrive at Lisbon Portela Airport, collect luggage, meet tour guide/driver. Meet the group in the hotel lobby at 2:30 PM and begin a panoramic sightseeing tour of Lisbon including St. Jerome's Monastery, the Belem Quarter/Belem Tower, and St. Anthony's Church where Mass is celebrated. Transfer to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Collect luggage and meet tour guide/driver; Meet group in hotel lobby; Panoramic sightseeing tour of Lisbon; Visit St. Jerome's Monastery; Drive by Belem Quarter and Belem Tower; Visit St. Anthony's Church and celebrate Mass; Transfer to hotel, dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Lisbon - Santarem â Fatima
tourDays.description: Travel north to Santarem, attend Mass at the Church of St. Stephen (site of a 13th-century Eucharistic Miracle). Continue to Fatima to visit the Hamlet of Aljustrel (home of the three shepherd children), the Parish Church, and Fatima Parish Cemetery. Transfer to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Santarem; Attend Mass at Church of St. Stephen; Visit Aljustrel (hamlet of the shepherd children); Visit Parish Church and Fatima Parish Cemetery; Transfer to hotel, dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Fatima
tourDays.description: A day of prayer and meditation at Fatima: visit the Little Chapel of the Apparitions, Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary (tombs of St. Francisco, St. Jacinta, and Sister Lucia), the monument to the Sacred Heart of Jesus, the "Fatima: Light and Peace" museum exhibition, and the Holy Trinity Basilica. After lunch, participate in the Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra, visit Valinhos, and conclude with private devotions and a candlelight procession. Dinner and overnight in Fatima.
tourDays.activities: Visit Little Chapel of the Apparitions; Visit Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary; View monument commemorating the Sacred Heart of Jesus; Visit "Fatima: Light and Peace" museum exhibition; Visit Holy Trinity Basilica; Free time for lunch; Participate in Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra; Visit Valinhos; Private devotions and candlelight procession; Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Fatima (Private Prayer & Reflection)
tourDays.description: Day dedicated to private prayer, reflection, and additional time in Fatima for pilgrims who wish to spend more time in the shrine. The itinerary notes the first three days are group sightseeing; this and the following day(s) emphasize personal devotion.
tourDays.activities: Private prayer and reflection; Personal time at Fatima shrine

tourDays.title: Fatima - Lourdes
tourDays.description: After breakfast, transfer to Lisbon airport for a short flight to Toulouse. Arrive in Toulouse, collect luggage, and meet the tour driver for a scenic drive to Lourdes. Check in at the hotel and have free time to pray the Rosary; attend the candlelight procession in season (AprilâOctober). Dinner and overnight in Lourdes.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Lisbon airport; Short flight to Toulouse; Collect luggage and meet tour driver; Scenic drive to Lourdes; Hotel check-in; Free time to pray the Rosary; Attend candlelight procession (AprilâOctober); Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Lourdes
tourDays.description: Begin time in Lourdes dedicated to prayer and meditation at the sites of Our Lady's apparitions. Opportunities include attending Mass at the Grotto, watching a video about Lourdes, washing hands/face and drinking from the miraculous spring, meditating on the life-size Stations of the Cross that overlook the Grotto, and visiting Boly Mill and the Cachot. Evenings may include the candlelight procession and praying the Rosary.
tourDays.activities: Pray and meditate at the apparition sites; Attend Mass at the Grotto; Watch video presentation about Lourdes; Wash hands/face and drink water from the spring; Meditate on life-size Stations of the Cross; Visit Boly Mill (birthplace of St. Bernadette); Visit the Cachot; Attend evening candlelight procession and pray the Rosary

tourDays.title: Lourdes
tourDays.description: Continued time in Lourdes for prayer and spiritual activities: additional opportunities to attend Mass (including Mass at the Grotto), visit the baths, participate in devotions and processions, see the sanctuary sites associated with St. Bernadette, and personal reflection.
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass (including at the Grotto); Visit and/or bathe in the Lourdes baths; Drink from the miraculous spring; Visit sanctuary sites related to St. Bernadette; Participate in devotions and candlelight procession; Personal prayer and reflection

tourDays.title: Lourdes
tourDays.description: Final full day in Lourdes for prayer, meditation, and visiting key sites: attend Mass, view presentations about Lourdes, engage with the Stations of the Cross, and join the nightly candlelight procession. Opportunity to reflect on the story of Bernadette and the miracles associated with the spring and baths.
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass at the Grotto; Watch presentation/video on Lourdes; Pray the Stations of the Cross; Visit Boly Mill and the Cachot; Wash/drink from the spring and/or use the baths; Attend evening candlelight procession

tourDays.title: Return Home
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast and farewells, transfer to Pau, Toulouse, or Lourdes airport for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Transfer to airport (Pau, Toulouse, or Lourdes); Board return flights home

tourDays.activities: Board overnight flight to France

tourDays.activities: Board the ship in Paris

tourDays.description: Experience the Normandy region with choice of tours: visit the American sector of the Normandy Beaches (Colleville-sur-Mer, Omaha Beach, Longues-sur-Mer, Arromanches); tour the Gold and Juno beaches (Ranville Cemetery, Pegasus Bridge, Canadian cemetery at BÃ©ny-sur-Mer, WWII museum in Courseulles, Arromanches); take a full-day excursion to the Pays dâAuge; or visit the Seine Museum in Caudebec-en-Caux.
tourDays.activities: Visit Colleville-sur-Mer and Omaha Beach (American sector tour); See Longues-sur-Mer artillery battery; Visit Arromanches and remains of the floating harbor; Tour Gold and Juno beaches including Ranville Cemetery, Pegasus Bridge, BÃ©ny-sur-Mer, Courseulles WWII museum (British/Canadian sector option); Full-day excursion to Pays dâAuge (cider/Calvados/pommeau tasting); Visit Seine Museum in Caudebec-en-Caux

tourDays.description: Enjoy medieval Rouen with choices of excursions: walking tour (including the square where Joan of Arc was martyred, the Medieval Quarter and the Great Clock), the âTastes of Normandyâ tour (regional foods), or a guided bike tour. Then visit Bonnemare Castle.

tourDays.description: Enjoy scenic cruising around Vernon before disembarking for excursions: visit Claude Monetâs home and gardens in Giverny, tour the ChÃ¢teau de Bizy, or join a guided bike tour of the countryside. (Note: Monetâs Gardens may be closed; an alternative tour will operate if so.)
tourDays.activities: Scenic cruising around Vernon; Visit Monetâs home and gardens in Giverny; Tour ChÃ¢teau de Bizy (palace and gardens); Guided bike tour of the countryside

tourDays.description: Travel to Auberge Ravoux in Auvers-sur-Oise (Van Goghâs last home) or visit the ChÃ¢teau de Malmaison, or choose a guided cycling tour of Paris. In the afternoon, board a one-hour riverboat at the Port de la Bourdonnais near the Eiffel Tower for views of MusÃ©e dâOrsay, Notre Dame Cathedral and other landmarks.
tourDays.activities: Visit Auberge Ravoux in Auvers-sur-Oise (Van Goghâs last home); Visit ChÃ¢teau de Malmaison; Guided cycling tour of Paris (optional); One-hour riverboat cruise from Port de la Bourdonnais

tourDays.title: Paris â Disembarkation
tourDays.description: Bid farewell to Paris and prepare for your flight home.
tourDays.activities: Disembark the ship; Prepare for flight home

tourDays.title: Depart for Lourdes
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport, where you will board your overnight flight(s). Meals will be served while on board.
tourDays.activities: Make way to local airport; Board overnight flight(s); Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Arrive in Lourdes
tourDays.description: Upon arriving at Pau or Toulouse airport, make your way to the baggage claim area and collect your luggage. Proceed to the arrival hall, where you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver. Embark on the scenic drive to Lourdes. Check in to your hotel, and then relax or explore before dinner. Following dinner, you will have free time to pray the Rosary and to attend the candlelight procession (April-October only). These processions are lit by candlelight and guided by the Most Holy Rosary. Following this prayerful experience, you will return to your hotel.
tourDays.activities: Arrive at Pau or Toulouse airport; Collect luggage and proceed to arrival hall; Greeted by tour guide and/or driver; Scenic drive to Lourdes; Check in to hotel; Relax or explore before dinner; Pray the Rosary (free time after dinner); Attend candlelight procession (AprilâOctober only)

tourDays.title: Lourdes
tourDays.description: Over the next two days, you will stay in a small town, nestled within the Pyrenees Mountains. During your time in Lourdes, you will pray and meditate in a site of Our Ladyâs apparitions. Our Lady first appeared to Bernadette in 1858 and announced herself as âThe Immaculate Conceptionâ near the Grotto of Massabielle. During the first two apparitions, little Bernadette prayed the Rosary with Our Lady and left without exchanging words. During the following apparitions, Our Lady emphasized Godâs love for us and the necessity of performing acts of penance for sinners. Throughout your time in Lourdes, you will have the opportunity to attend Mass at the Grotto where Our Lady appeared to Bernadette. Watch a video presentation that explains, in detail, the story of Lourdes. Participate in the gesture of the miraculous spring by washing your hands and face, as well as drinking the water. Finish with a short prayer: Our Lady of Lourdes, pray for us. St. Bernadette, pray for us. O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee Additionally, you will have the opportunity to experience Christâs unconditional love, as you meditate upon the life-size Stations of the Cross that overlook the Grotto of Massabielle. In Lourdes, you will walk in the footsteps of St. Bernadette. Your group will have the opportunity to see Boly Mill, the birthplace of St. Bernadette, and the âCachot,â an abandoned prison where Bernadetteâs impoverished family lived. Each evening following dinner, you will have an opportunity to attend the candlelight procession and pray the Rosary before a restful overnight.
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass at the Grotto of Massabielle; Watch video presentation about Lourdes; Participate in the gesture of the miraculous spring (wash hands/face and drink the water); Pray short prayers/recitations; Meditate on the life-size Stations of the Cross; Visit Boly Mill (birthplace of St. Bernadette); Visit the Cachot (abandoned prison); Attend nightly candlelight procession and pray the Rosary

tourDays.title: Lourdes to Toulouse to Rocamadour
tourDays.description: Following breakfast, transfer to Toulouse. This southern French city was once a Roman colony home to numerous religious and historical treasures. While here, you will have the opportunity to view many of these rare artifacts, such as twenty historical pipe organs and the original burial place of St. Thomas Aquinas at the St. Sernin Basilica. One of the finest Romanesque churches in France, its exterior is constructed of red brick with white stone as a decorative accent. Following your visit to this magnificent church, continue north to Rocamadour, a town atop a rocky mountain. Upon arrival in Rocamadour, you will enjoy a delicious meal and a restful overnight.
tourDays.activities: Transfer from Lourdes to Toulouse; Visit St. Sernin Basilica in Toulouse; View historical pipe organs and burial place of St. Thomas Aquinas; Continue travel to Rocamadour; Dinner and overnight in Rocamadour

tourDays.title: Rocamadour and Paray Le Monial
tourDays.description: This morning you will awaken in the town overlooking the Alzou Valley which was the home to the early Christian hermit, Zaccheus of Jericho. Zaccheus conversed with Jesus himself and was the husband of St. Veronica, the woman who wiped the face of Jesus as He climbed to Calvary. During your time at this sacred destination, you will visit the Shrine of Our Lady of Rocamadour, a place of miraculous conversion. The Shrine consists of numerous religious structures and chapels centered around a statue of the Virgin Mary and the tomb of Zaccheus. After you visit this place of miraculous healing, your journey will continue to Paray Le Monial for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit the Shrine of Our Lady of Rocamadour; See chapels and religious structures centered around the statue of the Virgin Mary and the tomb of Zaccheus; Travel to Paray Le Monial; Dinner and overnight in Paray Le Monial

tourDays.title: Paray Le Monial to Nevers
tourDays.description: You will begin your day with breakfast. Following Mass, you will have some free time for prayer and reflection. You will then visit the Chapel of the Visitation. It is here that Jesus exposed His Sacred Heart to St. Margaret Mary Alacoque in the seventeenth century. The apparitions allowed St. Margaret to rest her head upon Jesusâ Sacred Heart, during which she experienced Our Lordâs unconditional love for humanity. During your visit to this holy place, you will have the opportunity to view relics of the beloved Saint, located beneath a wax figure of her image. After free time for lunch in Paray Le Monial, we will drive to Nevers through the picturesque Loire Valley. Nevers is where St. Bernadette lived for twelve years as a member of the Congregation of the Sisters of Nevers. The Saint suffered from several illnesses such as asthma, tuberculosis of the lungs, and a tubercular tumor in her right knee. For this, St. Bernadette received âthe Last Sacramentsâ three times and eventually passed away in 1879, at the age of thirty-five. End the day with a visit to the Convent of Saint Gildard. Enjoy a delicious meal before retiring for the evening.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast and Mass; Free time for prayer and reflection; Visit the Chapel of the Visitation; View relics of St. Margaret Mary Alacoque; Free time for lunch in Paray Le Monial; Drive to Nevers through the Loire Valley; Visit the Convent of Saint Gildard; Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Nevers to Chartres to Lisieux
tourDays.description: Upon waking up in Nevers, enjoy breakfast and Mass. Following Mass, you will depart for Chartres. Upon arrival, you will have free time for lunch in the quaint town. This afternoon, visit the massive Cathedral Notre Dame, known worldwide for its incredible stained-glass windows created in the twelfth and thirteenth century. A World Heritage site called the Cathedral âthe high point of French Gothic artâ and a âmasterpieceâ by UNESCO. Continue to Lisieux for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast and Mass in Nevers; Depart for Chartres; Free time for lunch in Chartres; Visit Chartres Cathedral (Cathedral Notre Dame) and view stained-glass windows; Continue to Lisieux; Dinner and overnight in Lisieux

tourDays.title: Normandy Beaches and Mont Saint Michel (day trip from Lisieux)
tourDays.description: This morning you will transfer to the Normandy Landing beaches. The Normandy landings were the landing operations, which took place on June 6, 1944 (termed D-Day) by the Allies during World War II. As the largest seaborne invasion in history, the operation began the liberation of German-occupied northwestern Europe from Nazi control and contributed to the Alliesâ victory on the Western Front. Continue to visit the Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial, a World War II cemetery and memorial in Colleville-Sur-Mer, Normandy, France, honoring the American troops that died in Europe during World War II. Many of the brave American soldiers of World War II were buried here. It is encouraged to say a prayer in thanksgiving for their courage. Next, visit Mont St. Michel, where the Monastery of Le Mont St. Michel is located. The Monastery is called âThe Wonder of the Western Worldâ. The monastery is surrounded by a magnificent bay, which has one of the greatest tidal ranges in Europe, resulting in a breathtaking view. In 709, St. Michael the Archangel, requested that Aubert, Bishop of Avranches, build and consecrate this monastery. Since the ninth century, the Abbey has been home to a monastic community to ensure the continuation of a spiritual presence. For centuries, it has been a pilgrimage site for those seeking Eternal Life with God. You will return to Lisieux for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Normandy Landing beaches; Visit Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial (Colleville-sur-Mer); Say a prayer in thanksgiving; Visit Mont St. Michel and the Monastery (Le Mont St. Michel); Return to Lisieux for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Lisieux: St. Therese sites and transfer to Paris
tourDays.description: After breakfast, you will explore the life of St. Therese. According to Pope Pius X, St. Therese of Lisieux was the âgreatest saint of modern timesâ. Her extraordinary love for God and service to humanity will come alive as you walk in this great Saintâs footsteps. Visit the beautiful Basilica of St. Therese, and see its magnificent mosaics and stained glass. Following your visit to the Basilica, you will have the opportunity to view relics, clothing, and personal objects of St. Therese when you visit her family home, Les Buissonnets. Tour the parish of St. Therese, the Cathedral of St. Peter, and the Carmelite Convent which she entered in 1888, and where she is now buried with her parents. Your tour of the âLittle Flowerâsâ life culminates as you board the bus to transfer to the âCity of Lightsâ: Paris. Upon arrival, enjoy dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Basilica of St. Therese; View relics, clothing, and personal objects at Les Buissonnets; Tour parish of St. Therese and Cathedral of St. Peter; Visit Carmelite Convent where St. Therese entered and is buried; Board bus and transfer to Paris; Dinner and overnight in Paris

tourDays.title: Paris: Miraculous Medal and Notre Dame (plus city highlights)
tourDays.description: We begin our tour of Paris, with our favorite spot Our Lady of Miraculous Medal. After celebrating Holy Mass, we will have the opportunity to view the incorrupt body of St. Catherine Laboure. The Saintâs guardian angel led her to the chapel where the Blessed Virgin Mary appeared to her. During the apparitions, Our Lady repeatedly instructed the making and purpose of the Miraculous Medal. According to the Blessed Virgin Mary, those who wear the Miraculous Medal will receive special protection and abundant graces. Following this prayerful and reflective experience, we will walk to nearby Saint Vincent de Paul Church. We continue our tour of Paris with stop at one of the most incredible churches in the world: Notre Dame Cathedral. The panoramic bus tour will take us to other most recognizable symbols of the city of Paris including the Eiffel Tower, the Invalides, the LâArch de Triomphe, and the Champ-Elysees, the worldâs most famous boulevard. We will stop at La Madeleine, with the statue of Mary Magdalene carried to heaven by angels. Your busy day ends with a lovely meal and a comfortable overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal; Celebrate Holy Mass; View the incorrupt body of St. Catherine LabourÃ©; Walk to Saint Vincent de Paul Church; Visit Notre Dame Cathedral; Panoramic bus tour of Paris (Eiffel Tower, Invalides, L'Arc de Triomphe, Champs-ÃlysÃ©es); Stop at La Madeleine; Dinner and overnight in Paris

tourDays.title: Return Home

tourDays.description: Welcome to Warsaw, Poland! Upon arrival, make your way to the baggage claim area and collect your luggage. Proceed to the Arrivalâs Hall, where you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver. Transfer to your hotel. Following check-in at your hotel, your pilgrimage will officially begin with Mass. Following Mass, enjoy a delicious dinner and have the opportunity to explore the city of Warsaw before retiring for a restful overnight.

tourDays.title: Warsaw
tourDays.description: Your day will begin with breakfast followed by Mass at St. James Church, iconic for its tower and square base. This church is where Helena Kowalska prayed extensively upon entering Warsaw. Also, it is where she confessed all that burdened her soul, and asked for the advice of Rev. James Dabrowski, which eventually resulted in the Saint entering the convent. Following this prayerful morning, your day of sightseeing begins. Your group will explore the Old Town, comprised of beautiful maze-like cobblestone streets and picturesque architecture that are symbols of Polandâs successful rebuild following its destruction during World War II. Some of the sites will include the Market Square (the center of the city filled with restaurants, cafes and shops), the Barbican, defense-like structures that have been rebuilt following World War II, and the Warsaw Ghetto monument that commemorates the Warsaw Ghetto Uprising of 1943 during World War II. You will also take in the Lazienski Park, a beautifully landscaped park, the Chopin Statue (a large bronze statue of musician, Frederic Chopin), and the Royal Castle (the official residence of the Polish monarchs). In the afternoon, visit the Stanislaw Kostka Church and view a special exhibit dedicated to Fr. Jerzy Popieluszko. This priest was a great personality of the Catholic Church, and killed by communists in 1984. In 1987, Saint John Paul II visited here to pray in front of Fr. Popieluzkoâs tomb. Your tour of Warsaw will conclude by returning to the hotel for a delicious meal, followed by an overnight at your hotel.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast; Attend Mass at St. James Church; Sightseeing in Old Town; Visit exhibits at Stanislaw Kostka Church; Return to hotel for dinner

tourDays.title: Warsaw - Niepokalanow - Swinice Warckie - Czestochowa
tourDays.description: This morning, you will enjoy breakfast followed by a transfer to Niepokalanow. This Franciscan Monastery is in the community of Teresin, and was founded by martyr, St. Maximilian Kolbe. Following your visit to this Holy Monastery, transfer to the village of Swinice Warckie. In Swinice Warckie, visit the church of St. Casimir. This historically rich parish is the site of baptism for St. Faustina (formally known as, Helena Kowalska). Little Helena received her first confession, and First Holy Communion, at this parish. Additionally, she and her family attended Sunday Mass and other services at this church. After visiting this simple, yet elegant church, we will continue to Czestochowa. Upon arrival in Czestochowa, you will check-in to your hotel, enjoy a magnificent dinner, and a restful overnight.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast; Transfer to Niepokalanow; Visit Franciscan Monastery; Transfer to Swinice Warckie; Visit Church of St. Casimir; Continue to Czestochowa; Hotel check-in and dinner

tourDays.title: Czestochowa - Wadowice - Krakow
tourDays.description: Today, you will awake in the home of the grandest pilgrimage shrine of Poland since the 14th century! You will begin your day with breakfast and Mass at Jasna Gora Monastery. This hill-top monastery is home to the beloved icon of the Black Madonna. Additionally, Saint John Paul II is said to have made frequent visits to this monastery throughout his life. Tradition tells us that this icon was painted by Luke the Evangelist, discovered by St. Helen, and later enshrined. While here, you will have the opportunity to venerate not only the Holy Icon, but also many other priceless treasures that are contained within. Following your prayerful visit to the Chapel of the Black Madonna, you will continue on to Wadowice, the birthplace of Karol Wojtyla (Saint John Paul II). While in the small city of Wadowice, you will have the opportunity to visit the church where this beloved Saint was baptized, and attended Mass as a child. Following this historically captivating experience, continue on to Krakow. Enjoy dinner at the local restaurant before resting up for the next day of activities.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast; Mass at Jasna Gora Monastery; Venerate the Black Madonna; Visit Wadowice and the baptismal church; Travel to Krakow; Dinner

tourDays.title: Krakow - Zakopane - Krakow
tourDays.description: After breakfast, you will drive through the mountains to the breathtaking, yet small and remote village of Zakopane. Take a cable car ride to the nearby mountaintop. At the top, you will truly experience Godâs magnificent Glory when you look out at the magnificent panoramic view. Following the many photos captured atop the mountain, head to the Jaszczorowka Chapel. This architecturally distinct chapel was visited many times by the young, Karol Wojtyla (Saint John Paul II). As a young boy, Karol Wojtyla often used the walking paths surrounding the Jaszczorowka Chapel for prayer and reflection. After you experience this beautiful site that assisted in Saint John Paul IIâs Holy journey, you will continue your tour to the colorful, Krupowki Street. While on this street, you will have the opportunity to do some shopping at the local bazaar before returning to Krakow. Enjoy a beautiful dinner and an optional stroll through the old city before retiring for the evening.
tourDays.activities: Drive through mountains to Zakopane; Take cable car to mountaintop; Visit Jaszczorowka Chapel; Walk and pray on surrounding paths; Shop on Krupowki Street; Return to Krakow for dinner

tourDays.title: Krakow - Auschwitz - Krakow
tourDays.description: After breakfast, you will explore Krakowâs Market Square as the sound of the silver trumpet from St. Maryâs Tower fills the air. The captivating beauty of this square is largely due to the fact that it has remained unchanged for almost 700 years. It contains a number of buildings that hold important historic value such as, the Town Hall Tower, the Cloth Hall, and the Burgherâs houses. Following your time in this longstanding square, you will make your way to Wawel Hill, where you will visit the beautiful Cathedral, and Coronation Chapel. These are among the most important sites in Poland as the Cathedral has been the coronation site of the Polish monarchs and has held numerous pieces of Gothic, Renaissance, Baroque, Classicist and Modern art. Also at this site, you will have the opportunity to pray at the tomb of the patron saint of Poland, St. Stanislaus. Next, a short drive to Auschwitz, notoriously known as a Nazi concentration camp during the Second World War. Upon arriving at the former camp, you can feel the darkness and sorrow that overtakes the atmosphere as there were numerous unspeakable atrocities that occurred at this site. Additionally, while on this visit, you will have the opportunity to view the cell that imprisoned the Christ-like, St. Maximilian Kolbe, and visit the Martyrdom Museum. After this reflective day, return to your hotel in Krakow for dinner and a restful overnight.
tourDays.activities: Explore Market Square; Visit Wawel Hill and Cathedral; Pray at the tomb of St. Stanislaus; Visit Auschwitz and Martyrdom Museum; Return to hotel for dinner

tourDays.title: Krakow - Lagiewniki - Wieliczka - Krakow
tourDays.description: On your last day of touring, after breakfast depart for your excursion to Lagiewniki, the capital of the Divine Mercy. Through the mediation of St. Faustina, Christ passed on the message of Divine Mercy at Lagiewniki. While here, you will have the opportunity to visit the Shrine of Divine Mercy that contains images of the Merciful Jesus, relics of St. Faustina, as well as, the Saintâs convent chapel and her Tomb. Visit and celebrate Mass at the Shrine of Divinity, which was visited by Saint John Paul II in 2002. Following Mass, have the opportunity to pray by a relic of Saint John Paul II. Continue to Wieliczka and visit Europeâs oldest salt mine, which has been listed by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site. Return to Krakow for your farewell dinner and last overnight in Poland.
tourDays.activities: Visit Shrine of Divine Mercy; Celebrate Mass at the shrine; Pray by a relic of Saint John Paul II; Visit Wieliczka Salt Mine; Farewell dinner in Krakow

tourDays.title: Prague
tourDays.description: After breakfast, make your way to the Church of Our Lady Victorious, home of the famous Child Jesus statue called the Infant Jesus of Prague. The statue, a 16th-century depiction of infant Jesus holding a globus cruciger, (an orb and cross), was donated to the Carmelite friars in 1628. Following Mass, enjoy a walking tour of Old Town Prague. Walk along the Royal Route to the Old Town Square. In beautiful Pragueâs Castle district, visit St. Nicholas Church, St. Vitus Cathedral, St. George Basilica, Loreto Church and Strahov Monastery. Continue along Karlova Street to Charles Bridge crossing the Vltava River adorned with many baroque statues. Enjoy breathtaking view of the magical Prague Castle. View the Astronomical Clock of Prague and walk on Wenceslas Square, one of the main city squares. The square is named after Saint Wenceslas, the patron saint of Bohemia. It is part of the historic center of Prague, a World Heritage Site. Return to the hotel for dinner and a restful overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Church of Our Lady Victorious; Attend Mass; Walking tour of Old Town and Royal Route; Visit multiple churches and monasteries; Walk Charles Bridge and view Prague Castle; See Astronomical Clock and Wenceslas Square

tourDays.title: Prague - Altotting - Salzburg
tourDays.description: Following breakfast we will depart Prague for Altotting, one of Germanyâs most celebrated shrines and a city whose purpose is pilgrimage. Upon arrival celebrate Mass at the center of the pilgrimage complex, the Chapel of Mercy. The chapel houses a 13th century statue of the Blessed Virgin to which numerous miraculous cures are credited. At the Shrines, you will have the opportunity to visit the Basilica, the Panorama of the Crucifixion and St. Konradâs Monastery. We will continue to Salzburg, the lovely birthplace of famed composer Mozart. Salzburg, also known as âAlt Stadtâ, is known for its beautiful baroque architecture and its amazing views of the Eastern Alps. Free time before dinner and an overnight in Salzburg.
tourDays.activities: Travel from Prague to Altotting; Celebrate Mass at Chapel of Mercy; Visit Basilica, Panorama of the Crucifixion, and St. Konradâs Monastery; Continue to Salzburg; Free time and dinner

tourDays.title: Salzburg
tourDays.description: After breakfast, your full day tour begins with Mass at St. Peterâs Abbey. Following Mass, explore the historic center of Salzburg on foot. Its narrow streets and secluded passageways are evidence of its medieval roots. The heritage of the Catholic Church is evident in the Archbishopâs Residence at DomPlatz. Visit Mirabell Palace with its beautiful gardens. Mirabell Palace, is one of the most important shooting locations from the famous Hollywood musical âThe Sound of Musicâ â Maria and the children dance around the Pegasus Fountain in front of the palace, singing the song âDo Re Miâ. Experience the unique views across Mirabell Gardens towards the Hohen Salzburg Castle. You will have a chance to visit the mighty Romanesque Cathedral as well as the Nonnberg Convent of Benedictine nuns. In the Getreidegasse, view Mozartâs birthplace, now one of the most visited museums in Austria. Make a stop at Hellbrunn Palace to enjoy its gardens and hidden trick fountains. Enjoy a delicious dinner before retiring for the evening.
tourDays.activities: Mass at St. Peterâs Abbey; Walking tour of Salzburg historic center; Visit Mirabell Palace and gardens; View Hohen Salzburg Castle; Visit Romanesque Cathedral and Nonnberg Convent; See Mozart's birthplace (museum); Stop at Hellbrunn Palace

tourDays.title: Salzburg â Mariazell â Melk - Vienna
tourDays.description: After breakfast, board the motor coach and travel east through the mountain of Austria to Mariazell, the most important pilgrimage place in Austria. Visit the Mariazell Basilica, also known as Basilica MariÃ¤ Geburt (Basilica of the Birth of the Virgin Mary). Mariazell Basilica is a Marian basilica, which holds the miraculous statue, housed in the Lady Chapel or Chapel of Miracles, built directly over the place where Magnus established his monastic cell in 1157. Continue to Melk, which is best known as the site of a massive baroque Benedictine monastery named Melk Abbey. Overlooking the Danube River, the Abbey, holds the tomb of Saint Coloman of Stockerau and the remains of several members of the House of Babenberg, Austriaâs first ruling dynasty. Enjoy free time in the lovely town of Melk before continuing to Vienna, Austriaâs capital for dinner and a restful overnight.
tourDays.activities: Board motor coach and travel to Mariazell; Visit Mariazell Basilica and Lady Chapel; Continue to Melk and visit Melk Abbey; Free time in Melk; Travel to Vienna for dinner

tourDays.title: Vienna
tourDays.description: After breakfast, enjoy a sightseeing tour of Vienna, home of Johann Strauss and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. Visit the spectacular St. Stephenâs cathedral, the symbol of Vienna. Construction commenced in the 12th century. Today, it is one of the most important Gothic structures in Austria. At St. Stephenâs, see the miraculous image of Our Lady of Mariapoch and tour the Cathedral and its catacombs. Those brave enough may climb the 343 steps to the top of the Cathedral spire. Continue with a visit of the Schonbrunn Royal palace, a summer residence with 1,441 rooms including a Hall of Mirrors where Mozart performed at the age of six before a young Marie Antoinette Louis. Schonbrunn Palace was put on the list of UNESCO World Cultural Heritage Sites in December 1996. Continue your journey in Vienna and view the Belvedere Palace, well known for its beautiful gardens. Back in the city center, go to Karlsplatz with its Church of St. Charles Borromeo and Otto Wagnerâs Stadtbahn pavilions. Somewhere along the way, have a little coffee break to enjoy the famous Vienna pastries such as Sacher cake. Dinner and an overnight in Vienna.
tourDays.activities: Sightseeing tour of Vienna; Visit St. Stephenâs Cathedral and catacombs; Optional climb of cathedral spire; Visit Schonbrunn Palace; View Belvedere Palace and gardens; Visit Karlsplatz and Church of St. Charles Borromeo; Coffee break (Vienna pastries)
