tourDays.description: Walk a few miles of El Camino. Celebrate the International Pilgrimsâ Mass at the Cathedral of St. James. Free time for lunch, visit the Cathedral (including the crypt with relics of St. James) and enjoy a sightseeing tour of the city (Obradoiro Square, Fonseca Palace, Gelmirez Palace, Franco Street). Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Walk a section of El Camino; Attend International Pilgrimsâ Mass; Visit Cathedral of St. James and descend to the crypt; Sightseeing tour of Santiago de Compostela

tourDays.title: Santiago de Compostela - Lisbon
tourDays.description: Travel from Santiago de Compostela to Lisbon. Transfer to hotel in time for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Lisbon; Transfer to hotel

tourDays.title: Lisbon - Santarem â Fatima
tourDays.description: Travel north to Santarem. Visit and attend Mass at the Church of St. Stephen (site of a 13th-century Eucharistic Miracle). Then depart to Fatima, visiting the hamlet of Aljustrel, the Parish Church and the Fatima Parish Cemetery before hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Santarem; Attend Mass at Church of St. Stephen; Visit Aljustrel, Parish Church and Fatima Parish Cemetery; Travel to Fatima

tourDays.title: Fatima
tourDays.description: Visit the Little Chapel of the Apparitions, the Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary (tombs of St. Francisco, St. Jacinta, Sister Lucia), the "Fatima: Light and Peace" museum, and the Holy Trinity Basilica. In the afternoon walk the Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra, visit Valinhos. Evening private devotions and a candlelight procession. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Little Chapel of the Apparitions; Visit Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary and tombs; Visit Fatima museum; Visit Holy Trinity Basilica; Participate in Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra; Visit Valinhos; Private devotions and candlelight procession

tourDays.title: Lisbon - Medjugorje
tourDays.description: Depart from Lisbon for flights to Medjugorje. Upon arrival transfer by coach (about 2.5 hours) to the village of Medjugorje. Dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Medjugorje (Day 1 of stay)
tourDays.description: Stay in Medjugorje with a local guide. Opportunities include Daily Mass (English-speaking) at St. James Church, climbing Apparition Hill and Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain), attending evening commemorations of alleged apparitions, adoration, visiting the Community of Cenacolo, and prayer at the Statue of the Risen Christ.
tourDays.activities: Attend Daily Mass at St. James Church; Climb Apparition Hill (recite the Rosary while climbing); Climb Mt. Krizevac / Cross Mountain (pray Stations of the Cross while climbing); Attend evening apparitions/commemoration and Rosary; Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament (when scheduled); Visit Community of Cenacolo; Prayer at Statue of the Risen Christ

tourDays.title: Medjugorje (Day 2 of stay)
tourDays.description: Continued stay in Medjugorje with same opportunities: Daily Mass, climbing Apparition Hill and Mt. Krizevac, attending evening commemorations, adoration, visiting Community of Cenacolo, and prayer at the Statue of the Risen Christ.
tourDays.activities: Attend Daily Mass at St. James Church; Climb Apparition Hill; Climb Mt. Krizevac / Cross Mountain; Attend evening apparitions/commemoration and Rosary; Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament; Visit Community of Cenacolo; Prayer at Statue of the Risen Christ

tourDays.title: Medjugorje (Day 3 of stay)
tourDays.description: Final full day in Medjugorje with opportunities for Mass, hill climbs, adoration, visits to Cenacolo, prayer at the Risen Christ statue, and evening apparitions/commemorations.
tourDays.activities: Attend Daily Mass at St. James Church; Climb Apparition Hill; Climb Mt. Krizevac / Cross Mountain; Attend evening apparitions/commemoration and Rosary; Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament; Visit Community of Cenacolo; Prayer at Statue of the Risen Christ

tourDays.title: Return Home

tourDays.title: Arrival in Thessaloniki
tourDays.description: Arrive at Makedonia Thessaloniki Airport, collect luggage, meet the tour guide/driver in Arrivals Hall, transfer to the hotel, check in, relax, dinner and overnight in Thessaloniki.
tourDays.activities: Arrive at Makedonia Thessaloniki Airport; Baggage claim and meet guide/driver; Transfer to hotel; Hotel check-in and relax; Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Visit Philippi and Kavala; return to Thessaloniki
tourDays.description: After breakfast visit Philippi (site of Paul's first sermon and Lydia's baptism): Roman Forum, view the prison ruins. Continue to the port city of Kavala (ancient Neapolis) where Paul, Silas, Luke and Timothy landed. Return to Thessaloniki for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast at hotel; Visit Roman Forum in Philippi; View prison ruins associated with Paul and Silas; Sightseeing in Kavala (port/Neapolis); Return to Thessaloniki, dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Thessaloniki city tour and transfer to Kalambaka
tourDays.description: Breakfast, Thessaloniki city tour including ancient artifacts such as the triumphal Arch of Galerius on Via Egnatia. Following the city tour transfer to Kalambaka for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast at hotel; Thessaloniki city tour (including Arch of Galerius); Transfer to Kalambaka; Dinner and overnight in Kalambaka

tourDays.title: Visit Meteora Monasteries; travel to Delphi
tourDays.description: After breakfast drive to the Meteora Monasteries to visit monastic sites, view Byzantine art and surrounding scenery. Continue on to Delphi for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast at hotel; Visit Meteora Monasteries; View Byzantine art and scenery; Drive to Delphi; Dinner and overnight in Delphi

tourDays.title: Visit Delphi and transfer to Athens
tourDays.description: Visit the archaeological site of Delphi and the Delphi museum on the slopes of Mount Parnassus. Continue to Athens; dinner and overnight in Athens.
tourDays.activities: Visit Sanctuary of Apollo at Delphi (site); Visit Delphi museum; Transfer to Athens; Dinner and overnight in Athens

tourDays.title: Athens sightseeing and excursion to ancient Corinth
tourDays.description: After breakfast tour Athens: Acropolis (Parthenon, Erechtheum, Propylae), Mars Hill (where Paul spoke), the ancient Agora, drive by Syntagma Square (House of Parliament), University of Athens, National Library, and Panathenaic Stadium. Then proceed to ancient Corinth to see first-century shops, the site of Paul's trial by Gallio, the Fountain of Peirene, and the Temple of Apollo. Return to Athens for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast at hotel; Visit Acropolis (Parthenon, Erechtheum, Propylae); Ascend Mars Hill (Areopagus); Visit Ancient Agora; Drive-by sights: Syntagma Square/Parliament, University, National Library; Visit Panathenaic Stadium; Excursion to ancient Corinth (first-century shops, Gallio trial site, Fountain of Peirene, Temple of Apollo); Return to Athens, dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Return to USA
tourDays.description: After breakfast depart to Athens airport for return flights to the USA.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast at hotel; Transfer to Athens airport; Depart on return flights to the USA

tourDays.title: Depart USA
tourDays.description: Depart the United States for the pilgrimage.
tourDays.activities: Depart USA (international flight)

tourDays.title: Arrive Amman; Madaba & Mount Nebo; drive to Petra
tourDays.description: Early morning arrival in Amman. Visit Madaba to see the ancient mosaic map and Mount Nebo where Moses viewed the Promised Land and remains of a Byzantine church. Drive south to Petra for overnight.
tourDays.activities: Arrive Amman; Breakfast stop; Visit Madaba (mosaic map); Visit Mount Nebo and Byzantine church remains; Drive to Petra; overnight in Petra

tourDays.title: Petra - Dead Sea
tourDays.description: Morning tour of Petra including the siq and the Treasury, then drive to the Dead Sea for an overnight on its shores.
tourDays.activities: Tour Petra (walk through the siq, visit the Treasury, Roman theatre, Corinthian Tomb, Palace Tomb); Drive to the Dead Sea; Overnight on the Dead Sea

tourDays.title: Cross Allenby Bridge; Stella Maris; Mukhraka; Galilee/Nazareth
tourDays.description: Cross the Allenby Bridge into the Holy Land, visit Stella Maris in Haifa and celebrate Mass, enjoy the view of the bay of Acco, visit Mukhraka, and end the day at the hotel in Nazareth or on the Sea of Galilee.
tourDays.activities: Cross Allenby Bridge into Israel; Visit Stella Maris (Carmelite Monastery) in Haifa; Celebrate Mass at Stella Maris; View the bay of Acco; Visit Mukhraka Monastery; Transfer to hotel in Nazareth or Sea of Galilee

tourDays.title: Nazareth - Cana - Mount Tabor (Theme: The Annunciation)
tourDays.description: Visit Nazareth and celebrate Mass in the Basilica of the Annunciation; see the Byzantine Church of St. Joseph, Mary's Well, and the International Centre of Mary. In the afternoon visit Cana (opportunity for renewal of wedding vows) and Mount Tabor, then return to the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Nazareth; Celebrate Mass in the Basilica of the Annunciation; Visit Byzantine Church of St. Joseph and Mary's Well; Visit International Centre of Mary; Visit Cana and Franciscan chapel (wedding vow renewal opportunity); Visit Mount Tabor (Transfiguration site); Return to hotel

tourDays.title: Tiberias: Sea of Galilee - Banias (Theme: The Ministry of Christ in the Galilee)
tourDays.description: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee, visit the Mount of Beatitudes, Tabgha, Peter's Primacy, enjoy St. Peter fish for lunch, visit Capernaum (synagogue and site of Peter's home) and celebrate Mass, then visit Caesarea Philippi/Banias (source of the Jordan). Return to the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee; Visit Mount of Beatitudes; Visit Tabgha; Visit Peter's Primacy; Lunch (St. Peter fish); Visit Capernaum (synagogue and church over Peter's house); Celebrate Mass in Capernaum; Visit Caesarea Philippi / Banias (source of River Jordan); Return to hotel

tourDays.title: Samaria - Jerusalem
tourDays.description: Leave Galilee, visit Jacob's Well in Samaria, go to Sebastia for lunch and exploration, travel through the Levonah Valley passing Shiloh, and arrive in Jerusalem.
tourDays.activities: Depart Galilee; Visit Jacob's Well; Visit Sebastia and have a local lunch; Explore archaeological remains at Sebastia; Drive through Levonah Valley and pass Shiloh; Transfer to Jerusalem

tourDays.title: Ein Karem - Bethlehem (Theme: The Visitation and Nativity)
tourDays.description: Visit Ein Karem (birthplace of John the Baptist), pray the Rosary on the walk to the Church of the Visitation, then drive to Bethlehem to see the Shepherds' Field caves, visit Manger Square and the Church of the Nativity and descend to the Grotto of the Nativity. Attend Mass at the Church of St. Catherine and return to the hotel in Jerusalem.
tourDays.activities: Visit Ein Karem and Church of the Visitation; Pray the Mystery of the Rosary; Lunch on own; Visit Shepherds' Field caves; Visit Manger Square and Church of the Nativity; Descend to the Grotto of the Nativity; Attend Mass at Church of St. Catherine; Return to Jerusalem hotel

tourDays.title: Bethany - Jericho - Qumran - Dead Sea - Jordan River (Theme: The Wilderness)
tourDays.description: Begin with Mass at Bethany, drive through the Judean Wilderness, stop at Jericho to view the Mount of Temptation and a sycamore tree, visit Qumran (site of the Essene community and Dead Sea Scrolls), and have time for a swim in the Dead Sea before returning to the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass at Bethany; Drive through the Judean Wilderness; Visit Jericho (view Mount of Temptation and sycamore tree); Visit Qumran (essene remains / Dead Sea Scrolls site); Swim in the Dead Sea; Return to hotel

tourDays.title: Mount of Olives - Gethsemane - Mount Zion (Theme: Palm Sunday and the Agony in the Garden)
tourDays.description: Take in the panoramic view from the Mount of Olives, visit the Pater Noster shrine, walk Palm Sunday Road to Dominus Flevit, reflect in Gethsemane and pray at the Church of All Nations' 'Rock of Agony', follow the route through the Kidron Valley to Peter in Gallicantu and celebrate Mass there, then visit Mount Zion's Upper Room and the Benedictine Church of the Dormition.
tourDays.activities: Panoramic view from Mount of Olives; Visit Pater Noster shrine; Walk Palm Sunday Road; visit Dominus Flevit; Visit Gethsemane and Church of All Nations; pray at Rock of Agony; Follow route through Kidron Valley; Visit Peter in Gallicantu; celebrate Mass; Visit Mount Zion (Upper Room) and Benedictine Church of the Dormition

tourDays.title: Via Dolorosa - High Mass at the Holy Sepulchre (Theme: The Way of the Cross, The Crucifixion, The Resurrection)
tourDays.description: Begin the Via Dolorosa at the Antonia Fortress, follow the Stations of the Cross through the Old City to the Church of the Holy Sepulchre, attend High Mass at the Tomb of Christ, then revisit the Old City to see the Pool of Bethesda, St. Anne's Church, the Western Wall, walk through the Jewish Quarter and see the Roman Cardo. Afternoon free for exploration and shopping.
tourDays.activities: Start Via Dolorosa at Antonia Fortress and follow the Stations of the Cross; Attend High Mass at the Tomb of Christ in the Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Visit Pool of Bethesda, St. Anne's Church, and Western Wall; Walk through the Jewish Quarter and see the Roman Cardo; Free afternoon for exploration and shopping

tourDays.title: Modern Jerusalem - Emmaus (Abou Ghosh)
tourDays.description: Visit the Israel Museum (Model of Jerusalem) and the Shrine of the Book to see the Dead Sea Scrolls; optional visit to Yad Vashem. In the afternoon visit Abou Ghosh (probable Emmaus), its Crusader church and gardens, then return to the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Visit Israel Museum (Model of Jerusalem); Visit Shrine of the Book (Dead Sea Scrolls); Optional visit to Yad Vashem Holocaust Memorial; Visit Abou Ghosh (Emmaus), Crusader church and gardens; Return to hotel

tourDays.title: The Elah Valley - Beit Jemal Monastery
tourDays.description: Drive through the Elah Valley to Beit Guvrin to see underground caves and remains, then visit the Monastery of Beit Jemal which commemorates St. Stephen and celebrate Mass by the remains of the 5th-century church; visit the monastery store.
tourDays.activities: Drive through the Elah Valley to Beit Guvrin; Explore underground caves at Beit Guvrin; Visit Beit Jemal Monastery; Celebrate Mass by remains of the 5th-century church; Visit monastery store / meet nuns

tourDays.title: Jerash - Amman - Departure
tourDays.description: Cross back to Jordan to visit the Baptismal site of Bethany Beyond the Jordan, tour the Roman ruins at Jerash, drive to Amman for a city tour of the Citadel and Roman theatre, enjoy a farewell dinner, then transfer to the airport for late-night departure.
tourDays.activities: Visit Bethany Beyond the Jordan (Baptismal site); Tour Roman ruins at Jerash; Drive to Amman; visit Amman Citadel and Roman theatre; Farewell dinner; Transfer to airport and depart

tourDays.title: Depart for Lisbon
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport and board overnight flight(s) to Lisbon. Meals served on board.

tourDays.description: Arrive at Lisbon Airport, meet your tour guide/driver and group. Afternoon panoramic sightseeing of Lisbon including stops at St. Jeromeâs Monastery, the Belem Quarter/Belem Tower, and St. Anthonyâs Church where Mass is celebrated. Transfer to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Panoramic sightseeing tour; Visit St. Jeromeâs Monastery; Drive by Belem Quarter/Belem Tower; Visit St. Anthonyâs Church; Celebrate Mass

tourDays.title: Lisbon - Santarem - Fatima
tourDays.description: Travel north to Santarem for Mass at the Church of St. Stephen (site of a 13th-century Eucharistic Miracle). Continue to Fatima to visit the hamlet of Aljustrel, the parish church and Fatima parish cemetery. Dinner and overnight in Fatima.
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass at Church of St. Stephen; Visit Aljustrel (hamlet); Visit parish church and cemetery in Fatima

tourDays.description: Full day in Fatima: visit the Little Chapel of the Apparitions, Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary (tombs of the visionaries), the "Fatima: Light and Peace" museum, Holy Trinity Basilica, walk the Via Sacra (Stations of the Cross), visit Valinhos; conclude with private devotions and a candlelight procession.
tourDays.activities: Visit Little Chapel of the Apparitions; Visit Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary; Visit museum exhibition; Visit Holy Trinity Basilica; Pray Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra; Participate in private devotions and candlelight procession

tourDays.title: Fatima - Salamanca
tourDays.description: Depart Fatima after breakfast and transfer to Salamanca. Walking tour of Salamanca visiting Plaza Mayor, La Clerecia, Casa de las Conchas, University of Salamanca, Roman Bridge, Iglesia de San Marcos, Iglesia de San Martin, and the old and new Salamanca Cathedrals. Dinner and overnight in Salamanca.

Continue to Avila to see the medieval walls, Cathedral de Avila, Basilica de San Vicente and the Incarnation Convent. Continue to Burgos for dinner and overnight; evening free to explore Burgos Cathedral.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass at Carmelite Monastery in Alba de Tormes; Visit St. Teresa museum and relics; Sightseeing in Avila (city walls, Cathedral, Basilica de San Vicente, Incarnation Convent); Travel to Burgos and visit Burgos Cathedral

tourDays.activities: Visit Loyola: Basilica, Holy House (birthplace of St. Ignatius); Pray in venerated room associated with St. Ignatius; Travel to Lourdes

tourDays.title: Lourdes (day 1)
tourDays.description: Begin first day in Lourdes: participate in prayer and devotion at the sites of Our Ladyâs apparitions, attend Mass at the Grotto, view a video on Lourdes, and experience the miraculous spring and baths. Evening candlelight procession and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass at the Grotto of Massabielle; Watch Lourdes video presentation; Drink from and wash with spring water; Visit baths (optional); Attend evening candlelight procession

tourDays.title: Lourdes (day 2)
tourDays.description: Second day in Lourdes to continue prayerful visits: meditate at the Stations of the Cross overlooking the Grotto, visit Boly Mill and the Cachot, attend candlelight procession and other devotional opportunities. Overnight in Lourdes.
tourDays.activities: Meditate on life-size Stations of the Cross; Visit Boly Mill (birthplace of St. Bernadette); Visit the Cachot (familyâs former dwelling); Attend evening candlelight procession

tourDays.title: Lourdes - Paris - Lisieux (St. Therese)
tourDays.description: Breakfast then transfer to Pau or Lourdes Airport for a short flight to Paris and continue to Lisieux. Visit the Basilica of St. Therese, Les Buissonnets (family home) and the Carmelite Convent where St. Therese is buried. Dinner and overnight in Lisieux.

tourDays.description: Celebrate Mass in Lisieux then travel to the Normandy landing beaches. Visit the Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial in Colleville-sur-Mer and pray in thanksgiving for the fallen. Return to Lisieux for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.description: Early breakfast and depart for Chartres to visit Cathedral Notre Dame, view stained-glass windows and venerate the Veil of Our Lady. Free time for lunch in Chartres before continuing to Paris to check in, then dinner and overnight.

Krizevac / Cross Mountain (pray Stations of the Cross while climbing); Attend evening apparition prayer/gathering at St. James Church or Apparition Hill; Visit Community Cenacolo; Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament (on specified days); Prayer at the Statue of the Risen Christ

Depart for Greece
Make your way to your local airport where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served on board.

tourDays.title: Day 2
tourDays.description: Arrive Thessaloniki Upon landing at Makedonia Thessaloniki Airport, make your way to the baggage claim area and collect your luggage. Proceed to the Arrivalâs Hall, where you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver. You will be escorted to the bus to be transferred to your hotel. Enjoy some time to relax after check in and this evening enjoy a delicious meal. Overnight in Thessaloniki.

tourDays.title: Day 3
tourDays.description: Philippi - Kavala - Thessaloniki After breakfast, start your journey in Greece with the first stop of the day in Philippi. Philippi was the city where Saint Paul the Apostle delivered his first sermon and where he established the first church in Europe. âAnd from there (He went) to Philippi, which is the leading city of the district of Macedonia and a Roman Colony. We remained in this city some daysâ¦â (Acts 16:12-18). Also, it is the site where Saint Paul baptized a woman named Lydia, the first convert to Christianity in Europe. Visit the Roman Forum, where Saint Paul cast a spirit out of a fortune-telling woman. While here, you will have the opportunity to view the prison (now in ruins) in which Saint Paul and Silas were thrown into by the owners of the fortune-tellers. Continue to the modern port city of Kavala, which was once the ancient Neapolis. This port is where Saint Paul, Silas, Luke and Timothy landed when they sailed into Europe. After enjoying this city by the sea, return to Thessaloniki for a delicious meal and restful overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 4
tourDays.description: Thessaloniki City Tour - Kalambaka Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. In the winter of 49-50 A.D., Saint Paul wrote two epistles to the Thessalonians. These letters urged Christians to âlive blamelesslyâ and to refrain from living idly while they wait for the second coming of Christ. While in Thessaloniki, you will witness a number of ancient artifacts, such as the triumphal Arch of Galerius that is found at the start of Via Egnatia. Due to the convenient location, this arch was once a strategic artery of the Roman Empire. It was originally constructed in order to honor the Roman Emperor Galerius following the Roman victory over the Persians. Following your city-tour, transfer to Kalambaka. This evening, you will have a wonderful meal and a relaxing overnight in Kalambaka.

tourDays.title: Day 5
tourDays.description: Meteora - Delphi After breakfast, you will go for a short drive to the Meteora Monasteries. In the eleventh century, there were monks who settled within caves. However, as the occupation of the Turkish increased, the monks were forced to move their settlements higher upon the rocks until they were unreachable by any opposing enemy. These settlements became Monasteries by bringing building, and living, materials by ladders and baskets. The Meteora Monasteries are notorious for preserving not only the Hellenic religion, but also, their academics and arts. During your visit, you will be able to view stunning Byzantine art, as well as the breathtaking scenery that surrounds the Monastery. Continue to Delphi for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 6
tourDays.description: Delphi - Athens Visit Delphi, the center of the ancient world (navel) of the earth, whose prestige extended far beyond the boundaries of the Hellenic world. On the slopes of Mount Parnassus, in a landscape of unparalleled beauty and majesty, lie the ruins of the Sanctuary of Apollo Phthios. Visit the site and the museum and continue to Athens, âMen of Athens, I perceive that in every way you are religious. For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I found also an altar with this inscription âto an unknown Godâ. What therefore you worship as unknown, this I proclaim to youâ¦â Athens is one of the most glorious cities in the world and the cradle of western civilization as we know it today. Dinner and an overnight at your hotel in Athens.

tourDays.title: Day 7
tourDays.description: Athens - Excursion to Corinth After a nice breakfast at the hotel, you will start with a tour of the oldest city in the world, Athens! Visit the rock that has dominated the panorama of Athens for twenty-five centuries, the Acropolis. At the Acropolis, you will see the ruins of the Parthenon, Erectheum, and Propylae. After, you will ascend Mars Hill of where Saint Paul spoke to the Athenians. At this site, Paul spoke to the Athenians about the one and only God (Acts 17:22). While in this city, you will be able to view the ancient Agora, the former public center of Athenian life. It held the focus of a political, commercial, social, religious, and cultural center. As you are in the former political center, proceed for a drive through the city to view the House of Parliament on Syntagma Square. Also, you will have the opportunity to view the University of Athens, the oldest higher education institute in Greece, as well as, the National Library of Greece that holds 4,500 Greek manuscripts. Then, visit Panathenaic Stadium, the beautifully marbled multi-purpose stadium. It is home to the Olympian Zeus, and is the site of the first modern era Olympics (1896). Following your visit in Athens, you will proceed to the ancient Corinth. Under the shadow of the towering Acropolis, Saint Paul lived in Corinth for two years. While here, Saint Paul felt great grief over the way that the Gentile Church in Corinth has become. As a result, he was prompted to write four letters, all with the overarching theme of love. In Corinth, you will have the opportunity to view the remains of the first century shops, the site of Saint Paulâs trial by Gallio, the Fountain of Peirene, and the Temple of Apollo. Following your visit to Corinth, return to Athens for a delicious meal and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 8
tourDays.description: Athens - Start 3-day Cruise (Celestyal Cruises Cruise Line) to Mykonos Following breakfast, you will proceed to the Piraeus port where you will board your 3-day cruise. Your first stop will be the Island of Mykonos, the most cosmopolitan of the Greek islands that attracts visitors from all over the world. After docking, transfer to Hora, the islandâs capital. Upon arrival in Hora, you will enjoy a walking tour that will take you on the narrow cobbled streets of the city. Pass by chic boutiques, elegant nightclubs, and white washed houses to arrive in Alefkandra. This section of Mykonos is known as the âVenice of Mykonosâ, as the homes have wooden balconies and are built on the sea. Historically, these homes were of the wealthy merchants and captains. Return to the cruise ship for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 9
tourDays.description: Kusadasi - Ephesus (Mary's House) - Patmos After breakfast on board, arrive at the lively Turkish port of Kusadasi. Transfer to the small village of Mt. Koressos. While in this village, you will visit the small stone chapel that is situated upon the site where the Virgin Mary spent her last days following Christâs crucifixion. Following this visit, your group will walk through the Magnesian Gate to the ancient Ephesus. Begin your walking tour, which will take you through the most magnificent excavations in the world. Some of the sites include the Odeon (concert hall), the Fountain of Trajan, the steam-heated Baths of Scolastika, the Temple of Hadrian and the Latrians, and the Library of Celsus. The last stop on the walking tour is the Great Theatre, the largest ancient theatre that had a capacity of 25,000 people and is a site where Saint Paul preached. On the return of your walking tour, follow the exact route that Mark Anthony and Cleopatra once rode in procession via the Arcadian Way. This main street runs from the Great Theatre to the main cityâs harbor. On your transfer back to Kusadasi, you will have the opportunity to view the Basilica of Saint John. In the sixth century, Emperor Justinian erected this structure over the grave of the evangelist, John. Upon arrival in Kusadasi, enjoy free time to explore on your own before returning to the ship. When you embark on the ship, your journey will continue to Patmos, where you will transfer to the village of Chora. While in this islandâs capital, visit the monastery of Saint John the Theologian. This marvelous structure was built nine-hundred years ago, and continues to be supported by the walls of a strong fortification. In addition to the stunning main church that contains outstanding frescoes, you will have the opportunity to view the beautiful courtyard, dining room, and the bakery. Your tour continues to the small museum, where you will view priceless ecclesiastical treasures such as books, manuscripts, mosaics, icons, textiles, vestments, and jewelry. Board the bus, which will take you to the Monastery and Grotto of the Apocalypse. In this grotto, experience a once in a lifetime opportunity to view the site of where the Book of Revelations was written. The silver niches in the wall mark the pillow and ledge that were used as a desk by the author of the Book. Additionally, view the three-fold crack made by the voice of God who emphasized the importance of honoring the Holy Trinity. Your day will culminate with a transfer to the port of Scala. While in this quaint and picturesque harbor, you will enjoy free time before returning to the ship.

tourDays.title: Day 10
tourDays.description: Heraklion - Santorini This morning you will awaken and transfer to the largest city on the island of Crete, Heraklion. While in this administrative capital, visit the ancient ruins of the Palace of Knossos. These ruins were discovered in 1899, and the palace is currently partially reconstructed. This ancient palace is believed to have been the mythical Labyrinth of King Minos and the seat of ancient Minoan culture. Additionally, it is the site where Saint Paul met the owner and captain of the ship who warned him of continuing his journey to spread Christianity in Rome. Following this historical visit, you will embark the ship that will take you to the idyllic island of Santorini. Santorini is definitively the most breathtaking island of all of the Greek Islands. Upon arrival in Santorini, visit Thira with its iconic white-washed houses, narrow streets, open-air cafes, and glittering boutiques that cling to steep cliffs. This evening you will return to the ship for your last dinner and overnight on your cruise. (for sailings between late October to late March, the cruise line may use a winter schedule that does not include disembarkation on the Island of Crete, spending the entire day on Santorini)

tourDays.title: Day 11
tourDays.description: Piraeus - Athens â Tel Aviv Today marks the end of your cruise. After disembarkation you will be transferred to Athens airport where you will board your flight to Tel Aviv. Upon arrival in Tel Aviv, you will be met by the 206 Tours representative and transfer to your hotel in the Tel Aviv area. Dinner will be served at the hotel.

tourDays.title: Day 12
tourDays.description: Tel Aviv - Caesarea - Nazareth - Cana - Tiberias Theme: The Annunciation This morning we will depart Tel Aviv to Caesarea Maritima, located on the shores of the Mediterranean. Built by Herod the Great, Caesarea was where St. Peter baptized the first gentile convert, Cornelius (Acts 10). We will see the Roman theatre, Herodâs Palace, view the Hippodrome, and the harbor from which St. Paul sailed on his journeys to spread the Gospel of Jesus Christ throughout the ancient world. Continue to Nazareth to visit the museum and archaeological Garden, which contain remains of Nazareth at the time of Christ. Visit the museum and archaeological Garden where we can see the remains of Nazareth at the time of Christ, as well as St. Josephâs workshop â which is now known as St. Josephâs Church. Within the Church of the Annunciation, you will make your way down to the Grotto to see the remains of the house of the Blessed Mother and where the Angel of the Lord announced the good news to Mary. From here, we drive to Cana, where Jesus performed His first miracle, changing water into wine at His motherâs request. We celebrate Mass here at the Wedding Church, and married couples will have the chance to renew their wedding vows. From there, we continue to our hotel by the Sea of Galilee for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 13
tourDays.description: Tiberias: Sea of Galilee Theme: The Ministry of Christ in the Galilee This morning we take a boat ride on the beautiful Sea of Galilee (Luke 5:1). Then we visit Capernaum, the fishing town where Jesus lived and launched His ministry to change our lives and the world. In Capernaum, we see the Synagogue where Jesus taught (Mark 1:21-29) and gave the Sermon on the Bread of Life. We continue to the Mount of Beatitudes, where Jesus delivered the Sermon on the Mount (Luke 6:20-49). Then to Tabgha, where Jesus fed the crowd of 5,000 people with five loaves of bread and two fish (Luke 9:10-17). Nearby is St. Peterâs Primacy, where Peter confirmed his Love of Jesus (John 21), and it was in this place that Jesus anointed Peter to lead His Church and became the first Pope. (John 21:9). Continue visiting Mary Magdaleneâs birthplace in Magdala. During the time of Jesus, this village was a prosperous fishing village that exported fish and garum, a fish sauce reduction popular in Roman cooking. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 14
tourDays.description: Mt. Tabor - Jericho - Jerusalem Theme: The Transfiguration After breakfast, drive to the site of the Transfiguration, Mount Tabor (Matthew 17:1-50). You will have time to reflect on Christâs Divinity at this site. Celebrate Mass at the Basilica of the Transfiguration and then continue south towards the Jordan Valley, to the worldâs oldest inhabited city (Jericho (Joshua 6:12-25). In Jericho, you view the exact location, the Mount of Temptation, where the Devil tempted Jesus during his forty-day fast (Luke 4:1). Drive up to Jerusalem to check in to your hotel for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 15
tourDays.description: Jerusalem: Bethlehem & Ein Karem Theme: The Visitation and Nativity This morning we go to the village of Ein Karem to visit the Church of St John the Baptist, which marks his birthplace (Luke 1.5). Nearby is the Church of Visitation that commemorates the visit of our Blessed Mother to her cousin, Elizabeth, who stayed with her for three months (Luke 1.39). Many people pray the Mystery of the Rosary as they walk up the hill to the Church. Later drive to Bethlehem to visit the fields where the Angel appeared to the shepherds to proclaim the birth of Jesus Christ (Luke 2:8). We enter the caves where shepherds took shelter in ancient times and see the soot marks of the fires they lit to keep warm. Continue to Manger Square and the Church of the Nativity. We enter the Church through the door of humility and proceed down to the Grotto of the Nativity, which marks the place of Our Saviourâs birth (Matthew 2:1-18). Beneath the altar is a silver star and a Latin inscription that states: HIC DE VIRGINE MARIA JESUS CHRISTUS NATUS (Here, Jesus Christ was born to the Virgin Mary). Following Mass in Bethlehem, return to the hotel in Jerusalem for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 16
tourDays.description: Jordan River - Qumran - Dead Sea Theme: Early Years in Jerusalem & the Wilderness Drive through the Judean wilderness, the site where Jesus spent His 40 days of fasting. We head to the Jordan River for some time to reflect on the Baptism of Christ Matthew 3:13-17). In the afternoon, we visit the Essene site where the Dead Sea Scrolls were found in Qumran. (Ezekiel 47:8-10). These writings have helped further the understanding of the Jewish background of Christianity. Before returning to Jerusalem, there is also time to swim or float on the Dead Sea, the lowest and saltiest place on Earth.

tourDays.title: Day 17
tourDays.description: Jerusalem: Mt. Of Olives - Gethsemane - Mt. Zion (Upper Room) Theme: Palm Sunday and the Agony in the Garden After breakfast, you will make your way to the Mount of Olives, where you will be able to take in the beautiful, panoramic view of Jerusalem. Historically, the Mount of Olives was a mandatory transit point for Jesus during many iconic moments. Visit the Pater Noster Shrine where Jesus taught His disciples the Lordâs Prayer (Pater Noster) (Luke 11:1-4). You will have the opportunity to stop at Dominus Flevit which is a Church that commemorates where Jesus wept for Jerusalem (Luke 19:41). Continue on to Gethsemane, a garden at the foot of the Mount of Olives. Jesus brought His disciples here to pray the night before He was crucified (Luke 22:29-53). The Garden still contains trees with roots that date back to the time of Jesus. Your next stop, the Church of All Nations, is built over the âRock of Agonyâ. This is where Jesus prayed alone on the night of His arrest. Throughout this time, you are invited to remain in prayer and to reflect on Christâs agony that He experienced. You will have the opportunity to visit the Western Wall, which is the last remnant of the Jewish Temple after it was destroyed in 70 A.D. Continue with a visit to the house of the High Priest Caiaphas (Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu). This Church commemorates where Jesus was examined and eventually imprisoned before the Council in Jerusalem. It also commemorates Peterâs Denial of Christ (John 18:15-18), Petersâ repentance, and Jesusâ forgiveness of Peter. You will also visit the Upper Room on Mt. Zion. The Upper Room is where Jesus and His disciples celebrated the Last Supper (Matthew 26:17-30) and where Jesus appeared to His disciples after His Death and Resurrection (Mark 16:14). In addition, visit the nearby Benedictine Church of the Dormition. Tradition tells us that this Church is where Mary, the Mother of Jesus, âfell asleep.â At the end of this prayerful day, return to your hotel for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 18
tourDays.description: Jerusalem: Via Dolorosa - Holy Sepulchre- Western Wall Theme: The Way of the Cross, The Crucifixion, The Resurrection Very early this morning we walk together in prayerful procession along the Via Dolorosa (The Way of the Cross). We start at the Antonia Fortress, where Jesus was condemned to death by Pontius Pilate (John 18:28-19:16) and receives His cross. We end at the Church of the Holy Sepulcher, which marks the place of the Crucifixion & the Resurrection, (Luke 23:26-33). After Mass at the Church of the Holy Sepulcher we return to the hotel for breakfast. Later we revisit the Old City to see the Church of St. Anneâs, the traditional birthplace of the Virgin Mary. Nearby is the Pool of Bethesda, where Jesus healed the crippled man (John 5:1-9). End the day with a visit the Western Wall, which is the last remnant of the Jewish Temple destroyed in 70 A.D.

tourDays.title: Day 19
tourDays.description: Jerusalem - Tel Aviv - Rome After an early breakfast, you will transfer to Tel Aviv Airport for your flight(s) to Rome. Upon arrival in Rome, you will be greeted by your tour escort and/or driver. After a warm welcome to Italy, you will be escorted to your transportation to your hotel. This afternoon, your guide will introduce you to your fellow pilgrims and priest who will be with you for the rest of the journey. You will make your way to Mass, followed by a welcome dinner with wine. This evening, you may walk to St. Peterâs Square for Rosary (optional).

tourDays.title: Day 20
tourDays.description: Rome: Papal Audience - Piazza Navona â Pantheon - Basilica of St. John the Lateran â Holy Stairs - Basilica of St. Mary Major This morning, we will attend the Papal Audience in St. Peterâs Square or the Audience Hall. The Papal Audience is celebrated each Wednesday by His Holiness, Holy Father Pope Leo XIV (pending the papal schedule). (During the month of July, Papal Audiences are typically cancelled while the Holy Father resides in Castel Gandolfo. For tours occurring during this time, the Audience will be replaced with an excursion to Castel Gandolfo with the itinerary below: Upon arrival in Castel Gandolfo, we will visit Piazza della LibertÃ . Here, we will take a moment to admire the impressive facade of the Papal Palace, the Popeâs summer residence. Our visit continues with an exploration of the Papal Palace itself, including the Vatican Observatory and the breathtaking Barberini Gardens, which offer panoramic views of Lake Albano.) Next, head to the Piazza Navona area for some free time and lunch (on your own). This afternoon, visit the oldest of the four major Basilicas in Rome, the Archbasilica of St. John the Lateran, the cathedral church and seat of the Bishop of Rome. Cross the street to the Holy Stairs, which were brought to Rome by St. Helen in the 4th century. These were the same stairs that led up to the praetorium of Pontius Pilate in Jerusalem, which Jesus climbed on His way to trial during His Passion. Our final stop will be at the Basilica of St. Mary Major which is dedicated to Our Lady. Here we will celebrate Holy Mass, and then have dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 21
tourDays.description: Rome: St. Peter's Basilica - Vatican Museum - Appian Way - Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls - Catacombs Today we tour St. Peterâs Basilica, built on the site where St. Peter the Apostle was martyred. Here, youâll have the opportunity to view Michelangeloâs Pieta sculpture, pray at the tombs of Pope Benedict XVI and St. John Paul II. Next you will visit the Vatican Museum, where you can see the Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, and Sistine Chapel. After lunch, continue down the Appian Way, one of the earliest roads built in ancient Rome to the Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls and the Catacombs. Dinner and overnight in Rome.

tourDays.description: After breakfast, depart for Lisbon. Afternoon panoramic sightseeing tour including St. Jeromeâs Monastery, Belem Quarter and Belem Tower, 25th of April Bridge (drive by), Discoveries Monument, Basilica of the Star, Rossio Square, Commerce Square, Marquee of Pombal Square, concluding at St. Anthonyâs Church for Mass. Check in at hotel, dinner and overnight.

tourDays.description: Head to Fatima with a stop in Santarem for Mass at St. Stephenâs Church and the opportunity to venerate a 13th-century Eucharistic Miracle. Continue to Fatima (Hamlet of Aljustrel), birthplace of the three shepherd children. Dinner and overnight in Fatima.

tourDays.description: Depart Fatima after breakfast and head to Salamanca. Walking tour including Plaza Mayor, La Clerecia, La Casa de las Conchas, University of Salamanca, Roman Bridge, La Iglesia de San Marcos, La Iglesia de San Martin, and the two joint Salamanca Cathedrals (old and new). Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.

Continue to Burgos for dinner, evening exploration, and overnight.

tourDays.description: Transfer from Burgos to Loyola to visit the birthplace of St. Ignatius and the 17th-century Basilica and Holy House. Free time for lunch, then continue to Lourdes with views of the Pyrenees Mountains. Check in to hotel, dinner and overnight in Lourdes.

Evening candlelight procession and Rosary. Overnight in Lourdes.

tourDays.description: Breakfast, depart for Pau or Lourdes Airport for a short flight to Paris, continue on to Lisieux. Visit the Basilica of St. Therese, view mosaics and stained glass, see relics, clothing, and personal objects at Les Buissonnets (family home), and tour the Carmelite Convent where she is buried. Dinner and overnight in Lisieux.

tourDays.title: Normandy D-Day beaches and American Cemetery
tourDays.description: After breakfast and Mass in Lisieux, travel to the Normandy landing beaches and visit the Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial in Colleville-sur-Mer. Return to Lisieux for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass in Lisieux; Travel to Normandy landing beaches; Visit Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial; Return to Lisieux

tourDays.activities: Transfer to Chartres; Visit Chartres Cathedral and venerate Veil relic; Free time for lunch; Transfer to Paris and hotel check-in; Dinner

tourDays.title: Mass and Paris sightseeing
tourDays.description: Celebrate Mass, visit Sacre Coeur Basilica on Montmartre, possible ascent to the Dome for panoramic views, visit the Chapel of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal to view incorrupt body of St. Catherine Laboure, walk to Saint Vincent de Paul Church, visit Notre Dame Cathedral (re-opened to visitors), then board a bus tour to see the Eiffel Tower, Les Invalides, Arc de Triomphe, and the Champs-Elysees. Dinner and overnight in Paris.

tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport, where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served while on board.

tourDays.description: Arrive at Toulouse or Pau airport. Meet your tour guide/driver and embark on a scenic drive to Lourdes. Check in to your hotel, relax or explore before dinner. Free time to attend the candlelight procession (AprilâOctober only) guided by the Rosary, then overnight at the hotel.

Evening candlelight procession available.

tourDays.description: Continued time in Lourdes to continue prayer, attend Mass, and visit key sites associated with St. Bernadette and the apparitions. Opportunities to use the baths and participate in devotional activities; evening candlelight procession is available.
tourDays.activities: Prayer and meditation at Lourdes sites; Attend Mass; Use baths/visit sanctuary facilities; Participate in devotional activities; Attend candlelight procession (evening, where available)

tourDays.description: After breakfast transfer to Plavilla to meet the Community of the Lamb (Dominican/Franciscan spirituality). Continue to Fanjeaux to meet Dominican sisters at the monastery of Prouilhe. After Mass, continue to Carcassonne to discover the fortified medieval city, walk through small paved streets from the chateau to the ramparts, and pass the Basilica of Saint-Nazaire and ancient houses. Dinner and overnight in Carcassonne.

tourDays.title: Aigues-Mortes, Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer and Avignon
tourDays.description: Visit Aigues-Mortes (ramparts built by King Saint Louis) and the Constance Tower. Continue to the Camargue region to discover the sanctuary of the Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer (site associated with Mary Salome, Mary Jacob and Our Lady of the Sea). Celebrate Mass, then continue to Avignon for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Aigues-Mortes and its ramparts; Visit the Constance Tower; Travel to the Camargue; Visit the sanctuary of the Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer; Celebrate Mass; Transfer to Avignon

tourDays.title: Avignon, Gordes and Saint-Maximin-la-Sainte-Baume
tourDays.description: Visit the Papal Palace of Avignon (UNESCO World Heritage site). After lunch drive to Gordes to visit the Abbey of Senanque (guided visit to dormitory, abbey church, cloister, etc.). Transfer to Saint-Maximin-la-Sainte-Baume to celebrate Mass and check in to the Convent Royal for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit the Papal Palace (Avignon); Lunch (on route); Drive to Gordes; Guided visit of the Abbey of Senanque; Transfer to Saint-Maximin-la-Sainte-Baume; Celebrate Mass; Hotel check-in (Convent Royal)

tourDays.title: Marseille panorama and Cassis Calanques
tourDays.description: Transfer to Marseille for a panoramic tour and celebrate Mass. Visit the Basilica Notre-Dame de la Garde and its museum. After lunch discover the Calanques of Cassis; options include a short cruise ride along the coastline, a walk, or enjoying the port. Return to Saint-Maximin-la-Sainte-Baume for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Marseille; Panoramic tour of Marseille; Celebrate Mass; Visit Basilica Notre-Dame de la Garde and museum; Lunch; Discover Calanques of Cassis (short cruise, walk, or port visit); Return to hotel in Saint-Maximin-la-Sainte-Baume

tourDays.title: Cotignac, Le Thoronet and Cannes
tourDays.description: Board the bus to Cotignac to visit the sanctuary Notre-Dame de Graces and pray with the community of Saint-Jean. Continue to Le Thoronet to discover the Abbey of Thoronet (Cistercian architecture) and the nearby monastery of the Torrent de Vie; celebrate Mass in the monastery with the Sisters of Bethlehem. Continue to Cannes for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Board bus to Cotignac; Visit sanctuary Notre-Dame de Graces (Cotignac); Pray with community of Saint-Jean; Visit Abbey of Thoronet; Visit monastery of the Torrent de Vie; Celebrate Mass with the Sisters of Bethlehem; Transfer to Cannes

tourDays.title: Lerins Abbey (island of Saint-Honorat)
tourDays.description: Board a boat to Lerins Abbey on the island of Saint-Honorat. Celebrate Mass at the Benedictine Abbey, meet with a brother of the religious community, enjoy a wine tasting (Abbey wines/liqueurs), then return by boat to Cannes for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Boat transfer to Lerins Abbey (island of Saint-Honorat); Celebrate Mass at Lerins Abbey; Visit Benedictine Abbey of Lerins; Meet with a brother of the community; Wine tasting; Return by boat to Cannes

tourDays.title: Return home via Nice
tourDays.description: After breakfast transfer to Nice airport and board your flight home.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast; Transfer to Nice airport; Board return flight

tourDays.title: Depart USA for Italy
tourDays.description: Depart USA for an overnight flight to Rome. Dinner and breakfast will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Depart USA; Overnight flight to Rome; Meals served on board (dinner, breakfast)

tourDays.title: Arrive Rome

tourDays.activities: Arrive in Rome; Meet escort; Transfer to hotel; Free afternoon

tourDays.title: Rome to San Giovanni Rotondo via Montecassino

tourDays.activities: Drive south from Rome; Stop at Abbey of Montecassino; Transfer to San Giovanni Rotondo; Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: San Giovanni Rotondo and Monte Sant'Angelo
tourDays.description: Celebrate Mass at the tomb of Padre Pio; tour the sanctuary, old church and see Padre Pio's crucifix and confessional. Visit the Grotto of Michael the Archangel and enjoy views of the Gargano Peninsula; return to San Giovanni Rotondo for devotions and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass at Padre Pio's tomb; Tour sanctuary and old church; See Padre Pio's crucifix and confessional; Visit Grotto of Michael the Archangel; Devotions and reflection

tourDays.title: Coastal drive to Lanciano, Loreto, then Assisi
tourDays.description: After breakfast drive up the Adriatic coast to Lanciano to see the Eucharistic Miracle and celebrate Mass. Continue to the Marian shrine of Loreto to visit the Holy House of Nazareth, then proceed to Assisi for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast at hotel; Drive to Lanciano; See the Eucharistic Miracle; Celebrate Mass; Visit Holy House of Loreto; Transfer to Assisi

tourDays.title: Assisi: Tomb of St. Francis and sites
tourDays.description: Visit the tomb of St. Francis and the 13th-century Basilica with frescoes and relics; visit St Mary of the Angels (Portiuncula, rose bush, cave), stroll medieval streets, stop at an outdoor cafe with a view of an ancient Roman temple, and visit the Church of St. Clare to see her incorrupt body.
tourDays.activities: Visit tomb of St. Francis; Explore Basilica of St. Francis; Visit St Mary of the Angels (Portiuncula, rose bush, cave); Stroll medieval streets; Visit Church of St. Clare

tourDays.title: Assisi to Siena and return to Rome
tourDays.description: After breakfast travel to Siena. Stroll Piazza del Campo, visit the Cathedral and the Basilica of St. Francis (and related relics), view the incorrupt head of St. Catherine at the Basilica of St. Dominic, then continue to Rome for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Siena; Stroll Piazza del Campo; Visit Siena Cathedral; Visit Basilica of St. Dominic (view incorrupt head of St. Catherine); Return to Rome

tourDays.title: Christian Rome sightseeing
tourDays.description: Sightseeing tour 'Christian Rome' visiting Basilica of St. Mary Major, the Holy Stairs, Basilica of St. John Lateran, St Paul Outside the Walls, the Appian Way (including Domine Quo Vadis Chapel), Baths of Caracalla, Arch of Drusus, Tomb of Cecilia Metella, the catacombs of St. Callixtus, and a visit to the Trevi Fountain. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Guided sightseeing tour (Christian Rome); Visit multiple basilicas and historical Christian sites; Visit catacombs and ancient Roman sites; Visit Trevi Fountain

tourDays.title: Papal Audience and Vatican Museums
tourDays.description: Attend the weekly Papal Audience or Blessing (pending papal schedule) in Vatican City. After the audience visit the Vatican Museums (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel) and enter St. Peter's Basilica (see Pieta, Bernini's canopy). Visit the Tomb of Saint John Paul II. Time at leisure before dinner.
tourDays.activities: Attend Papal Audience (pending schedule); Visit Vatican Museums (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel); Enter St. Peter's Basilica and view major works; Visit Tomb of Saint John Paul II; Leisure time

tourDays.title: Travel to Florence
tourDays.description: After breakfast depart for Florence. Upon arrival enjoy free time to rest and explore before dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Depart Rome for Florence; Transfer to hotel; Free time in Florence

tourDays.title: Florence guided tour and Accademia
tourDays.description: After Mass enjoy a guided tour of Florence including the Franciscan church of Santa Croce, Piazza Signoria, Palazzo Vecchio, Uffizi, Ponte Vecchio, Republic Square and Santa Maria del Fiore Cathedral. After lunch visit the Accademia to view Michelangelo's 'David' and other works. Free time before dinner.
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass; Guided walking tour of Florence sites; Visit Galleria dell'Accademia (view Michelangelo's David); Free time in Florence

tourDays.title: Padua and St. Anthony
tourDays.description: Travel to Padua. After Mass at the Basilica of St. Anthony, sightseeing includes the university, the tomb of St. Anthony and his relics, Prato della Valle and the Basilica of Santa Giustina. Time to relax before dinner and overnight in Padua.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Padua; Attend Mass at Basilica of St. Anthony; Sightseeing: university, tomb and relics of St. Anthony; Visit Prato della Valle and Basilica of Santa Giustina

tourDays.title: Day trip to Venice
tourDays.description: After breakfast travel to Venice for a tour of St. Mark's Square, the Basilica of San Marco, the Bridge of Sighs and the Doge's Palace. Free time to explore, shop or optionally take a gondola ride. Return to Padua for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Venice; Visit St. Mark's Square and Basilica of San Marco; Visit Bridge of Sighs and Doge's Palace; Free time in Venice; Optional gondola ride

tourDays.title: Flight from Venice to Medjugorje
tourDays.description: Depart for Venice Airport and take a short flight to Medjugorje. Upon arrival be greeted and take a 2 1/2 hour drive by private coach to the village. Meet your guide and be introduced to your host family where you will stay for four nights. Orientation tour on arrival; representative available for questions.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Venice Airport; Short flight to Medjugorje; 2.5-hour coach drive to Medjugorje; Meet guide and host family; Orientation tour (on arrival)

tourDays.title: Medjugorje: Prayer and pilgrimage activities
tourDays.description: Experience Medjugorje with opportunities for prayer and reflection. Assemble at St. James Church for English-language Mass each morning, follow the path up Apparition Hill, pray at the cross, and join villagers and pilgrims each evening to pray the rosary and attend Croatian Mass with blessing of the sick and items. Opportunities to climb Krizevac Mountain, visit the Blue Cross and the community of Cenacolo. Daily Mass in English and English confessions available at St. James Church.
tourDays.activities: Attend English Mass at St. James Church; Walk Apparition Hill and pray at the commemorative cross; Pray evening rosary with villagers and pilgrims; Attend Croatian Mass and receive Blessing of the Sick; Climb Krizevac Mountain; Visit Blue Cross; Visit the community of Cenacolo; Personal prayer, reflection and free time

tourDays.title: Medjugorje: Prayer and pilgrimage activities
tourDays.description: Continued time in Medjugorje for prayer, Mass and devotional activities. Participate in daily Mass and scheduled devotional opportunities; additional time for climbing Krizevac, visiting Apparition Hill, the Blue Cross, Cenacolo community, and personal retreat.
tourDays.activities: Attend English Mass at St. James Church; Walk Apparition Hill; Pray evening rosary and attend Croatian Mass; Climb Krizevac Mountain; Visit Blue Cross; Visit Cenacolo community; Personal prayer and reflection

tourDays.title: Medjugorje: Prayer and pilgrimage activities

tourDays.activities: Attend English Mass at St. James Church; Walk Apparition Hill; Pray evening rosary and attend Croatian Mass with Blessing of the Sick; Climb Krizevac Mountain; Visit Blue Cross and Cenacolo community; Personal prayer and reflection

tourDays.title: Return to USA
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast depart by motor coach for Dubrovnik Airport (or Split or Sarajevo) for return flights home.

tourDays.title: Depart USA

tourDays.activities: Visit Mount Tabor and celebrate Mass; Drive through Jordan Valley to Jericho; View Mt. Temptation and Sycamore Tree; Visit Baptismal site on the Jordan River; Transfer to Jerusalem and check in

tourDays.activities: Visit Second Temple scale model; Visit Ein Karem and Church of the Visitation; Pray the Mystery of the Rosary; Visit Bethlehem: Manger Square, Church of the Nativity, Grotto of the Nativity; Celebrate Mass

tourDays.title: Bethany - Masada - Dead Sea
tourDays.description: Drive to Qumran (Dead Sea Scrolls site); take cable car to Masada and learn its history; optional dip in the Dead Sea; drive through the Judean Wilderness (area of Jesus' fasting and John the Baptist) and visit Bethany, celebrating Mass there before returning to the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Visit Qumran (Dead Sea Scrolls site); Cable car to Masada; Optional swim/dip in the Dead Sea; Drive through Judean Wilderness; Visit Bethany and celebrate Mass

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Mt. Of Olives - Gethsemane - Mt. Zion - Western Wall

Zion to visit the Upper Room and the Dormition Church.

tourDays.activities: Sanctuary visits (Basilica, Grotto); Use healing baths and spring; Attend blessing of the sick; Participate in nightly candlelight procession; Private devotions and Mass

tourDays.title: Lourdes - Medjugorje

tourDays.title: Medjugorje - USA

tourDays.title: Depart USA

tourDays.activities: Overnight transatlantic flight; In-flight meals (dinner and breakfast)

tourDays.title: Travel to Paris

tourDays.activities: Attend Papal Audience or Blessing (pending schedule); Tour Vatican Museums (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel); Enter and visit St. Peter's Basilica; Visit grave of Saint John Paul II

tourDays.title: Garabandal and Santo Toribio de Liebana Monastery
tourDays.description: After breakfast, spend the day in Garabandal. Little has changed in this rural town since June 18, 1961, when four children had an apparition of an Angel, sent to prepare them for a visit from the Blessed Virgin Mary. From July 2, 1961, until November 13, 1965, Our Lady appeared to the children and confided secrets of future events. The children reported a promised future miracle at the grove of pine trees on a bluff overlooking the village of Garabandal. In the afternoon, travel to Santo Toribio de Liebana Monastery. The monastery was founded before the 6th century. According to tradition, the monastery venerates the largest piece of the Lignum Crucis (the True Cross) discovered in Jerusalem by Saint Helena of Constantinople and brought from the Church of the Holy Sepulchre by Saint Turibius of Astorga. The left arm of the True Cross is kept in a gilded silver reliquary. You will return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.
tourDays.activities: Visit Garabandal and apparition sites; Travel to Santo Toribio de Liebana Monastery; Venerate the Lignum Crucis relic (left arm of the True Cross); Return to hotel and dinner
