Pilgrims venerate the statue of Our Lady within the cave, and there is also a Basilica nearby. The Basilica is built in the neo-Romanesque style... We will leave Covadonga and depart for the great city of Santiago de Compostela, where we will have dinner and a restful overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Covadonga Sanctuary (Holy Cave and Basilica); Venerate the statue of Our Lady of Covadonga and associated sites; Depart for Santiago de Compostela; Dinner and overnight in Santiago de Compostela

tourDays.title: El Camino walk and Cathedral of St. James
tourDays.description: This morning, you will walk a few miles of El Camino, immerse yourselves in the fragrant eucalyptus groves, and experience the breathtaking scenery. Later this morning, join in celebrating the International Pilgrim Mass at the Cathedral of St. James. After Mass, there will be free time for lunch, followed by a visit to the Cathedral of Santiago. Pilgrims traditionally hug the statue of St. James as they enter the Cathedral. Descend into the crypt where the Patron Saint of Pilgrims relics is displayed. Following your visit, enjoy a sightseeing tour of the city. Some stops on your tour include the Obradoiro Square, Fonseca Palace, Gelmirez Palace, Franco Street, and much more. Your evening will be free to spend at your leisure until dinner and an overnight.
tourDays.activities: Walk a few miles of El Camino; Attend the International Pilgrim Mass at the Cathedral of St. James; Visit the Cathedral of Santiago (hug the statue, descend into the crypt); Sightseeing tour of Santiago de Compostela (Obradoiro Square, Fonseca Palace, Gelmirez Palace, Franco Street); Free time for lunch

tourDays.title: Transfer to Lisbon and St. Anthony's Church
tourDays.description: Today, you will transfer to Lisbon. Following your orientation drive through Lisbon, you will visit St. Anthonyâs Church. Although this patron Saint of lost things is known as St. Anthony of Padua (Italy), he was born in Lisbon, Portugal. This Church was built on the site of St. Anthonyâs birth. This evening, you will enjoy dinner and an overnight in Lisbon.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Lisbon; Orientation drive through Lisbon; Visit St. Anthony's Church (site of the saint's birth)

tourDays.title: Santarem (Eucharistic Miracle) and transfer to Fatima
tourDays.description: Today, your group will travel north to the old city of Santarem. In Santarem, your group will visit and attend Mass at the Church of St. Stephen, which holds a Eucharistic Miracle dating back to the 13th century. Following your visit to this miraculous site, your group will board the bus and transfer to Fatima. You will arrive in time for dinner at your hotel, followed by a restful overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Santarem; Attend Mass at the Church of St. Stephen (site of a 13th-century Eucharistic Miracle); Transfer to Fatima; Dinner and overnight in Fatima

tourDays.title: Fatima pilgrimage: chapel, basilica, Aljustrel, Valinhos, Via Sacra
tourDays.description: Our profoundly reflective day begins with Mass at the Little Chapel of the Apparitions. Following Mass, your tour of Fatima begins at the neoclassical Basilica of Our Lady of Fatima, which contains the tombs of Francisco and Jacinta and features altars dedicated to the mysteries of the Rosary. Following this visit, your tour will continue to the Hamlet of Aljustrel and Valinhos. Experience Christâs unconditional love by participating in the Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra. Your night will conclude with private devotions and a candlelight procession. Enjoy dinner and a comfortable nightâs rest in Fatima.
tourDays.activities: Mass at the Little Chapel of the Apparitions; Visit the Basilica of Our Lady of Fatima (tombs of Francisco and Jacinta); Visit Aljustrel and Valinhos; Participate in the Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra; Private devotions and a candlelight procession

tourDays.title: Return to USA
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast and heartfelt farewells, you will transfer to Lisbon airport for your return flight(s) home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Transfer to Lisbon airport; Return flights to USA

tourDays.title: Depart for the Holy Land
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport and board an overnight flight to Israel. Meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Depart from local airport; Overnight flight to Israel; In-flight meals

tourDays.title: Arrive in Tel Aviv
tourDays.description: Arrive at Ben Gurion Airport in Tel Aviv, collect luggage, meet your guide or driver, transfer to the hotel in Tel Aviv, check in and enjoy dinner at the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Arrive at Ben Gurion Airport; Baggage claim and meet guide/driver; Transfer to hotel and check-in; Dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Tel Aviv - Caesarea - Nazareth - Cana - Tiberias
tourDays.description: Travel from Tel Aviv to Caesarea Maritima to see the Roman theatre, Herod's Palace, the Hippodrome and harbor. Continue to Nazareth to visit the museum and archaeological garden and St. Joseph's Church. Visit the Church of the Annunciation grotto. Proceed to Cana to celebrate Mass at the Wedding Church (with opportunity for married couples to renew vows). Continue to the hotel by the Sea of Galilee for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Caesarea Maritima (Roman theatre, Herod's Palace, Hippodrome, harbor); Visit Nazareth museum and archaeological garden; Visit St. Joseph's Church / workshop; Visit Church of the Annunciation grotto; Celebrate Mass at the Wedding Church in Cana; Renew wedding vows (optional for married couples); Transfer to Sea of Galilee hotel

tourDays.title: Tiberias: Sea of Galilee
tourDays.description: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee, visit Capernaum (including the synagogue), the Mount of Beatitudes, Tabgha, St. Peter's Primacy, and Magdala (Mary Magdalene's birthplace). Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee; Visit Capernaum and the synagogue; Visit Mount of Beatitudes; Visit Tabgha; Visit St. Peter's Primacy; Visit Magdala

tourDays.title: Mt. Tabor - Jericho - Jerusalem
tourDays.description: Drive to Mount Tabor (site of the Transfiguration) and celebrate Mass at the Basilica of the Transfiguration. Continue to the Jordan Valley and visit Jericho including the Mount of Temptation, then drive up to Jerusalem and check in to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Mount Tabor; Celebrate Mass at the Basilica of the Transfiguration; Visit Jericho and view the Mount of Temptation; Transfer to Jerusalem and check-in

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Bethlehem & Ein Karem
tourDays.description: Visit Ein Karem to see the Church of St. John the Baptist and the Church of the Visitation. Later drive to Bethlehem to visit the shepherds' fields, enter the caves, visit Manger Square and the Church of the Nativity, descend to the Grotto of the Nativity, and celebrate Mass in Bethlehem. Return to the hotel in Jerusalem for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Church of St. John the Baptist (Ein Karem); Visit Church of the Visitation; Drive to Bethlehem and visit shepherds' fields; Enter ancient caves and visit Manger Square; Visit Church of the Nativity and Grotto of the Nativity; Celebrate Mass in Bethlehem

tourDays.title: Jordan River - Qumran - Dead Sea
tourDays.description: Drive through the Judean wilderness, visit the Jordan River for reflection on the Baptism of Christ, visit Qumran (site of the Dead Sea Scrolls), and have time to swim or float in the Dead Sea before returning to Jerusalem.
tourDays.activities: Drive through the Judean wilderness; Visit the Jordan River for reflection; Visit Qumran (Dead Sea Scrolls site); Swim or float in the Dead Sea

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Mt. Of Olives - Gethsemane - Mt. Zion (Upper Room)
tourDays.description: Begin on the Mount of Olives for a panoramic view of Jerusalem, visit the Pater Noster Shrine, walk down the Palm Sunday Road visiting Dominus Flevit, continue to Gethsemane and the Church of All Nations, then visit the house of Caiaphas on Mt. Zion (Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu) and the Upper Room.
tourDays.activities: Panoramic view from Mount of Olives; Visit Pater Noster Shrine; Walk down the Palm Sunday Road; Visit Dominus Flevit; Visit Gethsemane and Church of All Nations; Visit Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu (house of Caiaphas); Visit the Upper Room

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Via Dolorosa - Holy Sepulchre - Western Wall
tourDays.description: Very early walk in prayerful procession along the Via Dolorosa starting at the Antonia Fortress and ending at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre. Celebrate Mass at the Holy Sepulchre, then visit the Church of St. Anne's, the Pool of Bethesda, and the Western Wall.
tourDays.activities: Prayerful procession along the Via Dolorosa; Begin at Antonia Fortress and end at Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Celebrate Mass at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Visit Church of St. Anne's and Pool of Bethesda; Visit the Western Wall

tourDays.title: Tel Aviv - Prague
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast, fly to Prague. On arrival, meet the local guide, transfer to the hotel, enjoy free time to explore Prague's cobblestone streets, and gather for a welcome dinner at a local restaurant.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast and transfer to airport; Flight from Tel Aviv to Prague; Meet local guide and transfer to hotel; Free time in Prague; Welcome dinner

tourDays.title: Sacred Spaces of Prague
tourDays.description: Visit the Church of Our Lady Victorious (Infant Jesus of Prague) and celebrate Mass. Continue with a walking tour of Old Town and the Royal Route, visiting Old Town Square, the Castle District, St. Nicholas Church, St. Vitus Cathedral, St. George Basilica, Loreto Church, Strahov Monastery, Charles Bridge, Prague Castle, the Astronomical Clock, and Wenceslas Square.
tourDays.activities: Visit Church of Our Lady Victorious (Infant Jesus of Prague); Celebrate Mass; Walking tour of Old Town and Royal Route; Visit Castle District sites (St. Nicholas, St. Vitus, St. George Basilica, Loreto Church, Strahov Monastery); View Charles Bridge, Prague Castle, Astronomical Clock and Wenceslas Square

tourDays.title: From Prague to Altotting and Salzburg
tourDays.description: Travel from Prague to Altotting in Germany. In Altotting, celebrate Mass in the Chapel of Mercy (home to a 13th-century statue of the Blessed Virgin Mary), and visit the Basilica, the Panorama of the Crucifixion, and St. Konradâs Monastery. Continue on to Salzburg for the evening.
tourDays.activities: Drive from Prague to Altotting; Celebrate Mass in the Chapel of Mercy; Visit Basilica, Panorama of the Crucifixion and St. Konrad's Monastery; Continue to Salzburg

tourDays.title: Exploring the Divine in Salzburg
tourDays.description: Attend Mass at St. Peter's Abbey, then take a walking tour of Salzburg visiting the Archbishop's Residence at Dom Platz, Mirabell Palace gardens, the Cathedral, the Nonnberg Convent, Mozart's birthplace, and Hellbrunn Palace gardens and trick fountains. Dinner and overnight in Salzburg.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass at St. Peter's Abbey; Walking tour of Salzburg (Dom Platz, Archbishop's Residence); Visit Mirabell Palace gardens; Visit Salzburg Cathedral and Nonnberg Convent; Visit Mozart's birthplace; Visit Hellbrunn Palace gardens and trick fountains

tourDays.title: Journey to Mariazell, Melk, and Vienna
tourDays.description: Depart Salzburg and travel through the Austrian mountains to Mariazell to visit the Mariazell Basilica. Continue to Melk to visit Melk Abbey overlooking the Danube, then proceed to Vienna for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive from Salzburg to Mariazell; Visit Mariazell Basilica; Continue to Melk and visit Melk Abbey; Travel on to Vienna

tourDays.title: Experiencing Vienna's Cultural and Catholic Heritage
tourDays.description: Tour Vienna including St. Stephen's Cathedral (with opportunity to climb the spire time permitting), Schonbrunn Palace, Belvedere Palace, Karlsplatz and the Church of St. Charles Borromeo, and Otto Wagner's Stadtbahn pavilions. Pause for a coffee break and Viennese pastries, return to the hotel for dinner.
tourDays.activities: Visit St. Stephen's Cathedral (and optionally climb the spire); Visit Schonbrunn Palace; Visit Belvedere Palace; Visit Karlsplatz and Church of St. Charles Borromeo; Visit Otto Wagner's Stadtbahn pavilions; Coffee break to sample Viennese pastries

tourDays.title: Vienna to Budapest via Pannonhalma Abbey
tourDays.description: Depart Vienna for Budapest with a stop at Pannonhalma Abbey to visit the Marian sanctuary of Our Lady of Remete. Continue to Budapest and explore Matthias Church and Fisherman's Bastion in Buda's Castle District. Overnight in Budapest.
tourDays.activities: Depart Vienna and stop at Pannonhalma Abbey; Visit Marian sanctuary of Our Lady of Remete; Continue to Budapest; Explore Matthias Church and Fisherman's Bastion

tourDays.title: Discovering Budapest's Sacred Heart
tourDays.description: Begin with morning Mass at the 13th-century Cathedral of St. Matthew. Visit panoramic and historic sites including the Citadel on Mount Gellert, the Royal Castle, the Parliament, Heroes' Square, Church of St. Stephen and Fisherman's Bastion. Option to visit thermal baths. Gather for a farewell dinner.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate morning Mass at the Cathedral of St. Matthew; Visit the Citadel on Mount Gellert; Visit the Royal Castle; View the Parliament and Heroes' Square; Visit the Church of St. Stephen and Fisherman's Bastion; Optional visit to thermal baths; Farewell dinner

tourDays.title: Homeward Bound from Budapest
tourDays.description: Depart from Budapest Airport and begin your journey home.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Budapest Airport; Depart for home

tourDays.title: Depart for Lisbon
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport, where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Travel to local airport; Board overnight flight(s); Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Arrive in Lisbon
tourDays.description: Upon landing at Lisbon Airport, head to baggage claim and collect your luggage. Proceed to the arrival hall, where you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver. After meeting your group in the hotel lobby at 2:30 PM, board the bus and begin a panoramic sightseeing tour of Lisbon. We will stop at St. Jeromeâs Monastery, built to give thanks to the Virgin Mary for guiding Vasco da Gama on his voyage that linked Europe and Asia. Continue to drive by the Belem Quarter, which contains the iconic entryway to the Lisbon harbor, the Belem Tower. This important historic structure has many beautiful sculptures, such as depictions of St. Vincent and Our Lady of Safe Homecoming. The next stop is St. Anthonyâs Church, built upon the site of Saintâs birth; it is here that we will celebrate Mass. After Mass, we will drive to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Collect luggage; Meet tour guide/driver; Meet group in hotel lobby; Panoramic sightseeing tour of Lisbon; Stop at St. Jeromeâs Monastery; Drive by Belem Quarter and Belem Tower; Celebrate Mass at St. Anthonyâs Church; Transfer to hotel for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Lisbon - Santarem â Fatima
tourDays.description: Today, we will travel north to the old city of Santarem. We will attend Mass at the Church of St. Stephen, which holds a 13th-century Eucharistic Miracle. Continue to Fatima and visit the Hamlet of Aljustrel, the home of the three shepherd children. Visit the Parish Church and Fatima Parish Cemetery. Continue to your hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Santarem; Attend Mass at Church of St. Stephen; Travel to Fatima; Visit Aljustrel (hamlet of the shepherd children); Visit Parish Church and Fatima Parish Cemetery; Transfer to hotel for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Fatima
tourDays.description: Visit the Little Chapel of the Apparitions, the Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary (containing the tombs of St. Francisco, St. Jacinta, and Sister Lucia), view the monument commemorating the Sacred Heart of Jesus, visit the Museum with the âFatima: Light and Peaceâ exhibition, and the Holy Trinity Basilica. After free time for lunch, participate in the Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra. Visit Valinhos. End the day with private devotions and a candlelight procession. Dinner and overnight in Fatima.
tourDays.activities: Visit Little Chapel of the Apparitions; Visit Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary (view tombs); View Sacred Heart of Jesus monument; Visit 'Fatima: Light and Peace' museum exhibition; Visit Holy Trinity Basilica; Participate in Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra; Visit Valinhos; Private devotions and candlelight procession

tourDays.title: Fatima â Salamanca
tourDays.description: Depart Fatima and head to Salamanca after breakfast. Walking tour of Salamanca including the Plaza Mayor, La Clerecia, La Casa de las Conchas, the University of Salamanca, the Roman Bridge, La Iglesia de San Marcos, La Iglesia de San Martin, and the two joint Salamanca Cathedrals (old and new). Return to hotel for dinner and overnight in Salamanca.
tourDays.activities: Depart Fatima after breakfast; Walking tour of Salamanca; Visit Plaza Mayor; Visit La Clerecia; Visit La Casa de las Conchas; See University of Salamanca; Walk across Roman Bridge; See La Iglesia de San Marcos and La Iglesia de San Martin; Visit Salamanca Cathedrals (old and new); Return to hotel for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Salamanca - Alba de Tormes - Avila - Burgos
tourDays.description: Transfer to Alba de Tormes and celebrate Mass at the Carmelite Monastery where St. Teresa died and is buried. Visit the museum dedicated to St. Teresa (which holds her incorrupt heart and left arm). Free time for lunch, then continue to Avila to see the city walls, Cathedral de Avila, Basilica de San Vicente, and the Incarnation Convent. Continue to Burgos for dinner, time to explore, and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Alba de Tormes; Celebrate Mass at Carmelite Monastery; Visit St. Teresa museum (incorrupt heart and left arm); Free time for lunch; Visit Avila: city walls, Cathedral de Avila, Basilica de San Vicente, Incarnation Convent; Transfer to Burgos; Dinner and explore Burgos; Overnight in Burgos

tourDays.title: Burgos - Loyola - Lourdes
tourDays.description: Transfer from Burgos to Loyola to visit the birthplace of St. Ignatius, including the 17th-century Basilica and the 'Holy House.' Opportunity to pray in the venerated room. Free time for lunch, then continue to Lourdes with views of the Pyrenees. Check in to hotel, dinner and overnight in Lourdes.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Loyola; Visit birthplace of St. Ignatius and 17th-century Basilica; Pray in the venerated room; Free time for lunch; Travel to Lourdes (view Pyrenees); Hotel check-in, dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Lourdes
tourDays.description: Pray and meditate at the site of Our Ladyâs apparitions. Attend Mass at the Grotto, watch a video presentation about Lourdes, drink and wash with water from the miraculous spring, wash in the baths, pray the life-size Stations of the Cross overlooking the Grotto, visit Boly Mill and the Cachot, attend the candlelight procession and pray the Rosary each evening. Overnight in Lourdes.
tourDays.activities: Pray and meditate at apparition sites; Attend Mass at the Grotto; Watch Lourdes video presentation; Drink from and wash with the miraculous spring water; Wash in the baths; Pray the Stations of the Cross overlooking the Grotto; Visit Boly Mill (birthplace of St. Bernadette); Visit the Cachot; Attend nightly candlelight procession and pray the Rosary

tourDays.title: Lourdes
tourDays.description: Continued time in Lourdes to pray and meditate at apparition sites. Opportunities to attend Mass at the Grotto, use the miraculous spring and baths, view the Stations of the Cross, visit Boly Mill and the Cachot, and participate in the evening candlelight procession and Rosary. Overnight in Lourdes.
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass at the Grotto; Use miraculous spring and baths; Pray the Stations of the Cross; Visit Boly Mill and the Cachot; Participate in candlelight procession and Rosary

tourDays.title: Lourdes - Paris - Lisieux (St. Therese - the Little Flower)
tourDays.description: Depart for Pau or Lourdes Airport for a short flight to Paris, then continue on to Lisieux. Visit the Basilica of St. Therese, view relics, clothing and personal objects at Les Buissonnets (her family home), and tour the Carmelite Convent where she entered in 1888 and is buried. Dinner and overnight in Lisieux.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Pau or Lourdes Airport; Fly to Paris and continue to Lisieux; Visit Basilica of St. Therese; View relics and personal objects at Les Buissonnets; Tour Carmelite Convent (Lisieux); Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Lisieux - Landing Beaches - American Cemetery - Lisieux
tourDays.description: Celebrate Mass in Lisieux, then travel to the Normandy landing beaches (D-Day sites). Visit the Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial in Colleville-sur-Mer to honor the American troops who died in Europe during World War II. Return to Lisieux for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass; Travel to Normandy landing beaches; Visit Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial (Colleville-sur-Mer); Return to Lisieux for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Lisieux - Chartres - Paris
tourDays.description: Depart for Chartres to visit the Cathedral Notre Dame of Chartres and its stained-glass windows and venerate a relic of the Veil of Our Lady. Free time for lunch in Chartres, then continue to Paris to check in at the hotel, followed by free time, dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Depart Lisieux for Chartres; Visit Chartres Cathedral (Notre Dame) and stained-glass windows; Venerate relic of the Veil of Our Lady; Free time for lunch; Continue to Paris and check in at hotel; Dinner and overnight in Paris

tourDays.title: Paris - Miraculous Medal â Notre Dame Cathedral
tourDays.description: Celebrate Mass, then a full day of sightseeing including Sacre Coeur Basilica on Montmartre Hill, the Chapel of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal (with incorrupt body of St. Catherine LabourÃ©), Saint Vincent de Paul Church, and Notre Dame Cathedral. Board a bus tour to see the Eiffel Tower, the Invalides, LâArc de Triomphe, and the Champs-Elysees. Dinner and overnight in Paris.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass; Visit Sacre Coeur Basilica (Montmartre); Visit Chapel of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal (view incorrupt body of St. Catherine LabourÃ©); Visit Saint Vincent de Paul Church; Visit Notre Dame Cathedral; Board bus tour of Paris (Eiffel Tower, Invalides, LâArc de Triomphe, Champs-Elysees); Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Paris â Rome
tourDays.description: Transfer to Charles de Gaulle Airport and board a short flight to Rome. Upon arrival, collect luggage and be greeted by a tour escort/driver, transfer to the hotel and check in. Free time to unpack or explore. Meet in the hotel lobby for a 'Meet and Greet', depart for Mass, attend a welcome dinner, and optionally walk to St. Peterâs Square as a group for the Rosary.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Charles de Gaulle Airport; Fly from Paris to Rome; Collect luggage and meet tour escort/driver; Transfer to hotel and check in; Free time in Rome; Meet and Greet in hotel lobby; Attend Mass and welcome dinner; Optional group Rosary at St. Peterâs Square

tourDays.title: Rome: Papal Audience - Basilica of St. John the Lateran - Holy Stairs - Basilica of St. Mary Major
tourDays.description: Begin with the Papal Audience in St. Peterâs Square (celebrated each Wednesday, pending the papal schedule). Free time for lunch, shopping, or mailing postcards. Visit the Basilica of St. John the Lateran, cross the street to the Holy Staircase (Scala Santa) and, time permitting, climb on knees while meditating. Proceed to the Basilica of St. Mary Major. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Attend Papal Audience in St. Peter's Square (pending papal schedule); Free time for lunch and shopping; Visit Basilica of St. John the Lateran; Visit the Holy Staircase (Scala Santa); Visit Basilica of St. Mary Major; Return to hotel for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Rome: St. Peter's Basilica - Vatican Museum - Appian Way - Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls - Catacombs
tourDays.description: Early breakfast then visit St. Peterâs Basilica (view Michelangeloâs Pieta). Proceed to the Vatican Museum to see the Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel, and the restored Last Judgment; visit the tomb of Saint John Paul II. Free time in the Piazza Navona area for lunch. Continue down the Appian Way to see Domino Quo Vadis Chapel, the Baths of Caracalla, the Arch of Drusus, the Tomb of Cecilia Metella, and the catacombs of St. Callixtus. Conclude with a visit to the Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls and dinner at a local restaurant.
tourDays.activities: Visit St. Peter's Basilica (view Michelangelo's Pieta); Tour Vatican Museum (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel, Last Judgment); Visit tomb of Saint John Paul II; Free time at Piazza Navona; Travel along the Appian Way (Domino Quo Vadis Chapel, Baths of Caracalla, Arch of Drusus, Tomb of Cecilia Metella, catacombs of St. Callixtus); Visit Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls; Dinner at local restaurant

tourDays.title: Return Home
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast and farewells, transfer to Rome or Naples airport for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Transfer to Rome or Naples airport; Depart on return flights home

tourDays.title: Depart USA
tourDays.description: Depart USA for your overnight flight to France. Dinner and breakfast will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Overnight flight to France; In-flight dinner and breakfast

tourDays.title: Paris
tourDays.description: Upon arrival in Paris, greeted by tour guide and brought to transportation. Free time for lunch, then tour of Paris beginning with holy Mass at the Shrine of the Miraculous Medal. View the incorrupt body of St. Catherine Labouret. Continue sightseeing including Notre Dame Cathedral, the Eiffel Tower, L'Arc de Triomphe, and the Champs Elysees. Dinner in Paris.
tourDays.activities: Transfer from airport and meet tour guide; Free time for lunch; Holy Mass at the Shrine of the Miraculous Medal; View incorrupt body of St. Catherine Labouret; Sightseeing tour (Notre Dame Cathedral, Eiffel Tower, L'Arc de Triomphe, Champs Elysees); Dinner in Paris

tourDays.title: Excursion to Lisieux
tourDays.description: After breakfast, depart for Lisieux to tour the home of St. Therese, visit the Basilica of Saint Therese, stop at Les Buissonets (St. Therese's family home) to see relics and personal objects, and tour the ancient Cathedral of St. Peter and the Carmelite Convent. Mass will be celebrated. Return to Paris for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Lisieux; Tour Basilica of Saint Therese; Tour Les Buissonets (St. Therese's family home) and view relics; Tour Cathedral of St. Peter; Visit Carmelite Convent; Celebrate Mass; Return to Paris

tourDays.title: Excursion to Nevers
tourDays.description: After breakfast, depart for Nevers via the Loire Valley. Visit the convent of St. Gildard to see St. Bernadette's incorrupt body, learn about her life and illnesses, then return to Paris for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Nevers via the Loire Valley; Visit convent of St. Gildard and see St. Bernadette's incorrupt body; Return to Paris

tourDays.title: Paris to Rome
tourDays.description: After breakfast, transfer to Paris Airport for a short flight to Rome. Upon arrival at Rome Airport, greeted by tour escort/driver and escorted to hotel. Free afternoon for rest, relaxation, or exploration.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Paris Airport; Flight from Paris to Rome; Transfer from Rome Airport to hotel; Free afternoon in Rome

tourDays.title: Rome - Vatican visit
tourDays.description: Attend the weekly Papal Audience or Blessing at Vatican City (pending papal schedule). Visit the Vatican Museums (including the Tapestry Gallery, The Raphael Rooms, and the Sistine Chapel). Enter St. Peter's Basilica to see the Pieta and Bernini's canopy and visit the grave of Saint John Paul II. Time at leisure before dinner.
tourDays.activities: Attend Papal Audience or Blessing (pending schedule); Tour Vatican Museums (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel); Enter and visit St. Peter's Basilica; See the Pieta and Bernini's bronze canopy; Visit the grave of Saint John Paul II; Leisure time

tourDays.title: Rome to Siena and Assisi
tourDays.description: After breakfast depart Rome and head north to Siena. In Siena stroll the Piazza del Campo, visit the Cathedral and the Basilica of St. Francis (containing miraculous consecrated hosts), and view the incorrupt head of St. Catherine at the Basilica of St. Dominic. Continue on to Assisi for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel from Rome to Siena; Stroll Piazza del Campo; Visit Siena Cathedral; Visit Basilica of St. Francis in Siena; View incorrupt head of St. Catherine at Basilica of St. Dominic; Continue to Assisi

tourDays.title: Assisi
tourDays.description: Visit the tomb of St. Francis and explore Assisi. Visit the 13th-century Basilica with frescoes and possessions of St. Francis. Visit St. Mary of the Angels Basilica including the Chapel Portiuncula, the rose bush, and the cave where St. Francis prayed. Stroll the medieval streets, stop at an outdoor cafe with a view of an ancient Roman temple, and visit the Church of St Clare to see her incorrupt body. Visit the saints' tombs before dinner.
tourDays.activities: Visit tomb of St. Francis; Visit Basilica (13th-century) and view frescoes and possessions of St. Francis; Visit St. Mary of the Angels Basilica (Chapel Portiuncula, rose bush, cave); Stroll medieval streets of Assisi; Stop at an outdoor cafe overlooking an ancient Roman temple; Visit the Church of St Clare and see the incorrupt body of St. Clare; Visit tombs of St. Francis and St. Clare

tourDays.title: Assisi to Florence
tourDays.description: After breakfast depart for Florence. Upon arrival enjoy free time to rest and explore before dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel from Assisi to Florence; Free time to rest and explore Florence

tourDays.title: Florence - guided tour
tourDays.description: After Mass, enjoy a guided tour of Florence including the Franciscan church of Santa Croce, Piazza Signoria, Palazzo Vecchio, the Uffizi, Ponte Vecchio, Republic Square, and the Santa Maria del Fiore cathedral. After lunch visit L'Accademia to view Michelangelo's 'David' and other works of art. Free time to explore the museum and city before dinner.
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass; Guided walking tour of Florence (Santa Croce, Piazza Signoria, Palazzo Vecchio, Uffizi, Ponte Vecchio, Republic Square, Santa Maria del Fiore); Visit L'Accademia to view Michelangelo's 'David'; Free time to explore Florence

tourDays.title: Return to USA

You will have a free afternoon in Krakow before reconvening for dinner and an overnight stay at the hotel.

tourDays.title: Rhodes, Greece
tourDays.description: Get the real, authentic Rhodes experience by exploring it on foot. Your walking tour will begin in the picturesque Old Town, where you will pass through and learn all about Agora and Collachium, where the Knights of St. John of Jerusalem lived and worked. Marvel at the stunning churches, exquisite Jewish quarter, the Inns of the Knights, and the Palace of the Grand Masters. You will then tour the palace interior and walk down the Street of the Knights. Its path is paved with impressive marble and mosaics. Exploring Rhodes on foot will inevitably leave a lasting impression on you.
tourDays.activities: Walking tour of Rhodes Old Town; Visit Agora and Collachium; See churches and Jewish quarter; Visit Inns of the Knights; Tour the Palace of the Grand Masters (interior); Walk down the Street of the Knights

tourDays.title: Kusadasi / Ephesus
tourDays.description: Ephesus was one of the Seven Churches of Revelation and was once a bustling port town with wide, colonnade-bordered streets and a population of 250,000. Spectacular excavations in the last 110 years have revealed much of the glory of ancient Ephesus, including the huge agora and the library, but much has been lost. Explore the ancient site virtually at the Ephesus Experience Museum where you will see life in Paulâs time. We will view the terrace houses, also known as "the houses of the rich," which give a true impression of the ancient lifestyle. The ancient world once declared the Temple of Artemis to be one of the Seven Wonders of the World, but today, only a single column remains to mark its site. After enjoying Ephesus, you will embark on another Turkish experience at the carpet factory for a local lunch and a presentation.
tourDays.activities: Visit ancient Ephesus site; Visit Ephesus Experience Museum (virtual presentation); View terrace houses (houses of the rich); See site of the Temple of Artemis (column remains); Visit a carpet factory; Enjoy local lunch and presentation

tourDays.title: Santorini, Greece
tourDays.description: Dock in Santorini today, one of the most beautiful Greek islands. Here, picturesque, whitewashed villages topped with brilliant blue domes stand in stark contrast to the sheer-drop cliffs overlooking the Aegean Sea. The island itself perches on the edges of a volcano whose eruption 3,500 years ago is thought to have led to the collapse of the Minoan civilization. Explore the island on your own or join one of the optional excursions available for purchase on board. Shore excursions are not included today and can be purchased directly from Celebrity.
tourDays.activities: Dock in Santorini; Explore the island on your own or join optional excursions (not included)

tourDays.title: Mykonos, Greece
tourDays.description: Arrive today at the world-famous Greek island of Mykonos, where gleaming whitewashed buildings seem to climb atop each other to reach the azure sky. Admire its many hills dotted with iconic windmills. Explore the island on your own or join one of the optional excursions available for purchase on board. Shore excursions are not included today and can be purchased directly from Celebrity.
tourDays.activities: Arrive in Mykonos; Sightseeing (windmills, whitewashed buildings); Explore on your own or join optional excursions (not included)

tourDays.title: Kavala / Philippi
tourDays.description: Visit Philippi, where Paul, intending to find a place to pray by the riverside, spoke to women who had gathered there, among whom was Lydia, the seller of purple, and whose heart the Lord words that he spoke. Lydia was the first Christian to be baptized on European soil. Visit the place where this event is remembered and see a crypt dating from the Roman period, which is thought to have served as a prison for the Apostle Paul. See the famous agora, the basilica, and the theater.
tourDays.activities: Visit Philippi; See the riverside site associated with Paul's meeting with Lydia; Visit Roman-period crypt; See the agora, basilica, and theater

tourDays.title: Thessaloniki, Greece
tourDays.description: Discover Thessaloniki, the âQueen of the North,â where Paul was accused of turning the world upside down with his preaching of Christ (Acts 17: 3-6). Built by King Cassander and named after the sister of Alexander the Great, the city flourished under the Byzantine Empire. Stroll through the beautiful basilica of St. Demetrios, dedicated to a distinguished Roman proconsul martyred for his Christian faith. Look upon the Roman Agora, the center of political and public life, constructed in the 1st century AD. Along the Via Egnatia stands the Galerius Arch, where you can look out over the second-largest city in Greece from the Old City Ramparts, some dating back to Roman times.
tourDays.activities: Stroll through the basilica of St. Demetrios; View the Roman Agora; See the Galerius Arch and Old City Ramparts; Sightseeing in Thessaloniki

tourDays.title: Athens, Greece / Corinth
tourDays.description: Disembark Celebrity Infinity this morning. Discover the rich architectural splendor of the ancient city of Athens as you explore the world-renowned Acropolis, the Propylaea, the Parthenon, and the Erechtheum. Stand on Mars Hill as the Apostle Paul did when he proclaimed, "I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD..." Travel to the city of Corinth, where the Apostle Paul met fellow tentmakers Aquila and Priscilla and received a vision from the Lord. As Paul spoke, Crispus and many others believed and were baptized, establishing the church at Corinth. Discover the archaeological museum, marketplace, and temples. As you walk among the ruins, stand on the Bema, where the Apostle Paul stood before Gallio to face charges brought against him by the Jews.
tourDays.activities: Disembark Celebrity Infinity; Explore the Acropolis (Propylaea, Parthenon, Erechtheum); Stand on Mars Hill; Travel to Corinth; Visit archaeological museum, marketplace, temples in Corinth; Stand on the Bema in Corinth

tourDays.title: Nagasaki memorials, Glover Garden and farewell
tourDays.description: Tour Hypocenter Park, visit Immaculate Conception Co-Cathedral (Urakami Cathedral), have lunch, visit Glover Garden, enjoy a farewell dinner, and go up to Mt. Inasa for a final view of Japan. Overnight in Nagasaki.
tourDays.activities: Tour Hypocenter Park; Visit Immaculate Conception Co-Cathedral (Urakami Cathedral); Visit Glover Garden; Farewell dinner; Visit Mt. Inasa for final view

tourDays.title: Return to USA
tourDays.description: Transfer to Nagasaki NGS for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Nagasaki NGS; Depart for return flights home

tourDays.title: Depart USA for London
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport and board flights to England on an overnight transatlantic flight. Dinner and breakfast are served on board.
tourDays.activities: Travel to local airport; Board overnight transatlantic flight; In-flight dinner and breakfast

tourDays.title: Arrive England - Aylesford - Canterbury - Dover
tourDays.description: Arrive at London Heathrow, meet the tour guide and transfer by bus. Visit Aylesford Priory for Mass, have lunch on your own, visit St. Augustineâs Abbey in Canterbury, then continue to Dover for dinner and hotel check-in.
tourDays.activities: Arrive in England and transfer to bus; Visit Aylesford Priory and celebrate Mass; Lunch on own; Visit St. Augustineâs Abbey in Canterbury; Three-course dinner in Dover; Hotel check-in and overnight

tourDays.title: Dover Cliffs - Dover - Canterbury - Cambridge
tourDays.description: Breakfast at the hotel, sightseeing at the Cliffs of Dover and a tour of Dover Castle and tunnels. Return to Canterbury for Mass at St. Dunstanâs Church and a visit to Canterbury Cathedral, then transfer to Cambridge for check-in and dinner.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast at hotel; Sightseeing at the Cliffs of Dover; Tour Dover Castle and its tunnels; Celebrate Mass at St. Dunstanâs Church; Visit Canterbury Cathedral; Transfer to Cambridge, check-in, dinner

tourDays.title: Cambridge - Ely - Walsingham - Cambridge
tourDays.description: After breakfast visit Ely Cathedral and the Shrine to St. Etheldreda, then proceed to Walsingham to see both the Anglican Shrine of Our Lady of Walsingham and the Roman Catholic National Shrine; celebrate Mass and return to Cambridge for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast at hotel; Visit Ely Cathedral and Shrine to St. Etheldreda; Visit Anglican and Roman Catholic Shrines at Walsingham; Celebrate Mass at Walsingham; Return to Cambridge for dinner

tourDays.title: Cambridge - Kidderminster - Birmingham
tourDays.description: Begin with a half-day guided walking tour of Cambridge, then travel to Kidderminster to visit Harvington Hall (guided tour of the house, tea rooms, malt house, visitor center, and gardens). Transfer to Birmingham for hotel check-in, Mass, dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Half-day guided walking tour of Cambridge; Lunch on own; Visit Harvington Hall with guided tour; Transfer to Birmingham; Hotel check-in and Mass; Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Birmingham - Stratford upon Avon - Oxford
tourDays.description: Breakfast, panoramic driving tour of Birmingham including the Oratory on Hagley Road (Oratory of Saint Philip Neri). Continue to Stratford-upon-Avon for sightseeing and Mass at St. Gregory the Great Roman Catholic Church, visit Blenheim Palace in Woodstock, then finish the day in Oxford for check-in and dinner.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast at hotel; Panoramic driving tour of Birmingham; Visit the Oratory on Hagley Road; Sightseeing in Stratford-upon-Avon; Celebrate Mass at St. Gregory the Great Roman Catholic Church; Visit Blenheim Palace (Woodstock); Transfer to Oxford, check-in, dinner

tourDays.title: Oxford
tourDays.description: Tour Oxford including Oriel College, Wolvercote Cemetery (J.R.R. Tolkienâs gravesite), the Holy Trinity Church, and the University Church of St. Mary the Virgin. Visit St. John Henry Newmanâs House at Littlemore and celebrate Mass; free time in Oxford and dinner in the evening.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast at hotel; Tour Oriel College; Visit Wolvercote Cemetery (J.R.R. Tolkienâs gravesite); Visit Holy Trinity Church and University Church of St. Mary the Virgin; Visit St. John Henry Newmanâs House and celebrate Mass; Free time in Oxford; Dinner

tourDays.title: Oxford - London
tourDays.description: After breakfast head to London to visit Westminster Abbey, have lunch on your own, enjoy a panoramic tour of London landmarks (Big Ben, London Eye, Buckingham Palace, Piccadilly Square, Regent Street, Trafalgar Square), and (subject to availability) celebrate Mass at Westminster Cathedral; then check in at the hotel and dinner.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast at hotel; Visit Westminster Abbey; Lunch on own; Panoramic guided tour of London landmarks; Celebrate Mass at Westminster Cathedral (subject to availability); Hotel check-in and dinner

tourDays.title: London
tourDays.description: Celebrate Mass at Brompton Oratory (Church of the Immaculate Heart of Mary), return to central London via Chelsea and Lambeth, visit the Tower of London, enjoy free afternoon time, then reconvene for dinner and a West End musical show.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass at Brompton Oratory; Return to central London via Chelsea and Lambeth; Visit the Tower of London; Afternoon at leisure; Dinner at a local restaurant; Attend a West End musical show

tourDays.title: London
tourDays.description: Visit Milk Street near Crutched Friars (site of St. Thomas More's birthplace), Guildhall Square, and St. Lawrence Jewry; tour St. Paulâs Cathedral including the Crypt, see Tower Bridge and Parliament Houses, have lunch on your own, celebrate Mass at Tyburn Convent (Martyrs' Shrine), then enjoy a farewell dinner and return to the hotel to pack.
tourDays.activities: Visit Milk Street near Crutched Friars; Visit Guildhall Square and St. Lawrence Jewry; Tour St. Paulâs Cathedral including the Crypt; See Tower Bridge and Parliament Houses; Lunch on own; Celebrate Mass at Tyburn Convent (Martyrs' Shrine); Farewell dinner and pack

tourDays.title: Return to the USA
tourDays.description: After breakfast and farewells, board transfers to the airport for return flights to the USA.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast at hotel; Check out and board transfer to airport; Depart on return flight(s) to the USA

tourDays.title: Depart for Greece Make your way to your local airport where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.description:
Depart for Greece
Make your way to your local airport where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served on board.

tourDays.title: Day 2
tourDays.description: Arrive Thessaloniki Upon landing at Makedonia Thessaloniki Airport, make your way to the baggage claim area and collect your luggage. Proceed to the Arrivalâs Hall, where you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver. You will be escorted to the bus to be transferred to your hotel. Enjoy some time to relax after check in and this evening enjoy a delicious meal. Overnight in Thessaloniki.

tourDays.title: Day 3
tourDays.description: Philippi - Kavala - Thessaloniki After breakfast, start your journey in Greece with the first stop of the day in Philippi. Philippi was the city where Saint Paul the Apostle delivered his first sermon and where he established the first church in Europe. âAnd from there (He went) to Philippi, which is the leading city of the district of Macedonia and a Roman Colony. We remained in this city some daysâ¦â (Acts 16:12-18). Also, it is the site where Saint Paul baptized a woman named Lydia, the first convert to Christianity in Europe. Visit the Roman Forum, where Saint Paul cast a spirit out of a fortune-telling woman. While here, you will have the opportunity to view the prison (now in ruins) in which Saint Paul and Silas were thrown into by the owners of the fortune-tellers. Continue to the modern port city of Kavala, which was once the ancient Neapolis. This port is where Saint Paul, Silas, Luke and Timothy landed when they sailed into Europe. After enjoying this city by the sea, return to Thessaloniki for a delicious meal and restful overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 4
tourDays.description: Thessaloniki City Tour - Kalambaka Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. In the winter of 49-50 A.D., Saint Paul wrote two epistles to the Thessalonians. These letters urged Christians to âlive blamelesslyâ and to refrain from living idly while they wait for the second coming of Christ. While in Thessaloniki, you will witness a number of ancient artifacts, such as the triumphal Arch of Galerius that is found at the start of Via Egnatia. Due to the convenient location, this arch was once a strategic artery of the Roman Empire. It was originally constructed in order to honor the Roman Emperor Galerius following the Roman victory over the Persians. Following your city-tour, transfer to Kalambaka. This evening, you will have a wonderful meal and a relaxing overnight in Kalambaka.

tourDays.title: Day 5
tourDays.description: Meteora - Delphi After breakfast, you will go for a short drive to the Meteora Monasteries. In the eleventh century, there were monks who settled within caves. However, as the occupation of the Turkish increased, the monks were forced to move their settlements higher upon the rocks until they were unreachable by any opposing enemy. These settlements became Monasteries by bringing building, and living, materials by ladders and baskets. The Meteora Monasteries are notorious for preserving not only the Hellenic religion, but also, their academics and arts. During your visit, you will be able to view stunning Byzantine art, as well as the breathtaking scenery that surrounds the Monastery. Continue to Delphi for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 6
tourDays.description: Delphi - Athens Visit Delphi, the center of the ancient world (navel) of the earth, whose prestige extended far beyond the boundaries of the Hellenic world. On the slopes of Mount Parnassus, in a landscape of unparalleled beauty and majesty, lie the ruins of the Sanctuary of Apollo Phthios. Visit the site and the museum and continue to Athens, âMen of Athens, I perceive that in every way you are religious. For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I found also an altar with this inscription âto an unknown Godâ. What therefore you worship as unknown, this I proclaim to youâ¦â Athens is one of the most glorious cities in the world and the cradle of western civilization as we know it today. Dinner and an overnight at your hotel in Athens.

tourDays.title: Day 7
tourDays.description: Athens - Excursion to Corinth After a nice breakfast at the hotel, you will start with a tour of the oldest city in the world, Athens! Visit the rock that has dominated the panorama of Athens for twenty-five centuries, the Acropolis. At the Acropolis, you will see the ruins of the Parthenon, Erectheum, and Propylae. After, you will ascend Mars Hill of where Saint Paul spoke to the Athenians. At this site, Paul spoke to the Athenians about the one and only God (Acts 17:22). While in this city, you will be able to view the ancient Agora, the former public center of Athenian life. It held the focus of a political, commercial, social, religious, and cultural center. As you are in the former political center, proceed for a drive through the city to view the House of Parliament on Syntagma Square. Also, you will have the opportunity to view the University of Athens, the oldest higher education institute in Greece, as well as, the National Library of Greece that holds 4,500 Greek manuscripts. Then, visit Panathenaic Stadium, the beautifully marbled multi-purpose stadium. It is home to the Olympian Zeus, and is the site of the first modern era Olympics (1896). Following your visit in Athens, you will proceed to the ancient Corinth. Under the shadow of the towering Acropolis, Saint Paul lived in Corinth for two years. While here, Saint Paul felt great grief over the way that the Gentile Church in Corinth has become. As a result, he was prompted to write four letters, all with the overarching theme of love. In Corinth, you will have the opportunity to view the remains of the first century shops, the site of Saint Paulâs trial by Gallio, the Fountain of Peirene, and the Temple of Apollo. Following your visit to Corinth, return to Athens for a delicious meal and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 8
tourDays.description: Athens - Start 3-day Cruise (Celestyal Cruises Cruise Line) to Mykonos Following breakfast, you will proceed to the Piraeus port where you will board your 3-day cruise. Your first stop will be the Island of Mykonos, the most cosmopolitan of the Greek islands that attracts visitors from all over the world. After docking, transfer to Hora, the islandâs capital. Upon arrival in Hora, you will enjoy a walking tour that will take you on the narrow cobbled streets of the city. Pass by chic boutiques, elegant nightclubs, and white washed houses to arrive in Alefkandra. This section of Mykonos is known as the âVenice of Mykonosâ, as the homes have wooden balconies and are built on the sea. Historically, these homes were of the wealthy merchants and captains. Return to the cruise ship for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 9
tourDays.description: Kusadasi - Ephesus (Mary's House) - Patmos After breakfast on board, arrive at the lively Turkish port of Kusadasi. Transfer to the small village of Mt. Koressos. While in this village, you will visit the small stone chapel that is situated upon the site where the Virgin Mary spent her last days following Christâs crucifixion. Following this visit, your group will walk through the Magnesian Gate to the ancient Ephesus. Begin your walking tour, which will take you through the most magnificent excavations in the world. Some of the sites include the Odeon (concert hall), the Fountain of Trajan, the steam-heated Baths of Scolastika, the Temple of Hadrian and the Latrians, and the Library of Celsus. The last stop on the walking tour is the Great Theatre, the largest ancient theatre that had a capacity of 25,000 people and is a site where Saint Paul preached. On the return of your walking tour, follow the exact route that Mark Anthony and Cleopatra once rode in procession via the Arcadian Way. This main street runs from the Great Theatre to the main cityâs harbor. On your transfer back to Kusadasi, you will have the opportunity to view the Basilica of Saint John. In the sixth century, Emperor Justinian erected this structure over the grave of the evangelist, John. Upon arrival in Kusadasi, enjoy free time to explore on your own before returning to the ship. When you embark on the ship, your journey will continue to Patmos, where you will transfer to the village of Chora. While in this islandâs capital, visit the monastery of Saint John the Theologian. This marvelous structure was built nine-hundred years ago, and continues to be supported by the walls of a strong fortification. In addition to the stunning main church that contains outstanding frescoes, you will have the opportunity to view the beautiful courtyard, dining room, and the bakery. Your tour continues to the small museum, where you will view priceless ecclesiastical treasures such as books, manuscripts, mosaics, icons, textiles, vestments, and jewelry. Board the bus, which will take you to the Monastery and Grotto of the Apocalypse. In this grotto, experience a once in a lifetime opportunity to view the site of where the Book of Revelations was written. The silver niches in the wall mark the pillow and ledge that were used as a desk by the author of the Book. Additionally, view the three-fold crack made by the voice of God who emphasized the importance of honoring the Holy Trinity. Your day will culminate with a transfer to the port of Scala. While in this quaint and picturesque harbor, you will enjoy free time before returning to the ship.

tourDays.title: Day 10
tourDays.description: Heraklion - Santorini This morning you will awaken and transfer to the largest city on the island of Crete, Heraklion. While in this administrative capital, visit the ancient ruins of the Palace of Knossos. These ruins were discovered in 1899, and the palace is currently partially reconstructed. This ancient palace is believed to have been the mythical Labyrinth of King Minos and the seat of ancient Minoan culture. Additionally, it is the site where Saint Paul met the owner and captain of the ship who warned him of continuing his journey to spread Christianity in Rome. Following this historical visit, you will embark the ship that will take you to the idyllic island of Santorini. Santorini is definitively the most breathtaking island of all of the Greek Islands. Upon arrival in Santorini, visit Thira with its iconic white-washed houses, narrow streets, open-air cafes, and glittering boutiques that cling to steep cliffs. This evening you will return to the ship for your last dinner and overnight on your cruise. (for sailings between late October to late March, the cruise line may use a winter schedule that does not include disembarkation on the Island of Crete, spending the entire day on Santorini)

tourDays.title: Day 11
tourDays.description: Piraeus - Athens - Tel Aviv Today marks the end of your cruise. After disembarkation you will be transferred to Athens airport where you will board your flight to Tel Aviv. Upon arrival in Tel Aviv, you will be met by the 206 Tours representative and transfer to your hotel in the Tel Aviv area. Dinner will be served at the hotel.

tourDays.title: Day 12
tourDays.description: Tel Aviv - Caesarea - Nazareth - Cana - Tiberias This morning we will depart Tel Aviv to Caesarea Maritima, located on the shores of the Mediterranean. Built by Herod the Great, Caesarea was where St. Peter baptized the first gentile convert, Cornelius (Acts 10). We will see the Roman theatre, Herodâs Palace, view the Hippodrome, and the harbor from which St. Paul sailed on his journeys to spread the Gospel of Jesus Christ throughout the ancient world. Continue to Nazareth to visit the museum and archaeological Garden, which contain remains of Nazareth at the time of Christ. Visit the museum and archaeological Garden where we can see the remains of Nazareth at the time of Christ, as well as St. Josephâs workshop â which is now known as St. Josephâs Church. Within the Church of the Annunciation, you will make your way down to the Grotto to see the remains of the house of the Blessed Mother and where the Angel of the Lord announced the good news to Mary. From here, we drive to Cana, where Jesus performed His first miracle, changing water into wine at His motherâs request. We celebrate Mass here at the Wedding Church, and married couples will have the chance to renew their wedding vows. From there, we continue to our hotel by the Sea of Galilee for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 13
tourDays.description: Tiberias: Sea of Galilee This morning we take a boat ride on the beautiful Sea of Galilee (Luke 5:1). Then we visit Capernaum, the fishing town where Jesus lived and launched His ministry to change our lives and the world. In Capernaum, we see the Synagogue where Jesus taught (Mark 1:21-29) and gave the Sermon on the Bread of Life. We continue to the Mount of Beatitudes, where Jesus delivered the Sermon on the Mount (Luke 6:20-49). Then to Tabgha, where Jesus fed the crowd of 5,000 people with five loaves of bread and two fish (Luke 9:10-17). Nearby is St. Peterâs Primacy, where Peter confirmed his Love of Jesus (John 21), and it was in this place that Jesus anointed Peter to lead His Church and became the first Pope. (John 21:9). Continue visiting Mary Magdaleneâs birthplace in Magdala. During the time of Jesus, this village was a prosperous fishing village that exported fish and garum, a fish sauce reduction popular in Roman cooking. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 14
tourDays.description: Mt. Tabor - Jericho - Jerusalem After breakfast, drive to the site of the Transfiguration, Mount Tabor (Matthew 17:1-50). You will have time to reflect on Christâs Divinity at this site. Celebrate Mass at the Basilica of the Transfiguration and then continue south towards the Jordan Valley, to the worldâs oldest inhabited city (Jericho (Joshua 6:12-25). In Jericho, you view the exact location, the Mount of Temptation, where the Devil tempted Jesus during his forty-day fast (Luke 4:1). Drive up to Jerusalem to check in to your hotel for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 15
tourDays.description: Jerusalem: Bethlehem & Ein Karem This morning we go to the village of Ein Karem to visit the Church of St John the Baptist, which marks his birthplace (Luke 1.5). Nearby is the Church of Visitation that commemorates the visit of our Blessed Mother to her cousin, Elizabeth, who stayed with her for three months (Luke 1.39). Many people pray the Mystery of the Rosary as they walk up the hill to the Church. Later drive to Bethlehem to visit the fields where the Angel appeared to the shepherds to proclaim the birth of Jesus Christ (Luke 2:8). We enter the caves where shepherds took shelter in ancient times and see the soot marks of the fires they lit to keep warm. Continue to Manger Square and the Church of the Nativity. We enter the Church through the door of humility and proceed down to the Grotto of the Nativity, which marks the place of Our Saviourâs birth (Matthew 2:1-18). Beneath the altar is a silver star and a Latin inscription that states: HIC DE VIRGINE MARIA JESUS CHRISTUS NATUS (Here, Jesus Christ was born to the Virgin Mary). Following Mass in Bethlehem, return to the hotel in Jerusalem for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 16
tourDays.description: Jordan River - Qumran - Dead Sea Drive through the Judean wilderness, the site where Jesus spent His 40 days of fasting. We head to the Jordan River for some time to reflect on the Baptism of Christ Matthew 3:13-17). In the afternoon, we visit the Essene site where the Dead Sea Scrolls were found in Qumran. (Ezekiel 47:8-10). These writings have helped further the understanding of the Jewish background of Christianity. Before returning to Jerusalem, there is also time to swim or float on the Dead Sea, the lowest and saltiest place on Earth.

tourDays.title: Day 17
tourDays.description: Jerusalem: Mt. Of Olives - Gethsemane - Mt. Zion (Upper Room) After breakfast, you will make your way to the Mount of Olives, where you will be able to take in the beautiful, panoramic view of Jerusalem. Historically, the Mount of Olives was a mandatory transit point for Jesus during many iconic moments. Visit the Pater Noster Shrine where Jesus taught His disciples the Lordâs Prayer (Pater Noster) (Luke 11:1-4). You will have the opportunity to stop at Dominus Flevit which is a Church that commemorates where Jesus wept for Jerusalem (Luke 19:41). Continue on to Gethsemane, a garden at the foot of the Mount of Olives. Jesus brought His disciples here to pray the night before He was crucified (Luke 22:29-53). The Garden still contains trees with roots that date back to the time of Jesus. Your next stop, the Church of All Nations, is built over the âRock of Agonyâ. This is where Jesus prayed alone on the night of His arrest. Throughout this time, you are invited to remain in prayer and to reflect on Christâs agony that He experienced. You will have the opportunity to visit the Western Wall, which is the last remnant of the Jewish Temple after it was destroyed in 70 A.D. Continue with a visit to the house of the High Priest Caiaphas (Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu). This Church commemorates where Jesus was examined and eventually imprisoned before the Council in Jerusalem. It also commemorates Peterâs Denial of Christ (John 18:15-18), Petersâ repentance, and Jesusâ forgiveness of Peter. You will also visit the Upper Room on Mt. Zion. The Upper Room is where Jesus and His disciples celebrated the Last Supper (Matthew 26:17-30) and where Jesus appeared to His disciples after His Death and Resurrection (Mark 16:14). In addition, visit the nearby Benedictine Church of the Dormition. Tradition tells us that this Church is where Mary, the Mother of Jesus, âfell asleep.â At the end of this prayerful day, return to your hotel for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 18
tourDays.description: Jerusalem: Via Dolorosa - Holy Sepulchre- Western Wall Very early this morning we walk together in prayerful procession along the Via Dolorosa (The Way of the Cross). We start at the Antonia Fortress, where Jesus was condemned to death by Pontius Pilate (John 18:28-19:16) and receives His cross. We end at the Church of the Holy Sepulcher, which marks the place of the Crucifixion & the Resurrection, (Luke 23:26-33). After Mass at the Church of the Holy Sepulcher we return to the hotel for breakfast. Later we revisit the Old City to see the Church of St. Anneâs, the traditional birthplace of the Virgin Mary. Nearby is the Pool of Bethesda, where Jesus healed the crippled man (John 5:1-9). End the day with a visit the Western Wall, which is the last remnant of the Jewish Temple destroyed in 70 A.D.

tourDays.title: Day 19
tourDays.description: Jerusalem - Tel Aviv - Rome After an early breakfast, you will transfer to Tel Aviv Airport for your flight(s) to Rome. Upon arrival in Rome, you will be greeted by your tour escort and/or driver. After a warm welcome to Italy, you will be escorted to your transportation to your hotel. This afternoon, your guide will introduce you to your fellow pilgrims and priest who will be with you for the rest of the journey. You will make your way to Mass, followed by a welcome dinner with wine. This evening, you may walk to St. Peterâs Square for Rosary (optional).

tourDays.title: Rome: Papal Audience - Piazza Navona â Pantheon - Basilica of St. John the Lateran â Holy Stairs - Basilica of St. Mary Major
tourDays.description:
After a nice breakfast at your hotel, your first sightseeing day in Rome starts! The tour begins with the Papal Audience in St. Peterâs Square! The Audience is celebrated each Wednesday by His Holiness, The Pope (pending the papal schedule). Following the Audience, there will be free time for lunch, or to shop, or to mail a postcard from the Vatican Post Office. This afternoon, you will visit the oldest of the four major Basilicas in Rome, and the home to the relics of Peter and Paul, the Basilica of St. John the Lateran. This Basilica is where The Pope was installed as Bishop of Rome, and where he officiates as the Bishop of Rome. Next, you will cross the street to visit the Holy Staircase. Tradition states that this staircase is from Pontius Pilateâs palace of Jerusalem during the time of Jesus. It is also said this Staircase was brought to Rome by St. Helen in the 4th century. If time permits, you may climb the steps on your knees, in memory of Christâs agonizing Passion. To conclude your day, you will proceed to the Basilica of St. Mary Major. This Basilica contains a relic from the Manger of the Infant Jesus. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight.
*The Scala Santa is currently under restoration. Thus, the Vatican has displayed an image replicating the stairs in front of the entrance where you will walk in. There are several staircases just to the side of the Scala Santa that you may ascend on your knees. You will still be able to receive the same graces and indulgences by going up any of the alternative stairs.

tourDays.title: Day 21
tourDays.description: Rome: St. Peter's Basilica - Vatican Museum - Appian Way - Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls - Catacombs This morning, you will enjoy an early breakfast before making your way to the largest Christendom Church, St. Peterâs Basilica. This Basilica was built on the site where St. Peter, the first Pope and Bishop of Rome, was martyred. Also, it was Our Holy Father, The Pope, who was the first Pontiff to visit the necropolis since extensive archaeological excavations were conducted at the ancient site decades ago. It is here that you will view Michelangeloâs Pieta. This stunning marble sculpture depicts the Virgin Mary holding Christ after His crucifixion, death, and removal off the cross before being placed in the tomb. Continue to proceed to the Vatican Museums. At the world-renowned museum, you will see the most impressive of edifices, galleries, and awe-inspiring relics. Additionally, you will observe the Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel, and Michelangeloâs Masterpiece, the restored mural of the Last Judgment. The final stop on your Vatican tour is at the tomb of Saint John Paul II. Next, head to the Piazza Navona area for some free time and lunch (on your own). Continue on your short journey down the Appian Way, the earliest road of Ancient Rome. This road leads to the Domino Quo Vadis Chapel, the Baths of Caracalla, the Arch of Drusus, the Tomb of Cecilia Metella, and the catacombs of St. Callixtus. The day concludes with a visit to the Basilica of St. Paul, outside the walls. Originally founded by Emperor Constantine in the 4th Century, this Basilica is the burial places of Saint Paul the Apostle. Next, make your way to a local restaurant for dinner. Following dinner, feel free to explore the streets of Rome, or return to the hotel for an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 22
tourDays.description: Rome - Montecassino - San Giovanni Rotondo Following breakfast, you will board your bus to enjoy the scenic route to Montecassino. Passing through the Roman countryside that is known for its villas and vineyards. During the bus ride, your tour escort will share interesting information regarding the spiritual, historical, and cultural aspects of Italy. Montecassino, the principle monastery of the Benedictine Order, was founded by Saint Benedict around 530 A.D. Following the tour, there will be an opportunity to visit the gift shop, before you board the bus to continue toward San Giovanni Rotondo, the hometown of Saint St. Padre Pio. Upon arrival in San Giovanni Rotondo, you will check-in, enjoy dinner in a restaurant, and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 23
tourDays.description: San Giovanni Rotondo (View Incorrupt Body of St. Padre Pio) - Monte Sant' Angelo This morning, after breakfast, you will visit the Old Church. After Mass, you will tour the sanctuary, it is here you will view the crucifix, in front of which St. Pio received the stigmata. Visit the confessional from where St. Pio spent an innumerable amount of hours listening to confessions. Next, you will board the bus and travel along the beautiful Gargano Peninsula to the Grotto of St. Michael the Archangel, a shrine consecrated by St. Michael. At this grotto, St. Michael appeared to a Bishop to assure him that his diocese would not be annihilated as he feared. Following the visit to the grotto, enjoy free time. On the way back to San Giovanni Rotondo, view breathtaking views of the ocean and surrounding countryside. Upon arrival, you will have time for devotion and reflection. Dinner and an overnight in San Giovanni Rotondo. *Candlelight Procession â Between May and October attend the weekly Candlelight Procession at the Sanctuary of St. Pio after dinner, at 9:00 PM. These processions are lit by candlelight, and are guided by the Most Holy Rosary. Following this prayerful experience, you will return to your hotel for a restful overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 24
tourDays.description: San Giovanni Rotondo - Lanciano - Loreto - Assisi After breakfast, you we leave for Assisi. On the way we stop in Lanciano for private Mass at the Convent/Church of Saint Francis built on top of the antique Church of St. Longinus â the site of a Eucharistic Miracle that occurred in the eighth century. At the time of the miracle, there was a Basilian monk, who struggled with the belief in the Real Presence in the Eucharist. During the time of Mass, the monk, with doubt in his voice, said the words of consecration and the bread and wine transformed into physical flesh and blood. Leave for Marian shrine of Loreto to visit the Holy House of Nazareth and the beautiful Madonna of Loreto. Tradition holds that this is the house in which Mary first prayed the Magnificat, in which Jesus grew to manhood, and in which the Holy Family lived, before it was transported several times by angels, to its current location. End the day in Assisi, hometown of St. Francis and St. Clare, with dinner and overnight at your hotel.

tourDays.title: Day 25
tourDays.description: Assisi (The Life of a Saint that inspired a Holy Father) As you visit the birthplace of St. Francis, you will become captivated as the atmosphere has not changed since St. Francis began his ministry, in the early 13th-century. You will start your tour at the St. Francis Basilica, visit his tomb of St. Francis, and have the opportunity to view a series of frescoes depicting his life, along with a few of the saintâs possessions. Followed by a visit to the Santuario Della Spogliazione where St. Carlo Acutis tomb is placed. Carlo is the first millennial to be declared a Saint who loved the Real Presence of Jesus in the Eucharist. From there, you will continue on a walking tour through this picturesque town, including the birthplace of St. Francis, and end with a tour of the Church that honors St. Clare, the foundress of the Poor Clare Sisters. This Saint followed the teachings of St. Francis very closely by also living a life of poverty and humility. Enjoy some free time on your own â you may take this time for additional prayer, shop in the many gift shops or enjoy a nice lunch. After lunch, you will board the bus, which will take you outside of the walls of Assisi, to the Basilica of St. Mary of the Angels. This is where St. Francis spent most of life. This Basilica is made up of two structures, both of which you will visit. The first structure, is the âPorziuncolaâ, which is where St. Francis founded his order of the Friar Minor (Franciscans). The second, is the âCapella del Transitoâ, which is the place of St. Francisâ death. During your time here, you will have the opportunity to visit the beautiful Rose Garden where St. Francis and other friars lived, as well as the cave where the Saint retired to pray. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 26
tourDays.description: Assisi - Orvieto - Assisi This morning, you will ride through the beautiful Umbrian mountains to Orvieto. This incredible town sits on a volcanic high rock formation. Here we visit one of the most beautiful and most renowned Cathedrals in Italy. Because of its strategic location, itâs Christian history officially started in 1004, but Orvieto was built over preexisting Etruscan era cave tunnels dating back 2,500 years, which some historians believe Christians used to celebrate Mass when Christianity was forbidden. Return to Assisi for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 27
tourDays.description: Assisi - Siena - Florence Breakfast, followed by a scenic drive to the Tuscan city of Siena. This medieval city is the birthplace of St. Catherine âDoctor of the Churchâ, and the Apostle of Italy, St. Bernardine. Visit of the Basilica of St. Catherine (which is also known as the Basilica of St. Domenico). St. Catherine passed a large part of her life inside the walls of this Basilica. It is here you will also view the incorrupt head of St. Catherine. After, visit the Shrine of St. Catherine, which occupies the site of her family home. Enjoy your walking tour through the Siena including a visit to its Cathedral (Duomo di Siena). Conclude at one of Italyâs finest squares, the Piazza Del Campo, where you will be given free time to spend at your own leisure. There are a number of restaurants surrounding the square to have lunch, as well as shops for gifts and souvenirs. Continue on to Florence. Upon arrival in Florence, you will notice immediately that it is the land for art lovers. Some of the most world renowned artists are from Florence such as, Dante, Leonardo da Vinci, Michelangelo, Raphael, Botticelli, Donatello, and many others. For the remainder of the afternoon, you will have the opportunity to explore the streets of Florence at leisure. In the evening gather for dinner, followed by an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 28
tourDays.description: Florence In Florence, your day begins with breakfast, followed by a guided tour. The tour starts at the Church of the Holy Cross, the Santa Croce, where many nobles are buried, such as Michelangelo, Galileo, and Machiavelli. Continue to walk by Piazza Signorina, Palazzo Vecchio, Uffizi, Ponte Vecchio, and Republic Square to the Santa Maria del Fiore. This Cathedral is an iconic piece of architecture of the city of Florence. It was designed by Filippo Brunelleschi in the 13th century. Next, a visit to LâAccademia, the well-known art gallery. At this gallery, you will have the opportunity to view the work from artists such as Botticelli, Ghirlandaio, Pontormo and the ever famous sculpture by Michelangelo, David. This afternoon you will have time to explore Florence on your own. Return to hotel for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 29
tourDays.description: Florence â Padua Following breakfast at your hotel, board the motor coach for your transfer to Padua. This Northern Italian city honors the âPatron Saint of Lost Things and Causesâ, St. Anthony. You will begin a sightseeing tour of the city, including a view of one of the oldest Universities in Italy, the University of Padua, as well as the Basilica of Santa Giustina, the âPatron Saint of Padua.â The tour will conclude at the Basilica of St. Anthony, where you will have the opportunity to visit his tomb. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 30
tourDays.description: Padua - Venice (Full Day Excursion) Today, you will have early breakfast and then board your bus to depart to the magical city of Venice. After Mass, enjoy a tour of the âcity paved with water!â Your walking tour includes a visit to St. Markâs Square, the largest square in the city and the site of many government buildings; the Golden Basilica of San Marco, known for the great mosaics that depict the Old and New Testament of the Bible; the Bridge of Sigh, a bridge that will bring eternal love to those who drift below it. You will also have the chance to view the Dogesâ Palace (Dukeâs Palace), which served as the seat of the Government for the Republic of Venice for centuries. Return to Padua for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Budapest â Esztergom â Szentendre â Budapest
tourDays.description: Breakfast on-board followed by your departure to Esztergom, a medieval city lying picturesquely on the Danube Bend. We will also visit Szentendre, the charming, ethnic artist colony with its winding lanes, seven aspiring church towers, colorful houses, narrow side streets, genuine Mediterranean ambience and scores of museums, galleries, guest houses and warm restaurants. It is the most frequented tourist destination of the Danube Bend. Return to the ship for lunch. After lunch, depart for a tour of Buda, the upper part of Budapest. Visit the Castle District and see the main attractions of the area: Fisherman's Bastion which takes its name from the guild of fishermen that were responsible for defending this stretch of city walls in the Middle Ages, followed by Matyas Church, a gorgeous Romanesque style church whose Ecclesiastical Art museum houses numerous sacred relics and medieval stone carvings, including replicas of the Hungarian royal crown and coronation jewels. Return to the ship for dinner and a folklore show this evening.
