tourDays.title: Theme: The Ministry of Christ in the Galilee
tourDays.description: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee; visit an ancient boat remains, Mount of Beatitudes, Tabgha, Peter's Primacy, Magdala excavations, and Capernaum.
tourDays.activities: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee; See remains of a 1st-century boat; Visit Mount of Beatitudes; Visit Tabgha (site of the Feeding of the 5,000); Visit Peter's Primacy site; Visit Magdala archaeological site and 1st-century synagogue; Visit Capernaum (synagogue and site of Peter's house)

tourDays.title: Theme: The Transfiguration
tourDays.description: Drive to Mount Tabor for the Transfiguration site and Mass; travel down the Jordan Valley to Jericho, view Mount of Temptation and a sycamore tree, visit Baptismal site on the Jordan River, then continue to Jerusalem.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Mount Tabor and celebrate Mass; Drive down the Jordan Valley to Jericho; View Mount of Temptation and a sycamore tree; Visit Baptismal site on the Jordan River; Transfer to Jerusalem and hotel check-in

tourDays.title: Theme: The Visitation and Nativity
tourDays.description: Visit Second Temple scale model, Ein Karem (birthplace of John the Baptist) and Church of the Visitation; in Bethlehem visit Shepherds' Field, Manger Square and Church of the Nativity including the Grotto of the Nativity; celebrate Mass and return to hotel.
tourDays.activities: Visit Second Temple scale model; Visit Ein Karem and Church commemorating John the Baptist; Pray the Rosary walk up to Church of the Visitation; Visit Shepherds' Field caves; Visit Manger Square; Enter Church of the Nativity and descend to the Grotto of the Nativity; Celebrate Mass

tourDays.title: Theme: Early Years in Jerusalem & the Wilderness
tourDays.description: Drive to Qumran to see Dead Sea Scrolls site; optional swim in the Dead Sea; traverse Judean Wilderness and visit Bethany (site of Lazarus raise) and celebrate Mass there before returning to hotel.
tourDays.activities: Visit Qumran (Dead Sea Scrolls site); Optional dip in the Dead Sea; Drive through the Judean Wilderness; Visit Bethany and celebrate Mass

tourDays.title: Theme: Palm Sunday and the Agony in the Garden
tourDays.description: Panoramic view from Mount of Olives, visit Pater Noster shrine, Dominus Flevit, Gethsemane and Church of All Nations (Rock of Agony), Western Wall, Peter in Gallicantu and Mt. Zion including the Upper Room and Dormition Church; celebrate Mass.
tourDays.activities: Take panoramic view from Mount of Olives; Visit Pater Noster shrine; Walk down Palm Sunday Road to Dominus Flevit; Reflect at Gethsemane and Church of All Nations (Rock of Agony); Visit the Western Wall; Visit Peter in Gallicantu (house of Caiaphas); Visit Mount Zion (Upper Room) and Benedictine Church of the Dormition; Celebrate Mass

tourDays.title: Theme: The Way of the Cross, The Crucifixion, The Resurrection
tourDays.description: Begin the Via Dolorosa at the Antonia Fortress and follow the Stations of the Cross through the Old City to the Church of the Holy Sepulchre for Mass; visit Church of St. Anne, Pool of Bethesda and Sisters of Zion with time to revisit the Old City in the afternoon.
tourDays.activities: Start Via Dolorosa at Antonia Fortress; Walk the Stations of the Cross to the Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Celebrate Mass in the Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Visit Church of St. Anne and the Pool of Bethesda; Visit Sisters of Zion; Free time to revisit Old City

tourDays.title: Tel Aviv - USA
tourDays.description: Transfer to Ben Gurion Airport in Tel Aviv for return flight to the USA.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to airport; Flight home

tourDays.title: Depart for Paris
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport, where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Travel to local airport; Board overnight flight(s); Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Arrive in Paris and transfer to Lisieux
tourDays.description: Arrive at Paris airport, meet driver, Spiritual Director and Tour Escort. Attend Mass at Sacre Coeur Basilica on Montmartre. Time permitting, opportunity to ascend to the Dome for panoramic views. Lunch on your own, then depart for Lisieux. Visit the Basilica of St. Therese. Dinner and overnight in Lisieux.
tourDays.activities: Meet driver, Spiritual Director and tour escort; Attend Mass at Sacre Coeur Basilica; Optional ascent to Sacre Coeur Dome; Lunch on own; Transfer to Lisieux; Visit Basilica of St. Therese; Dinner and overnight in Lisieux

tourDays.title: Normandy Landing Beaches and American Cemetery
tourDays.description: After breakfast and Mass in Lisieux, travel to the Normandy landing beaches and visit the Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial in Colleville-Sur-Mer. Return to Lisieux for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass in Lisieux; Visit Normandy landing beaches (D-Day sites); Visit Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial; Return to Lisieux for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Chartres and transfer to Paris
tourDays.description: Depart for Chartres to visit the Cathedral of Notre Dame and view its stained-glass windows. Venerate a relic of the Veil of Our Lady. Free time for lunch in Chartres, then continue to Paris to check in at the hotel. Dinner and overnight in Paris.
tourDays.activities: Visit Chartres Cathedral (Notre Dame); Venerate relic of the Veil of Our Lady; Free time for lunch in Chartres; Transfer to Paris and hotel check-in; Dinner and overnight in Paris

tourDays.title: Paris sightseeing: Sacre Coeur, Miraculous Medal Chapel, Notre Dame
tourDays.description: Celebrate Mass in the morning. Visit Sacre Coeur Basilica (Montmartre), Chapel of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal to view incorrupt body of St. Catherine Laboure, Saint Vincent de Paul Church, and Notre Dame Cathedral. Board a bus tour to see the Eiffel Tower, Les Invalides, L'Arc de Triomphe, and the Champs-Elysees. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass; Visit Sacre Coeur Basilica; Visit Chapel of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal and view incorrupt body of St. Catherine Laboure; Visit Saint Vincent de Paul Church; Visit Notre Dame Cathedral; Bus tour of Paris landmarks (Eiffel Tower, Les Invalides, Arc de Triomphe, Champs-Elysees); Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Fly from Paris to Rome
tourDays.description: Transfer to Charles de Gaulle Airport and board flight to Rome. Upon arrival in Rome, transfer to the hotel, check in, and free time to relax or explore. Meet in hotel lobby for a meet and greet, depart for Mass, then welcome dinner. Optional walk to St. Peter's Square to pray the Rosary. Overnight in Rome.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Charles de Gaulle Airport; Fly from Paris to Rome; Transfer to hotel and check-in; Meet and greet with fellow pilgrims; Attend Mass in Rome; Welcome dinner; Optional visit to St. Peter's Square to pray the Rosary

tourDays.title: Papal Audience and major basilicas
tourDays.description: Attend the Papal Audience in St. Peter's Square (pending papal schedule). Free time for lunch. Visit the Basilica of St. John the Lateran, the Holy Staircase, and the Basilica of St. Mary Major. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Attend Papal Audience in St. Peter's Square (subject to papal schedule); Free time for lunch and shopping; Visit Basilica of St. John the Lateran; Visit the Holy Staircase (Scala Sancta); Visit Basilica of St. Mary Major; Dinner and overnight in Rome

tourDays.title: Vatican tour and ancient Rome
tourDays.description: Early visit to St. Peter's Basilica to view Michelangelo's Pieta. Proceed to the Vatican Museum (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel, Last Judgment, tomb of St. John Paul II). Free time in Piazza Navona for lunch. Visit the Appian Way (Quo Vadis Chapel, Baths of Caracalla, Arch of Drusus, Tomb of Cecilia Metella, Catacombs of St. Callixtus). Conclude with Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls, then dinner at a local restaurant.
tourDays.activities: Visit St. Peter's Basilica and view Michelangelo's Pieta; Tour Vatican Museum (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel, Last Judgment); Visit tomb of Saint John Paul II; Free time at Piazza Navona for lunch; Visit Appian Way and associated sites (Quo Vadis Chapel, Baths of Caracalla, Arch of Drusus, Tomb of Cecilia Metella, Catacombs of St. Callixtus); Visit Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls; Dinner at a local restaurant

tourDays.title: Fly to Medjugorje and transfer to village
tourDays.description: Head to the airport for flights to Medjugorje. Upon arrival, greeted by guide/driver and transfer by road to the village of Medjugorje. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to airport; Fly from Rome to Medjugorje; Meet local guide/driver; Drive to Medjugorje village; Dinner and overnight in Medjugorje

tourDays.title: Medjugorje: prayer, Mass, climbs and local visits
tourDays.description: A local guide accompanies the group. Participate in spiritual activities including Daily Mass at St. James Church, climbing Apparition Hill and Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain), attending evening commemorations of apparitions, Adoration, Veneration of the Cross, a visit to the Community of Cenacolo, and prayer at the Statue of the Risen Christ.
tourDays.activities: Attend Daily Mass at St. James Church (English-speaking); Climb Apparition Hill (Blue Cross at base; pray Rosary during climb); Climb Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain) and pray Stations of the Cross; Join evening Apparitions commemorations and pray the Rosary; Attend Croatian Mass and Blessing of the Sick (when available); Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament (when scheduled); Visit the Community of Cenacolo; Pray at the Statue of the Risen Christ

tourDays.title: Medjugorje: continued spiritual program
tourDays.description: Continued time in Medjugorje with opportunities for Mass, climbs to Apparition Hill and Mt. Krizevac, evening apparitions/rosary, Adoration, visit to Community of Cenacolo, and prayer at the Statue of the Risen Christ. A local guide accompanies the group.
tourDays.activities: Attend Daily Mass at St. James Church (English-speaking); Climb Apparition Hill; Climb Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain); Join evening Apparitions commemorations and pray the Rosary; Attend Croatian Mass and Blessing of the Sick (when available); Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament (when scheduled); Visit the Community of Cenacolo; Prayer at the Statue of the Risen Christ

tourDays.title: Medjugorje: final full day
tourDays.description: Final full day in Medjugorje with continued participation in Mass, climbs, apparitions, Adoration, visit to Community of Cenacolo, and prayer at the Statue of the Risen Christ. A local guide accompanies the group.
tourDays.activities: Attend Daily Mass at St. James Church (English-speaking); Climb Apparition Hill; Climb Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain); Join evening Apparitions commemorations and pray the Rosary; Attend Croatian Mass and Blessing of the Sick (when available); Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament (when scheduled); Visit the Community of Cenacolo; Prayer at the Statue of the Risen Christ

tourDays.title: Return home
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast and farewells, transfer to Dubrovnik, Split, or Sarajevo Airport for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Transfer to designated airport (Dubrovnik, Split, or Sarajevo); Board return flights home

tourDays.title: Depart for the Holy Land Make your way to your local airport where you will board your overnight flight. Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.description:
Depart for the Holy Land
Make your way to your local airport where you will board your overnight flight. Your meals will be served on board.

tourDays.title: Day 2
tourDays.description: Arrive in Tel Aviv Upon arrival at Ben Gurion Airport in Tel Aviv, make your way to the baggage claim area and collect your luggage. Proceed to the Arrivalâs Hall, where you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver. Transfer to your hotel in Tel Aviv to check-in. Enjoy dinner at the hotel before retiring for the evening.

tourDays.title: Day 3
tourDays.description: Tel Aviv - Caesarea - Nazareth - Cana - Tiberias Theme: The Annunciation This morning we will depart Tel Aviv to Caesarea Maritima, located on the shores of the Mediterranean. Built by Herod the Great, Caesarea was where St. Peter baptized the first gentile convert, Cornelius (Acts 10). We will see the Roman theatre, Herodâs Palace, view the Hippodrome, and the harbor from which St. Paul sailed on his journeys to spread the Gospel of Jesus Christ throughout the ancient world. Continue to Nazareth to visit the museum and archaeological Garden, which contain remains of Nazareth at the time of Christ. Visit the museum and archaeological Garden where we can see the remains of Nazareth at the time of Christ, as well as St. Josephâs workshop â which is now known as St. Josephâs Church. Within the Church of the Annunciation, you will make your way down to the Grotto to see the remains of the house of the Blessed Mother and where the Angel of the Lord announced the good news to Mary. From here, we drive to Cana, where Jesus performed His first miracle, changing water into wine at His motherâs request. We celebrate Mass here at the Wedding Church, and married couples will have the chance to renew their wedding vows. From there, we continue to our hotel by the Sea of Galilee for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 4
tourDays.description: Tiberias: Sea of Galilee Theme: The Ministry of Christ in the Galilee This morning we take a boat ride on the beautiful Sea of Galilee (Luke 5:1). Then we visit Capernaum, the fishing town where Jesus lived and launched His ministry to change our lives and the world. In Capernaum, we see the Synagogue where Jesus taught (Mark 1:21-29) and gave the Sermon on the Bread of Life. We continue to the Mount of Beatitudes, where Jesus delivered the Sermon on the Mount (Luke 6:20-49). Then to Tabgha, where Jesus fed the crowd of 5,000 people with five loaves of bread and two fish (Luke 9:10-17). Nearby is St. Peterâs Primacy, where Peter confirmed his Love of Jesus (John 21), and it was in this place that Jesus anointed Peter to lead His Church and became the first Pope. (John 21:9). Continue visiting Mary Magdaleneâs birthplace in Magdala. During the time of Jesus, this village was a prosperous fishing village that exported fish and garum, a fish sauce reduction popular in Roman cooking. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 5
tourDays.description: Mt. Tabor - Jericho - Jerusalem Theme: The Transfiguration After breakfast, drive to the site of the Transfiguration, Mount Tabor (Matthew 17:1-50). You will have time to reflect on Christâs Divinity at this site. Celebrate Mass at the Basilica of the Transfiguration and then continue south towards the Jordan Valley, to the worldâs oldest inhabited city (Jericho (Joshua 6:12-25). In Jericho, you view the exact location, the Mount of Temptation, where the Devil tempted Jesus during his forty-day fast (Luke 4:1). Drive up to Jerusalem to check in to your hotel for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 6
tourDays.description: Jerusalem: Bethlehem & Ein Karem Theme: The Visitation and Nativity This morning we go to the village of Ein Karem to visit the Church of St John the Baptist, which marks his birthplace (Luke 1.5). Nearby is the Church of Visitation that commemorates the visit of our Blessed Mother to her cousin, Elizabeth, who stayed with her for three months (Luke 1.39). Many people pray the Mystery of the Rosary as they walk up the hill to the Church. Later drive to Bethlehem to visit the fields where the Angel appeared to the shepherds to proclaim the birth of Jesus Christ (Luke 2:8). We enter the caves where shepherds took shelter in ancient times and see the soot marks of the fires they lit to keep warm. Continue to Manger Square and the Church of the Nativity. We enter the Church through the door of humility and proceed down to the Grotto of the Nativity, which marks the place of Our Saviourâs birth (Matthew 2:1-18). Beneath the altar is a silver star and a Latin inscription that states: HIC DE VIRGINE MARIA JESUS CHRISTUS NATUS (Here, Jesus Christ was born to the Virgin Mary). Following Mass in Bethlehem, return to the hotel in Jerusalem for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 7
tourDays.description: Jordan River - Qumran - Dead Sea Theme: Early Years in Jerusalem & the Wilderness Drive through the Judean wilderness, the site where Jesus spent His 40 days of fasting. We head to the Jordan River for some time to reflect on the Baptism of Christ Matthew 3:13-17). In the afternoon, we visit the Essene site where the Dead Sea Scrolls were found in Qumran. (Ezekiel 47:8-10). These writings have helped further the understanding of the Jewish background of Christianity. Before returning to Jerusalem, there is also time to swim or float on the Dead Sea, the lowest and saltiest place on Earth.

tourDays.title: Day 8
tourDays.description: Jerusalem: Mt. Of Olives - Gethsemane - Mt. Zion (Upper Room) Theme: Palm Sunday and the Agony in the Garden After breakfast, you will make your way to the Mount of Olives, where you will be able to take in the beautiful, panoramic view of Jerusalem. Historically, the Mount of Olives was a mandatory transit point for Jesus during many iconic moments. Visit the Pater Noster Shrine where Jesus taught His disciples the Lordâs Prayer (Pater Noster) (Luke 11:1-4). You will have the opportunity to stop at Dominus Flevit which is a Church that commemorates where Jesus wept for Jerusalem (Luke 19:41). Continue on to Gethsemane, a garden at the foot of the Mount of Olives. Jesus brought His disciples here to pray the night before He was crucified (Luke 22:29-53). The Garden still contains trees with roots that date back to the time of Jesus. Your next stop, the Church of All Nations, is built over the âRock of Agonyâ. This is where Jesus prayed alone on the night of His arrest. Throughout this time, you are invited to remain in prayer and to reflect on Christâs agony that He experienced. You will have the opportunity to visit the Western Wall, which is the last remnant of the Jewish Temple after it was destroyed in 70 A.D. Continue with a visit to the house of the High Priest Caiaphas (Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu). This Church commemorates where Jesus was examined and eventually imprisoned before the Council in Jerusalem. It also commemorates Peterâs Denial of Christ (John 18:15-18), Petersâ repentance, and Jesusâ forgiveness of Peter. You will also visit the Upper Room on Mt. Zion. The Upper Room is where Jesus and His disciples celebrated the Last Supper (Matthew 26:17-30) and where Jesus appeared to His disciples after His Death and Resurrection (Mark 16:14). In addition, visit the nearby Benedictine Church of the Dormition. Tradition tells us that this Church is where Mary, the Mother of Jesus, âfell asleep.â At the end of this prayerful day, return to your hotel for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 9
tourDays.description: Jerusalem: Via Dolorosa - Holy Sepulchre- Western Wall Theme: The Way of the Cross, The Crucifixion, The Resurrection Very early this morning we walk together in prayerful procession along the Via Dolorosa (The Way of the Cross). We start at the Antonia Fortress, where Jesus was condemned to death by Pontius Pilate (John 18:28-19:16) and receives His cross. We end at the Church of the Holy Sepulcher, which marks the place of the Crucifixion & the Resurrection, (Luke 23:26-33). After Mass at the Church of the Holy Sepulcher we return to the hotel for breakfast. Later we revisit the Old City to see the Church of St. Anneâs, the traditional birthplace of the Virgin Mary. Nearby is the Pool of Bethesda, where Jesus healed the crippled man (John 5:1-9). End the day with a visit the Western Wall, which is the last remnant of the Jewish Temple destroyed in 70 A.D.

tourDays.title: Day 10
tourDays.description: Jerusalem - Lisbon Your journey to Lisbon begins with a departure for Tel Aviv Airport. Upon arrival, you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver and transferred to your hotel in time for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 11
tourDays.description: Lisbon - Santarem - Fatima Today, we will head to Fatima, on the way will stop in town of Santarem for Mass at St. Stephens Church, and to venerate the 13th century Eucharistic Miracle. Continue to Fatima, a Hamlet of Aljustrel, the birthplace and home of the three shepherd children. Dinner and overnight in Fatima.

tourDays.title: Day 12
tourDays.description: Fatima Today will surely be a memorable experience, as you pray and meditate upon one of Our Blessed Motherâs apparition sites. Our Lady appeared to three shepherd children; Venerable Sister Lucia (age 10), St. Jacinta (age 7), and St. Francisco (age 9). These apparitions occurred monthly from May until October of 1917. Historically, as the entire world was in true turmoil, Our Ladyâs most prominent message during this time was to pray for world peace. The destruction of the world at that point in history was also mentioned by Our Lady in her messages of Fatima, and more specifically, in her second secret to the children. Our profoundly reflective day begins with a visit to the Little Chapel of the Apparitions. This simple, yet modern, chapel is the site where the Virgin Mary first appeared on May 13, 1917. Continue with a visit to the stunning neoclassical church, the Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary. This Sacred space contains the tombs of St. Francisco, St. Jacinta, and Sister Lucia. View the monument that commemorates the Sacred Heart of Jesus, in the square. Due to Our Ladyâs consistency in Her messages to pray the Rosary, this Basilica also features fifteen altars, dedicated to the fifteen mysteries of the Rosary. While in the Basilica, you will be able to feel, through the Love of Our Lord and Lady, the many graces that were received here. Visit the Museum with the exhibition: Fatima: Light and Peace. Continue with a visit to the Holy Trinity Basilica. After free time for lunch, we will experience Christâs unconditional love by participating in the Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra. The âSacred Wayâ marks the path taken by the shepherd children of Fatima to their first apparition with Our Lady. It is composed of fifteen small chapels in commemoration of the Passion of Our Lord. The fifteenth station, the Resurrection, can be found close to the Chapel of Calvary, dedicated to St. Stephen, King of Hungary. The day ends with a visit to Valinhos, the site of Our Ladyâs August 1917 apparition and the first and third apparition of the Angel. Your night will conclude with private devotions, and a candlelight procession, requested by Our Lady (1917). Enjoy dinner and a comfortable nightâs rest in Fatima.

tourDays.title: Day 13
tourDays.description: Fatima - Salamanca Depart Fatima and head to Salamanca, following a full breakfast at the hotel. Salamanca is a city in the Castilla y Leon region, and is known for its large University, the oldest in Spain that is still active, along with its prominent culture. Our walking tour will bring us by the most noteworthy sites such as; the grand Plaza Mayor, an iconic square filled with food, shopping and city events; La Clerecia, a church and college of the Jesuit Order that was constructed in the seventeenth century; La Casa de las Conchas, currently a public library but also, a monument noted and decorated by shells, which symbolizes the ever-famous pilgrimage to Santiago (El Camino); the University of Salamanca, the oldest University in Spain and the third oldest in Europe; the Roman Bridge, extends along the River Tormes, is a national monument and among one of Salamancaâs sturdiest bridges; La Iglesia de San Marcos, constructed in the Romanesque style and contains breathtaking paintings that portray many scenes of Our Ladyâs life; La Iglesia de San Martin is a Church devoted to St. Martin of Tours, who is the patron saint of beggars and those most in need. Visit the inside of the two joint Salamanca Cathedrals (old and new), one of which is a Romanesque style and the other a Gothic style. Following this eventful day, you will return to your hotel for a delicious meal with your group and an overnight at your hotel in Salamanca.

tourDays.title: Day 14
tourDays.description: Salamanca - Alba de Tormes - Ãvila - Burgos This morning, after breakfast, you will board the bus and enjoy a short transfer to the village of Alba de Tormes. This town is home to the Carmelite Monastery that Saint Teresa founded in 1571. Upon arrival in Alba de Tormes, your group will celebrate Mass at this Monastery where the saint died and was buried. Following Mass, you will have the opportunity to visit the museum dedicated to St. Teresa of Avila, which also holds her incorrupt heart and left arm. Your group will enjoy free time for lunch on your own, before continuing to the medieval city of Avila. Upon arrival in Avila, you will immediately notice the perfectly preserved eleventh-century walls that surround the old town. The conservation of architecture in this city, to which St. Teresa was born, deems its shrines, convents and churches necessary to visit on any Catholic pilgrimage. The Cathedral de Avila encompasses the Romanesque, Gothic and Renaissance styles of its time, within its artwork and architecture. La Basilica de San Vicente in Avila, stands on the site of the martyrdom of St. Vincent. Visit the Incarnation Convent, where St. Teresa became a nun. Saint Therese convinced Saint John of the Cross to reform the male Carmelite order, the reform she started when she met Saint John in Medina del Campo. After walking in the footsteps of St. Teresa, continue your journey to Burgos. Upon arrival in the historic capital of Old Castile, enjoy dinner. Following dinner, you will have the opportunity to explore the city of Burgos, and admire its magnificent limestone, gothic-style Cathedral. Late this evening, you will return to your hotel for a restful overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 15
tourDays.description:
Burgos - Loyola - Lourdes Following breakfast, transfer from Burgos to Loyola to visit the birthplace of St. Ignatius, founder of the Jesuit Order. St. Ignatius dedicated himself to becoming a soldier of the Christian faith, and as a result of many tribulations, he wrote the ever-famous Spiritual Exercises. In Loyola, you will see the 17th century Basilica that is dedicated to this remarkable Saint. The Basilica is part of a series of buildings that surrounds the âHoly House,â the birthplace of St. Ignatius. When you visit these Holy places, you will also have the opportunity to pray at the most venerated room, where St. Ignatius prayed and began his conversion. After meditating on the life of this founder of the Jesuit Order, you will enjoy free time for lunch and board the bus for the next destination. We will continue to Lourdes with a spectacular view of the Pyrenees Mountains. Upon arrival in Lourdes, you will check-in to your hotel and enjoy a splendid dinner and peaceful overnight.
Days 16 & 17: Lourdes Over the next two days, you will stay in a small town, nestled within the Pyrenees Mountains. During your time in Lourdes, you will pray and meditate in a site of Our Ladyâs apparitions. Our Lady first appeared to Bernadette in 1858, and announced herself as âThe Immaculate Conceptionâ, near the Grotto of Massabielle. During the first two apparitions, little Bernadette prayed the Rosary with Our Lady and left without any exchange of words. During the following apparitions, Our Lady emphasized Godâs love for us, penance, and the necessity of performing acts of penance for sinners. Throughout your time in Lourdes, you will have the opportunity to attend Mass at the Grotto, where Our Lady appeared to Bernadette; watch a video presentation that explains in detail, the story of Lourdes; participate with the gesture of the miraculous spring ; Wash your hands, wash your face and drink the water. Finish with a short prayer: Our Lady of Lourdesâ¦Pray for us St. Bernadetteâ¦Pray for us Oh Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee Additionally, you will have the opportunity to experience Christâs unconditional love, as you meditate upon the âlife-sizeâ Stations of the Cross that overlook the Grotto of Massabielle. In Lourdes, you will walk in and meditate upon the footsteps of St. Bernadette. Your group will have the opportunity to see Boly Mill, the birthplace of St. Bernadette, and the âCachot,â an abandoned prison where Bernadetteâs impoverished family lived. Each evening following dinner, you will have an opportunity to attend the candlelight procession and the Rosary, before a restful overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 18
tourDays.description: Lourdes - Paris - Lisieux (St. Therese - the Little Flower) Today, you will enjoy breakfast before departing for Pau or Lourdes Airport for your short flight to Paris, continue on to Lisieux. According to Pope Pius X, St. Therese of Lisieux was the âgreatest saint of modern times.â Her extraordinary love for God and service to humanity will come alive as you walk in the great Saintâs footsteps. During your visit, you will see the beautiful Basilica of St. Therese and its magnificent mosaics and stained glass windows. You will have the opportunity to view relics, clothing, and personal objects that belonged to St. Therese when you visit her family home, Les Buissonnets. Additionally, you will tour the Carmelite Convent, which she entered in 1888 and where she is now buried. Dinner and overnight at your hotel in Lisieux.

tourDays.title: Day 19
tourDays.description: Lisieux - Landing Beaches - American Cemetery Upon waking up in Lisieux, enjoy breakfast, and then your group will celebrate Mass. After Mass we will travel to the Normandy Landing beaches. The Normandy landings were the landing operations, which took place on Tuesday, June 6, 1944 (termed D-Day) by the Allies of Normandy during World War II. As the largest seaborne invasion in history, the operation began the liberation of German-occupied northwestern Europe from Nazi control and contributed to the Alliesâ victory on the Western Front. Continue to visit The Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial, a World War II cemetery and memorial in Colleville-Sur-Mer, Normandy, France, honoring the American troops that died in Europe during World War II. Many of the brave American soldiers of World War II are buried here, and it is encouraged to say a prayer in thanksgiving for their courage. Return to Lisieux for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 20
tourDays.description: Lisieux â Chartres â Paris This morning, your day begins with an early breakfast before we depart for Chartres, known worldwide for its massive Cathedral Notre Dame and its incredible stained-glass windows from the 12th and 13th centuries. The World Heritage site, UNESCO, calls the Cathedral âthe high point of French Gothic artâ and a âmasterpieceâ. Pilgrims will also be able to venerate a precious relic of the Veil of Our Lady which is currently on display at the back of the main altar of the Cathedral of Chartres. You will have some free time for lunch in the quaint town of Chartres. After lunch, we will continue to Paris to check-in at your hotel, followed by some free time before a delicious dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 21
tourDays.description: Paris Following breakfast, we will celebrate Mass. Following Mass enjoy a full day of sightseeing including the magnificent Sacre Coeur Basilica atop Montmartre Hill. The Basilica, dedicated to the Sacred Heart of Jesus, was originally built in 1914 as an act of penance for infidelity that France experienced during that time. See the beautiful mosaic of the Risen Christ and the remarkable Grand Organ. Visit the the Tombs of many notable Cardinals. Time permitting, you may have the opportunity to ascend a staircase to the Dome, where you will take in a breathtaking panoramic view of Paris. Continue with a visit of the Chapel of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal, where we will have the opportunity to view the incorrupt body of St. Catherine Laboure. The Saintâs guardian angel led her to the chapel where the Blessed Virgin Mary appeared to her. During the apparitions, Our Lady repeatedly instructed the making and purpose of the Miraculous Medal. According to the Blessed Virgin Mary, those who wear the Miraculous Medal will receive special protection and abundant graces. Following this prayerful and reflective experience, we will walk to Saint Vincent de Paul Church. Next, on our tour of Paris, we will visit one of the most incredible churches in the world: Notre Dame Cathedral. The Cathedral has recently been re-opened to visitors. Guided group tours are scheduled to resume in June 2025. Board a bus tour and see some of the most recognizable symbols of Paris, including the Eiffel Tower, the Invalides, the LâArch de Triomphe, and the Champ-Elysees, the worldâs most famous boulevard. Your busy day ends with a lovely meal and a comfortable overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 22
tourDays.description: Paris - Rome Following breakfast at your hotel, your group will transfer to the Charles de Gaulle Airport and board your short flight to Rome. Upon arrival at Rome airport, collect your luggage in the baggage claim area, and continue to the arrivalâs hall, where you will be greeted by a tour escort and/or driver. You will make your way to the bus and transfer to your hotel. Following check-in, you will have free time to unpack and relax, or explore Rome on your own. Your tour escort may suggest places to visit. Later in the afternoon, your group will meet in the hotel lobby for a âMeet and Greetâ with your fellow pilgrims and depart for Mass. Following Mass, you will attend a welcome dinner. After dinner, you will have the opportunity to walk to St. Peterâs Square as a group, for the Rosary (optional), before retiring for the evening.

tourDays.title: Day 23
tourDays.description: Rome: Papal Audience - Piazza Navona â Pantheon - Basilica of St. John the Lateran â Holy Stairs - Basilica of St. Mary Major After a nice breakfast at your hotel, your first sightseeing day in Rome starts! The tour begins with the Papal Audience in St. Peterâs Square! The Audience is celebrated each Wednesday by His Holiness, The Pope (pending the papal schedule). Following the Audience, there will be free time for lunch, or shop, or mail a postcard from the Vatican Post Office. This afternoon you will visit the oldest of the four major Basilicas in Rome, and the home to the relics of Peter and Paul, the Basilica of St. John the Lateran. This Basilica is where The Pope was installed as Bishop of Rome, and where he officiates as the Bishop of Rome. Next, we will cross the street to visit the Holy Staircase. Tradition states that this staircase is from Pontius Pilateâs palace of Jerusalem during the time of Jesus. It is also said that this Staircase was brought to Rome by St. Helen in the 4th century. If time permits, you may climb the steps on your knees, in memory of Christâs agonizing Passion. To conclude your day, you will proceed to the Basilica of St. Mary Major. This Basilica contains a relic from the Manger of the Infant Jesus. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 24
tourDays.description: Rome: St. Peter's Basilica - Vatican Museum - Appian Way - Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls - Catacombs This morning you will enjoy an early breakfast before making your way to the largest Christendom Church, St. Peterâs Basilica. This Basilica was built on the site where St. Peter, the first Pope and Bishop of Rome, was martyred. Also, it was Our Holy Father, The Pope who was the first Pontiff to visit the necropolis since extensive archaeological excavations were conducted at the ancient site decades ago. It is here that you will view Michelangeloâs Pieta. This stunning marble sculpture depicts the Virgin Mary holding Christ after His crucifixion, death, and removal off the cross before being placed in the tomb. Continue to proceed to the Vatican Museums. At the world-renowned museum, you will see the most impressive of edifices, galleries, and awe-inspiring relics. Additionally, you will observe the Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel, and Michelangeloâs Masterpiece, the restored mural of the Last Judgment. The final stop on your Vatican tour is at the tomb of Saint John Paul II. Next, head to the Piazza Navona area for some free time and lunch (on your own). Continue on your short journey down the Appian Way, the earliest road of Ancient Rome. This road leads to the Domino Quo Vadis Chapel, the Baths of Caracalla, the Arch of Drusus, the Tomb of Cecilia Metella, and the catacombs of St. Callixtus. The day concludes with a visit to the Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls. Originally founded by Emperor Constantine in the 4th Century, this Basilica is the burial places of Saint Paul the Apostle. We will make our way to a local restaurant for dinner. Following dinner, feel free to explore the streets of Rome, or return to the hotel for an overnight.

tourDays.title: Caesarea - Stella Maris - Nazareth - Tiberias
tourDays.description: Visits to Caesarea archaeological remains, Stella Maris Carmelite Monastery in Haifa, and sites in Nazareth including Byzantine Church of St. Joseph, Church of the Annunciation, and Mary's Well. Transfer to Tiberias for hotel check-in, dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Caesarea archaeological site; Visit Stella Maris (Carmelite Monastery); Visit Byzantine Church of St. Joseph; Visit Church of the Annunciation; Visit Mary's Well; Transfer to Tiberias; Hotel check-in, dinner

tourDays.title: Tiberias â Sea of Galilee
tourDays.description: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee, see remains of an ancient boat, visit the Mount of Beatitudes, Tabgha, Peter's Primacy, Magdala archaeological site and Capernaum (synagogue and site of Peter's home). Dinner and overnight in Tiberias.
tourDays.activities: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee; See 1st-century boat remains; Visit Mount of Beatitudes; Visit Tabgha; Visit Peter's Primacy; Visit Magdala excavations; Visit Capernaum (synagogue, Peter's house)

tourDays.title: Mt. Tabor â Jericho â Jordan River â Jerusalem
tourDays.description: Drive to Mount Tabor (site of the Transfiguration) with Mass, then down the Jordan Valley to Jericho to view Mount of Temptation and a sycamore tree. Visit Baptismal site on the Jordan River then proceed to Jerusalem for hotel check-in, dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Mount Tabor; Celebrate Mass; Drive through Jordan Valley to Jericho; View Mount of Temptation and sycamore tree; Visit Baptismal site on the Jordan River; Transfer to Jerusalem; Hotel check-in, dinner

tourDays.title: Jerusalem â Ein Karem â Bethlehem
tourDays.description: Begin with the Second Temple scale model for an overview of Jerusalem, visit Ein Karem (birthplace of John the Baptist) and pray the Rosary to the Church of the Visitation. In the afternoon visit Bethlehem: Shepherds' Field, Manger Square and the Church/Grotto of the Nativity. Mass, then return to hotel in Jerusalem for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Second Temple scale model; Visit Ein Karem and Church of the Visitation; Pray the Rosary; Visit Shepherds' Field; Visit Manger Square; Enter Church of the Nativity and Grotto of the Nativity; Celebrate Mass

tourDays.title: Jordan Valley: Qumran, Dead Sea, Bethany
tourDays.description: Drive to Qumran (site where Dead Sea Scrolls were found). Optional time for a dip in the Dead Sea. Drive through the Judean Wilderness and visit Bethany where Jesus raised Lazarus; celebrate Mass then return to hotel.
tourDays.activities: Visit Qumran (Dead Sea Scrolls site); Optional swim in the Dead Sea; Drive through Judean Wilderness; Visit Bethany; Celebrate Mass

tourDays.title: Mount of Olives â Gethsemane â Mt. Zion â Western Wall
tourDays.description: Panoramic view from the Mount of Olives; visit Pater Noster shrine, walk down Palm Sunday Road to Dominus Flevit. Reflect at Gethsemane and pray at the Church of All Nations/Rock of Agony. Visit the Western Wall, Peter in Gallicantu (house of Caiaphas), Upper Room on Mt. Zion and the Benedictine Church of the Dormition. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Panoramic view from Mount of Olives; Visit Pater Noster shrine; Walk Palm Sunday Road; Visit Dominus Flevit; Visit Gethsemane and Church of All Nations; Pray at the Rock of Agony; Visit Western Wall; Visit Peter in Gallicantu; Visit Upper Room (Mt. Zion); Visit Benedictine Church of the Dormition

tourDays.title: Via Dolorosa â Church of the Holy Sepulchre
tourDays.description: Begin the Via Dolorosa at the Antonia Fortress and follow the Stations of the Cross through the Old City to the Church of the Holy Sepulchre (site of Calvary and the Tomb). Mass in the Holy Sepulchre. Visit Church of St Anne, Pool of Bethesda and Sisters of Zion. Afternoon free time to revisit the Old City.
tourDays.activities: Walk the Via Dolorosa starting at Antonia Fortress; Follow Stations of the Cross to Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Celebrate Mass in Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Visit Church of St. Anne; Visit Pool of Bethesda; Visit Sisters of Zion; Free time in Old City

tourDays.title: Fly Jerusalem/Tel Aviv to Rome
tourDays.description: Depart the Holy Land and fly to Rome. Upon arrival transfer to hotel, meet the rest of the group and the priest. Attend Mass, enjoy a welcome dinner with wine and optional evening walk to St. Peter's Square for Rosary.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to airport and fly to Rome; Hotel transfer; Meet fellow pilgrims and priest; Attend Mass; Welcome dinner with wine; Optional Rosary in St. Peter's Square

tourDays.title: Rome â Papal Audience and Rome highlights
tourDays.description: Attend the Papal Audience in St. Peter's Square (Wednesdays, pending Papal schedule). Visit Trevi Fountain or Piazza Navona, then Basilica of St. John Lateran, the Holy Staircase, and Basilica of St. Mary Major. Celebrate Mass and have dinner.
tourDays.activities: Attend Papal Audience (if scheduled); Visit Trevi Fountain or Piazza Navona; Visit Basilica of St. John Lateran; Visit Holy Stairs (optional climbing on knees); Visit Basilica of St. Mary Major; Celebrate Mass

tourDays.title: Vatican Museums, St. Peter's, Appian Way and Catacombs
tourDays.description: Celebrate Mass at St. Peter's Basilica. Visit the Vatican Museums including the Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms and the Sistine Chapel; return to St. Peter's Basilica. Visit tomb of St. John Paul II. After lunch visit St. Paul Outside the Walls, tour the Appian Way (Domine Quo Vadis Chapel, Baths of Caracalla, Arch of Drusus, Tomb of Cecilia Metella) and the catacombs of St. Callixtus. Conclude with dinner.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass at St. Peter's Basilica; Tour Vatican Museums (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel); Visit tomb of St. John Paul II; Visit St. Paul Outside the Walls; Tour Appian Way (Domine Quo Vadis Chapel, Baths of Caracalla, Arch of Drusus, Tomb of Cecilia Metella); Visit Catacombs of St. Callixtus

tourDays.title: Rome to Siena and Assisi
tourDays.description: Depart Rome for Siena. In Siena stroll Piazza del Campo, visit the Cathedral and other sites including the Basilica of St. Dominic (see incorrupt head of St. Catherine). Continue on to Assisi for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel from Rome to Siena; Stroll Piazza del Campo; Visit Siena Cathedral; Visit Basilica of St. Dominic (view incorrupt head of St. Catherine); Travel to Assisi, dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Assisi: Tomb of St. Francis and related sites
tourDays.description: Visit the tomb of St. Francis and the 13th-century Basilica with its frescoes and relics; visit St. Mary of the Angels Basilica (Portiuncola, Chapel, rose bush, cave). Stroll medieval streets and visit the Church of St. Clare to see her incorrupt body. Visit tombs of the two saints before dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Basilica of St. Francis and tomb of St. Francis; Visit St. Mary of the Angels (Portiuncola, Chapel, rose bush, cave); Stroll medieval streets; Visit Church of St. Clare (see incorrupt body); Visit tombs of St. Francis and St. Clare

tourDays.title: Travel to Florence
tourDays.description: Depart Assisi and travel to Florence. Upon arrival enjoy free time to rest and explore before dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel from Assisi to Florence; Free time to explore Florence

tourDays.title: Guided tour of Florence
tourDays.description: After Mass, guided tour of Florence including Basilica of Santa Croce (Holy Cross), Piazza Signoria, Palazzo Vecchio, Uffizi area, Ponte Vecchio, Republic Square, and Santa Maria del Fiore Cathedral. Visit the Galleria dell'Accademia to view Michelangelo's David. Free time to explore before dinner.
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass; Visit Basilica of Santa Croce; Walking tour: Piazza Signoria, Palazzo Vecchio, Uffizi, Ponte Vecchio, Republic Square; Visit Santa Maria del Fiore (Duomo); Visit Galleria dell'Accademia to see Michelangelo's David; Free time in Florence

tourDays.title: Travel to Padua
tourDays.description: Depart Florence for Padua. Celebrate Mass at the Basilica of St. Anthony, then sightseeing including the historic university, Tomb of St. Anthony and several relics, Prato della Valle and the Basilica of Santa Giustina. Arrive at hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel from Florence to Padua; Celebrate Mass at Basilica of St. Anthony; Sightseeing in Padua (university, Tomb of St. Anthony, relics); See Prato della Valle; Visit Basilica of Santa Giustina

tourDays.title: Excursion to Venice
tourDays.description: Full day excursion to Venice: tour St. Mark's Square, St. Mark's Basilica, Bridge of Sighs and visit the Doge's Palace. Free time to explore, shop, and optional gondola ride. Return to Padua for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Day trip to Venice; Tour St. Mark's Square and St. Mark's Basilica; See Bridge of Sighs; Visit Doge's Palace; Free time in Venice (shopping, optional gondola ride); Return to Padua

tourDays.title: Return to USA
tourDays.description: After breakfast depart from the hotel to Venice Airport for return flight to the USA. Farewell to fellow pilgrims.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Venice Airport; Fly back to USA; Farewell

tourDays.title: Depart the USA
tourDays.description: Depart the USA.
tourDays.activities: Depart the USA

tourDays.title: Arrive in Rome
tourDays.description: Arrive in Rome and transfer to the port of Civitavecchia to board the Celebrity Ascent cruise ship.
tourDays.activities: Arrive in Rome; Transfer to the port of Civitavecchia; Board the Celebrity Ascent cruise ship

tourDays.title: At Sea
tourDays.description: Enjoy your day at sea.
tourDays.activities: Leisure day at sea

tourDays.title: Chania, Crete
tourDays.description: Arrive in the morning in Chania port. Your tour begins at the British Commonwealth War Cemetery in Souda Bay. Afterward, continue to the Agia Triada Monastery of Jagarolon. It is one of the most significant monastic complexes from the end of the Venetian Occupation of Crete. It contains a rich offering of the history and education of Crete. Discover, in the east suburbs of Chania the hill of Profiti Ilias (Prophet Elijah). After a photo stop, continue to Chania town, where neoclassical mansions and massive Venetian fortifications testify to the city's turbulent and diverse past. You will have the chance to explore the Venetian port on your own before you return to the port.
tourDays.activities: Visit British Commonwealth War Cemetery in Souda Bay; Visit Agia Triada Monastery of Jagarolon; Photo stop at Profiti Ilias (Prophet Elijah hill); Visit Chania town; Explore the Venetian port (on your own)

tourDays.title: Santorini, Greece
tourDays.description: Dock in Santorini today, one of the most beautiful Greek islands. Here, picturesque, whitewashed villages topped with brilliant blue domes stand in stark contrast to the sheer-drop cliffs overlooking the Aegean Sea. The island itself perches on the edges of a volcano whose eruption 3,500 years ago is thought to have led to the collapse of the Minoan civilization. Explore the island on your own or join one of the optional excursions available for purchase on board. Shore excursions are not included today and can be purchased directly from Celebrity.
tourDays.activities: Dock in Santorini; Explore the island on your own or join optional excursions (available for purchase)

tourDays.title: Kusadasi / Ephesus
tourDays.description: Ephesus was one of the Seven Churches of Revelation and was once a bustling port town with wide, colonnade-bordered streets and a population of 250,000. Spectacular excavations in the last 110 years have revealed much of the glory of ancient Ephesus, including the huge agora and the library, but much has been lost. Explore the ancient site virtually at the Ephesus Experience Museum, where you can see life in Paulâs time. We will view the terrace houses, also known as "the houses of the rich," which give a true impression of the ancient lifestyle. The ancient world once declared the Temple of Artemis one of the Seven Wonders of the World, but today, only a single column remains to mark its site. After enjoying Ephesus, you will embark on another Turkish experience at the carpet factory for a local lunch and a presentation.
tourDays.activities: Visit the archaeological site of Ephesus; Visit the Ephesus Experience Museum; View the terrace houses (houses of the rich); See the site/remaining column of the Temple of Artemis; Visit a carpet factory and have a local lunch and presentation

tourDays.title: Istanbul, TÃ¼rkiye
tourDays.description: Nestled between Europe and Asia, TÃ¼rkiye offers a blend of both worlds. The country has been a bridge between the two continents for thousands of years. Istanbul offers sensory delights at every turn, from its towering, colorful minarets to the scent of coffee brewing with fragrant cardamom and sugar. Shore excursions are not included today and can be purchased directly from Celebrity.
tourDays.activities: Sightseeing in Istanbul (general); optional shore excursions available for purchase

tourDays.title: Istanbul â Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Spice Bazaar
tourDays.description: The bejeweled capital of Istanbul sits between two continents and is home to 450 mosques. You will visit the famous Blue Mosque with its six minarets and sparkling interior. Walk through St. Sophia (Hagia Sophia), the largest church in Christendom for 1000 years, built by Justinian (532-537 AD). The church has 107 columns, fossil-embedded white marble floors, and beautiful glass mosaics. Today, it is the Museum of Byzantine Art. Enjoy the aroma of cinnamon, cloves, thyme, and other exotic spices as you explore the Spice Bazaar.
tourDays.activities: Visit the Blue Mosque; Walk through Hagia Sophia (St. Sophia); Explore the Spice Bazaar

tourDays.title: At Sea
tourDays.description: Enjoy your day at sea.
tourDays.activities: Leisure day at sea

tourDays.title: Mykonos, Greece
tourDays.description: Arrive today at the world-famous Greek island of Mykonos, where gleaming whitewashed buildings seem to climb atop each other to reach the azure sky. Admire its many hills dotted with iconic windmills. Explore the island on your own or join one of the optional excursions available for purchase on board. Shore excursions are not included today and can be purchased directly from Celebrity.
tourDays.activities: Arrive in Mykonos; Admire island sights (including windmills); Explore the island on your own or join optional excursions

tourDays.title: At Sea
tourDays.description: Enjoy your day at sea.
tourDays.activities: Leisure day at sea

tourDays.title: Naples / Pompeii
tourDays.description: Journey inland to ancient Pompeii, dating almost to the time of Paul, where you can see the spectacular ruins that were covered by ash from the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in AD 79.
tourDays.activities: Journey inland to Pompeii; Visit the ruins of Pompeii

tourDays.title: Rome â Colosseum, Pantheon, Forum, St. Paul
tourDays.description: Disembark Celebrity Ascent this morning. History is woven through the streets and neighborhoods of Rome as in no other city. Today, youâll explore the many wonders of ancient Rome when you visit the magnificent Colosseum and the Pantheon. From the most sacred hill of ancient Rome, Campidoglio, you will view the Forum. You will also view the Circus Maximus, the Arch of Titus, the famous Baths of Caracalla, and the Arch of Constantine. You will see the Victor Emanuel Monument and the Monti Region, Romeâs most ancient neighborhood, which is spread over three of her seven hills. Also near the Forum is the Mamertine Prison. It was the site where Romans kept their high-profile prisoners until they died or were executed. It is revered as the place where Peter was held before his crucifixion. Visit the Basilica of St. Paulâs Outside the Walls, housing the Tomb of St. Paul the Apostle, affectionately known as the Apostle to the Gentiles.
tourDays.activities: Disembark Celebrity Ascent; Visit the Colosseum; Visit the Pantheon; View the Roman Forum from Campidoglio; View the Circus Maximus; View the Arch of Titus; View the Baths of Caracalla; View the Arch of Constantine; See the Victor Emanuel Monument; See the Monti Region; Visit the Mamertine Prison; Visit the Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls (Tomb of St. Paul)

tourDays.title: Return home
tourDays.description: Return home.
tourDays.activities: Return home

tourDays.title: Christian Rome (Extension)
tourDays.description: Visit the Vatican, and explore its museum. Marvel at the beauty of St. Peter's Basilica, and stand in awe of Michelangelo's frescoes in the Sistine Chapel. Next on to the Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls. The present structure stands over the place where Constantine built the first church over Saint Paulâs grave. The church features a portrait of every Pope that has served the church. Climb the graceful Spanish Steps and stop at the famous Trevi Fountain before returning to your hotel this evening.
tourDays.activities: Visit the Vatican Museums; Visit St. Peter's Basilica; See the Sistine Chapel; Visit the Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls; Climb the Spanish Steps; Visit the Trevi Fountain; Return to hotel

tourDays.title: Travestere (Trastevere) Walking Tour
tourDays.description: Enjoy a walking tour of Travestere, one of Rome's most enchanting neighborhoods, where cobblestone alleys, ivy-colored buildings, and lively piazzas create the perfect backdrop for an unforgettable journey. As you stroll through its winding streets, your guide will reveal the history and legends of this district, from medieval churches like Santa Maria in Travestere to hidden courtyards and bustling squares where locals gather. Along the way, the experience is enriched with authentic food tastings that bring Roman culture to life. You will savor crispy suppli, sample slices of wood-fired pizza, while a glass of local wine introduces you to the art of the Roman aperitivo. The tour concludes with a sweet finale - the creamy maritozzo paired with an espresso. In the evening, enjoy a farewell dinner at a local restaurant.
tourDays.activities: Walking tour of Travestere (Trastevere); Visit Santa Maria in Travestere; Food tastings (supplÃ¬, wood-fired pizza, local wine, maritozzo and espresso); Farewell dinner at a local restaurant

tourDays.title: Return Home (Extension)
tourDays.description: Return Home
tourDays.activities: Return home

tourDays.title: Depart for Rome
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport, where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Make your way to your local airport; Board overnight flight(s); Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Arrival in Rome
tourDays.description: Welcome to Rome. Upon landing at Rome airport, claim your baggage and proceed to the Arrivals Hall, where your tour guide and/or driver will greet you. Following check-in at the hotel, enjoy some free time. Later this afternoon, between 3:00 PM and 3:30 PM, your group will meet in the hotel lobby for a meet and greet with fellow pilgrims and your priest. You will depart together for Mass, and following Mass, you will attend a welcome dinner. After dinner there is an optional walk to St. Peterâs Square for the Rosary.
tourDays.activities: Claim baggage; Meet tour guide/driver; Hotel check-in; Free time to explore; Meet and greet with fellow pilgrims and priest; Attend Mass; Welcome dinner; Optional walk to St. Peter's Square for the Rosary

tourDays.title: Papal Audience & Major Basilicas
tourDays.description: Attend the Papal Audience in St. Peterâs Square or the Audience Hall (or, for tours in July, an excursion to Castel Gandolfo visiting Piazza della LibertÃ , the Papal Palace, Vatican Observatory and Barberini Gardens). Next, free time and lunch in the Piazza Navona area. This afternoon visit the Archbasilica of St. John the Lateran, the Holy Stairs, and the Basilica of St. Mary Major where Holy Mass will be celebrated. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Attend Papal Audience (or visit Castel Gandolfo on July departures); Free time and lunch in Piazza Navona; Visit Archbasilica of St. John the Lateran; Visit the Holy Stairs; Visit Basilica of St. Mary Major; Celebrate Holy Mass

tourDays.title: St. Peter's, Vatican Museum & Appian Way
tourDays.description: Tour St. Peterâs Basilica with opportunities to view Michelangeloâs Pieta and pray at the tombs of Pope Benedict XVI and St. John Paul II. Visit the Vatican Museum (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel). After lunch continue along the Appian Way to the Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls and the Catacombs. Dinner and overnight in Rome.
tourDays.activities: Tour St. Peter's Basilica; View Michelangelo's Pieta; Pray at tombs of Pope Benedict XVI and St. John Paul II; Visit the Vatican Museum (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel); Visit the Appian Way; Visit Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls; Visit the Catacombs

tourDays.title: Montecassino & Shrine of Saint Philomena, then Sorrento
tourDays.description: Board the bus to Montecassino, tour the Benedictine monastery founded by Saint Benedict. Opportunity to visit the gift shop, then continue to Mugnano del Cardinale to visit the Shrine of Saint Philomena. Drive to Sorrento with its panoramic views of the Bay of Naples; relax before dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Bus transfer to Montecassino; Tour Montecassino monastery; Visit gift shop; Visit Shrine of Saint Philomena in Mugnano del Cardinale; Drive to Sorrento

tourDays.title: Amalfi Coast Day Tour
tourDays.description: Tour the Amalfi Coast, following scenic winding roads. Stop for panoramic views of Positano, pass through Praiano by St. Gennaro Church, visit Amalfi and view the Amalfi Cathedral. Free time for lunch, then visit Ravello including its cathedral devoted to Saint Pantaleone and Villa Rufolo. View the Gulf of Salerno and return to Sorrento for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Tour the Amalfi Coast; Stop for panoramic view of Positano; Drive through Praiano; View St. Gennaro Church; Visit/view Amalfi Cathedral; Free time for lunch; Visit Ravello and Villa Rufolo; View Gulf of Salerno; Return to Sorrento

tourDays.title: Pompeii and Onward to Assisi
tourDays.description: After breakfast board the motor coach to Pompeii to walk through the archaeological site. Visit the Shrine of the Rosary of Pompei (La Madonna Del Rosario) and view the venerated painting and relics. Continue onto Assisi, check into the hotel and relax before dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Pompeii; Walk through Pompeii archaeological site; Visit Shrine of the Rosary of Pompei (La Madonna Del Rosario); Continue to Assisi; Hotel check-in

tourDays.title: Assisi: St. Francis Sites
tourDays.description: Visit the St. Francis Basilica, including the tomb of St. Francis and frescoes, and view some of the saintâs possessions. Visit the Santuario Della Spogliazione to pray at the tomb of St. Carlo Acutis. Continue on a walking tour including the birthplace of St. Francis and the Church of St. Clare. After lunch, bus outside the walls to the Basilica of St. Mary of the Angels to visit the Porziuncola and the Capella del Transito, the Rose Garden and the cave where St. Francis prayed. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit St. Francis Basilica and tomb; View frescoes and possessions of St. Francis; Visit Santuario Della Spogliazione and pray at the tomb of St. Carlo Acutis; Walking tour of Assisi including birthplace of St. Francis; Visit Church of St. Clare; Visit Basilica of St. Mary of the Angels (Porziuncola and Capella del Transito); Visit Rose Garden and cave

tourDays.title: Day Trip to Orvieto
tourDays.description: Ride through the Umbrian mountains to Orvieto. Visit Orvieto's renowned Cathedral and learn about the town's Etruscan-era cave tunnels and early Christian history. Return to Assisi for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Orvieto; Visit Orvieto Cathedral; Return to Assisi

tourDays.title: Siena: St. Catherine & On to Florence
tourDays.description: Scenic drive to Siena. Visit the Basilica of St. Catherine (St. Domenico) and view the incorrupt head of St. Catherine. Visit the Shrine of St. Catherine (site of her family home) and tour Siena including the Duomo di Siena. Free time at Piazza del Campo for lunch. Continue on to Florence; dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Siena; Visit Basilica of St. Catherine (St. Domenico); View incorrupt head of St. Catherine; Visit Shrine of St. Catherine; Walking tour of Siena including Duomo di Siena; Free time at Piazza del Campo; Continue to Florence

tourDays.title: Florence Guided Tour
tourDays.description: Guided tour beginning at Santa Croce (burial sites of Michelangelo, Galileo, Machiavelli). Walk by Piazza Signorina, Palazzo Vecchio, Uffizi, Ponte Vecchio and Republic Square to Santa Maria del Fiore. Visit L'Accademia to view works including Michelangelo's David. Afternoon free to explore on your own. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Guided walking tour of Florence (Santa Croce, Piazza Signorina, Palazzo Vecchio, Uffizi, Ponte Vecchio, Republic Square, Santa Maria del Fiore); Visit L'Accademia (view Michelangelo's David); Free afternoon to explore

tourDays.title: Transfer to Padua & Sightseeing
tourDays.description: Board the motor coach for transfer to Padua. Sightseeing includes a view of the University of Padua, the Basilica of Santa Giustina, and concludes at the Basilica of St. Anthony where you may visit his tomb. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Padua; Sightseeing in Padua (University of Padua, Basilica of Santa Giustina); Visit Basilica of St. Anthony and his tomb

tourDays.title: Full Day Excursion to Venice
tourDays.description: Early breakfast and depart by bus to Venice. After Mass, enjoy a walking tour including St. Markâs Square, the Golden Basilica of San Marco, the Bridge of Sighs, and the Dogesâ Palace. Return to Padua for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Bus transfer to Venice; Attend Mass in Venice; Walking tour of Venice (St. Mark's Square, St. Mark's Basilica/San Marco, Bridge of Sighs, Doges' Palace); Return to Padua

tourDays.title: Return Home
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast and farewells, transfer to Venice airport for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Transfer to Venice airport; Return flights home

tourDays.title: Depart USA for Spain
tourDays.description: Depart USA for an overnight flight to Spain. Dinner and breakfast served on board.
tourDays.activities: Overnight transatlantic flight; Meals served on board (dinner and breakfast)

tourDays.title: Arrival and transfer to Santiago de Compostela
tourDays.description: Upon arrival met by tour guide and driver and transferred to hotel in Santiago de Compostela. Free time before dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Meet tour guide and driver; Transfer to hotel; Free time; Dinner

tourDays.title: Sightseeing in Santiago de Compostela
tourDays.description: Visit the Cathedral of St. James: climb the stairs behind the high altar to the crypt where the relics of St. James are preserved, touch the central pillar (Portico de La Gloria), view the 'botafumeiro', and visit the cloister museum. Stroll the streets of Santiago de Compostela. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Cathedral of St. James; Climb to the crypt; Touch the central pillar (Portico de La Gloria); View the botafumeiro; Visit cloister museum; Stroll city streets

tourDays.title: Transfer to and tour of Lisbon
tourDays.description: After breakfast depart for Lisbon. Afternoon sightseeing tour of Lisbon including the Cathedral, St. Jeromeâs Monastery, Saint Anthony's Church, Belem Quarter (Belem Tower, 25 April Bridge, Discoveries Monument). Drive past the Basilica of the Star, Rossio Square, Commerce Square and Marquee of Pomba Square. Dinner and overnight in Lisbon.
tourDays.activities: Transfer from Santiago de Compostela to Lisbon; Sightseeing tour of Lisbon; Visit Cathedral, St. Jeromeâs Monastery, Saint Anthony's Church, Belem Quarter landmarks; Drive through/see major squares and monuments; Dinner

tourDays.title: Santarem and transfer to Fatima
tourDays.description: After breakfast depart Lisbon for Santarem. Walk through Santarem's narrow streets to the Church of St Stephen to see the Eucharistic miracle on display since 1269. Continue on to Fatima. Dinner and overnight in Fatima.
tourDays.activities: Transfer from Lisbon to Santarem; Walk Santarem streets; Visit Church of St Stephen (Eucharistic miracle); Transfer to Fatima; Dinner

tourDays.title: Touring Fatima shrines
tourDays.description: Tour Fatima: Little Chapel of the Apparitions, Basilica, the site of Francesco and Jacinta's graves, the Hamlet of Aljustrel, and Valinhos. Follow the Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra to the Chapel of Calvary. Join pilgrims in an evening candlelight procession.
tourDays.activities: Visit Little Chapel of the Apparitions; Visit the Basilica; Visit Francesco and Jacinta's graves; Visit Hamlet of Aljustrel; Visit Valinhos; Follow Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra; Attend evening candlelight procession

tourDays.title: Flight to Medjugorje and transfer
tourDays.description: After breakfast transfer to Fatima airport for flights to Medjugorje. Upon arrival transfer by private coach (approx. 2 1/2 hour drive) to the village of Medjugorje. Meet fellow pilgrims, spiritual leader and host family where you will stay for four nights. Local guide will accompany during stay.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Fatima airport; Flight from Fatima to Medjugorje; 2 1/2 hour coach transfer to Medjugorje; Meet local guide, fellow pilgrims and host family

tourDays.title: Pilgrimage activities in Medjugorje
tourDays.description: Experience Medjugorje with daily opportunities for Mass, prayer and visitation of pilgrimage sites. Activities include English-language Mass at St. James Church, following the path up Apparition Hill, praying at the cross, evening rosary and Croatian Mass, possible meetings with visionaries (subject to availability), climbing Krizevac Mountain, visiting Blue Cross and visiting the community of Cenacolo.
