tourDays.activities: Flight from Lourdes to Rome; Transfer to hotel in Rome; Free afternoon to rest, relax, or explore

tourDays.title: Christian Rome sightseeing
tourDays.description: Sightseeing tour entitled 'Christian Rome' which includes: the Basilica of St. Mary Major; the Holy Stairs; the Basilica of St. John the Lateran; St Paul Outside the Walls; the Appian Way and the Domine Quo Vadis Chapel; the ancient Baths of Caracalla; Arch of Drusus; Tomb of Cecilia Metella; and the catacombs of St Callixtus. Also visit the Trevi fountain. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Basilica of St. Mary Major; Visit the Holy Stairs; Visit Basilica of St. John the Lateran; Visit St Paul Outside the Walls; Visit the Appian Way and Domine Quo Vadis Chapel; See Baths of Caracalla; See Arch of Drusus; See Tomb of Cecilia Metella; Visit Catacombs of St. Callixtus; Visit Trevi fountain

tourDays.title: Papal Audience & Vatican Museums
tourDays.description: Attend the weekly Papal Audience or Blessing (pending papal schedule). Visit the Vatican Museums, including the Tapestry Gallery, the Raphael Rooms, and the Sistine Chapel. Enter St Peter's Basilica to see Michelangelo's Pieta, Bernini's bronze canopy, and visit the grave of Saint John Paul II. Time at leisure before dinner.
tourDays.activities: Attend Papal Audience or Blessing (pending schedule); Visit Vatican Museums (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel); Enter St. Peter's Basilica; See Pieta and Bernini's bronze canopy; Visit grave of Saint John Paul II; Leisure time

tourDays.title: Rome to Siena to Assisi
tourDays.description: Depart Rome and head north to Siena. In Siena stroll the Piazza del Campo, visit the Cathedral and the Basilica of St. Francis, and view the incorrupt head of St. Catherine at the Basilica of St. Dominic. Continue on to Assisi for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive from Rome to Siena; Stroll Piazza del Campo; Visit Siena Cathedral; Visit Basilica of St. Francis; View incorrupt head of St. Catherine at Basilica of St. Dominic; Continue to Assisi

tourDays.title: Assisi: St. Francis sites
tourDays.description: Visit the tomb of St Francis. Explore the 13th-century Basilica containing many of the saint's possessions and frescoes depicting his life. Visit St Mary of the Angels Basilica including the Chapel of the Portiuncula, the rose bush, and the cave where St Francis retired for prayer. Visit the Church of St Clare to see her incorrupt body. Stroll the medieval streets and stop at an outdoor cafe.
tourDays.activities: Visit tomb of St. Francis; Visit Basilica of St. Francis and view frescoes and possessions; Visit St Mary of the Angels Basilica (Chapel of the Portiuncula, rose bush, cave); Visit Church of St Clare to see incorrupt body; Stroll medieval streets

tourDays.title: Travel to Florence
tourDays.description: After breakfast depart for Florence. Upon arrival enjoy free time to rest and explore before dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive from Assisi to Florence; Free time in Florence

tourDays.title: Florence guided tour
tourDays.description: After Mass, guided tour of Florence including the Franciscan church of Santa Croce, Piazza Signoria, Palazzo Vecchio, the Uffizi, Ponte Vecchio, Republic Square, and the Santa Maria del Fiore cathedral. After lunch visit L'Accademia to view Michelangelo's 'David' and other works. Free time to explore before dinner.
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass; Guided walking tour of Florence (Santa Croce, Piazza Signoria, Palazzo Vecchio, Uffizi, Ponte Vecchio, Republic Square, Santa Maria del Fiore); Visit L'Accademia to view Michelangelo's David; Free time

tourDays.title: Travel to Medjugorje
tourDays.description: After breakfast depart from the hotel to Florence Airport for flights to Medjugorje. Upon arrival, greeted by a tour guide/driver and then a 2 1/2 hour drive by private coach to the village of Medjugorje. Meet fellow pilgrims, spiritual leader, and host family with whom you will stay for the next four nights.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Florence Airport; Flight(s) from Florence to Medjugorje region; 2 1/2 hour drive by private coach to Medjugorje; Orientation and meet host family

tourDays.title: Medjugorje: Prayer and pilgrimage
tourDays.description: Experience the village: assemble at St James Church for English-language Mass (daily at 10:00am; Feast days and Sundays English Mass at Noon). Follow the path up Apparition Hill where the visionaries first encountered Our Lady; touch and pray before the cross that commemorates the spot. Each evening join villagers and pilgrims to pray the rosary and attend Croatian Mass with Blessing of the Sick and blessing of items. Opportunity to climb Krizevac Mountain and visit Blue Cross at the base of Apparition Hill. Visit the Community Cenacolo. Time for personal retreat and reflection.
tourDays.activities: English-language Mass at St James Church; Walk Apparition Hill; Pray before the commemorative cross on Apparition Hill; Evening rosary with villagers and pilgrims; Attend Croatian Mass with Blessing of the Sick and blessing of items; Climb Krizevac Mountain; Visit Blue Cross; Visit Community Cenacolo; Personal prayer, reflection, and free time

tourDays.title: Medjugorje: Prayer and local devotions
tourDays.description: Continue time in Medjugorje for prayer and pilgrimage. Join morning English Mass at St James Church, walk Apparition Hill, participate in evening rosary and Croatian Mass with Blessing of the Sick. Opportunities include Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament (Tuesdays and Saturdays), Veneration of the Cross (Fridays), climb Krizevac, visit Blue Cross, and visit Community Cenacolo. Time for personal retreat.
tourDays.activities: English-language Mass at St James Church; Walk Apparition Hill; Evening rosary and Croatian Mass with Blessing of the Sick; Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament (Tuesdays and Saturdays); Veneration of the Cross (Fridays); Climb Krizevac Mountain; Visit Blue Cross; Visit Community Cenacolo; Personal prayer and reflection

tourDays.title: Medjugorje: Personal retreat and devotions
tourDays.description: Final full day in Medjugorje for prayer, reflection, and local devotions. Participate in morning Mass at St James Church, walk to Apparition Hill and Blue Cross, climb Krizevac Mountain, attend evening rosary and Croatian Mass with Blessing of the Sick, and visit the Community Cenacolo. Time for a personal retreat.
tourDays.activities: English-language Mass at St James Church; Walk Apparition Hill; Climb Krizevac Mountain; Visit Blue Cross; Evening rosary and Croatian Mass with Blessing of the Sick; Visit Community Cenacolo; Personal prayer and reflection

tourDays.title: Return to USA
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast and farewells, leave by motor coach for Dubrovnik Airport (or Split or Sarajevo) for return flights home to the USA.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Motor coach transfer to Dubrovnik (or Split or Sarajevo) Airport; Return flights home

tourDays.title: Depart from your Hometown to Cairo, Egypt
tourDays.description: Board your overnight flight to Cairo, Egypt. Meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Overnight flight to Cairo; Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Arrival in Cairo
tourDays.description: Arrive in Egypt; meet the guide at the airport and transfer to the hotel in Cairo for the next six nights. Dinner and overnight in Cairo.
tourDays.activities: Airport meet and transfer to hotel; Dinner and overnight in Cairo

tourDays.title: Cairo â The Pyramids & Grand Egyptian Museum
tourDays.description: Visit the Great Pyramids of Giza (including the Pyramid of Cheops) and the Sphinx. Tour the New Grand Egyptian Museum, home to the treasures of Tutankhamun and artifacts spanning more than 7,000 years.
tourDays.activities: Visit Great Pyramids of Giza; See the Sphinx; Tour the New Grand Egyptian Museum

tourDays.title: Cairo â Tel Basta â Belbis â Cairo
tourDays.description: Begin tracing the Flight of the Holy Family. Drive to Tel Basta to visit the Holy Well. Continue to Belbis to see the tree venerated as the Virgin Maryâs Tree and visit Saint George Church. Return to Cairo for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Tel Basta; Visit the Holy Well (Tel Basta); Visit Virgin Maryâs Tree (Belbis); Visit Saint George Church

tourDays.title: Cairo â Sakha & Samanoud â Cairo
tourDays.description: Travel to Sakha to visit the Virgin Mary Church (site containing a stone bearing the footprint of the Child Jesus). Cross the Nile to Samanoud to visit Saint Abanoub Church, pray at the well and venerate relics of Saint Abanoub. Return to Cairo for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Virgin Mary Church in Sakha; Visit Saint Abanoub Church in Samanoud; Pray at the well in Samanoud; Venerate relics of Saint Abanoub

tourDays.title: Cairo â Wadi Natrun â Cairo
tourDays.description: Journey to the Wadi Natrun Valley and visit four historic monasteries: Deir al-Baramous, Deir Anba Bishoy (where the saintâs body remains incorrupt), Abu Makar Monastery, and Deir El-Suryani. Return to Cairo for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Deir al-Baramous; Visit Deir Anba Bishoy; Visit Abu Makar Monastery; Visit Deir El-Suryani

tourDays.title: Coptic Cairo
tourDays.description: Visit the principal Coptic sites of Old Cairo: the Hanging Church (dedicated to the Virgin Mary), the Church of St. Sergius (Abu Serga), the Church of St. George, and the Church of the Holy Virgin Mary at Maadi. Dinner and overnight in Cairo.
tourDays.activities: Visit the Hanging Church; Visit the Church of St. Sergius (Abu Serga); Visit the Church of St. George; Visit the Church of the Holy Virgin Mary at Maadi

tourDays.title: Cairo â Minya City
tourDays.description: Travel south to Minya. Visit the Church of the Virgin Mary at Gabal Al Teir ('Church Beside the River'), located on a mountaintop overlooking the Nile. Dinner and overnight in Minya.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Minya; Visit Church of the Virgin Mary at Gabal Al Teir

tourDays.title: Minya â Monastery of the Holy Virgin (Assyut) â Luxor
tourDays.description: Continue south to Assyut to visit the Monastery of the Holy Virgin (Deir El Moharraq), a site where tradition says the Holy Family stayed for more than six months. Then proceed to Luxor for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Monastery of the Holy Virgin (Deir El Moharraq) in Assyut; Proceed to Luxor

tourDays.title: Luxor â Embark on the Nile Cruise
tourDays.description: Visit the Temple of Karnak and the East Bank of the Nile in the morning. Embark the Nile cruise ship. After lunch visit the Temple of Luxor. Dinner and overnight on board the cruise ship.
tourDays.activities: Visit Temple of Karnak; Embark Nile cruise ship; Visit Temple of Luxor

tourDays.title: Valley of the Kings & Temple of Hatshepsut
tourDays.description: Explore the Valley of the Kings and visit the Temple of Hatshepsut. Return to the ship for lunch and begin sailing toward Edfu, passing through the Esna Lock. Dinner and overnight on board.
tourDays.activities: Explore Valley of the Kings; Visit Temple of Hatshepsut; Sail toward Edfu; Pass through Esna Lock

tourDays.title: Edfu & Kom Ombo
tourDays.description: After breakfast visit the Temple of Edfu. Continue sailing to Kom Ombo to visit its unique double temple. Dinner and overnight on board as the ship sails toward Aswan.
tourDays.activities: Visit Temple of Edfu; Visit Kom Ombo double temple; Sail toward Aswan

tourDays.title: Aswan
tourDays.description: Visit the Aswan High Dam and the Philae Temple on Agilkia Island. An optional (highly recommended) visit to Abu Simbel is available to see the colossal temples of Ramses II and Queen Nefertari. For those remaining in Aswan, free time and a relaxing felucca sail around the Aga Khan Mausoleum are offered. Dinner and overnight on board.
tourDays.activities: Visit Aswan High Dam; Visit Philae Temple on Agilkia Island; Optional visit to Abu Simbel; Felucca sail around Aga Khan Mausoleum (optional); Free time in Aswan

tourDays.title: Aswan â Cairo
tourDays.description: Fly from Aswan back to Cairo. Enjoy a farewell stroll along historic Moez Street and through the Khan El Khalili Bazaar, followed by a special farewell dinner. Overnight in Cairo.
tourDays.activities: Fly Aswan to Cairo; Farewell stroll on Moez Street; Visit Khan El Khalili Bazaar; Special farewell dinner

tourDays.title: Departure for your return flights home or extend your stay
tourDays.description: After breakfast transfer to the airport for your return flight home, or extend your stay by joining another 206 Tours pilgrimage or arranging additional nights.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to the airport; Depart for home or extend stay

tourDays.title: Depart for the Holy Land
tourDays.description: Board your overnight flight from your local airport; meals served on board.
tourDays.activities: Board overnight flight; Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Arrive in Tel Aviv
tourDays.description: After landing at Ben Gurion Airport, collect your luggage and meet your guide and driver; optional stroll along the Tel Aviv boardwalk, gather for Mass, dinner and overnight at hotel.
tourDays.activities: Arrive at Ben Gurion Airport; Collect luggage; Meet guide and driver; Stroll along Tel Aviv boardwalk; Gather for Mass; Dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Tel Aviv â Jaffa â Nazareth â Jesus Trail
tourDays.description: Walk along the sea front promenade from Tel Aviv to Jaffa; explore Jaffa and attend Mass at the Church of St Peter; drive to Nazareth to visit the Church of the Annunciation; walk a section of the Jesus Trail through Beit Keshet forest toward the Sea of Galilee; overnight at hotel overlooking the Sea of Galilee.
tourDays.activities: Walk along sea front promenade; Explore Jaffa alleyways; Mass at Church of St Peter; Visit Church of the Annunciation; Walk Jesus Trail section through Beit Keshet forest; Overnight at Sea of Galilee hotel

tourDays.title: Arbel â Valley of the Doves â Magdala - Capernaum
tourDays.description: Walk along a section of the Gospel trail near the Horns of Hittin to the cliffs of Arbel for panoramic views; pause for photo and prayer; descend to the Valley of the Doves and continue to the archaeological park at Magdala, including the First Century Synagogue and Duc in Altum prayer center; visit Capernaum to see St Peter's home and the ancient synagogue; return to hotel.
tourDays.activities: Walk Gospel trail near Horns of Hittin; Walk to Arbel cliffs and take group photo; Short prayer led by priest; Walk to Valley of the Doves; Visit Magdala archaeological park and First Century Synagogue; Visit Duc in Altum prayer & meditation centre; Visit Capernaum (St Peter's home and ancient synagogue)

tourDays.title: Mt of Beatitudes â Tabgha â Primacy â Golan Heights
tourDays.description: After Mass, visit the Mount of Beatitudes, follow a path toward the Sea of Galilee, visit a cave believed to be a prayer spot of Jesus, then Tabgha and St. Peter's Primacy; enjoy a 45-minute boat ride across the Sea of Galilee; continue to Banias for a walk along the stream to the waterfall and stop overlooking the border with Syria.
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass; Visit Mount of Beatitudes; Walk toward Sea of Galilee and visit cave; Visit Tabgha (site of feeding of the 5,000); Visit St. Peter's Primacy; 45-minute boat ride on the Sea of Galilee; Walk at Banias along ancient path and stream; View waterfall; Stop at overlook of Syria border

tourDays.title: Mt. Tabor â Akko â Jerusalem
tourDays.description: Drive to Mount Tabor (site of the Transfiguration), celebrate Mass at the Basilica of the Transfiguration and walk the summit loop; travel to Akko to stroll ancient alleyways and food markets and explore Crusader-era buildings; drive to Jerusalem for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Mount Tabor; Celebrate Mass at Basilica of the Transfiguration; Walk summit loop on Mount Tabor; Travel to Akko; Stroll through Akko alleyways and food markets; Explore Knights Templar / Hospitalier buildings; Drive to Jerusalem

tourDays.title: Herodium â Bethlehem â Ein Karem â Jerusalem
tourDays.description: Hike up Herodium for views; visit Shepherd's Fields and Manger Square; enter the Church of the Nativity and proceed to the Grotto of the Nativity; celebrate Mass, free time for shopping in Bethlehem; drive to Ein Karem to hike olive terraces and view the Church of the Visitation; relax before dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Hike up Herodium; Visit Shepherd's Fields; Visit Manger Square; Enter Church of the Nativity and Grotto of the Nativity; Celebrate Mass; Free time/shop in Bethlehem; Drive to Ein Karem; Hike olive tree terraces in Ein Karem; View Church of the Visitation; Relaxing stretch/exercises

tourDays.title: Mt of Olives â Old City historical walk
tourDays.description: Begin on the Mount of Olives with views of the Old City; visit Pater Noster, walk Palm Sunday Road to Dominus Flevit, and visit the Garden of Gethsemane and Church of All Nations; follow the Kidron Valley passing Absalom's Tomb to the Pool of Siloam and the pilgrim's way to the Temple Mount; visit Church of Peter in Gallicantu and celebrate Mass; walk to Mt Zion to see the Tomb of David, Upper Room and Dormition Abbey; enter Old City via Zion Gate to view the Western Wall and walk through Jewish, Armenian and Christian Quarters with refreshments and dinner in the Christian Quarter; exit via New Gate and return to hotel.
tourDays.activities: Visit Pater Noster church; Walk down Palm Sunday Road to Dominus Flevit; Visit Garden of Gethsemane and Church of All Nations; Walk through Kidron Valley (pass Absalom's Tomb); Visit Pool of Siloam; Walk pilgrim's way to Temple Mount; Visit Church of Peter in Gallicantu and celebrate Mass; Walk to Mt Zion (Tomb of David, Upper Room, Dormition Abbey); Enter Old City via Zion Gate; view Western Wall; Walk through Jewish, Armenian and Christian Quarters; Refreshments and meal in Christian Quarter

tourDays.title: Via Dolorosa, Holy Sepulchre and Emmaus
tourDays.description: Very early start to begin the Via Dolorosa at the Antonia Fortress, reflect on the Stations of the Cross through the Old City markets to the Church of the Holy Sepulchre and celebrate Mass there; after a late breakfast visit the Israel Museum (Model of Jerusalem) and walk part of the Emmaus Trail; end at the Monastery in Emmaus for local wine, cheeses and olive oil tastings; return to hotel for a light dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Very early wake-up and begin Via Dolorosa at Antonia Fortress; Reflect on Stations of the Cross through Old City markets; Visit Church of the Holy Sepulchre and celebrate Mass; Visit Israel Museum (Model of Jerusalem); Walk part of the Emmaus Trail; Visit Monastery in Emmaus and taste local wine, cheeses and olive oils; Return to hotel

tourDays.title: Judean Wilderness, Ein Gedi and Jordan River
tourDays.description: Drive through the Judean Desert to Ein Gedi and hike the gorge to see waterfalls and wildlife; travel to the Jordan River to visit the baptismal site with opportunity to renew baptismal vows and receive a blessing; view the Mount of Temptation and its monastery; stop at Wadi Qelt to view the desert monastery of St George; farewell dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive through Judean Desert; Hike in Ein Gedi gorge; Visit Jordan River baptismal site; Opportunity to renew baptismal vows with priest's blessing; View Mount of Temptation and monastery; Stop at Wadi Qelt to view St George monastery; Farewell dinner

tourDays.title: Return Flights Home
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast and farewells, transfer to the Tel Aviv airport for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Transfer to Tel Aviv airport; Board return flights home

tourDays.title: Depart for the Holy Land
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport where you will board your overnight flight. Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Travel to local airport; Board overnight flight; Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Arrive in Tel Aviv
tourDays.description: Upon arrival at Ben Gurion Airport in Tel Aviv, collect luggage, meet your tour guide/driver, transfer to your hotel in Tel Aviv to check in, and enjoy dinner at the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Arrive at Ben Gurion Airport; Collect luggage; Meet tour guide/driver; Transfer to hotel; Hotel check-in; Dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Caesarea, Nazareth, Cana; travel to Sea of Galilee
tourDays.description: Depart Tel Aviv to Caesarea Maritima to see the Roman theatre, Herod's Palace, the Hippodrome and harbor. Continue to Nazareth to visit the museum and archaeological garden and St. Joseph's workshop/Church. Visit the Church of the Annunciation grotto. Drive to Cana to celebrate Mass at the Wedding Church and offer married couples the chance to renew wedding vows. Continue to hotel by the Sea of Galilee for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Depart Tel Aviv for Caesarea Maritima; See Roman theatre, Herod's Palace, Hippodrome and harbor; Visit Nazareth museum and archaeological garden; Visit St. Joseph's Church/workshop; Enter Church of the Annunciation grotto; Celebrate Mass at the Wedding Church in Cana; Renew wedding vows (for married couples); Transfer to hotel by the Sea of Galilee; Dinner

tourDays.title: Sea of Galilee and surrounding sites
tourDays.description: Take a boat ride on the Sea of Galilee. Visit Capernaum (including the Synagogue), the Mount of Beatitudes, Tabgha (site of the feeding of the 5,000), St. Peter's Primacy, and Magdala. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee; Visit Capernaum and the Synagogue; Visit Mount of Beatitudes; Visit Tabgha; Visit St. Peter's Primacy; Visit Magdala; Return to hotel

tourDays.title: Mount Tabor, Jericho, travel to Jerusalem
tourDays.description: Drive to Mount Tabor for reflection and celebrate Mass at the Basilica of the Transfiguration. Continue south to the Jordan Valley to Jericho, view the Mount of Temptation, then drive up to Jerusalem to check in to your hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Mount Tabor; Reflect and celebrate Mass at Basilica of the Transfiguration; Drive to the Jordan Valley and Jericho; View Mount of Temptation; Drive to Jerusalem and hotel check-in; Dinner

tourDays.title: Ein Karem and Bethlehem
tourDays.description: Visit Ein Karem to see the Church of St John the Baptist and the Church of the Visitation. Drive to Bethlehem to visit the shepherds' fields, caves, Manger Square and the Church of the Nativity; proceed down to the Grotto of the Nativity. Following Mass in Bethlehem, return to the hotel in Jerusalem for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Church of St John the Baptist (Ein Karem); Visit Church of the Visitation; Drive to Bethlehem; Visit shepherds' fields and caves; Visit Manger Square and Church of the Nativity; Enter Grotto of the Nativity; Attend Mass in Bethlehem; Return to hotel in Jerusalem

tourDays.title: Jordan River, Qumran and Dead Sea
tourDays.description: Drive through the Judean wilderness, visit the Jordan River for reflection on the Baptism of Christ. In the afternoon visit Qumran, the site of the Dead Sea Scrolls. Before returning to Jerusalem, there is time to swim or float on the Dead Sea.
tourDays.activities: Drive through the Judean wilderness; Reflect at the Jordan River (Baptism site); Visit Qumran (Dead Sea Scrolls site); Swim or float on the Dead Sea; Return to Jerusalem

tourDays.title: Mount of Olives, Gethsemane and Mount Zion
tourDays.description: Visit the Mount of Olives for panoramic views, Pater Noster Shrine, and Dominus Flevit. Continue to Gethsemane and the Church of All Nations (Rock of Agony). Visit the Western Wall, the Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu, the Upper Room on Mount Zion, and the Benedictine Church of the Dormition. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Mount of Olives and panoramic viewpoint; Visit Pater Noster Shrine; Visit Dominus Flevit; Visit Gethsemane and Church of All Nations; Visit Western Wall; Visit Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu; Visit Upper Room on Mt. Zion; Visit Benedictine Church of the Dormition; Return to hotel

tourDays.title: Via Dolorosa, Church of the Holy Sepulchre and Old City sites
tourDays.description: Very early in the morning, walk in prayerful procession along the Via Dolorosa beginning at the Antonia Fortress and ending at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre. Celebrate Mass at the Holy Sepulchre, return to the hotel for breakfast, then revisit the Old City to see the Church of St. Anne and the Pool of Bethesda. End the day with a visit to the Western Wall.
tourDays.activities: Prayerful procession along the Via Dolorosa; Begin at Antonia Fortress; Visit Church of the Holy Sepulchre and attend Mass; Return to hotel for breakfast; Visit Church of St. Anne; Visit Pool of Bethesda; Visit Western Wall

tourDays.title: Fly from Jerusalem/Tel Aviv to Lisbon
tourDays.description: Depart for Tel Aviv Airport and fly to Lisbon. Upon arrival you will be greeted by a tour guide/driver and transferred to your hotel in Lisbon in time for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Depart for Tel Aviv Airport; Flight to Lisbon; Meet local guide/driver in Lisbon; Transfer to hotel; Dinner and overnight in Lisbon

tourDays.title: Santarem and Fatima
tourDays.description: Travel toward Fatima with a stop in Santarem for Mass at St. Stephen's Church and to venerate the 13th-century Eucharistic Miracle. Continue to Fatima (Aljustrel) for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Santarem; Attend Mass at St. Stephen's Church; Venerate the 13th-century Eucharistic Miracle; Continue to Fatima; Dinner and overnight in Fatima

tourDays.title: Shrine of Our Lady of Fatima and Via Sacra
tourDays.description: Visit the Little Chapel of the Apparitions, the Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary (containing the tombs of St. Francisco, St. Jacinta and Sister Lucia), the Museum (Fatima: Light and Peace), and the Holy Trinity Basilica. After free time for lunch, participate in the Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra and visit Valinhos. The night concludes with private devotions and a candlelight procession.
tourDays.activities: Visit Little Chapel of the Apparitions; Visit Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary and tombs; View monument to the Sacred Heart of Jesus; Visit Museum: Fatima: Light and Peace; Visit Holy Trinity Basilica; Free time for lunch; Participate in Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra; Visit Valinhos; Private devotions and candlelight procession

tourDays.title: Travel to Salamanca and walking tour
tourDays.description: Depart Fatima for Salamanca. Walking tour of Salamanca visiting Plaza Mayor, La Clerecia, La Casa de las Conchas, the University of Salamanca, the Roman Bridge, Iglesia de San Marcos, Iglesia de San Martin, and the two joined Salamanca Cathedrals (old and new). Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Depart Fatima for Salamanca; Walking tour of Salamanca (Plaza Mayor, La Clerecia, Casa de las Conchas, University, Roman Bridge); Visit Iglesia de San Marcos and Iglesia de San Martin; Visit the two Salamanca Cathedrals; Return to hotel for dinner

tourDays.title: Alba de Tormes, Ãvila and Burgos
tourDays.description: Transfer to Alba de Tormes to celebrate Mass at the Carmelite Monastery where St. Teresa died and was buried, and visit the museum dedicated to St. Teresa. After free time for lunch, continue to Avila to see the city walls, Cathedral de Avila, Basilica de San Vicente and the Incarnation Convent. Continue to Burgos for dinner and an opportunity to explore the city and its Gothic cathedral.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Alba de Tormes; Celebrate Mass at Carmelite Monastery; Visit museum dedicated to St. Teresa; Free time for lunch; Visit Avila (city walls, Cathedral de Avila, Basilica de San Vicente, Incarnation Convent); Continue to Burgos; Dinner and evening exploration of Burgos Cathedral

tourDays.title: Loyola and travel to Lourdes
tourDays.description: Transfer from Burgos to Loyola to visit the birthplace of St. Ignatius and the 17th-century Basilica, including the venerated room where St. Ignatius prayed. After free time for lunch, continue to Lourdes, check in to the hotel, enjoy dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Loyola; Visit birthplace of St. Ignatius and 17th-century Basilica; Pray in the venerated room; Free time for lunch; Transfer to Lourdes; Hotel check-in and dinner

tourDays.title: Lourdes: Grotto and local sites
tourDays.description: Pray and meditate at sites of Our Lady's apparitions. Opportunities include attending Mass at the Grotto of Massabielle, watching a video presentation about Lourdes, participating with the miraculous spring (wash hands/face and drink the water), praying the life-size Stations of the Cross overlooking the Grotto, visiting Boly Mill and the Cachot, and participating in the nightly candlelight procession and the Rosary.
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass at the Grotto of Massabielle; Watch video presentation about Lourdes; Participate with the miraculous spring (wash hands/face, drink water); Pray the life-size Stations of the Cross; Visit Boly Mill (birthplace of St. Bernadette); Visit the Cachot; Attend nightly candlelight procession and the Rosary

tourDays.title: Return flights home
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast and farewells, leave by motor coach and transfer to the Toulouse, Pau or Lourdes airport for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Farewells; Transfer by motor coach to airport; Depart from Toulouse, Pau or Lourdes airport

tourDays.title: Depart USA
tourDays.description: Depart USA on an overnight flight to Amman. Dinner and breakfast served on board.
tourDays.activities: Overnight flight to Amman; Meals served on board (dinner and breakfast)

tourDays.title: Depart for Jordan
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport where you will board your overnight flight. Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Depart from local airport; Overnight flight; In-flight meals served

tourDays.title: Arrive Amman
tourDays.description: Arrive in Amman, greeted by driver and transferred to hotel. Dinner and overnight in Amman.
tourDays.activities: Arrival transfer to hotel; Dinner and overnight in Amman

tourDays.title: Arrive Amman
tourDays.description: Upon arrival in Amman, make your way to the baggage claim area and collect your luggage. Proceed to the Arrivalâs Hall, where you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver. Transfer to the hotel in Amman for check-in and enjoy dinner at the hotel before retiring for the evening.
tourDays.activities: Collect luggage; Meet tour guide/driver; Transfer to hotel; Hotel check-in; Dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Petra
tourDays.description: Depart for Petra. Walking tour beginning with the Siq to the Treasury, continue along main/collonaded street, ending at the Petra Museum. Visit a Byzantine chapel with preserved mosaics. Free afternoon for shopping, exploration, or rest.
tourDays.activities: Walking tour of Petra; Visit the Siq and the Treasury; Walk the colonnaded/main street; Visit the Petra Museum; See Byzantine chapel and mosaics; Free afternoon for shopping/exploration/rest

tourDays.title: Petra â Excursion
tourDays.description: Transfer to the âlostâ city of Petra. Enjoy a walking tour of the former capital and trading center. Visit the Siq and culminate with a visit to the Petra Museum. Spend the afternoon at leisure to shop. Return to Amman for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Walking tour of Petra; Visit the Siq; Visit Petra Museum; Afternoon at leisure / shopping; Return to Amman

tourDays.title: Petra - Kerak - Madeba - Mt. Nebo - Amman
tourDays.description: Travel the King's Highway visiting Kerak (including the Castle of Kerak), Madeba to see St. George Church and its map, and Mt. Nebo (Sanctuary and memorial of Moses). Return to Amman for dinner.
tourDays.activities: Visit the Castle of Kerak; Visit St. George Church in Madeba (City of Mosaics); Visit Mt. Nebo Sanctuary and memorial of Moses; Return to Amman for dinner

tourDays.title: Excursion Kerak - Madaba - Mt. Nebo
tourDays.description: Travel to the Castle of Kerak. Transfer to Madaba to visit St. Georgeâs Church and its ancient map of the Holy Land. Visit Mt. Nebo, the site where Moses died and was buried. Return to Amman for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Castle of Kerak; Visit St. Georgeâs Church (Madaba) and the Holy Land map; Visit Mt. Nebo; Return to Amman

tourDays.title: Amman - Jerash - Tel Aviv
tourDays.description: Depart Amman for Jerash to see extensive Roman remains (colonnaded streets, temples, theaters, plazas). Continue to hotel on the Mediterranean coast (Tel Aviv area) for buffet dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit the archaeological site of Jerash; Transfer to hotel on the Mediterranean coast (Tel Aviv); Buffet dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Amman - Jerash - Tel Aviv
tourDays.description: Depart to Jerash to see well-preserved Roman architecture. Continue to the hotel on the Mediterranean coast for check-in and a buffet dinner.
tourDays.activities: Visit Jerash; Transfer to Mediterranean coast hotel; Buffet dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Caesarea - Stella Maris - Nazareth - Tiberias
tourDays.description: Visit Caesarea's archaeological remains, then Stella Maris in Haifa (Carmelite Monastery and Elijah's cave). Continue to Nazareth to visit the Byzantine Church of St. Joseph, the Church of the Annunciation, and Mary's Well. Transfer to Tiberias for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit archaeological remains at Caesarea; Visit Stella Maris (Haifa); Visit St. Joseph Church in Nazareth; Visit Church of the Annunciation; Visit Mary's Well; Transfer to and check in at hotel in Tiberias

tourDays.title: Caesarea - Haifa - Stella Maris - Nazareth - Tiberias - Cana
tourDays.description: Drive to Caesarea to visit archaeological remains. Continue to Haifa to visit Stella Maris monastery. Drive to Nazareth to visit the Church of the Annunciation, St. Josephâs church, the Church of the Incarnation and Maryâs Well. Visit Cana and the Franciscan Wedding Church (opportunity to renew wedding vows). Transfer to Tiberias for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Caesarea archaeological remains; Visit Stella Maris (Carmelite Monastery); Visit Church of the Annunciation and St. Joseph's in Nazareth; Visit Church of the Incarnation and Grotto; Visit Maryâs Well; Visit Franciscan Wedding Church in Cana (renew wedding vows option); Transfer to Tiberias

tourDays.title: Tiberias: Sea of Galilee
tourDays.description: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee; view remains of a 1st-century boat; visit the Mount of Beatitudes, Tabgha (site of the Miracle of the Loaves and Fishes) and Peter's Primacy. After lunch visit Magdala (including a 1st-century synagogue) and end at Capernaum to see the synagogue and the church built over Peter's home. Dinner and overnight at hotel.
tourDays.activities: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee; View 1st-century boat remains; Visit Mount of Beatitudes; Visit Tabgha; Visit Peter's Primacy; Visit Magdala and 1st-century synagogue; Visit Capernaum and its synagogue/church

tourDays.title: Tiberias: Sea of Galilee
tourDays.description: Begin with a boat ride on the Sea of Galilee. See the remains of an ancient boat, visit the Mount of Beatitudes, Tabgha, and Peterâs Primacy. After lunch visit the remains of Magdala and its 1st century synagogue discovery. End the day at Capernaum to see the synagogue and the church built over Peterâs home. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee; See remains of an ancient boat; Visit Mount of Beatitudes; Visit Tabgha; Visit Peterâs Primacy; Visit Magdala and its archaeological remains; Visit Capernaum (synagogue and church over Peter's home)

tourDays.title: Jordan River â Mt. Tabor â Jericho â Jordan River â Jerusalem
tourDays.description: Drive to Mount Tabor (site of the Transfiguration) and celebrate Mass. Continue down the Jordan Valley to Jericho to view the Mount of Temptation and a Sycamore Tree. Visit the Baptismal site on the Jordan River and then proceed to Jerusalem for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Mount Tabor and celebrate Mass; Drive through Jordan Valley to Jericho; View Mount of Temptation and Sycamore Tree; Visit Baptismal site on the Jordan River; Transfer to Jerusalem

tourDays.title: Jordan River - Mt. Tabor â Jericho â Jordan River - Jerusalem
tourDays.description: Drive to Mount Tabor (site of the Transfiguration) with time for reflection and Mass. Drive down the Jordan Valley to Jericho to view Mt. Temptation and a Sycamore Tree. Visit the Baptismal site on the Jordan River. Proceed to Jerusalem for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Mount Tabor and celebrate Mass; Drive to Jericho and view Mt. Temptation and a Sycamore Tree; Visit Baptismal site on the Jordan River; Transfer to Jerusalem

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Temple Model - Ein Karem - Bethlehem
tourDays.description: Visit the Second Temple scale model for an overview of Jerusalem of Jesus' time. Visit Ein Karem, birthplace of John the Baptist, and the Church of the Visitation (pray the Mystery of the Rosary). In the afternoon visit Bethlehem: Manger Square, Church of the Nativity and the Grotto of the Nativity. Celebrate Mass and return to the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Visit Second Temple scale model; Visit Ein Karem and Church of the Visitation; Pray the Mystery of the Rosary; Visit Manger Square and Church of the Nativity; Enter the Grotto of the Nativity; Celebrate Mass

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Bethlehem & Ein Karem
tourDays.description: Visit the Second Temple scale model. Drive to Ein Karem (birthplace of John the Baptist) and visit the Church of the Visitation, praying the Mystery of the Rosary on the walk up. In the afternoon visit Bethlehem: Shepherdsâ Field caves, Manger Square, and the Church of the Nativity down to the Grotto of the Nativity. After Mass return to the hotel in Jerusalem.
tourDays.activities: Visit Second Temple scale model; Visit Ein Karem and Church of the Visitation; Pray Mystery of the Rosary on walk to the church; Visit Shepherds' Field; Visit Manger Square and Church of the Nativity (Grotto); Attend Mass

tourDays.title: Bethany - Dead Sea
tourDays.description: Drive down the Jordan Valley to Qumran (where the Dead Sea Scrolls were found). Time permitting, optional dip in the Dead Sea. Drive through the Judean Wilderness and visit Bethany (site where Jesus raised Lazarus). Celebrate Mass and return to the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Visit Qumran (Dead Sea Scrolls site); Optional dip in the Dead Sea; Drive through Judean Wilderness; Visit Bethany and celebrate Mass

tourDays.title: Jordan River- Qumran - Dead Sea
tourDays.description: Drive down the Jordan Valley to Qumran where the Dead Sea Scrolls were found. There may be time for a dip in the Dead Sea. Drive through the Judean Wilderness (area where John the Baptist lived) and visit Bethany where Jesus raised Lazarus; celebrate Mass in Bethany before returning to the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Visit Qumran (Dead Sea Scrolls site); Optional dip in the Dead Sea; Drive through the Judean Wilderness; Visit Bethany and celebrate Mass

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Mt. Of Olives - Gethsemane - Mt. Zion - Western Wall
tourDays.description: From the Mount of Olives take a panoramic view of Jerusalem; visit the Pater Noster shrine. Walk down Palm Sunday Road to Dominus Flevit. Reflect at Gethsemane and pray at the Church of All Nations at the Rock of Agony. Visit the Western Wall and the site of Peter in Gallicantu. After Mass go up to Mt. Zion to visit the Upper Room and the Benedictine Church of the Dormition.
tourDays.activities: Panoramic viewing from Mount of Olives; Visit Pater Noster shrine; Visit Dominus Flevit; Visit Gethsemane and Church of All Nations (Rock of Agony); Visit Western Wall; Visit Peter in Gallicantu; Celebrate Mass; Visit Upper Room on Mt. Zion; Visit Benedictine Church of the Dormition

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Mt. Of Olives - Gethsemane - Mt. Zion - Western Wal
tourDays.description: Panoramic view from the Mount of Olives. Visit the Pater Noster shrine. Walk down Palm Sunday Road to Dominus Flevit. Reflect at Gethsemane and visit the Church of All Nations to pray at the 'Rock of Agony.' Visit the Western Wall and the house of the High Priest Caiaphas (Peter in Gallicantu). After Mass, go up to Mt. Zion to visit the Upper Room and the Benedictine Church of the Dormition. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Panoramic viewing from Mount of Olives; Visit Pater Noster shrine; Walk Palm Sunday Road to Dominus Flevit; Visit Gethsemane and Church of All Nations; pray at Rock of Agony; Visit Western Wall; Visit Peter in Gallicantu (house of Caiaphas); Attend Mass; Visit Mt. Zion, Upper Room, Benedictine Church of the Dormition

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Via Dolorosa - Holy Sepulchre
tourDays.description: Begin the Via Dolorosa at the Antonia Fortress and follow the Stations of the Cross through the Old City to the Church of the Holy Sepulchre (site of Calvary and the Tomb of Christ). Mass in the Church of the Holy Sepulchre. Also visit the Church of St. Anne, the Pool of Bethesda and the Sisters of Zion. Afternoon time to revisit the Old City.
tourDays.activities: Walk the Via Dolorosa starting at Antonia Fortress; Follow the Stations of the Cross to the Church of the Holy Sepulchre and attend Mass; Visit Church of St. Anne; Visit Pool of Bethesda; Visit Sisters of Zion; Free time to revisit the Old City

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Via Dolorosa - Holy Sepulchre- Western Wall
tourDays.description: Start the Via Dolorosa at the Antonia Fortress where Jesus was condemned. Follow the Stations of the Cross through the Old City markets to the Church of the Holy Sepulchre (site of Calvary and the Tomb of Christ). Mass will be in the Church of the Holy Sepulchre. Visit the Church of St. Anneâs, the Pool of Bethesda and the Sisters of Zion. Afternoon time to revisit the Old City.
tourDays.activities: Begin Via Dolorosa at Antonia Fortress; Walk the Stations of the Cross to the Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Attend Mass at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Visit Church of St. Anneâs, Pool of Bethesda, Sisters of Zion; Free time in Old City

tourDays.title: Tel Aviv - Medjugorje
tourDays.description: Early morning transfer to Tel Aviv Airport for flights to Medjugorje via a European connecting airport with onward flight(s) to Dubrovnik, Split or Sarajevo. Upon arrival, transfer by vehicle (approximately 2 1/2 hour drive) to the village of Medjugorje, meet fellow pilgrims, spiritual leader and host family; check in to modest inn for four nights. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Early morning transfer to Tel Aviv Airport; Fly via European connecting airport to Dubrovnik/Split/Sarajevo; Ground transfer to Medjugorje; Meet spiritual leader and host family; Check in to local inn; Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Jerusalem - Tel Aviv - Medjugorje
tourDays.description: Early morning transfer to Tel Aviv Airport for flights to Medjugorje. Arrive at a European connecting airport and board flights to Dubrovnik, Split or Sarajevo. After arrival, collect luggage and transfer by vehicle on a 2 1/2 hour drive to the village of Medjugorje. Meet fellow pilgrims, your spiritual leader and your host family; dinner and overnight in Medjugorje.
tourDays.activities: Early transfer to Tel Aviv Airport; Flights via European connecting airport to Dubrovnik/Split/Sarajevo; Collect luggage and meet local guide/driver; 2.5 hour drive to Medjugorje; Meet spiritual leader and host family; Dinner and overnight in Medjugorje

tourDays.title: Medjugorje (Day 1 of stay)
tourDays.description: Begin stay in Medjugorje with opportunities to participate in local devotional activities and visits. Local guide accompanies visits. Daily English Mass and confessions available at St. James Church. Activities include assembling for Mass at St. James, visiting Apparition Hill and Blue Cross, evening rosary and Croatian Mass, Blessing of the Sick, and climbing Krizevac Mountain.
tourDays.activities: Assemble at St. James Church for English Mass; Visit Apparition Hill and touch/pray at the cross; Visit Blue Cross; Join evening rosary and Croatian Mass; Receive Blessing of the Sick and blessing of personal items during Croatian Mass; Opportunity to climb Krizevac Mountain; Guided local visits with a local guide

tourDays.title: Medjugorje
tourDays.description: Stay in Medjugorje with opportunities for daily Mass, climbing Apparition Hill and Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain), attending evening apparitions and Croatian Mass, adoration and visits to the Community of Cenacolo. The local guide accompanies the group throughout the stay.
tourDays.activities: Attend Daily Mass at St. James Church; Climb Apparition Hill and pray the Rosary; Climb Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain) and pray the Stations of the Cross; Attend evening Apparitions at St. James Church or Apparition Hill; Attend Croatian Mass and Blessing of the Sick; Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament; Visit the Community of Cenacolo; Pray at the Statue of the Risen Christ; Attend Confessions in English (where available)

tourDays.title: Medjugorje (Day 2 of stay)
tourDays.description: Continued time in Medjugorje with opportunities to attend Mass, visit apparition sites, participate in evening devotions, and climb Krizevac. Local guide available for orientation and visits.
tourDays.activities: Attend English Mass at St. James Church; Visit Apparition Hill and Blue Cross; Participate in evening rosary and Croatian Mass with Blessing of the Sick; Opportunity to climb Krizevac Mountain; Local guided visits

tourDays.title: Medjugorje
tourDays.description: Continued stay in Medjugorje with the same spiritual activities: daily Mass, climbs to Apparition Hill and Cross Mountain, evening apparitions and other devotional opportunities accompanied by a local guide.
tourDays.activities: Attend Daily Mass at St. James Church; Climb Apparition Hill and pray the Rosary; Climb Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain) and pray the Stations of the Cross; Attend evening Apparitions at St. James Church or Apparition Hill; Attend Croatian Mass and Blessing of the Sick; Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament; Visit the Community of Cenacolo; Pray at the Statue of the Risen Christ; Attend Confessions in English (where available)

tourDays.title: Medjugorje (Day 3 of stay)
tourDays.description: Final full day in Medjugorje to participate in liturgies, visit devotional sites, join evening devotions and blessings, and spend time in prayer and reflection. English Mass and confessions available at St. James Church.
tourDays.activities: Attend English Mass at St. James Church; Visit Apparition Hill and Blue Cross; Participate in evening rosary and Croatian Mass with Blessing of the Sick; Opportunity to climb Krizevac Mountain; Local guided visits

tourDays.title: Medjugorje
tourDays.description: Final full day in Medjugorje with opportunities to attend Mass, climb Apparition Hill and Cross Mountain, participate in evening devotions, visit local devotional sites and hear testimonies at the Community of Cenacolo.
tourDays.activities: Attend Daily Mass at St. James Church; Climb Apparition Hill and pray the Rosary; Climb Mt. Krizevac (Cross Mountain) and pray the Stations of the Cross; Attend evening Apparitions at St. James Church or Apparition Hill; Attend Croatian Mass and Blessing of the Sick; Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament; Visit the Community of Cenacolo; Pray at the Statue of the Risen Christ; Attend Confessions in English (where available)

tourDays.title: Medjugorje - USA
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast depart by motor coach for Dubrovnik, Split or Sarajevo for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Motor coach transfer to Dubrovnik, Split or Sarajevo airports; Return flights home

tourDays.title: Medjugorje - USA
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast and farewells, depart by motor coach for Dubrovnik Airport (or Split or Sarajevo) for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Transfer by motor coach to Dubrovnik / Split / Sarajevo airport; Depart for return flights home

tourDays.title: Depart the USA
tourDays.description: Depart the USA on your flight to Reykjavik.
tourDays.activities: Depart the USA on international flight to Reykjavik

Explore the Reykjanes Peninsula, transfer to hotel (luggage stored if rooms not ready). 2-course group lunch at a downtown restaurant. Free time in the afternoon. 3-course welcome dinner near the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Meet local guide and transfer by private coach; Visit Viking World Museum / Ãslendingur ship; Explore Reykjanes Peninsula; Hotel drop-off and luggage storage; Group 2-course lunch at downtown restaurant; Free time to explore; 3-course welcome dinner

tourDays.title: Reykjavik walking tour, Blue Lagoon, Northern Lights hunt
tourDays.description: Morning Reykjavik walking city tour with an English-speaking Icelander guide. Break for lunch on your own. Afternoon visit to the Blue Lagoon (silica mud mask included). Group 2-course lunch en route. Group dinner near the hotel. Evening Northern Lights hunt from Reykjavik into the countryside with guides who monitor conditions and take photos.
tourDays.activities: Reykjavik walking city tour; Lunch on your own; Visit and bathe at Blue Lagoon (silica mud face mask provided); 2-course lunch en route; Group dinner near hotel; Northern Lights hunting tour with guide and photos

tourDays.title: Free day in Reykjavik
tourDays.description: Free day in Reykjavik to explore independently or add optional activities. Farewell dinner near the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Free time / optional activities; Farewell dinner near the hotel

tourDays.title: Departure
tourDays.description: Breakfast at the hotel. Time to explore Reykjavik or shop depending on flight schedule. Departure transfer in private coach without a guide to the airport.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast at hotel; Optional morning exploration or shopping (time dependent on flight); Private coach transfer to the airport (without guide)

tourDays.title: Depart USA
tourDays.description: Depart USA for an overnight flight to France. Dinner and breakfast will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Overnight transatlantic flight to France; Meals served on board (dinner and breakfast)

tourDays.title: Lourdes
tourDays.description: Upon arrival in Lourdes transfer to your hotel. Relax or explore before dinner, followed by a candlelight procession before retiring. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Arrival transfer to hotel; Relaxation or independent exploration; Candlelight procession; Dinner and overnight stay

tourDays.title: Lourdes
tourDays.description: Mass at the Grotto, enjoy a video presentation telling the story of Lourdes, and walk in the footsteps of St. Bernadette. Visit Boly Mill and the 'Cachot.' Pray for the sick, drink water from the miraculous spring or use the healing baths. Experience the life-sized Stations of the Cross overlooking the Grotto and kneel in the chapel built on the rock of the Grotto. Evenings include Blessed Sacrament Procession before dinner; candlelight procession and group rosary April through October only.
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass at the Grotto; Watch video presentation about Lourdes; Visit Boly Mill; Visit the Cachot (family home/prison); Pray for the sick and use spring water/healing baths; Walk the Stations of the Cross; Kneel in chapel on the rock of the Grotto; Blessed Sacrament Procession / candlelight procession and group rosary (seasonal)

tourDays.title: Lourdes
tourDays.description: Continued time in Lourdes repeating activities such as Mass at the Grotto, visits (Boly Mill, Cachot), prayer at the spring and healing baths, Stations of the Cross, and evening processions/rosary (candlelight procession and group rosary April through October only).
tourDays.activities: Attend Mass at the Grotto; Visit Boly Mill and the Cachot; Pray at the spring and/or use healing baths; Walk the Stations of the Cross; Evening Blessed Sacrament Procession / candlelight procession and group rosary (seasonal)

tourDays.title: Lourdes to Rome
tourDays.description: After breakfast, leave on your flight(s) to Rome. Upon arrival your escort will greet you and welcome you to Italy. Transfer to your hotel and enjoy a free afternoon for rest, relaxation, or exploration.
tourDays.activities: Flight(s) from Lourdes to Rome; Arrival transfer and hotel check-in; Free afternoon for rest or independent exploration

tourDays.title: Christian Rome sightseeing
tourDays.description: Sightseeing tour 'Christian Rome' including: Basilica of St. Mary Major; the Holy Stairs; the Basilica of St John Lateran; St Paul Outside the Walls; the Appian Way and Quo Vadis Chapel; Baths of Caracalla; Arch of Drusus; Tomb of Cecilia Metella; and the catacombs of St Callixtus. Also visit the Trevi fountain. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Guided 'Christian Rome' sightseeing tour; Visit Basilica of St. Mary Major; Visit the Holy Stairs; Visit Basilica of St John Lateran; Visit St Paul Outside the Walls; Drive/see the Appian Way and Quo Vadis Chapel; See Baths of Caracalla, Arch of Drusus, Tomb of Cecilia Metella; Visit catacombs of St Callixtus; Visit the Trevi fountain

tourDays.title: Vatican City: Papal Audience & Museums
tourDays.description: Attend the weekly Papal Audience or Blessing (pending papal schedule) at Vatican City. Visit the Vatican Museums (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel) and enter St. Peter's Basilica to see works such as Michelangelo's Pieta and Bernini's canopy. Visit the grave of Saint John Paul II. Time at leisure before dinner.
tourDays.activities: Attend Papal Audience or Blessing (subject to papal schedule); Visit Vatican Museums (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel); Enter St. Peter's Basilica and view artworks (Pieta, Bernini canopy); Visit the grave of Saint John Paul II; Leisure time for independent exploration

tourDays.title: Rome to Siena and Assisi
tourDays.description: Depart Rome and head north to Siena. In Siena stroll the Piazza del Campo and visit the Cathedral and the Basilica of St. Francis; view the incorrupt head of St. Catherine at the Basilica of St. Dominic. Continue on to Assisi for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive from Rome to Siena; Stroll Piazza del Campo; Visit Siena Cathedral; Visit the Basilica of St. Francis (as described); View incorrupt head of St. Catherine at Basilica of St. Dominic; Continue to Assisi and evening arrival

tourDays.title: Assisi (St. Francis)
tourDays.description: Visit the tomb of St. Francis and the 13th-century Basilica containing his possessions and frescoes. Kneel before the crucifix that spoke to St. Francis. Visit St. Mary of the Angels Basilica (Chapel Portiuncula, the rose bush, and the cave) and the Church of St. Clare to see her incorrupt body. Stroll the medieval streets and stop at an outdoor cafe with views of an ancient Roman temple. Visit both saints' tombs before dinner and retiring.
tourDays.activities: Visit tomb of St. Francis; Explore the 13th-century Basilica and its frescoes; Kneel before the crucifix associated with St. Francis; Visit St. Mary of the Angels Basilica (Chapel Portiuncula, rose bush, cave); Stroll medieval streets and visit an outdoor cafe; Visit Church of St. Clare and see incorrupt body

tourDays.title: Travel to Medjugorje
tourDays.description: After breakfast depart from the hotel to Rome or Florence Airport for flights to Medjugorje. Upon arrival you'll be greeted by a tour guide/driver and taken on a 2 1/2 hour drive by private coach to the village of Medjugorje. Meet fellow pilgrims, your spiritual leader, and your host family where you will stay for the next four nights.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Rome or Florence Airport; Flights to Medjugorje; Approx. 2 1/2 hour private coach drive to Medjugorje village; Meet guide/driver, fellow pilgrims, spiritual leader and host family; Check into host family/inn accommodations

tourDays.title: Medjugorje â spiritual retreat activities
tourDays.description: Experience the village of Medjugorje: assemble at St. James Church for English-language Mass each morning (10:00am; on Feast days and Sundays English Mass is at Noon). Walk Apparition Hill to the site of the first apparitions and pray at the commemorative cross. Each evening join villagers and pilgrims to pray the rosary (5:00pm or 6:00pm daylight savings time); the apparition takes place at 5:40pm (or 6:40pm DST) followed by Croatian Mass. On Tuesdays and Saturdays there is Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament; on Fridays Veneration of the Cross. Each evening during Croatian Mass there is Blessing of the Sick and blessing of items. Opportunity to climb Krizevac Mountain and visit Blue Cross. Visit the community of Cenacolo. The balance of your time is intended for personal retreat and private prayer.
tourDays.activities: Attend English-language Mass at St. James Church (10:00am; Noon on Feast days/Sundays); Walk Apparition Hill and pray at the commemorative cross; Evening rosary with villagers and pilgrims; Attend Croatian Mass with Blessing of the Sick and blessing of items; Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament (Tuesdays and Saturdays); Veneration of the Cross (Fridays); Climb Krizevac Mountain; Visit Blue Cross; Visit Community Cenacolo; Personal prayer, reflection and retreat time

tourDays.title: Medjugorje â spiritual retreat activities
tourDays.description: Continuation of Medjugorje activities: attend daily English Mass at St. James Church, walk Apparition Hill, participate in evening rosary and Croatian Mass with Blessing of the Sick, attend Adoration (Tues/Sat) or Veneration of the Cross (Fri) as scheduled, climb Krizevac, visit Blue Cross and the Community Cenacolo. Time for personal retreat and prayer.
tourDays.activities: Attend English-language Mass at St. James Church (10:00am; Noon on Feast days/Sundays); Walk Apparition Hill and pray at the cross; Evening rosary and Croatian Mass with Blessing of the Sick; Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament (Tuesdays and Saturdays); Veneration of the Cross (Fridays); Climb Krizevac Mountain; Visit Blue Cross; Visit Community Cenacolo; Personal prayer and reflection

tourDays.title: Medjugorje â spiritual retreat activities
tourDays.description: Final full day in Medjugorje for personal retreat and shared spiritual activities: daily Mass, Apparition Hill, evening rosary and Croatian Mass with Blessing of the Sick, optional Adoration or Veneration of the Cross as scheduled, climb Krizevac, visit Blue Cross, and visit the Community Cenacolo.

tourDays.title: Arrival in Istanbul / Transfer to hotel
tourDays.description: Upon arrival in Istanbul Airport you will find your luggage. After exiting the baggage claim, turn left and walk toward Gate 9 â then proceed into the arrivals hall where you will be greeted by our tour escort and/or driver. You will be transferred to your hotel in Istanbul. Attend a welcome briefing. Dinner and a restful overnight.
tourDays.activities: Arrive at Istanbul Airport and claim luggage; Meet tour escort and/or driver; Transfer to hotel; Attend welcome briefing; Dinner and overnight at hotel

tourDays.title: Old City guided tour
tourDays.description: Following breakfast we begin our full day of the old City with a guided tour exploring the ancient city including the magnificent Topkapi Palace (main residences of Ottoman Sultans) and the Byzantine Hippodrome that was the scene of chariot races. Around the corner we will visit St. Sophia Basilica, historic seat of the Byzantine church, built in 360 AD and now a museum whose mosaics, stained glass windows and decorated domes have been crafted to create an environment of breathtaking beauty. Enjoy a short walk through gardens and proceed to the Blue Mosque of Sultan Ahmet 1 built in 1616, famous for its unparalleled ceramic tile work. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Guided tour of Istanbul's Old City; Visit Topkapi Palace; Visit Byzantine Hippodrome; Visit St. Sophia Basilica; Walk through gardens; Visit Blue Mosque; Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Galata, Catholic churches, Grand Covered Bazaar
tourDays.description: Following breakfast we will visit the Galata Tower and Bridge. In the Galata district many Catholic Churches are located. We will visit The Basilica of St Anthony of Padua, the most prestigious Catholic Church in Istanbul, originally built on this site in 1725, but was demolished in the early 20th Century, in order to make way for a tramway. The church was rebuilt by the architect, Giulio Mongeri and completed in 1912. Celebrate Mass. Following lunch visit The Church of Our Lady of Lourdes is a historic parish of the Georgian Greek Catholic Church in the district of Bomonti of the Istanbul district of ÅiÅli. We also will stop by SS Peter and Paul is a Catholic church in Istanbul, important for historical reasons. The church owns an icon of the Virgin of the Hodegetria type, which originally lay in a Dominican church in Caffa, Crimea. Ending our day with a visit of the Grand Covered Bazaar, a maze of streets and shops aroma and sounds of old Turkey. Dinner and overnight in Istanbul.
tourDays.activities: Visit Galata Tower and Bridge; Visit Basilica of St Anthony of Padua; Celebrate Mass; Visit Church of Our Lady of Lourdes; Stop by SS Peter and Paul church; Visit Grand Covered Bazaar; Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Flight to Kayseri; Cappadocia visit
tourDays.description: This morning we will take a short flight to Kayseri and visit the âmoon-likeâ topography and unique landscape of Cappadocia. We will visit the underground city of Kaymakli where thousands of early Christians lived concealed from persecutors in eight story complexes of subterranean dwellings. We will enjoy the picturesque views of this ancient and historic land as we make our way to our hotel. We enjoy dinner and a restful overnight in Cappadocia.
tourDays.activities: Short flight to Kayseri; Visit Cappadocia landscape / viewpoints; Visit underground city of Kaymakli; Transfer to hotel; Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Goreme museum, Uchisar Castle; drive to Konya
tourDays.description: Early in the morning you may experience an optional Hot-Air Balloon Ride. Cappadocia is one of Turkeyâs most fanciful and recognizable landscapes. During the Balloon Ride take in a unique panorama with fairy-tale chimneys in the light of dawn. Following breakfast we will visit the famous Goreme âopen-air museum,â. Goreme with its chapels carved by early Christians and decorated with frescoes dating from the 6th and 10th centuries is an unforgettable experience. Continue on a short drive to the Uchisar Castle which is the panoramic watching point Cappadocia. This afternoon we drive to Konya. Paul and Barnabas visited the city on Paulâs first missionary journey (Acts 13:51â14:7). Here they preached in the synagogue and then the city. Paul revisited the city on his second (Acts 16:2) and probably third journeys. In the center of the modern city of Konya, directly on the hill on which the ancient Iconium was located stands the Church of St. Paul, built in 1910 by the Sultan for the numerous Catholic workers on the Anatolian Railway. Dinner and overnight in Konya.
tourDays.activities: Optional hot-air balloon ride (early morning, optional); Visit Goreme open-air museum; Drive to and view Uchisar Castle; Drive to Konya; Visit Church of St. Paul; Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Pisidian Antioch; travel to Pamukkale; thermal pools
tourDays.description: After breakfast we drive to Pisidian Antioch. The history of Pisidian Antioch goes back to some time between 310-280 BC. The first Biblical reference to this city is Paulâs mention of it in Acts 13:14-16 as the synagogue from which he preached his first recorded sermon during his first missionary journey. We continue to Pamukkale, the white Cotton Castle formed by lime cascades. Enjoy a leisurely bath in the warm mineral waters of your hotelâs thermal pools before dinner and a restful night sleep.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Pisidian Antioch; Visit site associated with Paul's sermon; Continue to Pamukkale; Leisurely bath in hotel's thermal pools; Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Hierapolis, Laodicea, Colossae day trip
tourDays.description: Today we will enjoy a full day excursion and visit the ancient City of Hierapolis meaning âSacred City,â Philip the Evangelistâs home. Tour the extensive necropolis, churches and baths. We continue with a scenic drive to Laodicea located in the Lycus River Valley of western Asia Minor, a primary trade route between the cultures of the West and East. âThe âlukewarmâ church with a faith thatâs neither hot nor coldâ (Rev. 3:14-22). Continue to nearby Colossae, which is well-known throughout Christian circles as the receiver of Paulâs letter to the Colossians. Today, the town has fallen into obscurity and nothing remains. Return to Pamukkale for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Hierapolis (necropolis, churches, baths); Scenic drive to Laodicea and visit site; Visit Colossae; Return to Pamukkale for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Ephesus and House of the Virgin Mary; Basilica of St. John
tourDays.description: After breakfast at the hotel, we will depart for Ephesus, which was the most influential capital city of Asia Minor on the Aegean Sea. âEphesus receives praise for its perseveranceâ (Rev. 2:1-7). You will explore some of the best preserved theatres, fountains and buildings in the world. We then visit the House of the Virgin Mary which was miraculously discovered hidden on a wooded hilltop. A pilgrimage site for many which has also been accepted by the Vatican. Finally visit the Basilica of St. John which stands over the believed burial site of St. John, who is identified as the apostle, evangelist (author of the Fourth Gospel) and prophet (author of Revelation). Continue on to Izmir were our day ends with dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Depart Pamukkale for Ephesus; Explore Ephesus (theatres, fountains, buildings); Visit the House of the Virgin Mary; Visit the Basilica of St. John; Transfer to Izmir, dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Seven Churches: Philadelphia, Sardis, Thyatira
tourDays.description: Our day starts with visit the site of Philadelphia also one of the Seven Churches of Revelation (Rev. 3: 7-13). Christ told those who overcame that He would write upon them âthe name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is New Jerusalem.â (Rev.3: 12). Continue onto Then Sardis, another of the Seven Churches of Revelation. Jesus told Sardis, âI know thy works, that thou hast a name, that thou livest, and art deadâ(Rev. 3: 1-6). Sardis, located on the banks of the Pactolus River in western Asia Minor. âThe church of Sardis is described as dead, and it must wake up. We continue on to Thyatira, known for its textiles and dyeing trade. It is now known as the Turkish city of Akhisar. It is âpraised for its increasing faith and serviceâ (Rev. 2:18-29) Return to Izmir for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Philadelphia site; Visit Sardis site; Visit Thyatira (Akhisar); Return to Izmir for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Smyrna (Agora) and Pergamum (Acropolis, Asclepion)
tourDays.description: We wake up in the modern Turkish city of Izmir. In ancient times âSmyrnaâ, as it was called, was in a powerful trading position on the Aegean Sea known for its harbors, commerce, and marketplaces. Visit the archeological remains of the Agora. The Agora in Izmir is an ancient Roman marketplace located in the heart of the city. It was originally built in the 4th century BCE and later expanded by the Romans. The site features impressive ruins, including colonnaded streets, a large courtyard, and the remains of various public buildings. The Agora served as a central hub for commerce, politics, and social activities in ancient times. Today, it stands as a significant historical site and a popular attraction for visitors interested in exploring Izmirâs rich history and ancient architecture. Continue to Pergamum, located on the plains and foothills along the Caicus River in Western Turkey. The city, is âpraised for its martyrdom and perseverance but those who hold false teachings are criticizedâ (Rev. 2:12-17). Here you will see the Acropolis famous for Greek & Roman Temples as well as the unique Greek theatre built into the steep hillside. Also visit the Asclepion, the ancient medical center for the Greeks. Return to Izmir for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Agora (Smyrna/Izmir); Continue to Pergamum; See Pergamum Acropolis and Greek theatre; Visit Asclepion (ancient medical center); Return to Izmir for dinner and overnight

The tour starts at the Church of the Holy Cross, the Santa Croce, where many nobles are buried, such as Michelangelo, Galileo, and Machiavelli. Continue to walk by Piazza Signorina, Palazzo Vecchio, Uffizi, Ponte Vecchio, and Republic Square to the Santa Maria del Fiore. This afternoon you will have time to explore Florence on your own. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
