tourDays.title: Florence - Padua
tourDays.description: Following breakfast at your hotel, board the motorcoach for your transfer to Padua. This Northern Italian city honors St. Anthony. You will begin a sightseeing tour of the city, including a view of the University of Padua and the Basilica of Santa Giustina. The tour will conclude at the Basilica of St. Anthony, where you will have the opportunity to visit his tomb. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast; Motorcoach transfer to Padua; Sightseeing tour of Padua; Visit Basilica of Santa Giustina; Visit Basilica of St. Anthony (tomb); Group dinner

tourDays.title: Padua - Venice (Full Day Excursion) - Padua
tourDays.description: You will have early breakfast and then board your bus to depart to the city of Venice. After Mass, enjoy a tour of Venice. Your walking tour includes a visit to St. Markâs Square; the Golden Basilica of San Marco; the Bridge of Sighs; and views of the Dogesâ Palace. Return to Padua for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Motorcoach transfer to Venice; Attend Mass; Guided walking tour of Venice; Visit St. Mark's Square, Basilica of San Marco, Bridge of Sighs, view Doges' Palace; Return transfer to Padua; Group dinner

tourDays.title: Padua - Verona - Milan
tourDays.description: After breakfast, depart towards Verona. Upon arrival tour the medieval old town, including Juliet's House, Piazza delle Erbe, Torre dei Lamberti, San Zeno Basilica, Verona Cathedral, Museo di Castelvecchio, and Ponte Pietra. After lunch continue onto the city of Milan for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast; Motorcoach transfer to Verona; Sightseeing tour of Verona (including Juliet's House and medieval sites); Lunch (on own); Continue by coach to Milan; Group dinner

tourDays.title: Milan - Pavia - Milan
tourDays.description: Following breakfast, embark on a sightseeing journey with a local guide in Milan. Visit the Basilica of St. Ambrogio and the Milan Cathedral (Duomo) and their tombs and relics. After free time for lunch, venture north of Pavia to admire the Carthusian Certosa di Pavia monastery and explore Pavia's covered bridge over the Ticino River, the Towers of Pavia historical center, and San Pietro in Ciel dâOro where the remains of St. Augustine of Hippo are located. Return to the hotel in Milan for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast; Guided sightseeing in Milan (visit Basilica of St. Ambrogio and Milan Cathedral); Venerate relics (including duomo relics); Free time for lunch; Visit Certosa di Pavia (monastery); Sightseeing in Pavia (covered bridge, Towers of Pavia, San Pietro in Ciel d'Oro); Return to Milan; Group dinner

tourDays.title: Milan - Mesero - Castelnuovo Don Bosco - Turin
tourDays.description: Traverse the countryside around Milan to visit the shrine and tomb of St. Gianna Beretta Molla at Mesero. Visit Magenta in Ponte Nuovo to see the house where Gianna was born, the Basilica di San Martino (where she was baptized), and the chapel of Madonna del Buon Consiglio. Free time for lunch before moving on to Castelnuovo Don Bosco, the birthplace of St. John Bosco. After visiting these sites, travel to Turin for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel through countryside by coach; Visit shrine and tomb of St. Gianna Beretta Molla (Mesero); Visit Gianna Beretta Molla's birthplace house in Magenta (Ponte Nuovo); Visit Basilica di San Martino and chapel of Madonna del Buon Consiglio; Free time for lunch; Visit Castelnuovo Don Bosco (birthplace of St. John Bosco); Transfer to Turin; Group dinner

tourDays.title: Turin - Cathedral of St. John the Baptist, Sanctuary of Maria Ausiliatrice, Corpus Domini
tourDays.description: Wake up in Turin, home of the Shroud of Turin. Visit the Cathedral of St. John the Baptist (where the Shroud is kept) and venerate the buried body of St. Pier Giorgio Frassati. Move on to the Sanctuary of Maria Ausiliatrice (Basilica of Our Lady Help of Christians) where St. John Bosco is buried along with relics of St. Dominic Savio. Lastly visit the Corpus Domini Basilica, site of the 15th century Eucharistic miracle. Afternoon free time for shopping before gathering at the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Cathedral of St. John the Baptist (Shroud location) and venerate St. Pier Giorgio Frassati; Visit Sanctuary of Maria Ausiliatrice (Basilica of Our Lady Help of Christians); Visit Corpus Domini Basilica (site of Eucharistic miracle); Free time for shopping; Group dinner

tourDays.title: Turin - Oropa - Biella - Turin
tourDays.description: Journey to Oropa, one of the oldest Marian shrines in the world. Visit the Black/Brown Madonna, the church where St. Pier Giorgio Frassati prayed, and see the mountain he climbed. Take a cable car that goes halfway up the mountain to the lake (weather and time permitting). Return to Turin for a farewell dinner and final overnight stay.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Oropa by coach; Visit the Brown/Black Madonna shrine; Visit church where St. Pier Giorgio Frassati prayed; See the mountain climbed by Frassati; Take cable car partway up the mountain (weather/time permitting); Return to Turin; Farewell dinner

tourDays.title: Return Home
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast, your group will leave by motor coach and transfer to the Turin airport for your return flights.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Motorcoach transfer to Turin airport; Board return flights

tourDays.title: Depart USA
tourDays.description: Board your overnight transatlantic flights from your home town. Meals are served on board.
tourDays.activities: Overnight transatlantic flight; Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Arrive Barcelona
tourDays.description: Upon arrival you will be greeted by the tour guide and driver. Transfer to the hotel for free time to rest and refresh before Mass. Dinner and overnight in Barcelona.
tourDays.activities: Meet tour guide and driver; Transfer to hotel; Mass; Dinner

tourDays.title: Barcelona sightseeing
tourDays.description: Morning tour of Barcelona with panoramic views of the Harbor area, Montjuic, Plaza de EspaÃ±a and Plaza de Catalunya. Guided walk through the Gothic Quarter to visit the cathedral and view Gaudi's Sagrada Familia. Afternoon at leisure to explore Las Ramblas. Dinner and overnight in Barcelona.
tourDays.activities: Panoramic city tour; Guided walk through the Gothic Quarter; Visit cathedral; View Sagrada Familia; Free time/explore Las Ramblas; Dinner

tourDays.title: Montserrat & Manresa excursion
tourDays.description: Visit Montserrat to see the Benedictine monastery and the Shrine of Our Lady of Montserrat (the Black Madonna). Historical background provided. Return to Barcelona for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Benedictine monastery; Visit Shrine of Our Lady of Montserrat; Return to Barcelona

tourDays.title: Zaragoza visit and travel to Madrid
tourDays.description: Depart Barcelona for Zaragoza. Visit the Basilica del Pilar (site of Our Lady's apparition to Saint James), the Cathedral of Zaragoza, and do a walking tour of the city. Continue to Madrid for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Zaragoza; Visit Basilica del Pilar; Visit Cathedral of Zaragoza; Walking tour of Zaragoza; Continue to Madrid; Dinner

tourDays.title: Madrid tour and Toledo visit
tourDays.description: Tour Madrid including the Royal Palace and Plaza Mayor. Depart for Toledo to see the city's historic churches, synagogues and monuments such as the Cathedral, Santo TomÃ©, TrÃ¡nsito Synagogue, Santa MarÃ­a La Blanca, San Juan de los Reyes and several city gates. Return to Madrid for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Tour of Madrid (Royal Palace, Plaza Mayor); Travel to Toledo; Sightseeing in Toledo (multiple historic sites); Return to Madrid; Dinner

tourDays.title: Travel to Santiago de Compostela
tourDays.description: Depart Madrid for Santiago de Compostela. Stop in Villafranca del Bierzo to visit the Collegiate Church of Santa MarÃ­a, the churches of Santiago and San Nicolas, and Agua Street. Enter Galicia by Lugo and stop in O Cebreiro to see pallozas and a Pre-Romanesque temple. Continue to Santiago de Compostela for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel toward Santiago de Compostela; Visit Villafranca del Bierzo (Collegiate Church of Santa MarÃ­a, churches of Santiago and San Nicolas, Agua Street); Stop in Lugo region/O Cebreiro (see pallozas and Pre-Romanesque temple); Continue to Santiago de Compostela; Dinner

tourDays.title: Pilgrimage to the Cathedral of St. James
tourDays.description: Join the walking pilgrims at Monte del Gozo and walk the last miles of El Camino to the Cathedral. Attend the International Pilgrim Mass at the Cathedral of St. James, perform rites including hugging the Saint, going under the main altar and visiting the crypt with relics of St. James. In the afternoon visit the city (Obradoiro Square, Fonseca Palace, Gelmirez Palace, Franco Street). Dinner and overnight in Santiago de Compostela.
tourDays.activities: Walk from Monte del Gozo (join pilgrims); Walk final miles of El Camino; Attend International Pilgrim Mass; Perform pilgrim rites (hug the Saint, go under main altar, visit crypt); Sightseeing in Santiago (Obradoiro Square, Fonseca Palace, Gelmirez Palace, Franco Street); Dinner

tourDays.title: Travel to Lisbon
tourDays.description: Depart for Lisbon. After an orientation drive through Lisbon, stop and visit St. Anthony's Church. Dinner and overnight in Lisbon.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Lisbon; Orientation drive through Lisbon; Visit St. Anthony's Church; Dinner

tourDays.title: Santarem and Fatima
tourDays.description: Depart Lisbon for Santarem. Walk through Santarem's narrow streets to the Church of St. Stephen to see the Eucharistic Miracle on display since 1269. Continue on to Fatima for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Santarem; Walk to Church of St. Stephen; See Eucharistic Miracle display; Continue to Fatima; Dinner

tourDays.title: Fatima pilgrimage
tourDays.description: Visit the Little Chapel of the Apparitions, the Basilica, the gravesite of Francesco and Jacinta, the Hamlet of Aljustrel, and Valinhos. Follow the Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra ending at the Chapel of Calvary. Join the evening candlelight procession to pray the rosary. Dinner and overnight in Fatima.
tourDays.activities: Visit Little Chapel of the Apparitions; Visit Basilica; Visit gravesite of Francesco and Jacinta; Visit Hamlet of Aljustrel; Visit Valinhos; Follow Stations of the Cross along Via Sacra; Attend evening candlelight rosary procession; Dinner

tourDays.title: Fly to Medjugorje and transfer to village
tourDays.description: Early morning departure from Fatima for flights to Medjugorje. Upon arrival you are greeted by a tour guide and/or driver and take a 2 1/2 hour drive by private coach to the village of Medjugorje. Meet your host family and settle into accommodations for the next four nights.
tourDays.activities: Early morning departure from Fatima; Flights to Medjugorje; Transfer by private coach to Medjugorje; Meet host family and check in

tourDays.title: Medjugorje stay (day 1)
tourDays.description: During your stay in Medjugorje you will share faith with pilgrims and be accompanied by a local guide. Daily activities include English language Mass at St. James Church, walking Apparition Hill, praying at the cross, evening rosary and Croatian Mass with blessings. Opportunities for Adoration, Veneration of the Cross, climbing Krizevac Mountain, visiting the Blue Cross and the Community Cenacolo are available.
tourDays.activities: Attend English Mass at St. James Church; Walk up Apparition Hill and pray at the cross; Join evening rosary and Croatian Mass (Blessing of the Sick and items); Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament (Tuesdays and Saturdays); Veneration of the Cross (Fridays); Climb Krizevac Mountain; Visit Blue Cross; Visit Community Cenacolo

tourDays.title: Medjugorje stay (day 2)
tourDays.description: Continuation of Medjugorje activities: English Mass at St. James Church, pilgrimage to Apparition Hill and other devotional sites, evening rosary and Croatian Mass with blessings, and optional visits such as Krizevac Mountain, Blue Cross and Community Cenacolo. Note: a spiritual director will not be with the group throughout the stay; English confessions are available at St. James Church.
tourDays.activities: Attend English Mass at St. James Church; Walk Apparition Hill and pray at the cross; Join evening rosary and Croatian Mass (Blessing of the Sick and items); Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament (Tuesdays and Saturdays); Veneration of the Cross (Fridays); Climb Krizevac Mountain; Visit Blue Cross; Visit Community Cenacolo; English confessions available

tourDays.title: Medjugorje stay (day 3)
tourDays.description: Final full day in Medjugorje continuing devotional activities with the local guide: attend Mass, visit Apparition Hill and Krizevac, participate in evening rosary and Croatian Mass with blessings, and visit Community Cenacolo.
tourDays.activities: Attend English Mass at St. James Church; Walk Apparition Hill and pray at the cross; Join evening rosary and Croatian Mass (Blessing of the Sick and items); Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament (Tuesdays and Saturdays); Veneration of the Cross (Fridays); Climb Krizevac Mountain; Visit Blue Cross; Visit Community Cenacolo

tourDays.title: Return to USA
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast, depart by motor coach for Dubrovnik Airport (Split or Sarajevo) for return flights home.
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Motor coach transfer to airport; Return flights home

tourDays.title: Depart for Bulgaria
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Make your way to your local airport; Board overnight flight(s); Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Arrival to Bulgaria Sofia
tourDays.description: Upon landing into Sofia airport, make your way to the baggage claim area and collect your luggage. Proceed to the arrival's hall, where you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver. Transfer to your hotel with afternoon to explore. This evening celebrate Mass, followed with a welcome dinner at a local restaurant with Nestinari fire dances and a spectacular folklore show. Overnight in Sofia.
tourDays.activities: Collect luggage at Sofia airport; Meet tour guide/driver; Transfer to hotel; Afternoon to explore Sofia; Celebrate Mass; Welcome dinner with Nestinari fire dances and folklore show

tourDays.title: Sofia â Rila Monastery â Sofia
tourDays.description: After breakfast we will travel to one of the largest orthodox monasteries in the world â the Rila Monastery. ... Explore among others the main church and the monastery museum with its valuable exhibits of religious books, ancient weapons of the monastery guards, deeds by Bulgarian Tsars, jewellery and church objects. After the visit return to Sofia, where we will start our city tour of the Bulgarian capital. The tour starts at Sveta Nedelya square. ... Enjoy a delicious dinner at a local restaurant. Overnight in Sofia.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Rila Monastery; Explore main church and monastery museum at Rila Monastery; Return to Sofia; City tour of Sofia (starting at Sveta Nedelya square); Dinner at a local restaurant

tourDays.title: Sofia â Plovdiv â Kazanlak â Veliko Tarnovo
tourDays.description: Following breakfast we will travel towards Plovdiv, the 2019 European Cultural Capital. ... During the city tour you will discover the unique cultural and historical heritage such as the Ancient Roman Theatre, the Roman Odeon, the Roman stadium and the Folk Art Museum. Celebrate Mass at the local Cathedral before enjoying some free time for lunch in Plovdiv. We will continue our journey towards Kazanlak, where we will visit the local rose distilery and enjoy a rose brandy tasting. In the evening arrive in Veliko Tarnovo. Check-in and have dinner at the hotel before a restful night in Veliko Tarnovo.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Plovdiv; Plovdiv city tour (Ancient Roman Theatre, Roman Odeon, Roman stadium, Folk Art Museum); Celebrate Mass in Plovdiv; Free time for lunch in Plovdiv; Visit rose distillery in Kazanlak; Rose brandy tasting; Arrive and check-in at Veliko Tarnovo hotel; Dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Veliko Tarnovo â Ruse â Bucharest
tourDays.description: After time for breakfast this morning we will enjoy a walking tour of Veliko Tarnovo. Start with visit of the Tsaravets fortress, ... Walk by the ancient gates, visit the Balduinâs Tower and the St. Petka church. Continue to the crafts street âSamovodska charshiaâ. We will transfer to Ruse, ... enjoy some free time for lunch. At the Romanian border you will meet your Romanian guide and depart towards Bucharest. Check-in at your hotel upon arrival followed by Mass celebration at the local Cathedral. This evening enjoy a walking tour in the Old Town of Bucharest with dinner at a local restaurant. Overnight in Bucharest.
tourDays.activities: Veliko Tarnovo walking tour; Visit Tsaravets fortress; Walk by ancient gates; Visit Balduinâs Tower; Visit St. Petka church; Visit Samovodska charshia (crafts street); Transfer to Ruse and free time for lunch; Meet Romanian guide at border; Transfer to Bucharest and hotel check-in; Celebrate Mass at Bucharest Cathedral; Walking tour of Bucharest Old Town; Dinner at local restaurant

tourDays.title: Bucharest â Sibiu
tourDays.description: After breakfast we will head towards Sibiu, the largest and wealthiest walled citadel built in Transylvania in the 12th century by the German settlers. We will stop for lunch in Calimanesti, where you can also admire the 14th century Cozia Monastery. Continue to Sibiu and check-in at your hotel upon arrival. Visit the Grand Square, the Small Square, the Liarâs Bridge and the impressive Evangelical Cathedral. In the Grand Square you will find the Holy Trinity Cathedral, where we will celebrate Mass. Dinner at a local restaurant in the evening and overnight in Sibiu.
tourDays.activities: Travel from Bucharest to Sibiu; Stop for lunch in Calimanesti; Admire Cozia Monastery; Check-in at hotel in Sibiu; Visit Grand Square, Small Square, Liarâs Bridge, Evangelical Cathedral; Celebrate Mass at Holy Trinity Cathedral; Dinner at a local restaurant

tourDays.title: Sibiu â Turda â Cluj Napoca â Bistrita
tourDays.description: Today you depart towards the Turda Salt Mine, which is one of the worldâs oldest salt mines, ... After some free time for lunch depart to Cluj Napoca, the largest city of Transylvania. Take a stroll at the Unification Square, discover the equestrian statue of the Hungarian King Matthias Corvinus and the Catholic Church St. Michael. Continue your tour towards Bistrita, where upon arrival check-in at your hotel and celebrate Mass at the local Cathedral. Dinner at the hotel and overnight in Bistrita.
tourDays.activities: Visit Turda Salt Mine; Free time for lunch; Depart to Cluj Napoca; Stroll at Unification Square; See equestrian statue of Matthias Corvinus; Visit St. Michael Catholic Church; Travel to Bistrita and hotel check-in; Celebrate Mass at Bistrita Cathedral; Dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Bistrita â Voronet â Moldovita â Bistrita
tourDays.description: Following breakfast we will start our tour of the painted monasteries of Bucovina with the most famous Romanian monastery. The Voronet monastery ... After free time for lunch we will continue to Moldovita, where you visit one of the most representative Romanian orthodox monasteries, the Moldovita monastery. Return to Bistrita in the afternoon to celebrate Mass at the local Cathedral upon arrival. Dinner at a local restaurant in Bistrita.
tourDays.activities: Tour the painted monasteries of Bucovina; Visit Voronet monastery (interior and exterior paintings); Free time for lunch; Visit Moldovita monastery; Return to Bistrita; Celebrate Mass at Bistrita Cathedral; Dinner at a local restaurant

tourDays.title: Bistrita â Targu Mures â Sighisoara
tourDays.description: Discover today one of the most interesting towns in Transylvania â Targu Mures. During the city tour you can admire the cityâs landmarks such as the Apollo Palace, the Old Prefecture building, The Teleki Palace and the Orthodox Cathedral. After the tour you will celebrate Mass at the local Cathedral and then enjoy some free time for lunch. You travel then towards Sighisoara, one of the few still inhabited medieval citadels in the world. After the check-in enjoy a walking tour inside the citadel, and dinner at a local historic restaurant, also known as Draculaâs birth house. Overnight in Sighisoara.
tourDays.activities: Targu Mures city tour (Apollo Palace, Old Prefecture, Teleki Palace, Orthodox Cathedral); Celebrate Mass at Targu Mures Cathedral; Free time for lunch; Travel to Sighisoara; Check-in at hotel; Walking tour inside Sighisoara citadel; Dinner at local historic restaurant

tourDays.title: Sighisoara â Bran â Brasov
tourDays.description: After breakfast depart to Bran, where you will find the most famous castle in the world â the Dracula Castle. ... Free time for lunch near the castle. Continue to Brasov, ... visit the well preserved old town of Brasov, where you will get to know the historical and cultural attractions such as the Council Square, the Nicholas Church, the Black Church and the Brasov fortress. After the tour attend the church mass at the local Cathedral. Check-in at the hotel and in the evening enjoy dinner at a local restaurant in the Old Town. Overnight in Brasov.
tourDays.activities: Depart to Bran; Visit Bran Castle (Dracula Castle); Free time for lunch near the castle; Continue to Brasov; Visit Brasov old town (Council Square, Nicholas Church, Black Church, Brasov fortress); Attend Mass at local Cathedral; Check-in at hotel; Dinner in Brasov Old Town

tourDays.title: Brasov â Sinaia â Bucharest
tourDays.description: In the morning depart to Sinaia, where you visit the Peles Castle from the 19th century. Travel to Bucharest in the afternoon. Visit the impressive Parliament Palace upon arrival. Enjoy a panoramic tour which features all the important attractions such as the Union Square, University Square, Roman Square, the Arch of Triumph, the Victory Square, the Victory Avenue and the revolution Square. After the check-in at the hotel, take part in the church mass at the St. Josef Cathedral in Bucharest. In the evening enjoy a farewell dinner at a historic restaurant in the Old Town. Overnight in Bucharest.
tourDays.activities: Depart to Sinaia; Visit Peles Castle; Travel to Bucharest; Visit Parliament Palace; Panoramic tour of Bucharest (Union Square, University Square, Roman Square, Arch of Triumph, Victory Square, Victory Avenue, Revolution Square); Celebrate Mass at St. Josef Cathedral; Farewell dinner at historic restaurant

tourDays.title: Bucharest to Chisinau
tourDays.description: This morning transfer to Bucharest airport for your short flight to Chisinau. Upon arrival to Moldova make your way to the baggage claim area and collect your luggage. Proceed to the arrival's hall, where you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver. Transfer to your hotel for the check-in and free time. In the afternoon enjoy a short panoramic tour of the Moldavian capital, which includes the National Palace, the Arch of Triumph and the Palace of the Parliament. In the evening take a short trip to Cricova, where you will visit the largest wine cellar in the world and where you will enjoy some of the best Moldavian wines. Enjoy a welcome dinner at the winery then return to Chisinau. Overnight in Chisinau.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Bucharest airport; Short flight to Chisinau; Collect luggage and meet guide/driver in Chisinau; Transfer to hotel and check-in; Short panoramic tour of Chisinau (National Palace, Arch of Triumph, Palace of the Parliament); Trip to Cricova winery; Visit Cricova wine cellar and wine tasting; Welcome dinner at the winery

tourDays.title: Chisinau â Capriana â Curchi â Old Orhei â Chisinau
tourDays.description: After breakfast we will travel to Capriana to visit the local monastery. Continue on to Curchi, and visit the Summer Church âNativity of Virgin Maryâ. The tour takes you next to the Old Orhei region, visiting the unique cave monastery (13th cent.). We will visit the house-museum of traditional life of Moldavian farmers in the village Butuceni. Dinner in the rural pension which includes national Moldovan dishes and homemade wine. Enjoy Moldovan songs and dances, as well as the opportunity to participate in the folk program. Return to Chisinau in the evening. Dinner at the hotel.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Capriana and visit Capriana Monastery; Visit Curchi and Summer Church 'Nativity of Virgin Mary'; Visit Old Orhei cave monastery; Visit house-museum of traditional Moldavian life in Butuceni; Dinner in rural pension with national Moldovan dishes and homemade wine; Participate in Moldovan songs and dances / folk program; Return to Chisinau and dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Departure
tourDays.description: After breakfast transfer to Chisinau airport for your return flight(s) home.
tourDays.activities: Breakfast; Transfer to Chisinau airport; Board return flight(s)

tourDays.title: Depart for Rome
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport, where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Make your way to local airport; Board overnight flight(s); Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Arrival in Rome
tourDays.description: Upon landing at Rome airport, claim your baggage and proceed to the arrival hall where your tour guide and/or driver will greet you. Following check-in at the hotel, enjoy free time to unpack, relax, or explore. Later this afternoon, meet in the hotel lobby for a meet and greet with fellow pilgrims and your priest, depart together for Mass, attend a welcome dinner, and optionally walk to St. Peterâs Square for the Rosary.
tourDays.activities: Claim baggage; Meet and greet with tour guide/priest; Check in at hotel; Attend Mass; Welcome dinner; Optional Rosary at St. Peterâs Square; Free time to explore Rome

tourDays.title: Rome: Papal Audience and Major Basilicas
tourDays.description: Attend the Papal Audience in St. Peterâs Square or the Audience Hall (pending the papal schedule). Visit Piazza Navona for free time and lunch on your own. This afternoon visit the Archbasilica of St. John the Lateran, the Holy Stairs, and the Basilica of St. Mary Major where Holy Mass will be celebrated. Dinner and overnight in Rome.
tourDays.activities: Attend Papal Audience (St. Peterâs Square or Audience Hall); Free time and lunch at Piazza Navona (on your own); Visit Archbasilica of St. John the Lateran; Visit the Holy Stairs; Visit Basilica of St. Mary Major; Celebrate Holy Mass; Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Rome: St. Peter's Basilica and Vatican Museum
tourDays.description: Tour St. Peterâs Basilica (view Michelangeloâs Pieta and pray at the tombs of Pope Benedict XVI and St. John Paul II). Visit the Vatican Museum (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel). After lunch, continue along the Appian Way to the Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls and the Catacombs. Dinner and overnight in Rome.
tourDays.activities: Tour St. Peterâs Basilica; View Michelangeloâs Pieta; Pray at tombs of Pope Benedict XVI and St. John Paul II; Visit Vatican Museum (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel); Walk the Appian Way; Visit Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls; Visit Catacombs; Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Rome to Monte Cassino and San Giovanni Rotondo
tourDays.description: Board the bus and travel to the Abbey of Monte Cassino, the principal monastery of the Benedictine Order. Continue on to San Giovanni Rotondo, where St. Pio lived for many decades. Dinner and overnight in San Giovanni Rotondo.
tourDays.activities: Bus transfer to Abbey of Monte Cassino; Visit Abbey of Monte Cassino; Continue by bus to San Giovanni Rotondo; Dinner and overnight in San Giovanni Rotondo

tourDays.title: San Giovanni Rotondo and Monte Sant' Angelo
tourDays.description: Visit the Old Church of Our Lady of Grace and see the confessional where St. Pio spent many hours listening to confessions. Travel along the Gargano Peninsula to the Grotto of St. Michael the Archangel. Return for dinner and overnight in San Giovanni Rotondo. (Between May and October, attend the weekly candlelight procession at the Sanctuary of St. Pio after dinner, at 9:00 p.m.)
tourDays.activities: Visit Old Church of Our Lady of Grace; See the confessional of St. Pio; Bus along the Gargano Peninsula; Visit the Grotto of St. Michael the Archangel; Return to San Giovanni Rotondo; (MayâOctober) Attend weekly candlelight procession at the Sanctuary of St. Pio

tourDays.title: Lanciano, Loreto and travel to Assisi
tourDays.description: After breakfast depart for Assisi with stops en route. In Lanciano attend a private Mass at the Church of St. Longinus (site of an 8th-century Eucharistic Miracle). Visit the Marian Shrine of Loreto to see the Holy House of Nazareth. End the day in Assisi for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Private Mass at the Church of St. Longinus (Lanciano); Visit the Marian Shrine of Loreto (Holy House of Nazareth); Travel to Assisi; Dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Assisi: Basilica of St. Francis and Porziuncola
tourDays.description: Begin with a tour of the Basilica of St. Francis to see his tomb, frescoes depicting his life, and a few of his possessions. Visit the Santuario Della Spogliazione to pray at the tomb of St. Carlo Acutis. Free time for prayer, shopping, and lunch. After lunch visit the Basilica of St. Mary of the Angels to see the Porziuncola and the Capella del Transito (where St. Francis died). Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Tour Basilica of St. Francis and visit his tomb; View frescoes and possessions of St. Francis; Visit Santuario Della Spogliazione and pray at the tomb of St. Carlo Acutis; Free time for prayer, shopping, and lunch; Visit Basilica of St. Mary of the Angels (Porziuncola and Capella del Transito); Return to hotel for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Day trip to Orvieto
tourDays.description: Drive through the Umbrian mountains to Orvieto, visit the renowned Orvieto Cathedral, then return to Assisi for dinner and a final overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Orvieto through the Umbrian mountains; Visit Orvieto Cathedral; Return to Assisi for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Return Home
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast and farewells, transfer to Rome Fiumicino airport for your return flight(s) home. (Your flight departure time should be no earlier than 10AM.)
tourDays.activities: Early breakfast; Transfer to Rome Fiumicino Airport; Board return flight(s) home

tourDays.title: Depart for Paris
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport, where you will board your overnight flight(s). Meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Travel to local airport; Board overnight flight(s); Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Arrive Paris

Free time to unpack or explore. Between 3:00 PM and 3:30 PM meet in the hotel lobby for a meet and greet with fellow pilgrims and your priest, depart together for Mass, attend a welcome dinner, and optional walk to St. Peterâs Square for the Rosary.

tourDays.title: Sacred Spaces of Prague

tourDays.title: Kolkata / Embark
tourDays.description: Arrive in Kolkata and transfer to the jetty to embark on the ship. Enjoy lunch on board. After lunch, proceed for a Panoramic Tour of Kolkata, highlighting well-preserved British colonial buildings including Writer's Building, General Post Office, High Court, Raj Bhawan (Governor's House), Town Hall, Council House, Treasury Building, Reserve Bank of India, and Dalhousie Square. A stop will be made at the grand Victoria Memorial for a photo opportunity. Next, visit St. Paulâs Cathedral, the cityâs largest cathedral and a symbol of European heritage. Built between 1839 and 1847, it is renowned for its Indo-Gothic architecture, vibrant stained-glass windows, and Florentine Renaissance-style frescoes. (L, D)
tourDays.activities: Transfer to jetty and embark ship; Lunch on board; Panoramic tour of Kolkata colonial buildings; Photo stop at Victoria Memorial; Visit St. Paulâs Cathedral

tourDays.title: Kolkata: Flower Market, Kumartuli, Mother Teresaâs Home
tourDays.description: After breakfast, visit Kolkataâs Flower Market, located beneath the cantilevered Howrah Bridge. The market is bustling with vendors and buyers exchanging flowers, and there are artists creating garlands and ornaments for temples, weddings, and other occasions. Next, visit Kumartuli, a traditional pottersâ quarter, famous for sculpting clay idols used in festivals. These artisans make idols of gods and goddesses for local and regional worship. Before returning to the ship, visit Mother Teresaâs Home and Tomb. Mother Teresa founded the Missionaries of Charity in 1952, then lived and worked here until her death in 1997. Return to the ship for lunch and sail upstream, passing under the Howrah Bridge while observing colonial buildings along the Ganges River. In the afternoon, attend a talk by an expert about the iconic churches of Kolkata and their role in social welfare. (B, L, D)
tourDays.activities: Visit Flower Market beneath Howrah Bridge; Visit Kumartuli potters' quarter; Visit Mother Teresaâs Home and Tomb; Return to ship for lunch and sail under Howrah Bridge; Attend expert talk on Kolkata churches

tourDays.title: Bandel
tourDays.description: Set sail upstream to Bandel, founded by Portuguese settlers around 1660. Visit the Hooghly Imambara, a significant Shiya pilgrimage center built in 1841. This two-story building houses pilgrims and classrooms for Quran teachings. It also features a Victorian-era clock and stunning Persian chandeliers. Continue to the Basilica of the Holy Rosary, also known as Bandel Church. Founded in 1599, it is one of the oldest Christian churches in West Bengal, dedicated to Nossa Senhora do RosÃ¡rio (Our Lady of the Rosary). (B, L, D)
tourDays.activities: Sail upstream to Bandel; Visit Hooghly Imambara; Visit Basilica of the Holy Rosary (Bandel Church)

tourDays.title: Kalna / Rajbari temple complex
tourDays.description: Sail to Kalna, enjoying breakfast and lunch on board. Upon arrival, ride e-rickshaws to visit the Rajbari temple complex. The Nabakailas temple features 108 eight-slope-roofed shrines dedicated to Lord Shiva, and other temples showcase intricate terracotta plaques depicting Hindu epics and daily life. Return to the ship, walking through the local vegetable market. (B, L, D)
tourDays.activities: Sail to Kalna; Ride e-rickshaws to Rajbari temple complex; Visit Nabakailas temple and other terracotta temples; Walk through local vegetable market

tourDays.title: Nabadwip and Mayapur
tourDays.description: Sail to Nabadwip while having breakfast and lunch on board. Nabadwip is the birthplace of Saint Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, the founder of the Hindu Vaishnav religion. After lunch, take a walking tour of the riverbank village, where local people engage in handloom weaving of cotton fabric, such as saris and stoles. Later, ride a country boat across the river to Mayapur, the headquarters of the International Society for Krishna Consciousness (ISKCON). Explore the pilgrimâs bazaar, meet Krishna followers, and visit the temple, comparable in size to the Vatican. (B, L, D)
tourDays.activities: Sail to Nabadwip; Walking tour of riverbank village and handloom weaving demonstration; Boat ride to Mayapur; Explore pilgrimâs bazaar and visit ISKCON temple

tourDays.title: Guptipara and Fulia

Explore the town, visiting Vaishnav temples with remarkable terracotta artwork and a potterâs home to observe artisans creating clay items. Return to the ship for lunch. Afterward, sail to the village of Fulia, known for its weaving of Jacquard and Jamdani sarees. (B, L, D)
tourDays.activities: Sail to Guptipara; Visit Vaishnav temples and terracotta artworks; Visit potterâs home to observe artisans; Sail to Fulia and observe saree weaving (Jacquard and Jamdani)

tourDays.title: Chandernagore and Serampore
tourDays.description: After breakfast, sail to Chandernagore, a former French colony. Explore colonial buildings along the promenade, including the former French governorâs residence, now a museum. Visit the Sacred Heart Church, a heritage site that showcases French architectural influence in India. Return to the ship and sail to Serampore. After lunch, take a walk through the old quarters to visit the Danish Tavern, other Danish heritage monuments, and St. Olav's Church, one of the few remaining structures from Danish rule in Bengal. (B, L, D)
tourDays.activities: Sail to Chandernagore and explore colonial promenade; Visit former French governorâs residence (museum); Visit Sacred Heart Church; Sail to Serampore; Walk Serampore old quarters and visit Danish Tavern and St. Olav's Church

tourDays.title: Day 1: Depart from the U.S.

tourDays.title: Day 2: Cairo
tourDays.description: Arrive in Cairo, meet local guide and transfer to hotel for check-in. Dinner and overnight in Cairo.

tourDays.title: Day 3: Cairo
tourDays.description: Breakfast; visit the Giza pyramids (including Cheops) and the Sphinx; tour the Egyptian Museum (Tutankhamenâs treasures). Dinner and overnight in Cairo.
tourDays.activities: Visit pyramids of Giza; See the Sphinx; Tour the Egyptian Museum

tourDays.title: Day 4: Cairo
tourDays.description: After breakfast visit Memphis (view statue of Ramses II), Sakkara (Step Pyramid of King Zoser), stop to see Egyptian carpet-making, then drive to Faiyum to see ancient storehouses and man-made lake. Dinner and overnight in Cairo.
tourDays.activities: Visit Memphis and view Ramses II statue; Visit Sakkara and Step Pyramid; Stop to view local carpet-making; Visit Faiyum and archaeological sites

tourDays.title: Day 5: Fly from Cairo to Luxor - Embark Nile Cruise
tourDays.description: Transfer to airport and fly to Luxor. Visit Temple of Karnak and East Bank sites. Embark Nile cruise. Lunch aboard; visit Temple of Luxor. Dinner and overnight on cruise.
tourDays.activities: Flight from Cairo to Luxor; Visit Karnak Temple and East Bank; Embark Nile cruise; Lunch and dinner aboard ship; Visit Luxor Temple

tourDays.title: Day 6: Valley of the Kings
tourDays.description: Visit the Valley of the Kings and the Temple of Hatshepsut; return to cruise for lunch and begin sailing toward Edfu passing through Esna lock. Dinner and overnight on ship.
tourDays.activities: Visit Valley of the Kings; Visit Temple of Hatshepsut; Sail toward Edfu via Esna lock; Meals aboard cruise

tourDays.title: Day 7: Edfu, Kom Ombo
tourDays.description: Breakfast aboard ship; visit Edfu temple then reboard cruise and sail to Kom Ombo to visit the temple dedicated to the crocodile-headed god; continue sailing to Aswan. Dinner and overnight aboard cruise in Aswan.
tourDays.activities: Visit Edfu Temple; Visit Kom Ombo Temple; Sail to Aswan; Meals aboard cruise

tourDays.title: Day 8: Aswan
tourDays.description: Breakfast; visit the Aswan High Dam and Philae Temple on Agilkia/Isi Island. Optional afternoon excursion to Abu Simbel (UNESCO Nubian Monuments). Free time or felucca ride around the Agha Khan Mausoleum. Dinner and overnight on board.
tourDays.activities: Visit Aswan High Dam; Visit Philae Temple; Optional visit to Abu Simbel (afternoon); Felucca ride (optional); Free time in Aswan

tourDays.title: Day 9: Aswan - Cairo - Amman
tourDays.description: Breakfast and transfer to airport for flight to Amman via Cairo. Arrive Amman, collect luggage and meet guide; transfer to hotel for check-in, dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Flight from Aswan to Amman (via Cairo); Airport arrivals and luggage claim; Meet local guide/driver; Transfer to hotel and check-in; Dinner at hotel

tourDays.title: Day 10: Petra â Excursion
tourDays.description: Transfer to Petra; walking tour including the Siq and other carved structures; visit Petra Museum. Afternoon at leisure for shopping. Return to Amman for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Petra; Walking tour of Petra and the Siq; Visit Petra Museum; Free time/shopping in Petra; Return transfer to Amman

tourDays.title: Day 11: Excursion Kerak - Madaba - Mt. Nebo
tourDays.description: Travel to Kerak Castle, then to Madaba to visit St. George's Church and its ancient mosaic map. Continue to Mt. Nebo to visit the site associated with Moses. Return to Amman for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Kerak Castle; Visit St. George's Church in Madaba and see mosaic map; Visit Mt. Nebo

tourDays.title: Day 12: Amman - Jerash - Tel Aviv
tourDays.description: Depart for Jerash to visit Roman ruins (colonnaded streets, theaters, temples). Cross Jordanian border into Israel and continue to Tel Aviv for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Jerash archaeological site; Cross the Jordan-Israel border; Transfer to Tel Aviv; Dinner and overnight in Tel Aviv

tourDays.title: Theme: The Annunciation
tourDays.description: Depart Tel Aviv to Caesarea Maritima (Roman theater, Herod's Palace, harbor). Continue to Nazareth to visit archaeological garden, museum, St. Joseph's workshop and Church of the Annunciation grotto. Drive to Cana for Mass at the Wedding Church with opportunity for married couples to renew vows. Continue to hotel by the Sea of Galilee for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Caesarea Maritima (Roman theater, Herod's Palace, hippodrome, harbor); Visit Nazareth archaeological garden and museum; Visit St. Joseph's workshop and Church of the Annunciation grotto; Celebrate Mass at Cana (Wedding Church); Opportunity to renew wedding vows for married couples; Transfer to Sea of Galilee area hotel

tourDays.title: Theme: The Ministry of Christ in the Galilee
tourDays.description: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee. Visit Capernaum (synagogue), Mount of Beatitudes, Tabgha (site of the Feeding of the 5,000), St. Peter's Primacy, and Magdala (Mary Magdaleneâs birthplace). Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Boat ride on the Sea of Galilee; Visit Capernaum and its synagogue; Visit Mount of Beatitudes; Visit Tabgha (site of the Feeding of the 5,000); Visit St. Peter's Primacy; Visit Magdala

tourDays.title: Theme: The Transfiguration
tourDays.description: Drive to Mount Tabor (site of the Transfiguration) and celebrate Mass at the Basilica of the Transfiguration. Continue to the Jordan Valley and visit Jericho (Mount of Temptation). Drive up to Jerusalem and check in to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Mount Tabor; Celebrate Mass at Basilica of the Transfiguration; Visit Jericho and view Mount of Temptation; Transfer to Jerusalem and hotel check-in

tourDays.title: Theme: The Visitation and Nativity
tourDays.description: Visit Ein Karem (Church of St. John the Baptist and Church of the Visitation). Drive to Bethlehem to visit the fields of the shepherds, Manger Square and the Church of the Nativity; descend to the Grotto of the Nativity and attend Mass in Bethlehem. Return to Jerusalem for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Church of St. John the Baptist (Ein Karem); Visit Church of the Visitation; Visit Bethlehem fields and caves; Enter Church of the Nativity and Grotto of the Nativity; Attend Mass in Bethlehem

tourDays.title: Theme: Early Years in Jerusalem & the Wilderness
tourDays.description: Drive through the Judean wilderness to the Jordan River for reflection on the Baptism of Christ. Visit Qumran (site of the Dead Sea Scrolls). Time to swim or float in the Dead Sea before returning to Jerusalem.
tourDays.activities: Visit Jordan River for reflection on baptism; Visit Qumran archaeological site; Swim or float in the Dead Sea

tourDays.title: Theme: Palm Sunday and the Agony in the Garden
tourDays.description: Visit the Mount of Olives for panoramic views; stop at the Pater Noster shrine and Dominus Flevit. Continue to Gethsemane and the Church of All Nations (Rock of Agony). Visit the Western Wall, Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu (house of Caiaphas), the Upper Room on Mt. Zion, and the Benedictine Church of the Dormition. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Mount of Olives for panoramic view; Visit Pater Noster shrine; Visit Dominus Flevit; Visit Gethsemane and Church of All Nations; Visit Western Wall; Visit Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu; Visit the Upper Room (Mt. Zion); Visit the Church of the Dormition

tourDays.title: Theme: The Way of the Cross, The Crucifixion, The Resurrection
tourDays.description: Very early prayerful procession along the Via Dolorosa beginning at the Antonia Fortress and ending at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre. Attend Mass at the Holy Sepulchre, then revisit Old City sites including the Church of St. Anne, Pool of Bethesda, and end the day at the Western Wall.
tourDays.activities: Prayerful procession along the Via Dolorosa; Begin at Antonia Fortress; Attend Mass at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Visit Church of St. Anne; Visit Pool of Bethesda; Visit the Western Wall

tourDays.title: Depart for Greece Make your way to your local airport where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.description:
Depart for Greece
Make your way to your local airport where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served on board.

tourDays.title: Day 2
tourDays.description: Arrive Thessaloniki Upon landing at Makedonia Thessaloniki Airport, make your way to the baggage claim area and collect your luggage. Proceed to the Arrivalâs Hall, where you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver. You will be escorted to the bus to be transferred to your hotel. Enjoy some time to relax after check in and this evening enjoy a delicious meal. Overnight in Thessaloniki.

tourDays.title: Day 3
tourDays.description: Philippi - Kavala - Thessaloniki After breakfast, start your journey in Greece with the first stop of the day in Philippi. Philippi was the city where Saint Paul the Apostle delivered his first sermon and where he established the first church in Europe. âAnd from there (He went) to Philippi, which is the leading city of the district of Macedonia and a Roman Colony. We remained in this city some daysâ¦â (Acts 16:12-18). Also, it is the site where Saint Paul baptized a woman named Lydia, the first convert to Christianity in Europe. Visit the Roman Forum, where Saint Paul cast a spirit out of a fortune-telling woman. While here, you will have the opportunity to view the prison (now in ruins) in which Saint Paul and Silas were thrown into by the owners of the fortune-tellers. Continue to the modern port city of Kavala, which was once the ancient Neapolis. This port is where Saint Paul, Silas, Luke and Timothy landed when they sailed into Europe. After enjoying this city by the sea, return to Thessaloniki for a delicious meal and restful overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 4
tourDays.description: Thessaloniki City Tour - Kalambaka Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. In the winter of 49-50 A.D., Saint Paul wrote two epistles to the Thessalonians. These letters urged Christians to âlive blamelesslyâ and to refrain from living idly while they wait for the second coming of Christ. While in Thessaloniki, you will witness a number of ancient artifacts, such as the triumphal Arch of Galerius that is found at the start of Via Egnatia. Due to the convenient location, this arch was once a strategic artery of the Roman Empire. It was originally constructed in order to honor the Roman Emperor Galerius following the Roman victory over the Persians. Following your city-tour, transfer to Kalambaka. This evening, you will have a wonderful meal and a relaxing overnight in Kalambaka.

tourDays.title: Day 5
tourDays.description: Meteora - Delphi After breakfast, you will go for a short drive to the Meteora Monasteries. In the eleventh century, there were monks who settled within caves. However, as the occupation of the Turkish increased, the monks were forced to move their settlements higher upon the rocks until they were unreachable by any opposing enemy. These settlements became Monasteries by bringing building, and living, materials by ladders and baskets. The Meteora Monasteries are notorious for preserving not only the Hellenic religion, but also, their academics and arts. During your visit, you will be able to view stunning Byzantine art, as well as the breathtaking scenery that surrounds the Monastery. Continue to Delphi for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 6
tourDays.description: Delphi - Athens Visit Delphi, the center of the ancient world (navel) of the earth, whose prestige extended far beyond the boundaries of the Hellenic world. On the slopes of Mount Parnassus, in a landscape of unparalleled beauty and majesty, lie the ruins of the Sanctuary of Apollo Phthios. Visit the site and the museum and continue to Athens, âMen of Athens, I perceive that in every way you are religious. For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I found also an altar with this inscription âto an unknown Godâ. What therefore you worship as unknown, this I proclaim to youâ¦â Athens is one of the most glorious cities in the world and the cradle of western civilization as we know it today. Dinner and an overnight at your hotel in Athens.

tourDays.title: Day 7
tourDays.description: Athens - Excursion to Corinth After a nice breakfast at the hotel, you will start with a tour of the oldest city in the world, Athens! Visit the rock that has dominated the panorama of Athens for twenty-five centuries, the Acropolis. At the Acropolis, you will see the ruins of the Parthenon, Erectheum, and Propylae. After, you will ascend Mars Hill of where Saint Paul spoke to the Athenians. At this site, Paul spoke to the Athenians about the one and only God (Acts 17:22). While in this city, you will be able to view the ancient Agora, the former public center of Athenian life. It held the focus of a political, commercial, social, religious, and cultural center. As you are in the former political center, proceed for a drive through the city to view the House of Parliament on Syntagma Square. Also, you will have the opportunity to view the University of Athens, the oldest higher education institute in Greece, as well as, the National Library of Greece that holds 4,500 Greek manuscripts. Then, visit Panathenaic Stadium, the beautifully marbled multi-purpose stadium. It is home to the Olympian Zeus, and is the site of the first modern era Olympics (1896). Following your visit in Athens, you will proceed to the ancient Corinth. Under the shadow of the towering Acropolis, Saint Paul lived in Corinth for two years. While here, Saint Paul felt great grief over the way that the Gentile Church in Corinth has become. As a result, he was prompted to write four letters, all with the overarching theme of love. In Corinth, you will have the opportunity to view the remains of the first century shops, the site of Saint Paulâs trial by Gallio, the Fountain of Peirene, and the Temple of Apollo. Following your visit to Corinth, return to Athens for a delicious meal and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 8
tourDays.description: Athens - Start 3-day Cruise (Celestyal Cruises Cruise Line) to Mykonos Following breakfast, you will proceed to the Piraeus port where you will board your 3-day cruise. Your first stop will be the Island of Mykonos, the most cosmopolitan of the Greek islands that attracts visitors from all over the world. After docking, transfer to Hora, the islandâs capital. Upon arrival in Hora, you will enjoy a walking tour that will take you on the narrow cobbled streets of the city. Pass by chic boutiques, elegant nightclubs, and white washed houses to arrive in Alefkandra. This section of Mykonos is known as the âVenice of Mykonosâ, as the homes have wooden balconies and are built on the sea. Historically, these homes were of the wealthy merchants and captains. Return to the cruise ship for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 9
tourDays.description: Kusadasi - Ephesus (Mary's House) - Patmos After breakfast on board, arrive at the lively Turkish port of Kusadasi. Transfer to the small village of Mt. Koressos. While in this village, you will visit the small stone chapel that is situated upon the site where the Virgin Mary spent her last days following Christâs crucifixion. Following this visit, your group will walk through the Magnesian Gate to the ancient Ephesus. Begin your walking tour, which will take you through the most magnificent excavations in the world. Some of the sites include the Odeon (concert hall), the Fountain of Trajan, the steam-heated Baths of Scolastika, the Temple of Hadrian and the Latrians, and the Library of Celsus. The last stop on the walking tour is the Great Theatre, the largest ancient theatre that had a capacity of 25,000 people and is a site where Saint Paul preached. On the return of your walking tour, follow the exact route that Mark Anthony and Cleopatra once rode in procession via the Arcadian Way. This main street runs from the Great Theatre to the main cityâs harbor. On your transfer back to Kusadasi, you will have the opportunity to view the Basilica of Saint John. In the sixth century, Emperor Justinian erected this structure over the grave of the evangelist, John. Upon arrival in Kusadasi, enjoy free time to explore on your own before returning to the ship. When you embark on the ship, your journey will continue to Patmos, where you will transfer to the village of Chora. While in this islandâs capital, visit the monastery of Saint John the Theologian. This marvelous structure was built nine-hundred years ago, and continues to be supported by the walls of a strong fortification. In addition to the stunning main church that contains outstanding frescoes, you will have the opportunity to view the beautiful courtyard, dining room, and the bakery. Your tour continues to the small museum, where you will view priceless ecclesiastical treasures such as books, manuscripts, mosaics, icons, textiles, vestments, and jewelry. Board the bus, which will take you to the Monastery and Grotto of the Apocalypse. In this grotto, experience a once in a lifetime opportunity to view the site of where the Book of Revelations was written. The silver niches in the wall mark the pillow and ledge that were used as a desk by the author of the Book. Additionally, view the three-fold crack made by the voice of God who emphasized the importance of honoring the Holy Trinity. Your day will culminate with a transfer to the port of Scala. While in this quaint and picturesque harbor, you will enjoy free time before returning to the ship.

tourDays.title: Day 10
tourDays.description: Heraklion - Santorini This morning you will awaken and transfer to the largest city on the island of Crete, Heraklion. While in this administrative capital, visit the ancient ruins of the Palace of Knossos. These ruins were discovered in 1899, and the palace is currently partially reconstructed. This ancient palace is believed to have been the mythical Labyrinth of King Minos and the seat of ancient Minoan culture. Additionally, it is the site where Saint Paul met the owner and captain of the ship who warned him of continuing his journey to spread Christianity in Rome. Following this historical visit, you will embark the ship that will take you to the idyllic island of Santorini. Santorini is definitively the most breathtaking island of all of the Greek Islands. Upon arrival in Santorini, visit Thira with its iconic white-washed houses, narrow streets, open-air cafes, and glittering boutiques that cling to steep cliffs. This evening you will return to the ship for your last dinner and overnight on your cruise. (for sailings between late October to late March, the cruise line may use a winter schedule that does not include disembarkation on the Island of Crete, spending the entire day on Santorini)

tourDays.title: Day 11
tourDays.description: Piraeus - Athens â Tel Aviv Today marks the end of your cruise. After disembarkation you will be transferred to Athens airport where you will board your flight to Tel Aviv. Upon arrival in Tel Aviv, you will be met by the 206 Tours representative and transfer to your hotel in the Tel Aviv area. Dinner will be served at the hotel.

tourDays.title: Day 12
tourDays.description: Tel Aviv - Caesarea - Nazareth - Cana - Tiberias Theme: The Annunciation This morning we will depart Tel Aviv to Caesarea Maritima, located on the shores of the Mediterranean. Built by Herod the Great, Caesarea was where St. Peter baptized the first gentile convert, Cornelius (Acts 10). We will see the Roman theatre, Herodâs Palace, view the Hippodrome, and the harbor from which St. Paul sailed on his journeys to spread the Gospel of Jesus Christ throughout the ancient world. Continue to Nazareth to visit the museum and archaeological Garden, which contain remains of Nazareth at the time of Christ. Visit the museum and archaeological Garden where we can see the remains of Nazareth at the time of Christ, as well as St. Josephâs workshop â which is now known as St. Josephâs Church. Within the Church of the Annunciation, you will make your way down to the Grotto to see the remains of the house of the Blessed Mother and where the Angel of the Lord announced the good news to Mary. From here, we drive to Cana, where Jesus performed His first miracle, changing water into wine at His motherâs request. We celebrate Mass here at the Wedding Church, and married couples will have the chance to renew their wedding vows. From there, we continue to our hotel by the Sea of Galilee for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 13
tourDays.description: Tiberias: Sea of Galilee Theme: The Ministry of Christ in the Galilee This morning we take a boat ride on the beautiful Sea of Galilee (Luke 5:1). Then we visit Capernaum, the fishing town where Jesus lived and launched His ministry to change our lives and the world. In Capernaum, we see the Synagogue where Jesus taught (Mark 1:21-29) and gave the Sermon on the Bread of Life. We continue to the Mount of Beatitudes, where Jesus delivered the Sermon on the Mount (Luke 6:20-49). Then to Tabgha, where Jesus fed the crowd of 5,000 people with five loaves of bread and two fish (Luke 9:10-17). Nearby is St. Peterâs Primacy, where Peter confirmed his Love of Jesus (John 21), and it was in this place that Jesus anointed Peter to lead His Church and became the first Pope. (John 21:9). Continue visiting Mary Magdaleneâs birthplace in Magdala. During the time of Jesus, this village was a prosperous fishing village that exported fish and garum, a fish sauce reduction popular in Roman cooking. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 14
tourDays.description: Mt. Tabor - Jericho - Jerusalem Theme: The Transfiguration After breakfast, drive to the site of the Transfiguration, Mount Tabor (Matthew 17:1-50). You will have time to reflect on Christâs Divinity at this site. Celebrate Mass at the Basilica of the Transfiguration and then continue south towards the Jordan Valley, to the worldâs oldest inhabited city (Jericho (Joshua 6:12-25). In Jericho, you view the exact location, the Mount of Temptation, where the Devil tempted Jesus during his forty-day fast (Luke 4:1). Drive up to Jerusalem to check in to your hotel for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 15
tourDays.description: Jerusalem: Bethlehem & Ein Karem Theme: The Visitation and Nativity This morning we go to the village of Ein Karem to visit the Church of St John the Baptist, which marks his birthplace (Luke 1.5). Nearby is the Church of Visitation that commemorates the visit of our Blessed Mother to her cousin, Elizabeth, who stayed with her for three months (Luke 1.39). Many people pray the Mystery of the Rosary as they walk up the hill to the Church. Later drive to Bethlehem to visit the fields where the Angel appeared to the shepherds to proclaim the birth of Jesus Christ (Luke 2:8). We enter the caves where shepherds took shelter in ancient times and see the soot marks of the fires they lit to keep warm. Continue to Manger Square and the Church of the Nativity. We enter the Church through the door of humility and proceed down to the Grotto of the Nativity, which marks the place of Our Saviourâs birth (Matthew 2:1-18). Beneath the altar is a silver star and a Latin inscription that states: HIC DE VIRGINE MARIA JESUS CHRISTUS NATUS (Here, Jesus Christ was born to the Virgin Mary). Following Mass in Bethlehem, return to the hotel in Jerusalem for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 16
tourDays.description: Jordan River - Qumran - Dead Sea Theme: Early Years in Jerusalem & the Wilderness Drive through the Judean wilderness, the site where Jesus spent His 40 days of fasting. We head to the Jordan River for some time to reflect on the Baptism of Christ Matthew 3:13-17). In the afternoon, we visit the Essene site where the Dead Sea Scrolls were found in Qumran. (Ezekiel 47:8-10). These writings have helped further the understanding of the Jewish background of Christianity. Before returning to Jerusalem, there is also time to swim or float on the Dead Sea, the lowest and saltiest place on Earth.

tourDays.title: Day 17
tourDays.description: Jerusalem: Mt. Of Olives - Gethsemane - Mt. Zion (Upper Room) Theme: Palm Sunday and the Agony in the Garden After breakfast, you will make your way to the Mount of Olives, where you will be able to take in the beautiful, panoramic view of Jerusalem. Historically, the Mount of Olives was a mandatory transit point for Jesus during many iconic moments. Visit the Pater Noster Shrine where Jesus taught His disciples the Lordâs Prayer (Pater Noster) (Luke 11:1-4). You will have the opportunity to stop at Dominus Flevit which is a Church that commemorates where Jesus wept for Jerusalem (Luke 19:41). Continue on to Gethsemane, a garden at the foot of the Mount of Olives. Jesus brought His disciples here to pray the night before He was crucified (Luke 22:29-53). The Garden still contains trees with roots that date back to the time of Jesus. Your next stop, the Church of All Nations, is built over the âRock of Agonyâ. This is where Jesus prayed alone on the night of His arrest. Throughout this time, you are invited to remain in prayer and to reflect on Christâs agony that He experienced. You will have the opportunity to visit the Western Wall, which is the last remnant of the Jewish Temple after it was destroyed in 70 A.D. Continue with a visit to the house of the High Priest Caiaphas (Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu). This Church commemorates where Jesus was examined and eventually imprisoned before the Council in Jerusalem. It also commemorates Peterâs Denial of Christ (John 18:15-18), Petersâ repentance, and Jesusâ forgiveness of Peter. You will also visit the Upper Room on Mt. Zion. The Upper Room is where Jesus and His disciples celebrated the Last Supper (Matthew 26:17-30) and where Jesus appeared to His disciples after His Death and Resurrection (Mark 16:14). In addition, visit the nearby Benedictine Church of the Dormition. Tradition tells us that this Church is where Mary, the Mother of Jesus, âfell asleep.â At the end of this prayerful day, return to your hotel for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 18
tourDays.description: Jerusalem: Via Dolorosa - Holy Sepulchre- Western Wall Theme: The Way of the Cross, The Crucifixion, The Resurrection Very early this morning we walk together in prayerful procession along the Via Dolorosa (The Way of the Cross). We start at the Antonia Fortress, where Jesus was condemned to death by Pontius Pilate (John 18:28-19:16) and receives His cross. We end at the Church of the Holy Sepulcher, which marks the place of the Crucifixion & the Resurrection, (Luke 23:26-33). After Mass at the Church of the Holy Sepulcher we return to the hotel for breakfast. Later we revisit the Old City to see the Church of St. Anneâs, the traditional birthplace of the Virgin Mary. Nearby is the Pool of Bethesda, where Jesus healed the crippled man (John 5:1-9). End the day with a visit the Western Wall, which is the last remnant of the Jewish Temple destroyed in 70 A.D.

tourDays.title: Day 19
tourDays.description: Jerusalem - Tel Aviv - Rome Today you depart from the Holy Land for your flight to Rome. Upon arrival in Rome you will be met by your driver and transfer to the hotel where you will meet the rest of your group. This afternoon, you will be introduced to your fellow pilgrims and priest who will be with you for the rest of the journey. Next, make your way to Mass, which will be followed by a welcome dinner with wine. This evening, you may walk to St. Peterâs Square for Rosary (optional).

tourDays.title: Day 20
tourDays.description: Rome: Papal Audience - Piazza Navona â Pantheon - Basilica of St. John the Lateran â Holy Stairs - Basilica of St. Mary Major This morning, we will attend the Papal Audience in St. Peterâs Square or the Audience Hall. The Papal Audience is celebrated each Wednesday by His Holiness, Holy Father Pope Leo XIV (pending the papal schedule). (During the month of July, Papal Audiences are typically cancelled while the Holy Father resides in Castel Gandolfo. For tours occurring during this time, the Audience will be replaced with an excursion to Castel Gandolfo with the itinerary below: Upon arrival in Castel Gandolfo, we will visit Piazza della LibertÃ . Here, we will take a moment to admire the impressive facade of the Papal Palace, the Popeâs summer residence. Our visit continues with an exploration of the Papal Palace itself, including the Vatican Observatory and the breathtaking Barberini Gardens, which offer panoramic views of Lake Albano.) Next, head to the Piazza Navona area for some free time and lunch (on your own). This afternoon, visit the oldest of the four major Basilicas in Rome, the Archbasilica of St. John the Lateran, the cathedral church and seat of the Bishop of Rome. Cross the street to the Holy Stairs, which were brought to Rome by St. Helen in the 4th century. These were the same stairs that led up to the praetorium of Pontius Pilate in Jerusalem, which Jesus climbed on His way to trial during His Passion. Our final stop will be at the Basilica of St. Mary Major which is dedicated to Our Lady. Here we will celebrate Holy Mass, and then have dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 21
tourDays.description: Rome: St. Peter's Basilica - Vatican Museum - Appian Way - Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls - Catacombs Today we tour St. Peterâs Basilica, built on the site where St. Peter the Apostle was martyred. Here, youâll have the opportunity to view Michelangeloâs Pieta sculpture, pray at the tombs of Pope Benedict XVI and St. John Paul II. Next you will visit the Vatican Museum, where you can see the Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, and Sistine Chapel. After lunch, continue down the Appian Way, one of the earliest roads built in ancient Rome to the Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls and the Catacombs. Dinner and overnight in Rome.

tourDays.title: Day 22
tourDays.description: Rome - Montecassino - San Giovanni Rotondo Following breakfast, you will board your bus to enjoy the scenic route to Montecassino. Passing through the Roman countryside that is known for its villas and vineyards. During the bus ride, your tour escort will share interesting information regarding the spiritual, historical, and cultural aspects of Italy. Montecassino, the principle monastery of the Benedictine Order, was founded by Saint Benedict around 530 A.D. Following the tour, there will be an opportunity to visit the gift shop, before you board the bus to continue toward San Giovanni Rotondo, the hometown of Saint St. Padre Pio. Upon arrival in San Giovanni Rotondo, you will check-in, enjoy dinner in a restaurant, and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 23
tourDays.description: San Giovanni Rotondo (View Incorrupt Body of St. Padre Pio) - Monte Sant' Angelo This morning, after breakfast, you will visit the Old Church. After Mass, you will tour the sanctuary, it is here you will view the crucifix, in front of which St. Pio received the stigmata. Visit the confessional from where St. Pio spent an innumerable amount of hours listening to confessions. Next, you will board the bus and travel along the beautiful Gargano Peninsula to the Grotto of St. Michael the Archangel, a shrine consecrated by St. Michael. At this grotto, St. Michael appeared to a Bishop to assure him that his diocese would not be annihilated as he feared. Following the visit to the grotto, enjoy free time. On the way back to San Giovanni Rotondo, view breathtaking views of the ocean and surrounding countryside. Upon arrival, you will have time for devotion and reflection. Dinner and an overnight in San Giovanni Rotondo. *Candlelight Procession â Between May and October attend the weekly Candlelight Procession at the Sanctuary of St. Pio after dinner, at 9:00 PM. These processions are lit by candlelight, and are guided by the Most Holy Rosary. Following this prayerful experience, you will return to your hotel for a restful overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 24
tourDays.description: San Giovanni Rotondo - Lanciano - Loreto - Assisi After breakfast, you we leave for Assisi. On the way we stop in Lanciano for private Mass at the Convent/Church of Saint Francis built on top of the antique Church of St. Longinus â the site of a Eucharistic Miracle that occurred in the eighth century. At the time of the miracle, there was a Basilian monk, who struggled with the belief in the Real Presence in the Eucharist. During the time of Mass, the monk, with doubt in his voice, said the words of consecration and the bread and wine transformed into physical flesh and blood. Leave for Marian shrine of Loreto to visit the Holy House of Nazareth and the beautiful Madonna of Loreto. Tradition holds that this is the house in which Mary first prayed the Magnificat, in which Jesus grew to manhood, and in which the Holy Family lived, before it was transported several times by angels, to its current location. End the day in Assisi, hometown of St. Francis and St. Clare, with dinner and overnight at your hotel.

tourDays.title: Day 25
tourDays.description: Assisi (The Life of a Saint that inspired a Holy Father) As you visit the birthplace of St. Francis, you will become captivated as the atmosphere has not changed since St. Francis began his ministry, in the early 13th-century. You will start your tour at the St. Francis Basilica, visit his tomb of St. Francis, and have the opportunity to view a series of frescoes depicting his life, along with a few of the saintâs possessions. Followed by a visit to the Santuario Della Spogliazione where St. Carlo Acutis tomb is placed. Carlo is the first millennial to be declared a Saint who loved the Real Presence of Jesus in the Eucharist. From there, you will continue on a walking tour through this picturesque town, including the birthplace of St. Francis, and end with a tour of the Church that honors St. Clare, the foundress of the Poor Clare Sisters. This Saint followed the teachings of St. Francis very closely by also living a life of poverty and humility. Enjoy some free time on your own â you may take this time for additional prayer, shop in the many gift shops or enjoy a nice lunch. After lunch, you will board the bus, which will take you outside of the walls of Assisi, to the Basilica of St. Mary of the Angels. This is where St. Francis spent most of life. This Basilica is made up of two structures, both of which you will visit. The first structure, is the âPorziuncolaâ, which is where St. Francis founded his order of the Friar Minor (Franciscans). The second, is the âCapella del Transitoâ, which is the place of St. Francisâ death. During your time here, you will have the opportunity to visit the beautiful Rose Garden where St. Francis and other friars lived, as well as the cave where the Saint retired to pray. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 26
tourDays.description: Assisi - Orvieto - Assisi This morning, you will ride through the beautiful Umbrian mountains to Orvieto. This incredible town sits on a volcanic high rock formation. Here we visit one of the most beautiful and most renowned Cathedrals in Italy. Because of its strategic location, itâs Christian history officially started in 1004, but Orvieto was built over preexisting Etruscan era cave tunnels dating back 2,500 years, which some historians believe Christians used to celebrate Mass when Christianity was forbidden. Return to Assisi for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.activities: Transfer to Santarem; Attend Mass at St. Stephenâs Church; Venerate 13th-century Eucharistic Miracle; Transfer to Fatima

After lunch, participate in the Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra, visit Valinhos (site of August 1917 apparition), conclude with private devotions and a candlelight procession. Dinner and overnight in Fatima.

Proceed to Burgos for dinner and an opportunity to explore the city and its Gothic cathedral. Overnight in Burgos.

After free time for lunch, continue to Lourdes with views of the Pyrenees, check in to the hotel, dinner and overnight.

Contemplate the life-size Stations of the Cross overlooking the Grotto, visit Boly Mill (birthplace of St. Bernadette) and the Cachot. Evening candlelight procession and Rosary. Dinner and overnight.

Each evening, following dinner, you can attend the candlelight procession and pray the Rosary.

tourDays.description: During your time in Lourdes, you will pray and meditate at the site of Our Ladyâs apparitions. You will have the opportunity to attend Mass at the Grotto, watch a video presentation that explains the story of Lourdes, wash your hands, wash your face, and drink the water of the miraculous spring. Experience the life-size Stations of the Cross that overlook the Grotto. Visit Boly Mill, the birthplace of St. Bernadette, and the 'Cachot,' an abandoned prison where Bernadetteâs family lived. Each evening, following dinner, you can attend the candlelight procession and pray the Rosary.

tourDays.title: Lourdes - Rome
tourDays.description: Morning departure from Lourdes to the airport to board your flight(s) to Rome. Upon arrival at Rome airport, collect your luggage and continue to the arrival hall, where you will be greeted by a tour escort and/or driver. Transfer to your hotel. Following check-in, you will have free time to unpack, relax, or explore Rome. Later in the afternoon, your group will meet in the hotel lobby for a 'Meet and Greet' with your fellow pilgrims and depart for Mass. Following Mass, you will attend a welcome dinner. After dinner, you can walk to St. Peterâs Square as a group for the Rosary (optional).
tourDays.activities: Fly from Lourdes to Rome; Collect luggage and transfer to hotel; Free time to unpack/relax/explore; Meet and greet with fellow pilgrims; Attend Mass; Welcome dinner; Optional group Rosary at St. Peterâs Square

tourDays.title: Rome: Papal Audience and Major Basilicas
tourDays.description: After breakfast your day begins with the Papal Audience in St. Peterâs Square (pending the papal schedule). Following the Audience, there is free time for lunch and shopping. This afternoon, visit the Basilica of St. John the Lateran (houses relics of Peter and Paul and site of papal installation), the Holy Staircase (traditionally from Pontius Pilateâs palace; you may climb on your knees if time permits), and the Basilica of St. Mary Major (contains a relic from the Manger of the Infant Jesus). Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Attend Papal Audience in St. Peter's Square (pending papal schedule); Free time for lunch and shopping; Visit Basilica of St. John the Lateran; Visit the Holy Staircase (optional devotional climb); Visit Basilica of St. Mary Major

tourDays.title: Rome: Vatican, Appian Way, and Basilicas
tourDays.description: After an early breakfast, visit St. Peterâs Basilica to view Michelangeloâs Pieta. Proceed to the Vatican Museum to see the Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, the Sistine Chapel, and the restored mural of the Last Judgment; the tour concludes at the tomb of Saint John Paul II. Head to Piazza Navona for free time and lunch (on your own). Continue down the Appian Way to see the Quo Vadis Chapel, Baths of Caracalla, Arch of Drusus, Tomb of Cecilia Metella, and the catacombs of St. Callixtus. The day concludes with a visit to the Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls and dinner at a local restaurant.
tourDays.activities: Visit St. Peter's Basilica (view Michelangeloâs Pieta); Tour the Vatican Museum (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel, Last Judgment, tomb of St. John Paul II); Free time at Piazza Navona (lunch on your own); Visit Appian Way and associated sites (Quo Vadis Chapel, Baths of Caracalla, Arch of Drusus, Tomb of Cecilia Metella, Catacombs of St. Callixtus); Visit Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls; Dinner at local restaurant

tourDays.description: Depart from Italy for your flight(s) to Medjugorje. Upon arrival, you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver, who will take you on the approximately 2.5 hour drive to the village of Medjugorje. Dinner and overnight.
