Visit the Pater Noster Shrine, Dominus Flevit, and Gethsemane (including the Church of All Nations over the Rock of Agony). Visit the Western Wall, the Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu (house of Caiaphas), and the Upper Room on Mt. Zion. Also visit the Benedictine Church of the Dormition. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Panoramic view from the Mount of Olives; Visit Pater Noster Shrine; Visit Dominus Flevit; Visit Gethsemane and Church of All Nations; Visit Western Wall; Visit Church of St. Peter in Gallicantu; Visit the Upper Room (Mt. Zion); Visit Benedictine Church of the Dormition

tourDays.title: Jerusalem: Via Dolorosa - Holy Sepulchre - Western Wall
tourDays.description: Very early wake-up to begin the Via Dolorosa at the Antonia Fortress, reflecting on the Stations of the Cross through the Old City to the Church of the Holy Sepulchre. Celebrate Mass at the Holy Sepulchre. Visit the Church of St. Anne and the Pool of Bethesda, then enjoy a revisit to the Old City. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Begin Via Dolorosa at Antonia Fortress (Stations of the Cross); Walk through Old City markets to the Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Celebrate Mass at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre; Visit Church of St. Anne and Pool of Bethesda; Revisit Old City

tourDays.title: Depart for Lourdes
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport and board overnight flight(s) to France. Meals will be served on board.

tourDays.title: Arrive in Lourdes
tourDays.description: Arrive at Pau or Toulouse airport, collect luggage, meet your tour guide/driver and take a scenic drive to Lourdes. Check in to your hotel, relax or explore. After dinner, free time to pray the Rosary and attend the candlelight procession (AprilâOctober only).

Day 2
tourDays.description: Paris Arrive in Paris. Upon arrival, you will meet your driver and transfer to your hotel in Paris. Enjoy free time to rest, relax and explore before we depart for Mass at the Sacre Coeur. Dinner and overnight in Paris.

tourDays.title: Day 3
tourDays.description: Paris Wake up in Paris and depart for Mass at Shrine of the Miraculous Medal. View the incorrupt body of St. Catherine Labouret whose guardian angel led her to the chapel where the Blessed Virgin dis-played a vision of the miraculous medal and, later, the green scapular. The Virgin promised bountiful graces for all who wore these. Our sightseeing tour includes some of the most beautiful and important churches in the world, such as Notre Dame Cathedral and Sacre Coeur, see the Eiffel Tower, L'Arc de Triomphe, drive through the Champs Elysees, and many other sights on this mostly panoramic tour. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 4
tourDays.description: Excursion to Rouen and Lisieux After breakfast we depart for Rouen where on May 30, 1431, Joan of Arc was burnt at Place du Vieux Marche. We will visit the Joan of Arc museum and Rouen church. We continue on to Lisieux, the home of St. Therese whom Pope Pius X called "the greatest saint of modern times." Her extraordinary love for God and service to humanity comes alive as you visit the Basilica of Saint Therese, one of the biggest and most magnificent religious structures built in the 20th-century. During our stay in Lisiuex a Mass will be celebrated. We will stop at Les Buissonets, St. Thereseâs family home. There on display are relics, clothing, and personal objects belonging to the "little flower." Before leaving tour the ancient Cathedral of St. Peter and the Carmelite Convent. We return to Paris for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 5
tourDays.description: Paris - Nevers After breakfast we depart for Nevers by way of the picturesque Loire Valley. After taking the veil in 1867, St. Bernadette lived for 12 years as a member of the Congregation of the Sisters of Nevers. At least three times during her short life-time, she received the last Sacra-ments. In addition to asthma, she was gradually struck by other illnesses, among them was tuberculosis of the lung and a tubercular tumor in her right knee. St. Bernadette eventually died at the age of 35. See St. Bernadette's incorrupt body at the convent of St. Gildard, miraculously preserved since her death in 1879. Dinner and over-night in Nevers.

tourDays.title: Day 6
tourDays.description: Nevers - Paray-le-Monial - Ars - Lyon After breakfast we journey to Paray-le-Monial where we will visit the Chapel of the Visitation where Jesus exposed His Sacred Heart to St. Margaret Mary Alacoque during a number of apparitions, Reliquary of St. Margaret containing her relics, located underneath a wax figure of the saint. We continue on to the pretty little town of Ars, best known for St. Jean-Marie Vianney, the patron saint of priests. There are several sights of special importance such as: Church (Ãglise), a 12-century church where the saint preached; Basilica (Basilique), a newer basilica built next to the church that displays the saintâs incorrupt body; Heart Chapel, which contains the saintâs heart; Home of St. John Vianney preserved the way he left it; Underground Church constructed for pilgrim groups; La Providence, an orphanage founded by St. John Vianney. We continue to Lyon for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 7
tourDays.description: Excursion to La Salette After breakfast we depart for La Salette located in a high alpine pasture in the French Alps, La Salette is the site where the Virgin Mary appeared in 1846 to two shepherds, Melanie Matthew and Maximin Gird. Our Lady appeared to these shepherds crying, lamenting over the lack of observance of Sundays and the profaning of her Son's holy name. A spring forever marks the spot where the Virgin appeared and where millions of pilgrims come to in order to drink the fresh spring water and to pray. The stunning mountain scenery and lush mountain trails make La Salette one of the most spectacular pilgrimage site in France, with a beautiful Basilica built to honor the Virgin Mary. In 1996 La Salette celebrated the 150th anniversary of Our Lady's first appearance. We return to Lyon for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 8
tourDays.description: Lyon - Lisbon After breakfast depart for Lyon airport for your flight to Lisbon. Arrive Lisbon. This afternoon we will enjoy a tour of Lisbon. Sightseeing tour will include a visit of the Cathedral, St. Jeromeâs Monastery, Saint Anthony's Church, Belem Quarter: Belem Tower, 25 April Bridge, Discoveries Monument. Our drive will also take us through the Basilica of the Star, Rossio Square, Commerce square and Marquee of Pomba Square. Dinner and overnight in Lisbon.

tourDays.title: Day 9
tourDays.description: Lisbon - Santarem - Fatima After breakfast depart Lisbon for Santarem, where one of the oldest cities in the world is located. We will walk through its narrow streets to the Church of St Stephen, containing the oldest recorded Eucharistic miracle. This miracle has been on continuous display since 1269. We then continue on to Fatima, the place where the Blessed Mother appeared in 1917 to three simple shepherd children and exhorted mankind to pray for world peace. Dinner and overnight in Fatima.

tourDays.title: Day 10
tourDays.description: Fatima Six times, from the May 13 to Oct 13, 1917, the Virgin Mary appeared to three shepherd children in the diocese of Leiria. A new church has been built, however just as beautiful, an older church was constructed here in 1928, and millions of pilgrims visit each year. Fatima is one of the most visited holy places for Catholics from around the world. The atmosphere of intense spirituality and the importance of Fatima have been attested to by the visits of two Popes: Paul VI and John Paul II. Touring Fatima, see the Little Chapel of the Apparitions, Basilica, the site of Francesco and Jacinta's graves, the Hamlet of Aljustrel, where the children lived, and Valinhos, the site of Our Lady's appearance after the children's return from prison. Follow the Stations of the Cross along the Via Sacra (The Sacred Way) culminating in the Chapel of Calvary, which overlooks all of Fatima. Join pilgrims from around the world in an evening candlelight procession to pray the rosary. Dinner and overnight in Fatima.

tourDays.title: Lisbon - Tel Aviv
tourDays.description: After breakfast you will be transferred to Lisbon airport for your flight to Tel Aviv. Upon arrival at Ben Gurion Airport. Exit terminal at the sign marked "groups" and meet your local guide who will escort you to our hotel on the coast. Dinner and overnight.

tourDays.title: Day 12
tourDays.description: Galilee: Caesarea, Mt Carmel, Stella Maris, Cana, Nazareth, Basilica of the Annunciation We travel via the coast to Caesarea, where the Romans held Paul prisoner. Visit the Roman and Crusader ruins. Drive through the Carmel Mountains heading for Galilee. In Haifa, visit Stella Maris, a Carmelite Monastery with the Madonna of Mt Carmel. Continue to Mukhraka where Elijah confronted the false prophets of Baal and where the Carmelite Order was started. Drive to Cana, the village of Jesus' first miracle of changing water into wine; here couples may renew their wedding vows. Continue to the Basilica of Annunciation in Nazareth where we will celebrate Mass and visit Mary's Well and the Church of the Angel Gabriel. Dinner and overnight in the Galilee.

tourDays.title: Day 13
tourDays.description: The Ministry of Christ in the Galilee: Tiberias, Boat ride on Sea of Galilee, Capernaum, Mt. Beatitudes, Caesarea Philippi Some of today's highlights are a boat ride across the Sea of Galilee to Capernaum to see the synagogue and St. Peter's house, a visit to the Mount of the Beatitudes where the Sermon on the Mount was given, to Tabgha to see the splendid mosaic about the miracle of the loaves and fishes, and to the nearby Church of Peter's Primacy where Peter was told " Feed my lambs, feed my sheep." There will be an unforgettable Mass near the shores of the Sea of Galilee at the Primacy or Mt Beatitudes. In the afternoon we visit Caesarea Philippi, location of the testimony of St. Peter and where Jesus answered him âYou are the Rock and upon this rock I will build my Church.â Dinner and overnight at your hotel in the Galilee.

tourDays.title: Day 14
tourDays.description: Jordan River & Mt Tabor We start the day by going remembering our Baptism at the Jordan River. Continue to Mount Tabor, scene of the Transfiguration, where we will have Mass. Drive down the Jordan Valley and head towards Jerusalem. Dinner and overnight at the hotel in Jerusalem.

tourDays.title: Day 15
tourDays.description: Jerusalem and Bethlehem: Mt Olives, Church of Visitation, Shepard's Fields, Church of the Nativity On the first day in Jerusalem we present an overview for a better understanding of its geography and some of the key sites surrounding the area. This includes a dramatic view of the Old City from the Mount of Olives, revealing a city with 4000 years of history. From this vantage point see much of what makes Jerusalem such a unique city to the three major religions â Judaism, Christianity and Islam. We then head to the village of Ein Karem, the birthplace of St. John the Baptist and to the Church of Visitation where the Blessed Virgin Mary visited her cousin, Elizabeth, and proclaimed the 'Magnificat'. In the afternoon we drive to the Shepherd's Fields where the angels announced the birth of Jesus. Then we visit the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem that stands upon the site where Jesus was born. Mass in Bethlehem or the Shepherds Fields. Dinner and overnight at the hotel in Jerusalem.

tourDays.title: Day 18
tourDays.description: The Wilderness: Bethany, Jericho, Mt Temptation, Dead Sea We begin our day with a visit to Bethany where Jesus raised Lazarus from the dead. The desert east of Jerusalem is rich in Christian tradition. Further east, just off the Roman road that Jesus 'walked', is Wadi Qelt gorge, site of the Monastery of St. George. At the oasis town of Jericho, visit the excavations of the oldest city in the world and view Mt. Temptation where Jesus fasted and was tempted by Satan. On the way back there is time for a swim (or rather a float!) in the mineral-rich waters of the Dead Sea, renowned for its healing properties. In the afternoon, there will be time for you to revisit some of your favorite sites and time for last minute buying of gifts for your loved ones. Dinner and overnight at the hotel in Jerusalem.

tourDays.title: Tel Aviv - Medjugorje
tourDays.description:
After breakfast you will be transferred to Tel Aviv airport for your flights to Medjugorje. Upon arrival, you'll be greeted by a tour guide and/or driver who will then take you on the 2 1/2 hour drive by private coach to the village of Medjugorje. Guide will be with your throughout your stay. Once there, you'll meet your fellow pilgrims and your spiritual leader and be introduced to your host family in whose comfortable yet modest house (inn) you will be staying for the next four nights.
Days 20 to 22 - Medjugorje Experience the beauty and peace of this simple village. During your stay in Medjugorje you will have the opportunity to share faith with pilgrims from all over the world. Our local guide will accompany us throughout your stay.
Here are some of the activities you'll be sharing with our fellow pilgrims: Each morning at 10am we assemble at St. James Church for the English-language Mass (Feast days and Sundays English Mass is at Noon). Follow the path up Apparition Hill where the visionaries first encountered Our Lady. Touch and pray before the cross that commemorates the spot where Mary first appeared to the visionaries.
Each evening at 5pm or 6pm daylight savings time, we will join the villagers and pilgrims to pray the rosary. The apparition takes place at 5:40pm or 6:40 daylight savings time, and then stay on for Croatian Mass. Don't miss on Tuesdays and Saturdays Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament and on Fridays Veneration of the Cross in the Church. Each evening during Croatian Mass, there is the Blessing of the Sick and blessing of the items you have with you.
Our guide will arrange meetings with the visionaries at their own homes provided that they are in Medjugorje during your trip, and pending their availability. We will have the opportunity to climb Krizevac Mountain, where in 1933 the villagers built a 30' high cross on the anniversary of Jesus' crucifixion. Visit and pray at "Blue Cross", which is a place of great healings and graces- a very special place at the base of Apparition Hill. We will also visit the community of Cenacolo.

tourDays.title: Medjugorje - USA After an early breakfast and heartfelt farewells, we leave by motor coach for Dubrovnik Airport (Split or Sarajevo) for return flights home.

tourDays.activities: Drive/tour the Amalfi Coast; Stop for panoramic view of Positano; Drive through Praiano (pass by St. Gennaro Church); Visit Amalfi and view Amalfi Cathedral; Free time for lunch; Visit Ravello (Cathedral of Saint Pantaleone, Villa Rufolo); Return to Sorrento

tourDays.title: Pompeii and Shrine of the Rosary of Pompei
tourDays.description: After breakfast board the motorcoach to Pompeii. Walk through the excavated ruins and visit the Shrine of the Rosary of Pompei (La Madonna del Rosario) to venerate the painting and relics. Enjoy time to relax before dinner and overnight.

After free time, visit the Basilica of St. Mary of the Angels (Porziuncola and Capella del Transito), the Rose Garden, and the cave used by St. Francis, then return to the hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Basilica of St. Francis and his tomb; View frescoes and saintâs possessions; Visit Santuario Della Spogliazione and pray at tomb of St. Carlo Acutis; Walking tour of Assisi including birthplace of St. Francis; Visit Church of St. Clare; Free time for prayer, shopping or lunch; Visit Basilica of St. Mary of the Angels (Porziuncola and Capella del Transito); Visit Rose Garden and cave where St. Francis prayed

tourDays.title: Orvieto Day Trip

tourDays.activities: Drive through Umbrian mountains to Orvieto; Visit Orvieto Cathedral; Return to Assisi for dinner and overnight

Dinner and overnight in Lisieux.

tourDays.description: Celebrate Mass in Lisieux, then travel to the Normandy landing beaches and visit the Normandy American Cemetery and Memorial in Colleville-Sur-Mer. Return to Lisieux for dinner and overnight.

tourDays.activities: Travel to Chartres; Visit Chartres Cathedral (Notre Dame); Venerate relic of the Veil of Our Lady; Free time for lunch in Chartres; Travel to Paris and check in to hotel

tourDays.title: Paris
tourDays.description: Celebrate Mass, then a full day of sightseeing in Paris: Sacre Coeur Basilica, Chapel of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal (view incorrupt body of St. Catherine LabourÃ©), Saint Vincent de Paul Church, Notre Dame Cathedral, and a bus tour to see the Eiffel Tower, Invalides, Arc de Triomphe, and the Champs-Elysees. Dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass; Visit Sacre Coeur Basilica; Visit Chapel of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal and view incorrupt body of St. Catherine LabourÃ©; Walk to Saint Vincent de Paul Church; Visit Notre Dame Cathedral; Bus tour of Paris landmarks (Eiffel Tower, Invalides, Arc de Triomphe, Champs-Elysees)

tourDays.title: Paris - Rome
tourDays.description: Transfer to Charles de Gaulle Airport and board flight to Rome. Upon arrival, transfer to the hotel and check in. Meet and greet in the hotel lobby, attend Mass, and enjoy a welcome dinner. Optional walk to St. Peter's Square to pray the Rosary. Overnight in Rome.
tourDays.activities: Transfer to Charles de Gaulle Airport; Fly from Paris to Rome; Check in at Rome hotel; Meet and greet with fellow pilgrims; Attend Mass; Welcome dinner; Optional prayer/visit to St. Peter's Square

tourDays.title: Rome: Papal Audience - Basilica of St. John the Lateran - Holy Steps - Basilica of St. Mary Major
tourDays.description: Attend the Papal Audience in St. Peter's Square (pending papal schedule). Free time for lunch and shopping. Visit the Basilica of St. John the Lateran, the Holy Staircase (traditionally from Pontius Pilate's palace; optional to climb on knees), and the Basilica of St. Mary Major. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Attend Papal Audience in St. Peter's Square; Free time for lunch and shopping; Visit Basilica of St. John the Lateran; Visit the Holy Staircase (option to climb on knees); Visit Basilica of St. Mary Major

tourDays.description: Visit St. Peter's Basilica (view Michelangelo's PietÃ ), then the Vatican Museum (Tapestry Gallery, Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel, Last Judgment) and the tomb of Saint John Paul II. Dinner and overnight in San Giovanni Rotondo.

tourDays.description: Visit the Old Church in San Giovanni Rotondo, celebrate Mass, tour the sanctuary and see the crucifix where St. Pio received the stigmata, and visit the confessional used by St. Pio. Travel along the Gargano Peninsula to the Grotto of St. Michael the Archangel. Free time and return to San Giovanni Rotondo for devotion, reflection, dinner and overnight. Between May and October there is an optional weekly Candlelight Procession after dinner.
tourDays.activities: Visit the Old Church; Celebrate Mass; Tour the sanctuary (see crucifix associated with St. Pio's stigmata); Visit St. Pio's confessional; Travel to Grotto of St. Michael the Archangel; Free time and devotion/reflection

tourDays.title: San Giovanni Rotondo - Lanciano - Loreto - Assisi
tourDays.description: Depart for Assisi with a stop in Lanciano for a private Mass at the Convent/Church of Saint Francis (site of the 8th-century Eucharistic Miracle). Visit the Marian Shrine of Loreto to see the Holy House of Nazareth and the Madonna of Loreto. Continue to Assisi for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Depart for Assisi; Private Mass in Lanciano at Convent/Church of Saint Francis; Visit Marian Shrine of Loreto (Holy House of Nazareth, Madonna of Loreto); Travel to Assisi

tourDays.title: Assisi

After lunch, visit the Basilica of St. Mary of the Angels (Porziuncola and Capella del Transito), the Rose Garden, and the cave where St. Francis prayed. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Basilica of St. Francis and tomb of St. Francis; Walking tour of Assisi including birthplace of St. Francis; Visit Santuario Della Spogliazione (entombment of St. Carlo Acutis); Visit Church honoring St. Clare; Visit Basilica of St. Mary of the Angels (Porziuncola and Capella del Transito); Visit Rose Garden and cave where St. Francis prayed

tourDays.title: Assisi - Orvieto - Assisi
tourDays.description: Travel through the Umbrian mountains to Orvieto, visit Orvieto Cathedral and learn about the town's Etruscan and Christian history. Return to Assisi for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Orvieto; Visit Orvieto Cathedral; Return to Assisi

tourDays.title: Return Home

tourDays.activities: Transfer to Rome Fiumicino airport; Board return flight(s) home

tourDays.title: Depart for the Netherlands
tourDays.description: Make your way to your local airport where you will board your overnight flight(s). Your meals will be served on board.
tourDays.activities: Travel to local airport; Board overnight flight(s); Meals served on board

tourDays.title: Amsterdam
tourDays.description: Upon landing at Amsterdam Airport, make your way to the baggage claim area and collect your luggage. Proceed to the Arrivals Hall, where you will be greeted by your tour guide and/or driver before transferring to your hotel. This afternoon we will visit the Chapel of Our Lady of All Nations, one of the Virgin Maryâs apparition sites. From 1945 until 1959, Our Lady appeared to Ida Peerdeman with the continuous message of love, repentance, and the prayer for Nations. Following Mass, we will visit the site of a Eucharistic Miracle. In 1345, as a result of a manâs illness, a Sacred Host was found preserved in his house after it was moved numerous times and after having experienced a fire that left the city in ruins. The day will come to a close with returning to the hotel for dinner and an overnight in Amsterdam.
tourDays.activities: Arrive at Amsterdam Airport and transfer to hotel; Visit Chapel of Our Lady of All Nations; Celebrate Mass; Visit site of a Eucharistic Miracle; Dinner and overnight in Amsterdam

tourDays.title: Amsterdam â Zaanse Schans â Amsterdam
tourDays.description: Following breakfast, we will celebrate Mass. After Mass, we will enjoy a guided tour of Amsterdam, where you will experience its 17th-century historical and picturesque atmosphere amidst its canals and squares. During your walking tour, you will view the Royal Place, Vrijheidsbeeld (National Monument), the Flower Markets, Opera House, City Hall, and Begijnenhof. Additionally, you will experience a glimpse from the outside of the many cultural highlights Amsterdam has to offer, such as the Van Gogh Museum, the Anne Frank House, the Rembrandt House, and the Rijksmuseum. After free time for lunch, we will proceed to the Zaanse Schans, a unique piece of Dutch history on the river Zaan. It is a residential area in which the 18th and 19th centuries are brought to life. The Zaanse Schans is a unique part of the Netherlands, full of wooden houses, mills, barns, and workshops. Stroll past the bakery museum and enjoy the smell of fresh cookies. Take a look at where clogs are made. Donât miss the cheese factory, the various windmills, and much more. Return to Amsterdam for dinner and overnight.
tourDays.activities: Celebrate Mass; Guided walking tour of Amsterdam (view landmarks); Free time for lunch; Visit Zaanse Schans (stroll past bakery museum, see clog making, cheese factory, windmills); Return to Amsterdam for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Amsterdam â Utrecht â Ghent - Bruges
tourDays.description: After breakfast, we will depart for Utrecht. One of the principal political, economic, and cultural centers of the Netherlands. We will visit Katherineâs Convent Museum (Catharijne convent) located in the former hospice of the Order of St. John, telling the history of Christianity in the Netherlands. It also holds a large collection of medieval art treasures. You will have free time for lunch before boarding the motor coach for your transfer to Ghent. Ghent, Belgium, home to the famous painting, Adoration of the Mystic Lamb. The large and complex altarpiece was painted by Jan and Hubert Van Eyck in 1432 and, is currently housed in Ghentâs St. Bavo Cathedral, where we will later celebrate Mass. After Mass we will continue to Bruges, The Zeebrugge port of Bruges is an important center for European trade. The day will come to a close with dinner and a restful overnight.
tourDays.activities: Depart for Utrecht; Visit Catharijne Convent Museum (Katherineâs Convent Museum); Free time for lunch; Transfer to Ghent; Visit St. Bavo Cathedral and celebrate Mass; Transfer to Bruges for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Bruges
tourDays.description: Today following breakfast, we will visit the Church of Our Lady for Mass. You will notice the preserved culture of the Middle Ages that is still present. While at the Church, you will have the opportunity to view the magnificent marble statue, Madonna and her Child sculpted by Michelangelo. Next, we visit the Holy Saviorâs Cathedral, Bruges Cathedral. Continue with a visit to the Basilica of the Holy Blood. Most interestingly, this Basilica also holds a venerated relic of Jesus Christ that was collected by Joseph of Arimathea and brought from Jerusalem. Modeled on the Church of the Holy Sepulcher, it has a replica of Christâs tomb. This afternoon you will have free time to enjoy lunch and a stroll in this enchanting city. Return to your hotel on time to enjoy a delicious meal and a restful overnight.
tourDays.activities: Visit Church of Our Lady and celebrate Mass; View Michelangelo's marble statue Madonna and Child; Visit Holy Saviorâs Cathedral (Bruges Cathedral); Visit Basilica of the Holy Blood; Free time for lunch and stroll; Dinner and overnight in Bruges

tourDays.title: Bruges â Dinant - Beauraing - Banneux - Aachen
tourDays.description: Following breakfast, you will board the motor coach and head to Beaurin. We will make a stop in Dinant, a charming town located below steep limestone rocks and crowned by a mighty citadel to have lunch on your own. We will continue to visit the Shrine of Our Lady of Beauraing, also known as the Virgin of the Golden Heart. In 1932, the Blessed Mother appeared to a group of young children 33 times. She was described as being dressed in white with a golden crown on her head with hair of gold. Our Lady came to these children during the Great Depression and advised them to sacrifice themselves to Her. Next, we will continue to Banneux â Notre Dame, also known as, the Belgian Lourdes. Upon arrival, you will visit the Shrine of Our Lady of Banneux. In 1933, the Blessed Mother appeared to twelve-year-old Mariette Boco as the âVirgin of the Poor.â Our Lady appeared to little Mariette a few times and informed her that she (Our Lady) had come to relieve the suffering of the ill and the conflicts of all nations. At the end of the day we will continue to Aachen for dinner and an overnight stay.
tourDays.activities: Board motor coach and travel toward Dinant; Stop in Dinant for lunch on your own; Visit Shrine of Our Lady of Beauraing; Visit Shrine of Our Lady of Banneux (Banneux â Notre Dame); Continue to Aachen for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Aachen - Cologne - Aachen
tourDays.description: Today, you will enjoy a short sightseeing tour of the village of Aachen! We will attend Mass at the Aachen Cathedral, a Gothic Marian Shrine. The Church is the oldest in Germany and contains numerous treasures such as Jesusâ swaddling clothes, the Lordâs loincloth, the Blessed Virginâs Cloak, and the cloth used for St. John the Baptistâs head. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to venerate the miraculous 14th century statue of the Blessed Virgin. Later, you will depart for Cologne where you will enjoy another incredible sightseeing tour. Cologne was originally founded and established by the Romans in 50 A.D. When this city received relics of the Three Magi in 1194, it gained importance as a pilgrimage center. While in this city, you will have the opportunity to visit the magnificent Gothic Cathedral -the Kolner Dom â that houses the relics. Following this visit, you will learn about the two thousand years of history to which this Rhineland city is accompanied. In the Middle Ages, the city of Cologne served and flourished as one of the major trade routes between Eastern and Western Europe. The day will wrap up by returning to Aachen for a wonderful meal and a restful overnight.
tourDays.activities: Sightseeing tour of Aachen; Attend Mass at Aachen Cathedral; Venerate 14th century statue of the Blessed Virgin; Travel to Cologne and take a sightseeing tour; Visit Cologne Cathedral (KÃ¶lner Dom); Return to Aachen for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Aachen - Trier - Heidelberg
tourDays.description: After breakfast, will drive to Trier, the oldest city in Germany. It is situated in the Mosel wine region and was founded before the year 16 B.C. Trier is known for its well-preserved Roman and medieval buildings, all of which you will visit during your time in this ancient city. The Porta Nigra is the only one of four Roman gates that still stands and was formally the home to a hermit monk named Simeon. Additionally, the Roman amphitheater and baths were places of relaxation for the ancient monks. Lastly, the style and size of the Constantine Basilica (Aula Palatina) truly exemplifies the strength and power that the Roman Emperor had in ancient times. We will celebrate Mass at the Trier Cathedral, followed by free time for lunch. The day will continue with a visit to Trier Cathedral, which not only contains a remarkable collection of artwork but is also home to the Holy Robe that Our Lord Jesus Christ wore during the Crucifixion. Like the Shroud of Turin, it is very fragile and is only displayed every 10 â 15 years. Lastly, we will visit the Liebfrauenkirche, one of the first Gothic churches in Germany. It is located near the burial site of the Saint who replaced Judas Iscariot, St. Matthias. We will then proceed to Heidelberg for check-in followed by dinner and a restful overnight.
tourDays.activities: Drive to Trier; Visit Porta Nigra; Visit Roman amphitheater and baths; Visit Constantine Basilica (Aula Palatina); Celebrate Mass at Trier Cathedral; Free time for lunch; Visit Liebfrauenkirche; Proceed to Heidelberg for check-in, dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Heidelberg â Rothenburg ob der Tauber - Heidelberg
tourDays.description: Following breakfast at the hotel, we will start your day with a tour of Heidelberg. Visit the Old Town dominated by the ruins of Heidelberg Castle. See the marketplace with the Town Hall, the Church of the Holy Spirit located nearby, and have a walk on the main street. Admire the panoramic view of the city passing by the Old Bridge to the other banks of the river. We will celebrate Mass at the local church, followed by free time for lunch. Proceed to Rothenburg ob der Tauber. In Rothenburg, we will see picturesque lanes, half-timbered houses, and an intact fortification wall that will give you a good idea of what a medieval town looked like nearly 1000 years ago. Walk around the city on top of the wall to enjoy the stunning views over the old town. At the end of this full day, we will return to Heidelberg for dinner and an overnight.
tourDays.activities: Tour Heidelberg Old Town and Heidelberg Castle ruins; See marketplace, Town Hall and Church of the Holy Spirit; Walk Old Bridge and enjoy panoramic views; Celebrate Mass at local church; Free time for lunch; Proceed to Rothenburg ob der Tauber and walk city walls; Return to Heidelberg for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Heidelberg â Neuhausen am Rheinfall (Rhine Falls) â Muri Monastery - Lucerne
tourDays.description: This morning after breakfast we will depart for Neuhausen am Rheinfall for a boat trip where you will see the great spectacle of the Rhine Falls. After free time for lunch, we will transfer to the Benedictine monastery of Muri, one of the most significant cultural monuments in the Canton of Aargau. It was founded in 1027 by Ita of Lorraine and her husband, Count Radbot of Habsburg. See the Romanesque crypt, the Gothic raised choir, and the central octagon in Baroque style bear witness to the continuation of architectural alteration, renewal, and addition throughout the ages. Next, we will celebrate Mass at Muri Monastery. We will end the day by continuing to Lucerne for dinner and a restful overnight.
tourDays.activities: Depart for Neuhausen am Rheinfall; Boat trip at Rhine Falls; Free time for lunch; Transfer to Muri Monastery and see architectural features (Romanesque crypt, Gothic raised choir, central octagon); Celebrate Mass at Muri Monastery; Continue to Lucerne for dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Lucerne â Einsiedeln - Lucerne
tourDays.description: Today will begin with a guided tour of Lucerne. This central Switzerland city is known for its miraculous views of Mt. Pilatus and Rigi in the Swiss Alps. While in this breathtaking city, you will view from the outside the wooden Chapel Bridge that was first erected in the 14th century. This afternoon you will enjoy a scenic ride along Lake Lucerne and Lake Zug to Einsiedeln. Upon arrival, celebrate Mass at Einsiedeln Abbey. Visit the Benedictine Monastery of Einsiedeln dedicated to Our Lady of the Hermits. The abbey received this dedication due to its first inhabitant of the region around the year 850 A.D., a monk named Meinrad (St. Meinrad). This evening, you will return to your hotel in Lucerne. Enjoy a Farewell dinner and overnight at the hotel in Lucerne.
tourDays.activities: Guided tour of Lucerne (view Chapel Bridge exterior); Scenic ride along Lake Lucerne and Lake Zug; Celebrate Mass at Einsiedeln Abbey; Visit Benedictine Monastery of Einsiedeln; Return to Lucerne for farewell dinner and overnight

tourDays.title: Istanbul sightseeing and embarkation
tourDays.description: The bejeweled capital of Istanbul, situated between two continents, is home to 450 mosques. You will visit the famous Blue Mosque with its six minarets and sparkling interior. Walk through St. Sophia (Hagia Sophia), which was the largest church in Christendom for 1,000 years, built by Justinian (532-537 AD). The church has 107 columns, fossil-embedded white marble floors, and beautiful glass mosaics. Today, it is the Museum of Byzantine Art. Enjoy the aroma of cinnamon, cloves, thyme, and other exotic spices as you explore the Grand Bazaar. Over 4,000 shops sell everything from herbs to gold. In the afternoon, embark on the Azamara Onward cruise ship.
tourDays.activities: Visit the Blue Mosque; Walk through St. Sophia (Hagia Sophia); Explore the Grand Bazaar; Embark Azamara Onward (afternoon)

tourDays.title: Visit Philippi / Thessaloniki area
tourDays.description: Visit Philippi, where Paul, intending to find a place to pray by the riverside, spoke to women who had gathered there, among whom was Lydia, the seller of purple, whose heart the Lord opened to hear the words that he spoke. Lydia was the first Christian to be baptized on European soil. Visit the site where this event is commemorated and see a crypt dating back to the Roman period, which is believed to have served as a prison for the Apostle Paul. See the famous agora, the basilica, and the theater.
tourDays.activities: Visit Philippi; See commemorative site of Lydia's baptism; View Roman-period crypt; See agora, basilica, and theater

tourDays.title: Meteora monasteries (from Volos)
tourDays.description: Journey today through the rock forests of Meteora in the western Thessaly province and marvel at the rugged terrain that Paul walked in during his missionary treks. Here, monasteries were built by monks seeking refuge from persecution and the world. Beginning in the 14th century, the monks initially resided in caves, but eventually moved to higher ground and built wooden structures that were later replaced by the stone monasteries we see today. We will visit one or more of these monasteries. Lunch is on your own today.
tourDays.activities: Travel to Meteora; Visit one or more monasteries in Meteora; Observe rock formations and historic monastic sites; Lunch on your own

tourDays.title: Patmos: Monastery of St. John and Grotto of the Apocalypse
tourDays.description: Visit the Monastery of St. John, high on the mountain overlooking the entire island. Walk down to the Grotto of the Apocalypse and the caves where it is believed that the exiled Apostle Paul John lived and was inspired by God to write the Book of Revelation, as well as other letters to the early church.
tourDays.activities: Visit the Monastery of St. John; Walk to the Grotto of the Apocalypse; Visit caves associated with the Apostle John

tourDays.title: Mykonos â explore on your own or optional excursions
tourDays.description: Arrive today at the world-famous Greek island of Mykonos, where gleaming whitewashed buildings seem to climb atop each other to reach the azure sky. Admire its many hills dotted with iconic windmills. Explore the island on your own or join one of the optional excursions available for purchase on board. Shore excursions are not included today and can be purchased directly from Azamara.
tourDays.activities: Arrive in Mykonos; Admire windmills and whitewashed buildings; Explore on your own or join optional (purchased) excursions

tourDays.title: Monemvasia (The Rock)
tourDays.description: One look at Monemvasia as you pull in to port, and itâs easy to understand why locals nicknamed it The Rock. Shrouded by precipitous cliffs along the brilliant teal waters of the Myrtoan Sea, Monemvasia is a castle town suspended in history. Shore excursions are not included today and can be purchased directly from Azamara.
tourDays.activities: Arrive in Monemvasia; Sightsee the castle town and cliffs

tourDays.title: Disembark, Athens sightseeing and Corinth
tourDays.description: Disembark Azamara Onward this morning. Discover the rich architectural splendor of the ancient city of Athens as you explore the world-renowned Acropolis, the Propylaea, the Parthenon, and the Erechtheum. Stand on Mars Hill as the Apostle Paul did when he proclaimed, "I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.â Also, view the House of Parliament, the Presidential Palace, and the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. This afternoon, tour the city of Corinth, where the Apostle Paul met fellow tentmakers Aquila and Priscilla and received a vision from the Lord saying, "I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.â As Paul spoke, Crispus (chief ruler of the synagogue) and many others believed and were baptized, establishing the church at Corinth to whom Paul later wrote his two epistles. Discover the archaeological museum, marketplace, and temples. As you walk among the ruins, stand on the Bema, where the Apostle Paul stood before Gallio to face charges brought against him by the Jews.
tourDays.activities: Disembark Azamara Onward; Explore the Acropolis, Propylaea, Parthenon, and Erechtheum; Stand on Mars Hill; View House of Parliament, Presidential Palace, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier; Tour Corinth: archaeological museum, marketplace, temples; Visit the Bema at Corinth
